// ===== C:\Users\Lian Andrew\Desktop\RTU_Tindahan_Capstone\RTU_Tindahan_Final\RTU_Tindahan\frontend\src\common\api\client.ts =====
/**
 * API CLIENT
 * ---------------------------------------------------------------
 * One small wrapper around fetch() for talking to the Django backend.
 * - Base address comes from VITE_API_BASE_URL (see frontend/.env.example).
 * - The login token is stored in the browser and sent as
 *   "Authorization: Token <key>" (what Django REST Framework expects).
 * Nothing here changes the backend; it only calls the endpoints that exist.
 */

const BASE_URL = (import.meta.env.VITE_API_BASE_URL as string | undefined) ?? 'http://localhost:8000/api/v1'
const TOKEN_KEY = 'rtu_token'

export function getToken(): string | null {
  try {
    return localStorage.getItem(TOKEN_KEY)
  } catch {
    return null
  }
}

export function setToken(token: string | null) {
  try {
    if (token) localStorage.setItem(TOKEN_KEY, token)
    else localStorage.removeItem(TOKEN_KEY)
  } catch {
    /* ignore storage problems */
  }
}

/** Thrown for any failed request. `message` is safe to show to the user. */
export class ApiRequestError extends Error {
  status: number
  /** Machine code from the backend, e.g. "email_not_verified". */
  code?: string
  constructor(message: string, status: number, code?: string) {
    super(message)
    this.name = 'ApiRequestError'
    this.status = status
    this.code = code
  }
}

/** Turns Django's error JSON ({detail} or {field: [msgs]}) into one sentence. */
function messageFrom(data: unknown, fallback: string): string {
  if (data && typeof data === 'object') {
    const obj = data as Record<string, unknown>
    if (typeof obj.detail === 'string') return obj.detail
    if (Array.isArray(obj.detail) && typeof obj.detail[0] === 'string') return obj.detail[0]
    for (const value of Object.values(obj)) {
      if (Array.isArray(value) && typeof value[0] === 'string') return value[0]
      if (typeof value === 'string') return value
    }
  }
  return fallback
}

interface RequestOptions {
  method?: 'GET' | 'POST' | 'PATCH' | 'DELETE'
  body?: unknown
}

export async function apiFetch<T>(path: string, options: RequestOptions = {}): Promise<T> {
  const headers: Record<string, string> = { Accept: 'application/json' }
  if (options.body !== undefined) headers['Content-Type'] = 'application/json'
  const token = getToken()
  if (token) headers.Authorization = `Token ${token}`

  let response: Response
  try {
    response = await fetch(`${BASE_URL}${path}`, {
      method: options.method ?? 'GET',
      headers,
      body: options.body !== undefined ? JSON.stringify(options.body) : undefined,
    })
  } catch {
    throw new ApiRequestError('Cannot reach the server. Check your connection and try again.', 0)
  }

  if (response.status === 204) return undefined as T

  let data: unknown = null
  try {
    data = await response.json()
  } catch {
    /* empty or non-JSON body */
  }

  if (!response.ok) {
    const code =
      data && typeof data === 'object' && typeof (data as { code?: unknown }).code === 'string'
        ? ((data as { code: string }).code)
        : undefined
    throw new ApiRequestError(messageFrom(data, 'Something went wrong. Please try again.'), response.status, code)
  }
  return data as T
}

// ===== C:\Users\Lian Andrew\Desktop\RTU_Tindahan_Capstone\RTU_Tindahan_Final\RTU_Tindahan\frontend\src\common\components\BrandLoader\BrandLoader.tsx =====
import React, { useEffect, useLayoutEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import gsap from "gsap";
import "./BrandLoader.css";

/**
 * TUNING CONFIG â€” Adjust all BrandLoader timings from this single object.
 * All durations are in seconds; thresholds are in milliseconds.
 */
export const LOADER_TIMING = {
  // Anti-flicker & readiness thresholds (ms)
  antiFlickerDelayMs: 150, // Never show if ready faster than this
  slowLoadThresholdMs: 8000, // Show "Taking longer than usual..." + Retry

  // Full intro build (~2.0s total)
  full: {
    tindahanDuration: 0.55,
    taglineLinesDuration: 0.45,
    tileDropDuration: 0.32,
    tileStagger: 0.035, // ~40ms stagger across 17 tiles
    tilesOverlap: "-=0.25", // Slight overlap with step 1
    letterDropDuration: 0.35,
    letterStagger: 0.11,
    cursorPopDuration: 0.2,
    cursorClickDuration: 0.15,
    tagSwingDuration: 0.45,
    exitDuration: 0.45,
  },

  // Compact variant (~0.9s build, ~0.3s exit) for repeat loads in same session
  compact: {
    timeScale: 2.2,
    exitDuration: 0.3,
  },

  // Fast-forward multiplier when app becomes ready mid-build (legacy fallback)
  fastForwardTimeScale: 3.5,

  // Adaptive exit durations based on actual load speed (seconds)
  adaptiveExitFast: 0.24,   // < 400ms load
  adaptiveExitNormal: 0.32, // 400â€“1200ms load
  adaptiveExitSlow: 0.42,   // > 1200ms load

  // Calm idle shine sweep interval (seconds)
  idleShineDuration: 0.75,
  idleShineRepeatDelay: 1.6,

  // Reduced-motion fade duration (seconds)
  reducedMotionFade: 0.2,
} as const;

const SESSION_KEY = "rtu_tindahan_intro_seen";

// 17 awning tiles sampled left-to-right from the RTU Tindahan logo
const AWNING_COLORS = [
  "#ffbd59", "#c25959", "#ffffff",
  "#ffbd59", "#c25959", "#ffffff",
  "#ffbd59", "#c25959", "#ffffff",
  "#ffbd59", "#c25959", "#ffffff",
  "#ffbd59", "#c25959", "#ffffff",
  "#ffbd59", "#c25959",
] as const;

export type BrandLoaderVariant = "full" | "compact" | "auto";

export interface BrandLoaderProps {
  /** True when the app/page data is still loading */
  isLoading: boolean;
  /** "auto" plays full on first session visit, compact on subsequent boots */
  variant?: BrandLoaderVariant;
  /** Optional retry callback for the 8s slow-load fallback */
  onRetry?: () => void;
  /** Called after the exit animation finishes and the loader unmounts */
  onExited?: () => void;
  /** GSAP timeScale multiplier for build & exit (1 = normal, 2 = 2x faster, etc.) */
  timeScale?: number;
  /** Bypass the 150ms anti-flicker delay and show immediately (e.g. login flow) */
  immediate?: boolean;
}

function markIntroSeen(): void {
  try {
    window.sessionStorage.setItem(SESSION_KEY, "1");
  } catch {
    // Ignore storage errors in restricted/private contexts
  }
}

export const BrandLoader: React.FC<BrandLoaderProps> = ({
  isLoading,
  variant = "auto",
  onRetry,
  onExited,
  timeScale = 1,
  immediate = false,
}) => {
  const [shouldRender, setShouldRender] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [isExiting, setIsExiting] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [isSlowLoad, setIsSlowLoad] = useState<boolean>(false);

  const overlayRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement | null>(null);
  const stageRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement | null>(null);
  const buildTlRef = useRef<gsap.core.Timeline | null>(null);
  const idleTlRef = useRef<gsap.core.Timeline | null>(null);
  const buildCompletedRef = useRef<boolean>(false);
  const exitStartedRef = useRef<boolean>(false);
  const isLoadingRef = useRef<boolean>(isLoading);
  /** Recorded the moment shouldRender becomes true â€” used to compute elapsed load time. */
  const loadStartMsRef = useRef<number>(0);
  /** True on the very first render. On initial mount with isLoading=true we skip
   * the anti-flicker delay so the brand loader always shows on a fresh page load. */
  const initialMountRef = useRef(true);
  /** Prop refs â€” updated via effects so the build effect (which depends only on
   * shouldRender) always reads the latest props without re-running. */
  const variantRef = useRef<BrandLoaderVariant>(variant);
  const onExitedRef = useRef<(() => void) | undefined>(onExited);
  const timeScaleRef = useRef<number>(timeScale);
  /** Adaptive exit duration in seconds, set by accelerateToFinish(). */
  const adaptiveExitSecRef = useRef<number>(0.32);

  useEffect(() => {
    isLoadingRef.current = isLoading;
  }, [isLoading]);

  // Keep prop refs in sync so the build effect (which depends only on shouldRender)
  // always reads the latest props without re-running.
  useEffect(() => {
    variantRef.current = variant;
  }, [variant]);
  useEffect(() => {
    onExitedRef.current = onExited;
  }, [onExited]);
  useEffect(() => {
    timeScaleRef.current = timeScale;
  }, [timeScale]);

  // 1. Anti-flicker gate: don't mount overlay if loading finishes in < 150ms.
  // On initial mount with isLoading=true we show immediately â€” a full page reload
  // should always play the brand intro. When `immediate` is true (login flow) we
  // also bypass the delay so fast logins don't delay or skip the animation.
  // Subsequent loading states (route changes, data refetches) still get the
  // 150ms debounce to avoid flicker.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isLoading) return;
    if (shouldRender) return;

    if (initialMountRef.current || immediate) {
      loadStartMsRef.current = Date.now();
      setShouldRender(true);
      initialMountRef.current = false;
      return;
    }

    const timer = window.setTimeout(() => {
      if (isLoadingRef.current) {
        setShouldRender(true);
      }
    }, LOADER_TIMING.antiFlickerDelayMs);

    return () => window.clearTimeout(timer);
  }, [isLoading, shouldRender, immediate]);

  // 2. Slow-load timer (8s)
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!shouldRender || !isLoading) {
      setIsSlowLoad(false);
      return;
    }

    const slowTimer = window.setTimeout(() => {
      if (isLoadingRef.current) {
        setIsSlowLoad(true);
      }
    }, LOADER_TIMING.slowLoadThresholdMs);

    return () => window.clearTimeout(slowTimer);
  }, [shouldRender, isLoading]);

  // 3. Scroll lock + aria-busy on #root while visible
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!shouldRender) return;

    const rootEl = document.getElementById("root");
    document.body.style.overflow = "hidden";
    rootEl?.setAttribute("aria-busy", "true");

    return () => {
      // Clear overflow so CSS (and the app's normal scrolling) takes over.
      document.body.style.removeProperty("overflow");
      rootEl?.removeAttribute("aria-busy");
      // Always clear the inline navy background so the app's CSS background
      // (var(--bg)) shows through even if the exit animation never ran.
      document.body.style.removeProperty("background-color");
      document.body.style.removeProperty("margin");
      document.body.style.removeProperty("height");
    };
  }, [shouldRender]);

  // 7. Safety net: if the loader stays visible for more than 10 seconds
  //    (e.g. auth/restore or listings fetch is hung), force the exit so the
  //    user is never trapped behind a blank navy overlay.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!shouldRender || !isLoading) return;
    const safetyTimer = window.setTimeout(() => {
      runExit(0.2);
    }, 10000);
    return () => window.clearTimeout(safetyTimer);
  }, [shouldRender, isLoading]);

  // 4. Trigger exit animation helper
  const runExit = (adaptiveExitDuration?: number) => {
    if (exitStartedRef.current || !overlayRef.current || !stageRef.current) return;
    exitStartedRef.current = true;
    setIsExiting(true);
    idleTlRef.current?.kill();
    markIntroSeen();

    // Clear <body> inline navy styles immediately so the app's normal
    // background (var(--bg)) is already visible when the overlay fades out.
    // Doing this at the start of exit (not at onComplete) prevents a flash
    // of navy between the overlay disappearing and the styles clearing.
    const bodyEl = document.body;
    bodyEl.style.removeProperty("background-color");
    bodyEl.style.removeProperty("margin");
    bodyEl.style.removeProperty("height");
    bodyEl.style.removeProperty("overflow");

    const prefersReduced = window.matchMedia(
      "(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)"
    ).matches;

    let exitDuration: number;
    if (prefersReduced) {
      exitDuration = LOADER_TIMING.reducedMotionFade;
    } else if (adaptiveExitDuration !== undefined) {
      exitDuration = adaptiveExitDuration;
    } else {
      exitDuration = adaptiveExitSecRef.current || 0.32;
    }

    const tl = gsap.timeline({
      onComplete: () => {
        setShouldRender(false);
        setIsExiting(false);
        exitStartedRef.current = false;
        buildCompletedRef.current = false;
        onExited?.();
      },
    });

    if (prefersReduced) {
      tl.to(overlayRef.current, { opacity: 0, duration: exitDuration, ease: "power1.out" });
    } else {
      tl.to(stageRef.current, {
        y: -24,
        scale: 1.05,
        opacity: 0,
        duration: exitDuration * 0.8,
        ease: "power2.in",
      }).to(
        overlayRef.current,
        {
          opacity: 0,
          duration: exitDuration * 0.75,
          ease: "power2.out",
        },
        `-=${exitDuration * 0.45}`
      );
    }
  };

  // 5. GSAP Build & Idle Timeline (StrictMode-safe via gsap.context)
  //    Depends ONLY on [shouldRender] so prop changes (variant/timeScale/onExited)
  //    when isSigningIn flips never trigger ctx.revert() or kill the running timeline.
  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    if (!shouldRender || !overlayRef.current) return;

    // Resolve variant once for this run â€” never re-resolve on prop changes.
    const currentVariant =
      variantRef.current !== "auto"
        ? variantRef.current
        : (() => {
            try {
              return window.sessionStorage.getItem(SESSION_KEY)
                ? "compact"
                : "full";
            } catch {
              return "full";
            }
          })();
    const currentTimeScale = timeScaleRef.current;

    const prefersReduced = window.matchMedia(
      "(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)"
    ).matches;

    const ctx = gsap.context(() => {
      if (prefersReduced) {
        // Reduced motion: show all elements statically, then fade the overlay in
        gsap.set([
          ".bl-tindahan",
          ".bl-tagline-text",
          ".bl-tagline-line-left",
          ".bl-tagline-line-right",
          ".bl-tile",
          ".bl-letter",
          ".bl-cursor",
          ".bl-tag-group",
          ".bl-shine",
        ], { opacity: 1, scaleX: 1, y: 0, x: 0, skewX: 0, rotation: 0, scale: 1, transformOrigin: "center center" });
        gsap.fromTo(
          overlayRef.current,
          { opacity: 0 },
          {
            opacity: 1,
            duration: LOADER_TIMING.reducedMotionFade,
            onComplete: () => {
              buildCompletedRef.current = true;
              if (!isLoadingRef.current) {
                runExit(adaptiveExitSecRef.current);
              }
            },
          }
        );
        return;
      }

      const cfg = LOADER_TIMING.full;

      // Initial hidden states (transform & opacity only)
      gsap.set(".bl-tindahan", { x: -70, skewX: -12, opacity: 0 });
      gsap.set(".bl-tagline-text", { opacity: 0, scale: 0.94, transformOrigin: "center center" });
      gsap.set(".bl-tagline-line-left", { scaleX: 0, transformOrigin: "right center" });
      gsap.set(".bl-tagline-line-right", { scaleX: 0, transformOrigin: "left center" });
      gsap.set(".bl-tile", { y: -32, scaleY: 0.75, opacity: 0, transformOrigin: "center bottom" });
      gsap.set(".bl-awning-group", { transformOrigin: "center bottom" });
      gsap.set(".bl-letter", { y: -70, opacity: 0, transformOrigin: "center bottom" });
      gsap.set(".bl-cursor", { scale: 0, opacity: 0, transformOrigin: "20% 20%" });
      gsap.set(".bl-tag-group", { rotation: -28, opacity: 0, transformOrigin: "100% 0%" });
      gsap.set(".bl-shine", { x: -460, opacity: 0 });

      const tl = gsap.timeline({
        onComplete: () => {
          buildCompletedRef.current = true;
          if (!isLoadingRef.current) {
            runExit(adaptiveExitSecRef.current);
          } else {
            // Calm idle state: soft shine sweep across the awning every ~1.6s
            idleTlRef.current = gsap
              .timeline({ repeat: -1, repeatDelay: LOADER_TIMING.idleShineRepeatDelay })
              .fromTo(
                ".bl-shine",
                { x: -460, opacity: 0 },
                {
                  x: 520,
                  opacity: 0.45,
                  duration: LOADER_TIMING.idleShineDuration,
                  ease: "power1.inOut",
                }
              )
              .to(".bl-shine", { opacity: 0, duration: 0.15 }, "-=0.15");
          }
        },
      });

      // STEP 1: TINDAHAN rushes in + tagline lines draw outward from center
      tl.to(".bl-tindahan", {
        x: 0,
        skewX: 0,
        opacity: 1,
        duration: cfg.tindahanDuration,
        ease: "power3.out",
      })
        .to(
          ".bl-tagline-text",
          { opacity: 1, scale: 1, duration: 0.3, ease: "power2.out" },
          `-=${cfg.tindahanDuration * 0.5}`
        )
        .to(
          [".bl-tagline-line-left", ".bl-tagline-line-right"],
          { scaleX: 1, opacity: 1, duration: cfg.taglineLinesDuration, ease: "power2.out" },
          `-=${cfg.tindahanDuration * 0.45}`
        );

      // STEP 2: 17 Awning tiles drop left-to-right with overshoot + squash
      tl.to(
        ".bl-tile",
        {
          y: 0,
          scaleY: 1,
          opacity: 1,
          duration: cfg.tileDropDuration,
          stagger: cfg.tileStagger,
          ease: "back.out(1.6)",
        },
        cfg.tilesOverlap
      ).to(
        ".bl-tag-group",
        {
          rotation: 0,
          opacity: 1,
          duration: cfg.tagSwingDuration,
          ease: "elastic.out(1, 0.45)",
        },
        "-=0.35"
      );

      // STEP 3: R drops first, lands on awning with bounce
      tl.to(".bl-letter-r", {
        y: 0,
        opacity: 1,
        duration: cfg.letterDropDuration,
        ease: "bounce.out",
      }, "+=0.1")
        .to(".bl-awning-group", {
          scaleY: 0.94,
          duration: 0.07,
          yoyo: true,
          repeat: 1,
          ease: "power1.inOut",
        }, "-=0.15")
        // T drops right after R lands
        .to(".bl-letter-t", {
          y: 0,
          opacity: 1,
          duration: cfg.letterDropDuration,
          ease: "bounce.out",
        }, "-=0.22")
        .to(".bl-awning-group", {
          scaleY: 0.94,
          duration: 0.07,
          yoyo: true,
          repeat: 1,
          ease: "power1.inOut",
        }, "-=0.15")
        // U drops right after T lands
        .to(".bl-letter-u", {
          y: 0,
          opacity: 1,
          duration: cfg.letterDropDuration,
          ease: "bounce.out",
        }, "-=0.22")
        .to(".bl-awning-group", {
          scaleY: 0.94,
          duration: 0.07,
          yoyo: true,
          repeat: 1,
          ease: "power1.inOut",
        }, "-=0.15");

      // STEP 4: Cursor arrow pops in and performs a single "click" press
      tl.to(
        ".bl-cursor",
        {
          scale: 1,
          opacity: 1,
          duration: cfg.cursorPopDuration,
          ease: "back.out(2)",
        },
        "-=0.1"
      ).to(".bl-cursor", {
        scale: 0.84,
        duration: cfg.cursorClickDuration * 0.5,
        yoyo: true,
        repeat: 1,
        ease: "power2.inOut",
      });

      // Network-aware starting speed: slow networks play slower, fast networks play at normal/compact speed
      const effType = (navigator as any).connection?.effectiveType;
      const isSlowNetwork =
        effType === "slow-2g" || effType === "2g" || effType === "3g";
      let startTimeScale: number;
      if (isSlowNetwork) {
        startTimeScale = 0.75;
      } else if (currentVariant === "compact") {
        startTimeScale = LOADER_TIMING.compact.timeScale;
      } else if (currentTimeScale && currentTimeScale !== 1) {
        startTimeScale = currentTimeScale;
      } else {
        startTimeScale = 1.0;
      }
      tl.timeScale(startTimeScale);

      buildTlRef.current = tl;
    }, overlayRef);

    return () => {
      buildTlRef.current = null;
      idleTlRef.current = null;
      ctx.revert();
    };
  }, [shouldRender]);

  // Accelerate the build timeline to finish in targetSec seconds,
  // computed from remaining time and actual load elapsed time.
  const accelerateToFinish = (tl: gsap.core.Timeline) => {
    const remaining = Math.max(0.05, tl.duration() - tl.time());
    const elapsed = Date.now() - loadStartMsRef.current;
    // Fast load finishes remaining steps briskly (~0.42s); slower load eases out (~0.58s)
    const targetSec = elapsed < 400 ? 0.42 : elapsed < 1200 ? 0.50 : 0.58;
    const neededScale = Math.max(1.5, Math.min(6.0, remaining / targetSec));
    adaptiveExitSecRef.current = elapsed < 400 ? 0.24 : elapsed < 1200 ? 0.32 : 0.40;
    gsap.killTweensOf(tl);
    gsap.to(tl, {
      timeScale: neededScale,
      duration: 0.12,
      ease: "power2.out",
      overwrite: true,
    });
  };

  // 6. Bidirectional adaptive speed:
  //    - While loading drags on, smoothly decelerate the build (calm, never frozen)
  //    - When loading finishes, fast-forward proportionally to how fast it actually was
  //    - Safety: if the build timeline is null (e.g. context was recreated), force
  //      the exit so the overlay never traps the app under a blank navy screen.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!shouldRender) return;

    // ----- Still loading: schedule real-time slowdown -----
    if (isLoading) {
      if (loadStartMsRef.current === 0) {
        loadStartMsRef.current = Date.now();
      }

      const timer1 = window.setTimeout(() => {
        if (
          isLoadingRef.current &&
          buildTlRef.current &&
          !buildCompletedRef.current
        ) {
          gsap.to(buildTlRef.current, {
            timeScale: 0.55,
            duration: 0.5,
            ease: "power2.out",
            overwrite: true,
          });
        }
      }, 500);

      const timer2 = window.setTimeout(() => {
        if (
          isLoadingRef.current &&
          buildTlRef.current &&
          !buildCompletedRef.current
        ) {
          gsap.to(buildTlRef.current, {
            timeScale: 0.35,
            duration: 0.6,
            ease: "power2.out",
            overwrite: true,
          });
        }
      }, 1400);

      return () => {
        window.clearTimeout(timer1);
        window.clearTimeout(timer2);
      };
    }

    // ----- Loading finished: fast-forward adaptively -----
    if (!isLoading) {
      const elapsedMs = Date.now() - loadStartMsRef.current;
      adaptiveExitSecRef.current =
        elapsedMs < 400 ? 0.24 : elapsedMs < 1200 ? 0.32 : 0.40;

      if (buildCompletedRef.current) {
        runExit(adaptiveExitSecRef.current);
      } else if (buildTlRef.current) {
        accelerateToFinish(buildTlRef.current);
      } else {
        // No timeline exists â€” force the exit immediately so we never
        // leave the user staring at a blank navy overlay.
        runExit(adaptiveExitSecRef.current);
      }
    }
  }, [isLoading, shouldRender]);

  if (!shouldRender) return null;

  return (
    <div
      ref={overlayRef}
      className={`brand-loader-overlay${isExiting ? " brand-loader-overlay--exiting" : ""}`}
      role="status"
      aria-live="polite"
    >
      <span className="bl-sr-only">Loading RTU Tindahan</span>

      <div ref={stageRef} className="brand-loader-stage">
        <svg
          className="brand-loader-svg"
          viewBox="0 0 600 340"
          fill="none"
          xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
          aria-hidden="true"
        >
          <defs>
            {/* Clip path for the idle shine sweep across the 17-tile awning */}
            <clipPath id="bl-awning-clip">
              <rect x="82" y="166" width="436" height="46" rx="8" />
            </clipPath>
            <linearGradient id="bl-shine-grad" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="0%">
              <stop offset="0%" stopColor="#ffffff" stopOpacity="0" />
              <stop offset="50%" stopColor="#ffffff" stopOpacity="0.65" />
              <stop offset="100%" stopColor="#ffffff" stopOpacity="0" />
            </linearGradient>
          </defs>

          {/* LAYER 1: R, T, U Letters (sit directly on top of the awning) */}
          <g className="bl-letters-group">
            {/* R */}
            <g className="bl-letter bl-letter-r">
              <path
                d="M126 170V54C126 48.5 130.5 44 136 44H188C214 44 231 59 231 83C231 101 221 114 205 119L232 170H197L174 124H158V170H126ZM158 98H184C194 98 200 92 200 83C200 74 194 69 184 69H158V98Z"
                fill="#ffffff"
              />
            </g>
            {/* T */}
            <g className="bl-letter bl-letter-t">
              <path
                d="M258 44H352C357.5 44 362 48.5 362 54V66C362 71.5 357.5 76 352 76H322V170H288V76H258C252.5 76 248 71.5 248 66V54C248 48.5 252.5 44 258 44Z"
                fill="#ffffff"
              />
            </g>
            {/* U */}
            <g className="bl-letter bl-letter-u">
              <path
                d="M388 44H412C417.5 44 422 48.5 422 54V124C422 138 431 146 444 146C457 146 466 138 466 124V54C466 48.5 470.5 44 476 44H500C505.5 44 510 48.5 510 54V126C510 156 484 174 444 174C404 174 378 156 378 126V54C378 48.5 382.5 44 388 44Z"
                fill="#ffffff"
              />
            </g>
          </g>

          {/* LAYER 2: Cursor Arrow overlapping the T */}
          <g className="bl-cursor">
            <path
              d="M306 116L348 134L332 141L344 156L334 164L322 149L315 163L306 116Z"
              fill="#ffbd59"
            />
          </g>

          {/* LAYER 3: 17-Tile Awning + Idle Shine Sweep */}
          <g className="bl-awning-group">
            {AWNING_COLORS.map((color, i) => {
              const x = 86 + i * 25.2;
              const skew = (i - 8) * 1.1; // Subtle outward perspective fan
              return (
                <path
                  key={i}
                  className="bl-tile"
                  d={`M${x + skew * 0.4} 168 H${x + 25.2 + skew * 0.4} L${x + 25.2 + skew} 196 A12.6 12.6 0 0 1 ${x + skew} 196 Z`}
                  fill={color}
                />
              );
            })}

            {/* Idle Shine Overlay */}
            <g clipPath="url(#bl-awning-clip)">
              <rect
                className="bl-shine"
                x="80"
                y="160"
                width="90"
                height="60"
                fill="url(#bl-shine-grad)"
                transform="skewX(-20)"
              />
            </g>
          </g>

          {/* LAYER 4: Price Tag + String (left side) */}
          <g className="bl-tag-group">
            <path
              d="M90 198 C78 214, 108 232, 96 254 C90 264, 80 266, 76 266"
              stroke="#ffffff"
              strokeWidth="2.2"
              strokeLinecap="round"
              fill="none"
            />
            <path
              d="M78 265 L98 294"
              stroke="#ffffff"
              strokeWidth="2"
              strokeLinecap="round"
            />
            <g transform="translate(46, 252) rotate(-18)">
              <path
                d="M6 0 H30 L42 13 L30 26 H6 A6 6 0 0 1 0 20 V6 A6 6 0 0 1 6 0 Z"
                fill="#c25959"
              />
              <circle cx="31" cy="13" r="3.2" fill="#1a2f57" stroke="#ffffff" strokeWidth="1.5" />

          </g>

          {/* LAYER 5: TINDAHAN Wordmark */}
          <g className="bl-tindahan">
            <text
              x="300"
              y="264"
              textAnchor="middle"
              fill="#ffbd59"
              fontFamily="system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif"
              fontWeight="900"

            >
              TINDAHAN
            </text>
          </g>

          {/* LAYER 6: CAMPUS MARKETPLACE + Side Lines */}
          <g className="bl-tagline-group">
            <line
              className="bl-tagline-line bl-tagline-line-left"
              x1="88"
              y1="296"
              x2="164"
              y2="296"
              stroke="#ffbd59"
              strokeWidth="3"
              strokeLinecap="round"
            />
            <text
              className="bl-tagline-text"
              x="300"
              y="301"
              textAnchor="middle"
              fill="#ffffff"
              fontFamily="system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif"
              fontWeight="700"
              fontSize="16"
              letterSpacing="3.5"

              CAMPUS MARKETPLACE
            </text>
            <line
              className="bl-tagline-line bl-tagline-line-right"
              x1="436"

              y2="296"
              stroke="#ffbd59"
              strokeWidth="3"
              strokeLinecap="round"
            />
          </g>
        </svg>
      </div>

      {isSlowLoad && (
        <div className="brand-loader-slow">
          <span>Taking longer than usualâ€¦</span>
          <button
            type="button"
            className="brand-loader-retry"
            onClick={() => (onRetry ? onRetry() : window.location.reload())}
          >
            Retry
          </button>
        </div>
      )}

  );
};

import React, { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import "./BrandLoader.css";

const MINI_TILES = ["gold", "red", "white", "gold", "red"] as const;

export interface MiniLoaderProps {
  /** Controls whether loading is active (built-in 200ms delay & 400ms min duration) */
  isLoading?: boolean;
  /** "inline" for buttons, "section" for page/card content areas */
  variant?: "inline" | "section";
  size?: "sm" | "md" | "lg";
  label?: string;
  className?: string;
}

export const MiniLoader: React.FC<MiniLoaderProps> = ({
  isLoading = true,
  variant = "inline",
  size = "md",
  label,
  className = "",
}) => {
  // Inline button spinners show immediately; section loaders use 200ms anti-flicker delay
  const [visible, setVisible] = useState<boolean>(variant === "inline" && isLoading);
  const shownAtRef = useRef<number>(variant === "inline" && isLoading ? Date.now() : 0);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (variant === "inline") {
      setVisible(isLoading);
      return;
    }

    if (isLoading) {
      const showTimer = window.setTimeout(() => {
        shownAtRef.current = Date.now();
        setVisible(true);
      }, 200);
      return () => window.clearTimeout(showTimer);
    }

    if (visible) {
      const elapsed = Date.now() - shownAtRef.current;
      const remaining = Math.max(0, 400 - elapsed);
      const hideTimer = window.setTimeout(() => setVisible(false), remaining);
      return () => window.clearTimeout(hideTimer);
    }
  }, [isLoading, variant, visible]);

  if (!visible) return null;

  return (
    <span
      className={`mini-loader mini-loader--${variant} mini-loader--${size} ${className}`.trim()}
      role="status"
      aria-live="polite"
    >
      <span className="mini-loader-tiles" aria-hidden="true">
        {MINI_TILES.map((color, idx) => (
          <span
            key={idx}
            className={`mini-loader-tile mini-loader-tile--${color}`}
            style={{ animationDelay: `${idx * 90}ms` }}
          />
        ))}
      </span>
      {label ? (
        <span className="mini-loader-label">{label}</span>
      ) : (
        <span className="bl-sr-only">Loadingâ€¦</span>
      )}
    </span>
  );
};


// ===== C:\Users\Lian Andrew\Desktop\RTU_Tindahan_Capstone\RTU_Tindahan_Final\RTU_Tindahan\frontend\src\common\components\BrandLoader\useAppReady.ts =====
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";

interface UseAppReadyOptions {
  authLoading: boolean;
  isAuthenticated: boolean;
  listingsSettled: boolean;
  /** Safety timeout (ms) so a broken/slow catalogue request never traps the loader */
  listingsTimeoutMs?: number;
}

/**
 * First-load readiness rule:
 * 1. Auth session restore settled (/auth/me/)
 * 2. If signed in, first listings fetch settled OR 3s timeout elapsed
 * 3. Document fonts ready (or 1.5s fallback)
 */
export function useAppReady({
  authLoading,
  isAuthenticated,
  listingsSettled,
  listingsTimeoutMs = 3000,
}: UseAppReadyOptions): boolean {
  const [fontsReady, setFontsReady] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [listingsTimedOut, setListingsTimedOut] = useState<boolean>(false);

  // Wait for fonts with a safe fallback
  useEffect(() => {
    let active = true;
    const fallback = window.setTimeout(() => {
      if (active) setFontsReady(true);
    }, 1500);

    if (document.fonts && document.fonts.ready) {
      document.fonts.ready.then(() => {
        if (active) setFontsReady(true);
      });
    } else {
      setFontsReady(true);
    }

    return () => {
      active = false;
      window.clearTimeout(fallback);
    };
  }, []);

  // 3s safety timeout for the initial listings fetch when signed in
  useEffect(() => {
    if (authLoading || !isAuthenticated || listingsSettled) return;
    const timer = window.setTimeout(() => setListingsTimedOut(true), listingsTimeoutMs);
    return () => window.clearTimeout(timer);
  }, [authLoading, isAuthenticated, listingsSettled, listingsTimeoutMs]);

  const dataReady = !isAuthenticated || listingsSettled || listingsTimedOut;
  return !authLoading && dataReady && fontsReady;
}

import type { ButtonHTMLAttributes } from 'react'
import { MiniLoader } from '@/common/components/BrandLoader'

interface ButtonProps extends ButtonHTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement> {
  variant?: 'primary' | 'secondary' | 'outline' | 'ghost' | 'yellow'
  size?: 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg'
  isLoading?: boolean
}

/** Maps Button props to the project's existing CSS button classes (.btn, .btn.yellow, etc.) */
const variantClasses: Record<string, string> = {
  primary: 'btn',
  secondary: 'btn',
  outline: 'btn ghost',
  ghost: 'btn ghost',
  yellow: 'btn yellow',
}

const sizeClasses: Record<string, string> = {
  sm: 'btn sm',
  md: 'btn',
  lg: 'btn lg',
}

export function Button({
  children,
  className = '',
  variant = 'primary',
  size = 'md',
  isLoading = false,
  disabled,
  ...props
}: ButtonProps) {
  return (
    <button
      className={[
        variantClasses[variant],
        sizeClasses[size],
        isLoading || disabled ? 'opacity-60 cursor-not-allowed' : '',
        className,
      ].join(' ').trim()}
      disabled={disabled || isLoading}
      aria-busy={isLoading || undefined}
      {...props}
    >
      {isLoading ? (
        <MiniLoader variant="inline" size="sm" />
      ) : (
        children
      )}
    </button>
  )
}

// ===== C:\Users\Lian Andrew\Desktop\RTU_Tindahan_Capstone\RTU_Tindahan_Final\RTU_Tindahan\frontend\src\common\components\ErrorBoundary.tsx =====
/**
 * Root ErrorBoundary â€” catches any render/lifecycle error in the app tree
 * and shows it on screen instead of a blank navy #1a2f57 page.
 * Must be a class component (React only supports error boundaries in classes).
 */
import { Component, type ReactNode, type ErrorInfo, type ReactElement } from 'react'

export interface ErrorBoundaryProps {
  children: ReactNode
  fallback?: ReactElement
}

interface ErrorBoundaryState {
  hasError: boolean
  error: Error | null
  errorInfo: string | null
}

export class ErrorBoundary extends Component<ErrorBoundaryProps, ErrorBoundaryState> {
  state: ErrorBoundaryState = {
    hasError: false,
    error: null,
    errorInfo: null,
  }

  static getDerivedStateFromError(error: Error): ErrorBoundaryState {
    return { hasError: true, error, errorInfo: null }
  }

  componentDidCatch(error: Error, errorInfo: ErrorInfo) {
    this.setState({
      hasError: true,
      error,
      errorInfo: errorInfo.componentStack ?? null,
    })
  }

  render(): ReactNode {
    if (this.state.hasError) {
      if (this.props.fallback) return this.props.fallback
      return (
        <div
          style={{
            padding: 32,
            fontFamily: 'system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif',
            color: '#1a2f57',
            background: '#ffffff',
            minHeight: '100vh',
            display: 'flex',
            flexDirection: 'column',
            alignItems: 'center',
            justifyContent: 'center',
            gap: 16,
          }}
        >
          <h2 style={{ fontSize: 20, margin: 0 }}>RTU Tindahan encountered an error</h2>
          <p style={{ margin: 0, color: '#5f6f87', maxWidth: 420, textAlign: 'center' }}>
            {this.state.error?.message ?? 'Unknown error'}
          </p>
          {this.state.errorInfo && (
            <details
              style={{
                marginTop: 12,
                textAlign: 'left',
                width: 'min(90vw, 600px)',
                fontSize: 11,
                fontFamily: 'monospace',
                color: '#c0392b',
              }}
            >
              <summary style={{ cursor: 'pointer', marginBottom: 6 }}>Show stack trace</summary>
              <pre style={{ whiteSpace: 'pre-wrap', margin: 0 }}>{this.state.errorInfo}</pre>
            </details>
          )}
          <div style={{ marginTop: 20, display: 'flex', gap: 10 }}>
            <button
              onClick={() => {
                this.setState({ hasError: false, error: null, errorInfo: null })
                window.location.reload()
              }}
              style={{
                padding: '8px 16px',
                background: '#1a2f57',
                color: '#ffffff',
                border: 'none',
                borderRadius: 6,
                cursor: 'pointer',
                fontWeight: 600,
              }}
            >
              Reload
            </button>
            <button
              onClick={() => {
                try {
                  localStorage.clear()
                  sessionStorage.clear()
                } catch {
                  /* ignore storage errors */
                }
                window.location.reload()
              }}
              style={{
                padding: '8px 16px',
                background: '#f2f5f9',
                color: '#1a2f57',
                border: '1px solid #dde4ee',
                borderRadius: 6,
                cursor: 'pointer',
                fontWeight: 600,
              }}
            >
              Clear local cache & reload
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      )
    }
    return this.props.children
  }
}

import type { CSSProperties } from 'react'
import { ICON_PATHS, type IconName } from './icons'
import './Icon.css'

interface IconProps {
  name: IconName
  /** 'sm' = 14px, 'md' = 18px, or a pixel number (e.g. 16, 24). */
  size?: 'sm' | 'md' | number
  className?: string
  style?: CSSProperties
}

/**
 * <Icon name="cart" /> draws one of the prototype's line icons.
 * The colour follows the text colour of the parent (currentColor),
 * so a button's colour automatically colours its icon.
 */
export function Icon({ name, size = 'md', className = '', style }: IconProps) {
  const numStyle: CSSProperties | undefined =
    typeof size === 'number' ? { width: size, height: size, ...style } : style

  return (
    <svg
      className={`ico ${size === 'sm' ? 'sm' : ''} ${className}`.trim()}
      style={numStyle}
      viewBox="0 0 24 24"
      aria-hidden="true"
      dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: ICON_PATHS[name] }}
    />
  )
}

// ===== C:\Users\Lian Andrew\Desktop\RTU_Tindahan_Capstone\RTU_Tindahan_Final\RTU_Tindahan\frontend\src\common\hooks\useScrollSpy.ts =====
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react'

/**
 * Tells which page section is currently at the top of the screen.
 * Used by the public navbar to highlight "About Us / Insights / Need Help?".
 * Returns the id of the section, or '' when none has been reached yet.
 */
export function useScrollSpy(ids: string[]): string {
  const [current, setCurrent] = useState('')
  const key = ids.join('|')

  useEffect(() => {
    let queued = false
    const check = () => {
      queued = false
      let found = ''
      for (const id of key.split('|')) {
        const el = document.getElementById(id)
        if (el && el.getBoundingClientRect().top <= 120) found = id
      }
      setCurrent(found)
    }
    const onScroll = () => {
      if (queued) return
      queued = true
      requestAnimationFrame(check)
    }
    check()
    window.addEventListener('scroll', onScroll, { passive: true })
    return () => window.removeEventListener('scroll', onScroll)
  }, [key])

  return current
}


// ===== C:\Users\Lian Andrew\Desktop\RTU_Tindahan_Capstone\RTU_Tindahan_Final\RTU_Tindahan\frontend\src\common\hooks\useTheme.ts =====
import { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from 'react'

export type Theme = 'light' | 'dark'
const KEY = 'rtu_theme'
const THEME_CHANGE_EVENT = 'rtu-theme-change'

function readTheme(): Theme {
  try {
    return localStorage.getItem(KEY) === 'dark' ? 'dark' : 'light'
  } catch {
    return 'light'
  }
}

function applyThemeColor(theme: Theme) {
  const meta = document.querySelector('meta[name="theme-color"]')
  if (meta) {
    meta.setAttribute('content', theme === 'dark' ? '#121212' : '#f2f5f9')
  }
}

/**
 * Light / dark mode. The choice is saved in the browser (not on the server).
 * index.html applies the saved theme before React loads so there is no flash.
 *
 * Multiple components can call useTheme() and they will all stay in sync:
 * toggling the theme dispatches a window 'rtu-theme-change' event that every
 * listener re-renders from, and <meta name="theme-color"> follows the active theme.
 */
export function useTheme() {
  const [theme, setTheme] = useState<Theme>(readTheme)

  useEffect(() => {
    document.documentElement.dataset.theme = theme
    applyThemeColor(theme)
    try {
      localStorage.setItem(KEY, theme)
    } catch {
      /* private mode: just skip saving */
    }
    // Broadcast the change so other useTheme() instances stay in sync
    window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent(THEME_CHANGE_EVENT, { detail: { theme } }))
  }, [theme])

  // Listen for theme changes dispatched from other components/tabs
  useEffect(() => {
    const onThemeChange = (e: CustomEvent) => {
      const next = (e.detail as { theme?: Theme })?.theme
      if (next && next !== theme) {
        setTheme(next)
      }
    }
    window.addEventListener(THEME_CHANGE_EVENT as unknown as string, onThemeChange as EventListener)
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener(THEME_CHANGE_EVENT as unknown as string, onThemeChange as EventListener)
    }
  }, [theme])

  const toggle = useCallback(() => setTheme((t) => (t === 'dark' ? 'light' : 'dark')), [])
  return { theme, toggle }
}


// ===== C:\Users\Lian Andrew\Desktop\RTU_Tindahan_Capstone\RTU_Tindahan_Final\RTU_Tindahan\frontend\src\common\router\router.tsx =====
import { useEffect, useState, type AnchorHTMLAttributes } from 'react'

/**
 * TINY HASH ROUTER
 * ---------------------------------------------------------------
 * Pages live after the # in the address bar:
 *   http://localhost:5173/#/login          -> path "login"
 *   http://localhost:5173/#/browse?q=pen   -> path "browse", q = "pen"
 *   http://localhost:5173/                 -> path ""  (home)
 * No extra library is needed and refreshing the page always works.
 */

export interface Route {
  path: string
  params: URLSearchParams
}

function readRoute(): Route {
  const raw = window.location.hash.replace(/^#\/?/, '')
  const [path, query = ''] = raw.split('?')
  return { path: path.replace(/\/+$/, ''), params: new URLSearchParams(query) }
}

/** Go to another page. navigate('login'), navigate('browse?q=pen'). */
export function navigate(to: string, options: { replace?: boolean } = {}) {
  const target = `#/${to.replace(/^\/+/, '')}`
  if (options.replace) window.location.replace(target)
  else window.location.hash = target
  window.scrollTo({ top: 0 })
}

/** Returns the current route and re-renders when the address changes. */
export function useRoute(): Route {
  const [route, setRoute] = useState<Route>(readRoute)
  useEffect(() => {
    const onChange = () => setRoute(readRoute())
    window.addEventListener('hashchange', onChange)
    return () => window.removeEventListener('hashchange', onChange)
  }, [])
  return route
}

interface LinkProps extends Omit<AnchorHTMLAttributes<HTMLAnchorElement>, 'href'> {
  to: string
}

/** Like <a>, but for pages inside this app: <Link to="login">Sign in</Link> */
export function Link({ to, children, ...props }: LinkProps) {
  return (
    <a href={`#/${to.replace(/^\/+/, '')}`} {...props}>
      {children}
    </a>
  )
}

// ===== C:\Users\Lian Andrew\Desktop\RTU_Tindahan_Capstone\RTU_Tindahan_Final\RTU_Tindahan\frontend\src\common\utils\scrollToSection.ts =====
import { navigate } from '@/common/router/router'

/**
 * Smooth-scrolls to a section of the landing page (id="about", "insights", "help").
 * If the visitor is on another page, go home first and then scroll.
 */
export function scrollToSection(id: string) {
  const calm = window.matchMedia?.('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches
  const go = () => document.getElementById(id)?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: calm ? 'auto' : 'smooth', block: 'start' })
  const onHome = window.location.hash.replace(/^#\/?/, '') === ''
  if (onHome) go()
  else {
    navigate('')
    window.setTimeout(go, 80)
  }
}

// ===== C:\Users\Lian Andrew\Desktop\RTU_Tindahan_Capstone\RTU_Tindahan_Final\RTU_Tindahan\frontend\src\common\sounds.ts =====
/**
 * Web Audio API synthesizer for UI sound effects.
 * 100% offline, lightweight, and zero external asset dependencies.
 */

let audioCtx: AudioContext | null = null

function getAudioContext(): AudioContext | null {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return null
  if (!audioCtx) {
    const AudioContextClass =
      window.AudioContext ||
      (window as unknown as { webkitAudioContext: typeof AudioContext }).webkitAudioContext
    if (AudioContextClass) {
      audioCtx = new AudioContextClass()
    }
  }
  if (audioCtx && audioCtx.state === 'suspended') {
    void audioCtx.resume()
  }
  return audioCtx
}

/** Soft bubble pop for button clicks, toggles, chips, and menu interactions */
export function playPop() {
  try {
    const ctx = getAudioContext()
    if (!ctx) return
    const now = ctx.currentTime
    const osc = ctx.createOscillator()
    const gain = ctx.createGain()

    osc.type = 'sine'
    osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(420, now)
    osc.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(840, now + 0.06)

    gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.12, now)
    gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, now + 0.08)

    osc.connect(gain)
    gain.connect(ctx.destination)

    osc.start(now)
    osc.stop(now + 0.08)
  } catch {
    /* audio not allowed or failed */
  }
}

/** Cheerful ascending chime for order completed, cart add, and success states */
export function playSuccess() {
  try {
    const ctx = getAudioContext()
    if (!ctx) return
    const now = ctx.currentTime

    const notes = [523.25, 659.25, 783.99] // C5, E5, G5
    notes.forEach((freq, i) => {
      const osc = ctx.createOscillator()
      const gain = ctx.createGain()
      const t = now + i * 0.07

      osc.type = 'triangle'
      osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, t)

      gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.15, t)
      gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, t + 0.22)

      osc.connect(gain)
      gain.connect(ctx.destination)

      osc.start(t)
      osc.stop(t + 0.22)
    })
  } catch {
    /* ignore */
  }
}

/** Sweet high-pitched plink/sparkle for favoriting/liking */
export function playHeart() {
  try {
    const ctx = getAudioContext()
    if (!ctx) return
    const now = ctx.currentTime

    const osc = ctx.createOscillator()
    const gain = ctx.createGain()

    osc.type = 'sine'
    osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(660, now)
    osc.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(1100, now + 0.08)

    gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.16, now)
    gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, now + 0.16)

    osc.connect(gain)
    gain.connect(ctx.destination)

    osc.start(now)
    osc.stop(now + 0.16)
  } catch {
    /* ignore */
  }
}

/** Chat message send/receive pop */
export function playMessage() {
  try {
    const ctx = getAudioContext()
    if (!ctx) return
    const now = ctx.currentTime

    const osc1 = ctx.createOscillator()
    const gain1 = ctx.createGain()

    osc1.type = 'sine'
    osc1.frequency.setValueAtTime(587.33, now) // D5
    osc1.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(880, now + 0.05)

    gain1.gain.setValueAtTime(0.12, now)
    gain1.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, now + 0.09)

    osc1.connect(gain1)
    gain1.connect(ctx.destination)

    osc1.start(now)
    osc1.stop(now + 0.09)
  } catch {
    /* ignore */
  }
}

// ===== C:\Users\Lian Andrew\Desktop\RTU_Tindahan_Capstone\RTU_Tindahan_Final\RTU_Tindahan\frontend\src\features\authentication\components\ImageCarousel.tsx =====
'use client'

import { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react'

export interface CarouselImage {
  src: string
  alt: string
}

/**
 * Auto-sliding carousel showing 3 images at once:
 * previous (left), current (center), next (right).
 * Track physically slides left on each auto-advance, then images swap
 * and the track slides back â€” creating a seamless sliding effect.
 * No buttons or controls. Isolated to the login page left panel.
 */
export function ImageCarousel({ images }: { images: CarouselImage[] }) {
  const [index, setIndex] = useState(0)
  const [slideX, setSlideX] = useState(0)
  const intervalRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setInterval> | null>(null)

  useEffect(() => {
    if (images.length < 3) return
    intervalRef.current = setInterval(() => {
      // Slide track left
      setSlideX(-120)
      setTimeout(() => {
        // Swap images while track is offset
        setIndex((prev) => (prev + 1) % images.length)
        // Slide track back to center
        setSlideX(0)
      }, 400)
    }, 4000)
    return () => {
      if (intervalRef.current) clearInterval(intervalRef.current)
    }
  }, [images.length])

  const prev = images[(index - 1 + images.length) % images.length]
  const current = images[index]
  const next = images[(index + 1) % images.length]

  return (
    <div className="login-carousel">
      <div className="login-carousel-track" style={{ transform: `translateX(${slideX}px)` }}>
        <div className="login-carousel-card prev">
          <img src={prev.src} alt={prev.alt} />
        </div>
        <div className="login-carousel-card current">
          <img src={current.src} alt={current.alt} />
        </div>
        <div className="login-carousel-card next">
          <img src={next.src} alt={next.alt} />
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}


// ===== C:\Users\Lian Andrew\Desktop\RTU_Tindahan_Capstone\RTU_Tindahan_Final\RTU_Tindahan\frontend\src\features\authentication\components\LoginForm.tsx =====
'use client'

import { useState } from 'react'
import { navigate } from '@/common/router/router'
import { Icon } from '@/common/components/Icon'
import { Button } from '@/common/components/Button'
import type { LoginCredentials } from '../types'

interface LoginFormProps {
  onSubmit: (data: LoginCredentials) => void
  isLoading: boolean
  error: string | null
  onForgotPassword: () => void
}

export function LoginForm({ onSubmit, isLoading, error, onForgotPassword }: LoginFormProps) {
  const [email, setEmail] = useState('')
  const [password, setPassword] = useState('')
  const [emailErr, setEmailErr] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const [passErr, setPassErr] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const [showPass, setShowPass] = useState(false)

  const handleSubmit = (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault()
    setEmailErr(null)
    setPassErr(null)

    // Frontend-only RTU email format check (backend also validates this)
    const trimmed = email.trim().toLowerCase()
    if (!trimmed) {
      setEmailErr('Enter your RTU email address.')
      return
    }
    if (!/^[^@\s]+@rtu\.edu\.ph$/.test(trimmed)) {
      setEmailErr('Use your official RTU email, for example 0000-000000@rtu.edu.ph.')
      return
    }
    if (!password) {
      setPassErr('Enter your password.')
      return
    }

    onSubmit({ email: trimmed, password })
  }

  return (
    <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="card stack" style={{ width: '100%', maxWidth: '400px', gap: 14 }} noValidate>
      <div>
        <h2 style={{ fontSize: 22 }}>Welcome to Tindahan</h2>
        <p className="small muted" style={{ marginTop: 4 }}>
          Sign in with the RTU account you verified. New here? Create your account first.
        </p>
      </div>
      <div className="field">
        <label htmlFor="lg-email">RTU email address</label>
        <input
          id="lg-email"
          type="email"
          autoComplete="email"
          required
          className={`input ${emailErr ? 'border-red-500' : ''}`}
          placeholder="0000-000000@rtu.edu.ph"
          value={email}
          onChange={(e) => setEmail(e.target.value)}
        />
      </div>
      <div className="field">
        <div className="row between">
          <label htmlFor="lg-pass">Password</label>
          <button type="button" className="link" onClick={onForgotPassword}>
            Forgot password?
          </button>
        </div>
        <div className="password-input">
          <input
            id="lg-pass"
            type={showPass ? 'text' : 'password'}
            autoComplete="current-password"
            required
            className={`input ${passErr ? 'border-red-500' : ''} pr-10`}
            placeholder="â€¢â€¢â€¢â€¢â€¢â€¢â€¢â€¢"
            value={password}
            onChange={(e) => setPassword(e.target.value)}
          />
          <button
            type="button"
            className="password-toggle"
            onClick={() => setShowPass(!showPass)}
            aria-label={showPass ? 'Hide password' : 'Show password'}
          >
            <Icon name={showPass ? 'eye' : 'eyeoff'} size="sm" />
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
      {emailErr && <p className="err" role="alert">{emailErr}</p>}
      {passErr && <p className="err" role="alert">{passErr}</p>}
      {error && <p className="err" role="alert">{error}</p>}
      <Button variant="yellow" size="lg" isLoading={isLoading} className="block">
        <Icon name="lock" size="sm" /> Sign in with RTU account
      </Button>
      <p className="small muted" style={{ textAlign: 'center' }}>
        First time here?{' '}
        <button type="button" className="link" onClick={() => navigate('register')}>
          Create and verify my RTU account
        </button>
      </p>
    </form>
  )
}


// ===== C:\Users\Lian Andrew\Desktop\RTU_Tindahan_Capstone\RTU_Tindahan_Final\RTU_Tindahan\frontend\src\features\authentication\components\VerifyForm.tsx =====
'use client'

import { useState, useCallback } from 'react'
import { navigate } from '@/common/router/router'
import { Icon } from '@/common/components/Icon'
import { Button } from '@/common/components/Button'
import { useAuth } from '../AuthContext'

const RTU_EMAIL = /^\d{4}-\d{6}@rtu\.edu\.ph$/i

const PROGRAMS = [
  'BS Information Technology',
  'BS Computer Engineering',
  'BS Electronics Engineering',
  'BS Business Administration',
]

const YEARS = ['1st', '2nd', '3rd', '4th', '5th', '6th']

interface Step1Data {
  first: string
  last: string
  prog: string
  year: number
  email: string
  pass: string
  pass2: string
  code: string
  agree: boolean
}

interface VerifyFormProps {
  onStep3Complete?: () => void
}

export function VerifyForm({ onStep3Complete }: VerifyFormProps) {
  const { register, resendCode, confirmCode, otp } = useAuth()
  // A code was already requested (this page reloaded, or the user came back),
  // so resume on the code screen instead of asking for the details again.
  const [step, setStep] = useState<1 | 2 | 3>(otp ? 2 : 1)
  const [step1, setStep1] = useState<Step1Data>({
    first: '',
    last: '',
    prog: PROGRAMS[0],
    year: 1,
    email: '',
    pass: '',
    pass2: '',
    code: '',
    agree: false,
  })
  // Per-field errors shown below each input
  const [firstErr, setFirstErr] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const [lastErr, setLastErr] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const [emailErr, setEmailErr] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const [passErr, setPassErr] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const [pass2Err, setPass2Err] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const [codeErr, setCodeErr] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const [agreeErr, setAgreeErr] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const [showPass, setShowPass] = useState(false)
  const [showPass2, setShowPass2] = useState(false)
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false)

  const clearAllErr = useCallback(() => {
    setFirstErr(null)
    setLastErr(null)
    setEmailErr(null)
    setPassErr(null)
    setPass2Err(null)
    setCodeErr(null)
    setAgreeErr(null)
  }, [])

  const goBack = () => {
    if (window.history.length > 1) {
      window.history.back()
    } else {
      navigate('')
    }
  }

  // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
  // STEP 1: student account â€” name, program, RTU email, password
  // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
  const handleStep1Submit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault()
    clearAllErr()
    const { first, last, email, pass, pass2, prog, year, agree } = step1

    if (!first.trim() || !last.trim()) {
      if (!first.trim()) setFirstErr('Enter your first name.')
      if (!last.trim()) setLastErr('Enter your last name.')
      return
    }
    const em = email.trim().toLowerCase()
    if (!RTU_EMAIL.test(em)) {
      setEmailErr('Use your student number email, like 2024-123456@rtu.edu.ph.')
      return
    }
    if (!pass) {
      setPassErr('Enter a password.')
      return
    }
    if (pass.length < 8) {
      setPassErr('Choose a password with at least 8 characters.')
      return
    }
    if (!pass2) {
      setPass2Err('Confirm your password.')
      return
    }
    if (pass !== pass2) {
      setPass2Err('The two passwords do not match.')
      return
    }
    if (!agree) {
      setAgreeErr('Accept the privacy notice to create your account.')
      return
    }

    setIsLoading(true)
    try {
      // Creates the visitor account and emails the 6-digit code.
      await register({
        first: first.trim(),
        last: last.trim(),
        email: em,
        pass,
        prog,
        year,
        consent: agree,
      })
      setStep1((prev) => ({ ...prev, email: em }))
      setStep(2)
      window.scrollTo(0, 0)
    } catch (err) {
      setEmailErr(err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Account creation failed. Try again.')
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false)
    }
  }

  // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
  // STEP 2a: before code sent â€” "Send code" button
  // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
  const handleSendCode = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault()
    clearAllErr()
    setIsLoading(true)
    try {
      await resendCode(step1.email.trim().toLowerCase())
      window.scrollTo(0, 0)
    } catch (err) {
      setEmailErr(err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Could not send code. Try again.')
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false)
    }
  }

  // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
  // STEP 2b: code sent â€” enter the 6-digit code
  // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
  const handleResendCode = async () => {
    clearAllErr()
    setIsLoading(true)
    try {
      await resendCode(otp?.to || step1.email.trim().toLowerCase())
    } catch (err) {
      setEmailErr(err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Could not resend code. Try again.')
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false)
    }
  }

  const handleChangeEmail = () => {
    setStep(1)
    setStep1((prev) => ({ ...prev, code: '' }))
  }

  const handleVerifyCode = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault()
    clearAllErr()
    if (!/^\d{6}$/.test(step1.code)) {
      setCodeErr('Enter the 6 digits from the email.')
      return
    }
    setIsLoading(true)
    try {
      // Correct code activates the account and signs the user in.
      await confirmCode(otp?.to || step1.email, step1.code)
      setStep(3)
      onStep3Complete?.()
    } catch (err) {
      setCodeErr(err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Code verification failed. Try again.')
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false)
    }
  }

  // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
  // Helpers
  // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
  const maskMail = (m: string) => {
    const p = String(m).split('@')
    return `${p[0].slice(0, 2)}***@${p[1] || ''}`
  }

  // The address the code was sent to. Kept by AuthContext, so it survives a
  // page reload and the code screen can still resume.
  const otpEmail = otp?.to ?? step1.email

  return (
    <form
      onSubmit={(e) => {
        e.preventDefault()
        if (step === 1) {
          handleStep1Submit(e)
        } else if (step === 2 && otp) {
          handleVerifyCode(e)
        } else if (step === 2 && !otp) {
          handleSendCode(e)
        }
      }}
      className="stack"
      style={{ gap: 14, maxWidth: 560 }}
      noValidate
    >
      {/* ============ STEP 1 ============ */}
      {step === 1 ? (
        <>
          <h1 style={{ fontSize: 26, letterSpacing: '-0.02em', marginBottom: 4 }}>
            Create your student account
          </h1>
          <p className="small muted" style={{ marginBottom: 16 }}>
            Your RTU email is your student number, like 2024-123456@rtu.edu.ph. Next we will
            send a 6-digit code to that same RTU email.
          </p>
          <div className="card stack" style={{ gap: 12 }}>
            <b>About you</b>
            <div className="grid2">
              <div className="field">
                <label htmlFor="v-first">First name</label>
                <input
                  id="v-first"
                  className={`input ${firstErr ? 'border-red-500' : ''}`}
                  autoComplete="given-name"
                  value={step1.first}
                  onChange={(e) => {
                    setStep1((prev) => ({ ...prev, first: e.target.value }))
                    setFirstErr(null)
                  }}
                />
                {firstErr && <p className="err" role="alert">{firstErr}</p>}
              </div>
              <div className="field">
                <label htmlFor="v-last">Last name</label>
                <input
                  id="v-last"
                  className={`input ${lastErr ? 'border-red-500' : ''}`}
                  autoComplete="family-name"
                  value={step1.last}
                  onChange={(e) => {
                    setStep1((prev) => ({ ...prev, last: e.target.value }))
                    setLastErr(null)
                  }}
                />
                {lastErr && <p className="err" role="alert">{lastErr}</p>}
              </div>
            </div>
            <div className="field">
              <label htmlFor="v-prog">Program</label>
              <select
                className="input"
                id="v-prog"
                value={step1.prog}
                onChange={(e) => {
                  setStep1((prev) => ({ ...prev, prog: e.target.value }))
                  setEmailErr(null)
                }}
              >
                {PROGRAMS.map((o) => (
                  <option key={o} value={o} selected={step1.prog === o}>
                    {o}
                  </option>
                ))}
              </select>
            </div>
            <div className="field">
              <label htmlFor="v-year">Year level</label>
              <select
                className="input"
                id="v-year"
                value={step1.year}
                onChange={(e) =>
                  setStep1((prev) => ({ ...prev, year: Number(e.target.value) }))
                }
              >
                {YEARS.map((label, index) => (
                  <option key={label} value={index + 1}>
                    {label} year
                  </option>
                ))}
              </select>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div className="card stack" style={{ gap: 12 }}>
            <b>Sign-in details</b>
            <div className="field">
              <label htmlFor="v-email">RTU email (student number)</label>
              <input
                className={`input tnum ${emailErr ? 'border-red-500' : ''}`}
                id="v-email"
                type="email"
                inputMode="email"
                autoComplete="username"
                value={step1.email}
                placeholder="0000-000000@rtu.edu.ph"
                onChange={(e) => {
                  setStep1((prev) => ({ ...prev, email: e.target.value }))
                  setEmailErr(null)
                }}
              />
              <span className="tiny muted">Format: 4 digits, a dash, 6 digits, then @rtu.edu.ph</span>
              {emailErr && <p className="err" role="alert">{emailErr}</p>}
            </div>
            <div className="grid2">
              <div className="field">
                <label htmlFor="v-pass">Password</label>
                <div className="password-input">
                  <input
                    className={`input ${passErr ? 'border-red-500' : ''} pr-10`}
                    id="v-pass"
                    type={showPass ? 'text' : 'password'}
                    autoComplete="new-password"
                    value={step1.pass}
                    placeholder="At least 8 characters"
                    onChange={(e) => {
                      setStep1((prev) => ({ ...prev, pass: e.target.value }))
                      setPassErr(null)
                    }}
                  />
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    className="password-toggle"
                    onClick={() => setShowPass(!showPass)}
                    aria-label={showPass ? 'Hide password' : 'Show password'}
                  >
                    <Icon name={showPass ? 'eye' : 'eyeoff'} size="sm" />
                  </button>
                </div>
                {passErr && <p className="err" role="alert">{passErr}</p>}
              </div>
              <div className="field">
                <label htmlFor="v-pass2">Confirm password</label>
                <div className="password-input">
                  <input
                    className={`input ${pass2Err ? 'border-red-500' : ''} pr-10`}
                    id="v-pass2"
                    type={showPass2 ? 'text' : 'password'}
                    autoComplete="new-password"
                    value={step1.pass2}
                    onChange={(e) => {
                      setStep1((prev) => ({ ...prev, pass2: e.target.value }))
                      setPass2Err(null)
                    }}
                  />
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    className="password-toggle"
                    onClick={() => setShowPass2(!showPass2)}
                    aria-label={showPass2 ? 'Hide password' : 'Show password'}
                  >
                    <Icon name={showPass2 ? 'eye' : 'eyeoff'} size="sm" />
                  </button>
                </div>
                {pass2Err && <p className="err" role="alert">{pass2Err}</p>}
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
          <label className="row" style={{ gap: 10, alignItems: 'flex-start' }}>
            <input
              type="checkbox"
              checked={step1.agree}
              onChange={(e) => {
                setStep1((prev) => ({ ...prev, agree: e.target.checked }))
                setAgreeErr(null)
              }}
              style={{ marginTop: 3 }}
            />
            <span className="small">
              I accept the privacy notice. My RTU email, program, and year level are used only to
              run the marketplace (RA 10173).
            </span>
          </label>
          {agreeErr && (
            <p className="err" role="alert">
              {agreeErr}
            </p>
          )}
          <div className="err" role="alert">{emailErr}</div>
          <div className="row between wrap">
            <button
              type="button"
              className="btn ghost"
              onClick={goBack}
            >
              <Icon name="back" size="sm" /> Back
            </button>
            <span className="row">
              <span className="small muted">Takes about 2 minutes</span>
              <Button variant="yellow" size="lg" isLoading={isLoading} className="block">
                Continue
              </Button>
            </span>
          </div>
        </>
      ) : (
        // ============ STEP 2 ============
        <>
          {!otp ? (
            // Step 2 before code sent
            <>
              <h1 style={{ fontSize: 26, letterSpacing: '-0.02em', marginBottom: 4 }}>
                Confirm your RTU email
              </h1>
              <p className="small muted" style={{ marginBottom: 16 }}>
                We will email a 6-digit code to <b>{maskMail(step1.email)}</b>. Open that inbox,
                copy the code and enter it on the next screen.
              </p>
              <div className="card stack" style={{ gap: 12 }}>
                <div className="note blue">
                  <Icon name="lock" size="sm" />
                  <span>
                    The code goes only to your RTU student-number email. It proves the account is
                    really yours.
                  </span>
                </div>
              </div>
              <div className="err" role="alert">{emailErr}</div>
              <div className="row between wrap">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  className="btn ghost"
                  onClick={handleChangeEmail}
                >
                  <Icon name="back" size="sm" /> Back
                </button>
                <Button variant="yellow" size="lg" isLoading={isLoading} className="block" onClick={handleSendCode}>
                  Send code
                </Button>
              </div>
            </>
          ) : (
            // Step 2 after code sent â€” enter the code
            <>
              <h1 style={{ fontSize: 26, letterSpacing: '-0.02em', marginBottom: 4 }}>
                Enter your code
              </h1>
              <p className="small muted" style={{ marginBottom: 16 }}>
                We sent a 6-digit code to your RTU email <b>{maskMail(otpEmail)}</b>. It expires in
                5 minutes. Check your spam folder if you do not see it.
              </p>
              <div className="card stack" style={{ gap: 12 }}>
                <div className="field">
                  <label htmlFor="v-code">6-digit code</label>
                  <input
                    className={`input otp tnum ${codeErr ? 'border-red-500' : ''}`}
                    id="v-code"
                    inputMode="numeric"
                    autoComplete="one-time-code"
                    maxLength={6}
                    pattern="[0-9]*"
                    value={step1.code}
                    placeholder="000000"
                    onChange={(e) => {
                      setStep1((prev) => ({ ...prev, code: e.target.value.replace(/\D/g, '') }))
                      setCodeErr(null)
                    }}
                  />
                  {codeErr && <p className="err" role="alert">{codeErr}</p>}
                </div>
                <div className="row wrap">
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    className="link"
                    onClick={handleResendCode}
                  >
                    Send a new code
                  </button>
                  <span className="muted">Â·</span>
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    className="link"
                    onClick={handleChangeEmail}
                  >
                    Use a different RTU email
                  </button>
                </div>
              </div>
              <div className="err" role="alert">{codeErr}</div>
              <div className="row between wrap">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  className="btn ghost"
                  onClick={handleChangeEmail}
                >
                  <Icon name="back" size="sm" /> Back
                </button>
                <Button variant="yellow" size="lg" isLoading={isLoading} className="block" type="submit">
                  Verify and create account
                </Button>
              </div>
            </>
          )}
        </>
      )}

      {/* ============ STEP 3 ============ */}
      {step === 3 && (
        <div className="card stack" style={{ maxWidth: 560, gap: 14, alignItems: 'flex-start' }}>
          <span
            className="avatar"
            style={{
              background: 'var(--green-bg)',
              color: 'var(--green)',
              width: 46,
              height: 46,
            }}
          >
            <Icon name="check" />
          </span>
          <h2 style={{ fontSize: 24 }}>Welcome, {step1.first.trim() || 'friend'}</h2>
          <p className="muted">
            Your RTU email is confirmed and your account is ready. You can buy from the marketplace
            and sell from My shop. New listings are checked by RTU staff before they appear.
          </p>
          <div className="row wrap">
            <button
              className="btn"
              onClick={() => {
                navigate('marketplace', { replace: true })
                onStep3Complete?.()
              }}
            >
              Go to marketplace
            </button>
            <button className="btn ghost" onClick={() => navigate('', { replace: true })}>
              Back to homepage
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </form>
  )
}
