// ===== C:\Users\Lian Andrew\Desktop\RTU_Tindahan_Capstone\RTU_Tindahan_Final\RTU_Tindahan\frontend\src\features\authentication\pages\ForgotPasswordPage.tsx =====
import { useState, useEffect } from 'react'
import { navigate } from '@/common/router/router'
import { apiFetch } from '@/common/api/client'
import { Icon } from '@/common/components/Icon'
import logoImg from '@/assets/logo-removebg-preview.png'
import './ForgotPasswordPage.css'

type Step = 'email' | 'code' | 'done'

export function ForgotPasswordPage() {
  const [step, setStep] = useState<Step>('email')
  const [email, setEmail] = useState('')
  const [code, setCode] = useState('')
  const [newPass, setNewPass] = useState('')
  const [confirmPass, setConfirmPass] = useState('')
  const [emailErr, setEmailErr] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const [codeErr, setCodeErr] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const [passErr, setPassErr] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const [confirmErr, setConfirmErr] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false)

  // Always scroll down when entering the forgot password page
  useEffect(() => {
    const timer = setTimeout(() => {
      window.scrollTo({ top: document.documentElement.scrollHeight, behavior: 'smooth' })
    }, 1500)
    return () => clearTimeout(timer)
  }, [])

  const STUDENT_EMAIL = /^\d{4}-\d{6}@rtu\.edu\.ph$/i

  // ------------------------------------------------------------------
  // Step 1: Send verification code to the inputted email
  // ------------------------------------------------------------------
  const handleSendCode = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault()
    setEmailErr(null)
    setCodeErr(null)
    setPassErr(null)
    setConfirmErr(null)

    const trimmed = email.trim().toLowerCase()
    if (!trimmed) {
      setEmailErr('Enter your RTU email address.')
      return
    }
    if (!STUDENT_EMAIL.test(trimmed)) {
      setEmailErr('Use your official RTU email, for example 0000-000000@rtu.edu.ph.')
      return
    }

    setIsLoading(true)
    try {
      await apiFetch<{ detail: string }>('/auth/password-reset/', {
        method: 'POST',
        body: { email: trimmed },
      })
      setStep('code')
    } catch (err: any) {
      setEmailErr(
        err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Could not send verification code. Try again.'
      )
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false)
    }
  }

  // ------------------------------------------------------------------
  // Step 2: Verify code and set new password
  // ------------------------------------------------------------------
  const handleResetPassword = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault()
    setCodeErr(null)
    setPassErr(null)
    setConfirmErr(null)

    const digits = String(code).replace(/\s/g, '')
    if (!/^\d{6}$/.test(digits)) {
      setCodeErr('Enter the 6-digit code from your email.')
      return
    }
    if (!newPass) {
      setPassErr('Enter a new password.')
      return
    }
    if (newPass.length < 8) {
      setPassErr('Choose a password with at least 8 characters.')
      return
    }
    if (newPass !== confirmPass) {
      setConfirmErr('The two passwords do not match.')
      return
    }

    setIsLoading(true)
    try {
      await apiFetch<{ detail: string }>('/auth/password-reset/confirm/', {
        method: 'POST',
        body: {
          email: email.trim().toLowerCase(),
          code: digits,
          password: newPass,
          password_confirm: confirmPass,
        },
      })
      setStep('done')
    } catch (err: any) {
      setCodeErr(
        err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Invalid code or reset failed. Try again.'
      )
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false)
    }
  }

  // ------------------------------------------------------------------
  // Step 1 UI: email input
  // ------------------------------------------------------------------
  if (step === 'email') {
    return (
      <div className="forgot-page">
        <div className="split">
          {/* Left info panel (navy background) */}
          <div className="l">
            <button className="logo" type="button" onClick={() => navigate('/')}>
              <img className="logo-img" src={logoImg} alt="RTU Tindahan Campus Marketplace" />
            </button>
            <div className="info-panel">
              <h1 className="hero-h">Forgot your password?</h1>
              <p>
                Enter your RTU student-number email and we will send a verification code to your
                inbox. Use the code to set a new password and regain access to your account.
              </p>
              <div className="row wrap small" style={{ opacity: 0.9, gap: 16, justifyContent: 'center', marginTop: 16 }}>
                <span className="row" style={{ gap: 6 }}>
                  <Icon name="shield" size="sm" /> Verified RTU accounts
                </span>
                <span className="row" style={{ gap: 6 }}>
                  <Icon name="msg" size="sm" /> Code sent to RTU email
                </span>
                <span className="row" style={{ gap: 6 }}>
                  <Icon name="pin" size="sm" /> No online payment needed
                </span>
              </div>
              <div className="note blue">
                <Icon name="info" />
                <span>
                  Only verified RTU students and personnel can request a password reset. The code
                  expires after 15 minutes.
                </span>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Right form panel */}
          <div className="r">
            <div style={{ width: '100%', maxWidth: '400px', marginBottom: 18 }}>
              <button type="button" className="link" onClick={() => navigate('/login')}>
                â† Back to sign in
              </button>
            </div>

            <form onSubmit={handleSendCode} className="card stack" style={{ width: '100%', maxWidth: '400px', gap: 14 }} noValidate>
              <div>
                <h2 style={{ fontSize: 22 }}>Reset your password</h2>
                <p className="small muted" style={{ marginTop: 4 }}>
                  Step 1 of 2 â€” Send a verification code to your RTU email.
                </p>
              </div>
              <div className="field">
                <label htmlFor="fp-email">RTU email address</label>
                <input
                  id="fp-email"
                  type="email"
                  autoComplete="email"
                  required
                  className={`input ${emailErr ? 'border-red-500' : ''}`}
                  placeholder="0000-000000@rtu.edu.ph"
                  value={email}
                  onChange={(e) => {
                    setEmail(e.target.value)
                    setEmailErr(null)
                  }}
                />
                {emailErr && <p className="err" role="alert">{emailErr}</p>}
              </div>
              <button
                type="button"
                className="btn yellow block lg"
                disabled={isLoading}
                onClick={handleSendCode}
              >
                {isLoading ? 'Sending codeâ€¦' : 'Send verification code'}
              </button>
              <p className="small muted" style={{ textAlign: 'center' }}>
                Remember your password?{' '}
                <button type="button" className="link" onClick={() => navigate('/login')}>
                  Sign in instead
                </button>
              </p>
            </form>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    )
  }

  // ------------------------------------------------------------------
  // Step 2 UI: verification code + new password
  // ------------------------------------------------------------------
  if (step === 'code') {
    return (
      <div className="forgot-page">
        <div className="split">
          <div className="l">
            <button className="logo" type="button" onClick={() => navigate('/')}>
              <img className="logo-img" src={logoImg} alt="RTU Tindahan Campus Marketplace" />
            </button>
            <div className="info-panel">
              <h1 className="hero-h">Enter your code</h1>
              <p>
                We sent a 6-digit verification code to <b>{email}</b>. Enter it below along with
                your new password to reset your account.
              </p>
              <div className="note blue">
                <Icon name="info" />
                <span>
                  The code expires after 15 minutes. Didn't receive it? Go back and resend.
                </span>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="r">
            <div style={{ width: '100%', maxWidth: '400px', marginBottom: 18 }}>
              <button type="button" className="link" onClick={() => setStep('email')}>
                â† Back
              </button>
            </div>

            <form onSubmit={handleResetPassword} className="card stack" style={{ width: '100%', maxWidth: '400px', gap: 14 }} noValidate>
              <div>
                <h2 style={{ fontSize: 22 }}>Set your new password</h2>
                <p className="small muted" style={{ marginTop: 4 }}>
                  Step 2 of 2 â€” Enter the code and choose a new password.
                </p>
              </div>
              <div className="field">
                <label htmlFor="fp-code">Verification code</label>
                <input
                  id="fp-code"
                  type="text"
                  inputMode="numeric"
                  autoComplete="one-time-code"
                  maxLength={6}
                  pattern="[0-9]*"
                  className={`input ${codeErr ? 'border-red-500' : ''}`}
                  placeholder="000000"
                  value={code}
                  onChange={(e) => {
                    setCode(e.target.value.replace(/\D/g, ''))
                    setCodeErr(null)
                  }}
                />
                {codeErr && <p className="err" role="alert">{codeErr}</p>}
              </div>
              <div className="field">
                <label htmlFor="fp-new-pass">New password</label>
                <input
                  id="fp-new-pass"
                  type="password"
                  autoComplete="new-password"
                  required
                  className={`input ${passErr ? 'border-red-500' : ''} pr-10`}
                  placeholder="At least 8 characters"
                  value={newPass}
                  onChange={(e) => {
                    setNewPass(e.target.value)
                    setPassErr(null)
                  }}
                />
                {passErr && <p className="err" role="alert">{passErr}</p>}
              </div>
              <div className="field">
                <label htmlFor="fp-confirm-pass">Confirm new password</label>
                <input
                  id="fp-confirm-pass"
                  type="password"
                  autoComplete="new-password"
                  required
                  className={`input ${confirmErr ? 'border-red-500' : ''} pr-10`}
                  placeholder="Type the same password again"
                  value={confirmPass}
                  onChange={(e) => {
                    setConfirmPass(e.target.value)
                    setConfirmErr(null)
                  }}
                />
                {confirmErr && <p className="err" role="alert">{confirmErr}</p>}
              </div>
              <button
                type="button"
                className="btn yellow block lg"
                disabled={isLoading}
                onClick={handleResetPassword}
              >
                {isLoading ? 'Resetting passwordâ€¦' : 'Reset password'}
              </button>
              <p className="small muted" style={{ textAlign: 'center' }}>
                <button type="button" className="link" onClick={() => navigate('/login')}>
                  Back to sign in
                </button>
              </p>
            </form>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    )
  }

  // ------------------------------------------------------------------
  // Step 3 UI: done
  // ------------------------------------------------------------------
  return (
    <div className="forgot-page">
      <div className="split">
        <div className="l">
          <button className="logo" type="button" onClick={() => navigate('/')}>
            <img className="logo-img" src={logoImg} alt="RTU Tindahan Campus Marketplace" />
          </button>
          <div className="info-panel">
            <h1 className="hero-h">Password reset</h1>
            <p>
              Your RTU Tindahan password has been reset successfully. You can now sign in with
                your new password.
            </p>
            <div className="note blue">
              <Icon name="info" />
              <span>
                Remember: meet in visible campus areas, check the item before paying, and pay
                in person.
              </span>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="r">
          <div style={{ width: '100%', maxWidth: '400px', marginBottom: 18 }}>
            <button type="button" className="link" onClick={() => navigate('/login')}>
              â† Back to sign in
            </button>
          </div>

          <div className="card stack" style={{ width: '100%', maxWidth: '400px', gap: 14, textAlign: 'center' }}>
            <div style={{ fontSize: 56, lineHeight: 1 }}>âœ“</div>
            <h2 style={{ fontSize: 22 }}>Password reset complete</h2>
            <p className="small muted">
              Your new password is now active. Use it with your RTU email to sign in.
            </p>
            <button
              type="button"
              className="btn yellow block lg"
              onClick={() => navigate('/login')}
            >
              Sign in
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}

import { useLayoutEffect, useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react'
import gsap from 'gsap'
import { navigate } from '@/common/router/router'
import { LoginForm } from '../components/LoginForm'
import { useAuth } from '../AuthContext'

const CAROUSEL_IMAGES = [
  { src: img0, alt: 'Sample image 0' },
  { src: imgRtu, alt: 'Applying to RTU' },
  { src: imgBef, alt: 'Sample image bef71f2e0c003d63' },
  { src: img3, alt: 'Campus marketplace image 3' },
  { src: img4, alt: 'Campus marketplace image 4' },
  { src: img5, alt: 'Campus marketplace image 5' },
]

/* ---- Carousel motion settings ---- */
const STEP_SECONDS = 3 // how long each image rests in the center
const SLIDE_SECONDS = 1.2 // how long the glide to the next image takes
const TRAVEL = 210 // xPercent each card travels from (+) to (-); controls neighbour spacing

/**
 * Auto-sliding, seamlessly looping carousel (no controls).
 *
 * Based on the GSAP "infinite cards" loop: every card flies across the track
 * while scaling/fading in and out (yoyo), staggered so the card in the middle
 * is biggest and its neighbours shrink away on each side. Instead of a
 * ScrollTrigger, a single `pos` value is eased from slide to slide, and every
 * card's pass is rendered from that value, so the loop never has a seam.
 */
function LoginCarousel({ images }: { images: { src: string; alt: string }[] }) {
  const rootRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null)

  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    const root = rootRef.current
    if (!root) return

    const ctx = gsap.context(() => {
      const cards = gsap.utils.toArray<HTMLElement>('.login-carousel-card')
      const n = cards.length
      if (n === 0) return

      // One paused "pass" timeline per card: scale/opacity/grayscale peak in the
      // middle (yoyo) while the card travels right â†’ left in a straight line.
      const passes = cards.map((card) =>
        gsap
          .timeline({ paused: true })
          .fromTo(
            card,
            { scale: 0 },
            { scale: 1, duration: 0.5, yoyo: true, repeat: 1, ease: 'power1.in' },
            0
          )
          .fromTo(
            card,
            { opacity: 0, filter: 'grayscale(60%)' },
            { opacity: 1, filter: 'grayscale(0%)', duration: 0.5, yoyo: true, repeat: 1, ease: 'sine.in' },
            0
          )
          .fromTo(card, { xPercent: TRAVEL }, { xPercent: -TRAVEL, duration: 1, ease: 'none' }, 0)
      )

      const wrap = gsap.utils.wrap(0, 1)
      const state = { pos: 0 } // card `i` is centered whenever pos === i (mod n)

      const render = () => {
        passes.forEach((pass, i) => {
          const progress = wrap(0.5 + (state.pos - i) / n)
          pass.progress(progress)
          // keep the centered card on top (z-index must be an integer)
          cards[i].style.zIndex = String(Math.round((1 - Math.abs(progress - 0.5) * 2) * 100))
        })
      }
      render()

      if (window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches) return

      let target = 0
      const advance = () => {
        target += 1
        gsap.to(state, {
          pos: target,
          duration: SLIDE_SECONDS,
          ease: 'power3.inOut',
          overwrite: true,
          onUpdate: render,
        })
      }

      // slide on a steady beat, forever
      gsap
        .timeline({ repeat: -1, delay: STEP_SECONDS })
        .call(advance)
        .to({}, { duration: STEP_SECONDS })
    }, root)

    return () => ctx.revert()
  }, [images.length])

  return (
    <div className="login-carousel" ref={rootRef} aria-roledescription="carousel" aria-label="Campus marketplace images">
      <div className="login-carousel-track">
        {images.map(({ src, alt }) => (
          <div className="login-carousel-card" key={src}>
            <img src={src} alt={alt} draggable={false} />
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}

/** The sign-in page. Matches the prototype layout: split panel with info on the left, form on the right. */
export function LoginPage() {
  const { login } = useAuth()
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false)
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const [popup, setPopup] = useState<'guidelines' | 'policy' | null>(null)
  const loginStartRef = useRef<number>(0)

  // Always scroll down when entering the sign-in page
  useEffect(() => {
    const timer = setTimeout(() => {
      window.scrollTo({ top: document.documentElement.scrollHeight, behavior: 'smooth' })
    }, 1500)
    return () => clearTimeout(timer)
  }, [])

  const handleLogin = async ({ email, password }: LoginCredentials) => {
    loginStartRef.current = Date.now()
    setIsLoading(true)
    setError(null)
    try {
      await login(email, password)
      navigate('', { replace: true }) // the home route shows the marketplace once signed in
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Sign in failed. Please try again.')
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false)
    }
  }

  const handleForgotPassword = () => {
    navigate('forgot-password')
  }

  const handleGuidelines = () => {
    setPopup('guidelines')
  }

  return (
    <div className="login-page">
      <div className="split">
        {/* Left info panel (navy background, from prototype) */}
        <div className="l">
          <button className="logo" type="button" onClick={() => navigate('/')}>
            <img className="logo-img" src={logoImg} alt="RTU Tindahan Campus Marketplace" />
          </button>
          <LoginCarousel images={CAROUSEL_IMAGES} />
          <div className="info-panel">
            <h1 className="hero-h">Your campus marketplace, made for everyday student life.</h1>
            <p>
              Buy merienda, find pre-loved books, book student services, and request official RTU items from verified students and personnel at Pasig Campus.
            </p>
            <div className="row wrap small" style={{ opacity: 0.9, gap: 16, justifyContent: 'center' }}>
              <span className="row" style={{ gap: 6 }}>
                <Icon name="shield" size="sm" /> Verified RTU accounts
              </span>
              <span className="row" style={{ gap: 6 }}>
                <Icon name="pin" size="sm" /> Campus meetup only
              </span>
              <span className="row" style={{ gap: 6 }}>
                <Icon name="bag" size="sm" /> Cash or e-wallet
              </span>
            </div>
            <div className="note blue">
              <Icon name="info" />
              <span>
                Access is restricted to verified RTU students and personnel. Never share your password or other sign-in details.
              </span>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Right form panel */}
        <div className="r">
          <div className="row between" style={{ width: '100%', maxWidth: '400px', marginBottom: 18 }}>
            <button type="button" className="link" onClick={() => navigate('/verify')}>
              Need help verifying?
            </button>
            <button type="button" className="link" onClick={handleGuidelines}>
              View guidelines
            </button>
          </div>

          <LoginForm
            onSubmit={handleLogin}
            isLoading={isLoading}
            error={error}
            onForgotPassword={handleForgotPassword}
          />
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Popup: Community Guidelines â€” same as LandingPage */}
      {popup === 'guidelines' && (
        <div className="popup-overlay" onClick={() => setPopup(null)}>
          <div className="popup-box" onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}>
            <div className="row" style={{ gap: 8, marginBottom: 16 }}>
              <Icon name="note" size="sm" />
              <span style={{ fontWeight: 600, color: 'var(--ink)' }}>Community Guidelines</span>
            </div>
            <ul className="small muted" style={{ lineHeight: 1.55, marginBottom: 20, paddingLeft: 20 }}>
              <li>Be honest about what you sell, including its condition.</li>
              <li>Meet only at visible spots inside Pasig Campus.</li>
              <li>Pay in person. RTU Tindahan never handles money or delivery.</li>
              <li>No exam answers, vaping products, medicines, resale tickets or weapons.</li>
              <li>Treat every student and staff member with respect.</li>
            </ul>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'row', gap: 8, justifyContent: 'flex-end' }}>
              <button type="button" className="btn" onClick={() => setPopup(null)}>
                Got it
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  )
}

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react'
import { navigate } from '@/common/router/router'
import { Icon } from '@/common/components/Icon'
import { VerifyForm } from '../components/VerifyForm'
import logoImg from '@/assets/logo-removebg-preview.png'
import './VerifyPage.css'

const STEPS = [
  ['Student account', 'Name, RTU email, password'],
  ['Email code', 'Sent to your RTU email'],
  ['All set', 'Start using Tindahan'],
] as const

export function VerifyPage() {
  const [step, setStep] = useState<1 | 2 | 3>(1)

  // Always scroll down when entering the sign-up page
  useEffect(() => {
    const timer = setTimeout(() => {
      window.scrollTo({ top: document.documentElement.scrollHeight, behavior: 'smooth' })
    }, 1500)
    return () => clearTimeout(timer)
  }, [])

  const handleStep3Complete = () => {
    setStep(3)
  }

  const goBack = () => {
    if (window.history.length > 1) {
      window.history.back()
    } else {
      navigate('')
    }
  }

  const side = STEPS.map((s, i) => {
    const n = i + 1
    const done = step > n
    const cur = step === n
    return (
      <div
        key={n}
        className="step-row"
        style={{
          background: cur ? 'rgba(255,255,255,.14)' : 'rgba(255,255,255,.06)',
        }}
      >
        <span
          className="avatar"
          style={{
            background: done ? 'var(--green)' : cur ? 'var(--yellow)' : 'rgba(255,255,255,.18)',
          }}
        >
          {done ? <Icon name="check" size="sm" /> : String(n)}
        </span>
        <div>
          <b style={{ fontSize: 13, display: 'block' }}>{s[0]}</b>
          <span className="tiny" style={{ opacity: 0.75 }}>
            {s[1]}
          </span>
        </div>
      </div>
    )
  })

  return (
    <div className="split rev">
      <div className="l">
        <button className="logo" type="button" onClick={goBack}>
          <img className="logo-img" src={logoImg} alt="RTU Tindahan Campus Marketplace" />
        </button>
        <span className="eyebrow">JOIN YOUR CAMPUS</span>
        <h1>Sign up with a code sent to your RTU email.</h1>
        <div className="stack" style={{ gap: 8 }}>{side}</div>
        <div className="note blue">
          <Icon name="lock" />
          <span>
            Only students with an RTU student-number email can join. The code is sent to your RTU
            email only.
          </span>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div className="r">
        <div className="row between" style={{ marginBottom: 14, width: '100%' }}>
          <span className="eyebrow">STEP {step} OF 3</span>
          <span className="pill green">
            <Icon name="lock" size="sm" /> Secure sign up
          </span>
        </div>
        <VerifyForm onStep3Complete={handleStep3Complete} />
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}


// ===== C:\Users\Lian Andrew\Desktop\RTU_Tindahan_Capstone\RTU_Tindahan_Final\RTU_Tindahan\frontend\src\features\authentication\AuthContext.tsx =====
import { createContext, useCallback, useContext, useEffect, useMemo, useState, type ReactNode } from 'react'
import { apiFetch, getToken, setToken } from '@/common/api/client'
import type { User } from '@/common/types'

/**
 * AUTH CONTEXT â€” the Django backend is the source of truth
 * ------------------------------------------------------------
 * Replaced the prototype's offline authentication. Now:
 *
 *   Sign up   1. details  -> POST /auth/register/  (creates a visitor account
 *                           and emails a 6-digit code)
 *             2. code     -> POST /auth/verify-code/ (activates the account and
 *                           returns a token, so the user is signed in)
 *   Sign in                -> POST /auth/login/  (token, or an error code such
 *                           as "email_not_verified")
 *   Reload                 -> GET /auth/me/ with the stored token
 *   Sign out               -> POST /auth/logout/ deletes the token server-side
 *
 * The token lives in localStorage under `rtu_token` (see common/api/client.ts)
 * and is sent as `Authorization: Token <key>`.
 */

const STUDENT_EMAIL = /^\d{4}-\d{6}@rtu\.edu\.ph$/i
const LOGIN_EMAIL = /^[^@\s]+@rtu\.edu\.ph$/i

/** What the sign-up screen collects before the code is sent. */
export interface RegisterInput {
  first: string
  last: string
  email: string
  pass: string
  prog: string
  year: number | null
  consent: boolean
}

interface OtpState {
  /** Where the code was sent. Drives the "we emailed you" screen. */
  to: string
  /** When it was requested, so the screen can show a resend countdown. */
  sentAt: number
}

interface AuthValue {
  user: User | null
  /** true while restoring the session on first load */
  isLoading: boolean
  /** true while the login() API call is in flight (drives the persistent BrandLoader) */
  isSigningIn: boolean
  /** The pending sign-up code request (null before one has been sent) */
  otp: OtpState | null
  login: (email: string, password: string) => Promise<void>
  /** Step 2 of sign up: create the account and email a 6-digit code. */
  register: (input: RegisterInput) => Promise<void>
  /** Ask for another 6-digit code (30-second cooldown server-side). */
  resendCode: (email: string) => Promise<void>
  /** Step 3 of sign up: check the code and sign in. */
  confirmCode: (email: string, code: string) => Promise<void>
  logout: () => Promise<void>
}

const AuthContext = createContext<AuthValue | null>(null)

export function AuthProvider({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
  const [user, setUser] = useState<User | null>(null)
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState<boolean>(true)
  const [isSigningIn, setIsSigningIn] = useState<boolean>(false)
  const [otp, setOtp] = useState<OtpState | null>(null)

  // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
  // On first load: if a token is stored, ask the server who it belongs to.
  // A rejected token is dropped so the user simply appears signed out.
  // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
  useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false
    const restore = async () => {
      if (!getToken()) {
        setIsLoading(false)
        return
      }
      try {
        const me = await apiFetch<User>('/auth/me/')
        if (!cancelled) setUser(me)
      } catch {
        setToken(null)
      } finally {
        if (!cancelled) setIsLoading(false)
      }
    }
    void restore()
    return () => {
      cancelled = true
    }
  }, [])

  // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
  // Sign in
  // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
  const login = useCallback(async (email: string, password: string) => {
    const address = email.trim().toLowerCase()
    if (!LOGIN_EMAIL.test(address)) {
      throw new Error('Use your RTU email, like 2024-123456@rtu.edu.ph.')
    }
    if (!password) throw new Error('Enter your password.')

    setIsSigningIn(true)
    try {
      const data = await apiFetch<{ token: string; user: User }>('/auth/login/', {
        method: 'POST',
        body: { email: address, password },
      })
      setToken(data.token)
      setUser(data.user)
    } finally {
      setIsSigningIn(false)
    }
  }, [])

  // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
  // Sign up, step 1 -> 2: create the account, then email the code
  // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
  const register = useCallback(async (input: RegisterInput) => {
    const address = input.email.trim().toLowerCase()
    if (!STUDENT_EMAIL.test(address)) {
      throw new Error('Your RTU email must look like 2024-123456@rtu.edu.ph.')
    }
    if (!input.consent) {
      throw new Error('Accept the privacy notice to create your account.')
    }

    const displayName = `${input.first.trim()} ${input.last.trim()}`.trim()
    await apiFetch<{ detail: string; email: string }>('/auth/register/', {
      method: 'POST',
      body: {
        email: address,
        display_name: displayName,
        password: input.pass,
        password_confirm: input.pass,
        member_type: 'student',
        college: input.prog,
        ...(input.year ? { year_level: input.year } : {}),
        privacy_consent: input.consent,
      },
    })

    setOtp({ to: address, sentAt: Date.now() })
  }, [])

  const resendCode = useCallback(async (email: string) => {
    const address = email.trim().toLowerCase()
    await apiFetch<{ detail: string }>('/auth/resend-code/', {
      method: 'POST',
      body: { email: address },
    })
    setOtp({ to: address, sentAt: Date.now() })
  }, [])

  // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
  // Sign up, step 3: the code activates the account and signs the user in
  // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
  const confirmCode = useCallback(async (email: string, code: string) => {
    const address = email.trim().toLowerCase()
    const digits = String(code).replace(/\s/g, '')
    if (!/^\d{6}$/.test(digits)) {
      throw new Error('Enter the 6 digits from the email.')
    }

    const data = await apiFetch<{ token: string; user: User }>(
      '/auth/verify-code/',
      { method: 'POST', body: { email: address, code: digits } },
    )
    setToken(data.token)
    setUser(data.user)
    setOtp(null)
  }, [])

  // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
  // Sign out
  // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
  const logout = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      await apiFetch('/auth/logout/', { method: 'POST' })
    } catch {
      /* the token may already be gone; local state still has to clear */
    }
    setToken(null)
    setUser(null)
    setOtp(null)
  }, [])

  const value = useMemo(
    () => ({ user, isLoading, isSigningIn, otp, login, register, resendCode, confirmCode, logout }),
    [user, isLoading, isSigningIn, otp, login, register, resendCode, confirmCode, logout],
  )
  return <AuthContext.Provider value={value}>{children}</AuthContext.Provider>
}

// eslint-disable-next-line react-refresh/only-export-components
export function useAuth(): AuthValue {
  const ctx = useContext(AuthContext)
  if (!ctx) throw new Error('useAuth must be used inside <AuthProvider>')
  return ctx
}

 * Auth-specific types.
 */

import type { User } from '@/common/types'

export interface LoginCredentials {
  email: string
  password: string
}

export interface AuthState {
  user: User | null
  isAuthenticated: boolean
  isLoading: boolean
}

export type AuthAction =
  | { type: 'LOGIN_START' }
  | { type: 'LOGIN_SUCCESS'; payload: User }
  | { type: 'LOGIN_FAILURE'; payload: string }
  | { type: 'LOGOUT' }

export interface MockUser {
  email: string
  password: string
  user: User
}

  position: relative;
  border-radius: 20px;
  overflow: hidden;
  aspect-ratio: 4 / 3;
  background: var(--navy2);
  box-shadow: 0 10px 34px rgba(26, 47, 87, 0.2);
  min-width: 0;
  isolation: isolate;
}

  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;

// ===== C:\Users\Lian Andrew\Desktop\RTU_Tindahan_Capstone\RTU_Tindahan_Final\RTU_Tindahan\frontend\src\features\core\components\HeroCarousel.tsx =====
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react'
import { Icon } from '@/common/components/Icon'
import { ICON_PATHS, type IconName } from '@/common/components/icons'
import './HeroCarousel.css'

/**
 * Marketing slides for the landing page (same four as the prototype).
 * These are fixed texts, not marketplace data.
 * To change a slide: edit this list. `tone` is a gradient class in HeroCarousel.css.
 */
interface Slide {
  tone: string
  tag: string
  title: string
  text: string
  icons: [IconName, IconName, IconName]
}

const SLIDES: Slide[] = [
  { tone: 't-food', tag: 'Food and snacks', title: 'Merienda between classes',
    text: 'Home-cooked snacks and drinks from RTU students, ready for campus pickup.', icons: ['bowl', 'cup', 'tag'] },
  { tone: 't-study', tag: 'Books and supplies', title: 'Books, notes and school supplies',
    text: 'Textbooks, calculators and supplies at student prices.', icons: ['book', 'calc', 'note'] },
  { tone: 't-print', tag: 'Student services', title: 'Services from students',
    text: 'Printing, tutoring and other help from students who are free when you are.', icons: ['print', 'user', 'clock'] },
  { tone: 't-merch', tag: 'RTU merchandise', title: 'Official RTU items',
    text: 'Uniforms, books and merchandise published by RTU staff.', icons: ['shirt', 'store', 'shield'] },
]

const AUTOPLAY_MS = 6500

/** One decorative picture made of three big icons on soft circles. */
function SlideArt({ icons }: { icons: Slide['icons'] }) {
  const glyph = (name: IconName, x: number, y: number, scale: number) => (
    <g
      transform={`translate(${x} ${y}) scale(${scale})`}
      fill="none"
      stroke="#fff"
      strokeWidth="1.4"
      strokeLinecap="round"
      strokeLinejoin="round"
      dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: ICON_PATHS[name] }}
    />
  )
  return (
    <svg className="car-art" viewBox="0 0 400 260" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet" aria-hidden="true">
      <circle cx="336" cy="60" r="92" fill="rgba(255,255,255,.10)" />
      <circle cx="52" cy="226" r="74" fill="rgba(255,255,255,.08)" />
      <circle cx="200" cy="130" r="68" fill="rgba(255,255,255,.18)" />
      {glyph(icons[0], 152, 82, 4)}
      <rect x="88" y="150" width="54" height="54" rx="14" fill="rgba(255,255,255,.22)" />
      {glyph(icons[1], 97, 159, 1.5)}
      <rect x="262" y="40" width="50" height="50" rx="14" fill="rgba(255,255,255,.22)" />
      {glyph(icons[2], 270, 48, 1.4)}
    </svg>
  )
}

/**
 * Slideshow in the landing hero. Features: previous/next, dots, pause button,
 * auto-advance (stops on hover/focus, and when the visitor prefers reduced
 * motion), and Left/Right arrow keys.
 */
export function HeroCarousel() {
  const [index, setIndex] = useState(0)
  const [paused, setPaused] = useState(
    () => window.matchMedia?.('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches ?? false,
  )
  const [hovering, setHovering] = useState(false)
  const count = SLIDES.length

  const go = (i: number) => setIndex(((i % count) + count) % count)

  useEffect(() => {
    if (paused || hovering) return
    const id = window.setInterval(() => setIndex((i) => (i + 1) % count), AUTOPLAY_MS)
    return () => window.clearInterval(id)
  }, [paused, hovering, count, index])

  const onKeyDown = (e: React.KeyboardEvent) => {
    if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft') go(index - 1)
    if (e.key === 'ArrowRight') go(index + 1)
  }

  return (
    <div
      className="car"
      role="region"
      aria-roledescription="carousel"
      aria-label="Marketplace highlights"
      onKeyDown={onKeyDown}
      onMouseEnter={() => setHovering(true)}
      onMouseLeave={() => setHovering(false)}
      onFocus={() => setHovering(true)}
      onBlur={() => setHovering(false)}
    >
      <div className="car-track">
        {SLIDES.map((s, i) => (
          <div
            key={s.title}
            className={`car-slide ${s.tone} ${i === index ? 'on' : ''}`}
            role="group"
            aria-roledescription="slide"
            aria-label={`${i + 1} of ${count}`}
            aria-hidden={i === index ? undefined : true}
          >
            <SlideArt icons={s.icons} />
            <div className="car-cap">
              <span className="pill yellow">{s.tag}</span>
              <b>{s.title}</b>
              <p>{s.text}</p>
            </div>
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>

      <button type="button" className="car-nav prev" aria-label="Previous slide" onClick={() => go(index - 1)}>
        <Icon name="chev" />
      </button>
      <button type="button" className="car-nav next" aria-label="Next slide" onClick={() => go(index + 1)}>
        <Icon name="chev" />
      </button>

      <div className="car-bar">
        <div className="car-dots" role="group" aria-label="Choose a slide">
          {SLIDES.map((s, i) => (
            <button
              key={s.title}
              type="button"
              className={`car-dot ${i === index ? 'on' : ''}`}
              aria-label={`Show slide ${i + 1}`}
              aria-current={i === index ? 'true' : undefined}
              onClick={() => go(i)}
            />
          ))}
        </div>
        <button
          type="button"
          className="car-pause"
          aria-label={paused ? 'Play slideshow' : 'Pause slideshow'}
          onClick={() => setPaused((p) => !p)}
        >
          <svg className="ico sm" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true">
            {paused ? <path d="m8 5 11 7-11 7z" /> : <path d="M8 5v14M16 5v14" />}
          </svg>
        </button>
      </div>
      <p className="sr-only" aria-live="polite">{`Slide ${index + 1} of ${count}`}</p>
    </div>
  )
}

// ===== C:\Users\Lian Andrew\Desktop\RTU_Tindahan_Capstone\RTU_Tindahan_Final\RTU_Tindahan\frontend\src\features\core\components\PubTop.tsx =====
import { useState, useCallback, useEffect, useRef } from 'react'
import logoImg from '@/assets/logo-removebg-preview.png'
import { navigate, useRoute } from '@/common/router/router'
import './PubTop.css'

export type PubTopSection = 'about' | 'insights' | 'help'

interface PubTopProps {
onSection?: (section: PubTopSection) => void
onNavigate?: (route: string) => void
}

export function PubTop({ onSection, onNavigate }: PubTopProps = {}) {
const { path } = useRoute()
// null = no tab highlighted (at top / hero / after clicking logo)
const [activeSection, setActiveSection] = useState<PubTopSection | null>(null)
const [dropdownOpen, setDropdownOpen] = useState(false)
const [isMobile, setIsMobile] = useState(window.innerWidth <= 900)
const [mobileMenuOpen, setMobileMenuOpen] = useState(false)
// Prevents scroll spy from clearing the highlight right after a programmatic scroll
const isProgrammatic = useRef(false)

// Scroll spy: highlight the tab whose section is nearest the top of the viewport.
// When back at the hero (top of page), clear the highlight.
useEffect(() => {
    const handleScroll = () => {
    if (isProgrammatic.current) return

    const sections: { id: PubTopSection; elementId: string }[] = [
        { id: 'about', elementId: 'about' },
        { id: 'insights', elementId: 'insights' },
        { id: 'help', elementId: 'help' },
    ]
    let current: PubTopSection | undefined

    for (const { id, elementId } of sections) {
        const el = document.getElementById(elementId)
        if (el && el.getBoundingClientRect().top <= 120) {
        current = id
        }
    }

    setActiveSection(current ?? null)
    }

    handleScroll() // check on mount
    window.addEventListener('scroll', handleScroll, { passive: true })
    return () => window.removeEventListener('scroll', handleScroll)
}, [])

// Track mobile viewport (matches the max-width: 900px breakpoint in PubTop.css)
useEffect(() => {
    const onResize = () => setIsMobile(window.innerWidth <= 900)
    window.addEventListener('resize', onResize)
    return () => window.removeEventListener('resize', onResize)
}, [])

// Scroll to a section stored in sessionStorage after navigating to the landing page
// from a non-landing page (e.g. student-sellers or store guest pages).
useEffect(() => {
    const isLanding = path === '' || path === 'landing'
    if (!isLanding) return

    const target = sessionStorage.getItem('rtu:scroll-to-section')
    if (!target) return

    sessionStorage.removeItem('rtu:scroll-to-section')

    const timer = setTimeout(() => {
    isProgrammatic.current = true
    setActiveSection(target as PubTopSection)
    const el = document.getElementById(target)
    el?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' })
    setTimeout(() => (isProgrammatic.current = false), 800)
    }, 100)

    return () => clearTimeout(timer)
}, [path])

// Close the About Us dropdown when clicking outside the nav
useEffect(() => {
    if (!dropdownOpen) return
    const onDocClick = (e: MouseEvent) => {
    const target = e.target as Node
    const nav = document.querySelector('.pub-top nav')
    if (nav && !nav.contains(target)) {
        setDropdownOpen(false)
    }
    }
    window.addEventListener('click', onDocClick)
    return () => window.removeEventListener('click', onDocClick)
}, [dropdownOpen])

// Close mobile menu when clicking outside
useEffect(() => {
    if (!mobileMenuOpen) return
    const onDocClick = (e: MouseEvent) => {
    const target = e.target as Node
    const btn = document.querySelector('.mobile-menu-btn')
    const panel = document.querySelector('.mobile-menu-panel')
    if (btn && !btn.contains(target) && panel && !panel.contains(target)) {
        setMobileMenuOpen(false)
    }
    }
    window.addEventListener('click', onDocClick)
    return () => window.removeEventListener('click', onDocClick)
}, [mobileMenuOpen])

// Logo: scroll smoothly to top and clear the highlight
const handleLogo = useCallback(() => {
    isProgrammatic.current = true
    // Set the hash directly (useRoute picks it up via hashchange) so the
    // router's instant scroll doesn't override the smooth scroll below.
    window.location.hash = '#/'
    window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'smooth' })
    setActiveSection(null)
    setTimeout(() => (isProgrammatic.current = false), 800)
}, [])

// Auth buttons: go to their proper pages.
// On mobile, flag the next page to scroll down after 3 seconds (the timer
// can't live in PubTop because this component unmounts on navigation).
const handleAuth = useCallback((route: string) => {
    onNavigate?.(route)

    if (isMobile && (route === 'login' || route === 'register')) {
        sessionStorage.setItem('rtu:scroll-after-login', 'true')
    }

    navigate(route)
}, [isMobile, onNavigate])

// Nav tabs: highlight clicked tab and scroll to its section.
// If not on the landing page, navigate there first and store the target
// section in sessionStorage so the landing page can scroll to it on mount.
const handleSection = useCallback((section: PubTopSection) => {
    const isLanding = path === '' || path === 'landing'
    if (!isLanding) {
    sessionStorage.setItem('rtu:scroll-to-section', section)
    navigate('')
    setDropdownOpen(false)
    return
    }
    isProgrammatic.current = true
    onSection?.(section)
    setActiveSection(section)
    const el = document.getElementById(section)
    el?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' })
    setTimeout(() => (isProgrammatic.current = false), 800)
}, [path, onSection, navigate])

// Only show the About Us dropdown as active when on the landing page and a section is open.
// This prevents stale state from showing it as active on Student Sellers / Official RTU Store.
const isLanding = path === '' || path === 'landing'
const isDropdownActive =
    isLanding && (activeSection === 'about' || activeSection === 'insights' || activeSection === 'help')

return (
    <header className="pub-top">
    <button
        type="button"
        className="logo"
        onClick={handleLogo}
        aria-label="RTU Tindahan home"
    >
        <img className="logo-img" src={logoImg} alt="RTU Tindahan Campus Marketplace" />
    </button>

    <nav className="pub-top-nav" aria-label="Sections">
        {/* About Us dropdown: contains About Us (trigger), Insights, Need Help */}
        <div className="nav-dropdown" onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}>
        <button
            type="button"
            className={`nav-tab${isDropdownActive ? ' on' : ''} dropdown-trigger`}
            data-act="gnav"
            data-s="about"
            aria-current={isDropdownActive ? 'location' : undefined}
            aria-haspopup="true"
            aria-expanded={dropdownOpen}
            onClick={() => setDropdownOpen(!dropdownOpen)}
        >
            About Us<span className="dropdown-arrow"></span>
        </button>
        {dropdownOpen && (
            <div className="nav-dropdown-menu" role="menu">
            <button
                type="button"
                className="nav-dropdown-item"
                role="menuitem"
                onClick={() => {
                setDropdownOpen(false)
                handleSection('about')
                }}
            >
                About Us
            </button>
            <button
                type="button"
                className="nav-dropdown-item"
                role="menuitem"
                onClick={() => {
                setDropdownOpen(false)
                handleSection('insights')
                }}
            >
                Insights
            </button>
            <button
                type="button"
                className="nav-dropdown-item"
                role="menuitem"
                onClick={() => {
                setDropdownOpen(false)
                handleSection('help')
                }}
            >
                Need Help?
            </button>
            </div>
        )}
        </div>

        {/* Guest-facing marketplace buttons */}
        <button
        type="button"
        className={`nav-tab${path === 'student-sellers' ? ' on' : ''}`}
        aria-current={path === 'student-sellers' ? 'location' : undefined}
        onClick={() => {
        setDropdownOpen(false)
        navigate('student-sellers')
        }}
        >
        Student Sellers
        </button>
        <button
        type="button"
        className={`nav-tab${path === 'store' ? ' on' : ''}`}
        aria-current={path === 'store' ? 'location' : undefined}
        onClick={() => {
        setDropdownOpen(false)
        navigate('store')
        }}
        >
        Official RTU Store
        </button>
    </nav>

    <span className="pub-top-spacer" />

    <div className="pub-top-actions">
        {isMobile && (
        <button
            type="button"
            className="mobile-menu-btn"
            aria-expanded={mobileMenuOpen}
            onClick={() => setMobileMenuOpen(!mobileMenuOpen)}
        >
            â˜° Menu
        </button>
        )}
        {!isMobile && (
        <>
        <button
            type="button"
            className="btn ghost sm"
            onClick={() => handleAuth('login')}
            >
            Sign in
            </button>
        <button
            type="button"
            className="btn sm"
            onClick={() => handleAuth('register')}
            >
            Create account
            </button>
        </>
        )}
    </div>

    {isMobile && mobileMenuOpen && (
        <div className="mobile-menu-panel">
        <button
            type="button"
            className="mobile-menu-item"
            onClick={() => {
            setMobileMenuOpen(false)
            handleSection('about')
            }}
        >
            About Us
        </button>
        <button
            type="button"
            className="mobile-menu-item"
            onClick={() => {
            setMobileMenuOpen(false)
            handleSection('insights')
            }}
        >
            Insights
        </button>
        <button
            type="button"
            className="mobile-menu-item"
            onClick={() => {
            setMobileMenuOpen(false)
            handleSection('help')
            }}
        >
            Need Help?
        </button>
        <button
            type="button"
            className="mobile-menu-item"
            onClick={() => {
            setMobileMenuOpen(false)
            navigate('student-sellers')
            }}
        >
            Student Sellers
        </button>
        <button
            type="button"
            className="mobile-menu-item"
            onClick={() => {
            setMobileMenuOpen(false)
            navigate('store')
            }}
        >
            Official RTU Store
        </button>
        <div style={{ padding: '8px 16px', borderTop: '1px solid var(--line)', marginTop: 8, fontSize: 11, color: 'var(--ink)', textTransform: 'uppercase', letterSpacing: '0.5px' }}>
            Account
        </div>
        <button
            type="button"
            className="mobile-menu-item"
            onClick={() => {
            setMobileMenuOpen(false)
            handleAuth('login')
            }}
        >
            Sign in
        </button>
        <button
            type="button"
            className="mobile-menu-item"
            onClick={() => {
            setMobileMenuOpen(false)
            handleAuth('register')
            }}
        >
            Create account
        </button>
        </div>
    )}
    </header>
    )
}

// ===== C:\Users\Lian Andrew\Desktop\RTU_Tindahan_Capstone\RTU_Tindahan_Final\RTU_Tindahan\frontend\src\features\core\components\Sidebar.tsx =====
import { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react'
import { Icon } from '@/common/components/Icon'
import { Link } from '@/common/router/router'
import type { Role } from '@/common/types'
import { baoIsOfficialTxn, baoLowUnits, baoStatusOf } from '@/features/marketplace/baoHelpers'
import { FR_STATUS } from '@/features/marketplace/constants'
import { useTindahan } from '@/features/marketplace/context/TindahanContext'
import { APP_PAGES, NAV_SECTIONS, canSeeAdmin } from '../routes'
import './Sidebar.css'

interface SidebarProps {
  /** path of the page being shown, e.g. "browse" */
  activePath: string
  role: Role
  /** phone/tablet: is the slide-out drawer open? */
  open: boolean
  /** desktop: is the sidebar expanded? */
  isOpen: boolean
  onClose: () => void
  onToggle: () => void
}

const PATH_ALIASES: Record<string, string> = {
  market: 'marketplace',
  official: 'store',
  sellers: 'student-sellers',
  list: 'create',
  seller: 'shop',
  forumreports: 'forum-reports',
  'store-orders': 'baoorders',
  'store-inventory': 'baostock',
  post: 'forum',
  confirm: 'orders',
}

/**
 * NAVY SIDEBAR for signed-in pages. Menu items come from APP_PAGES (routes.ts).
 * On small screens it becomes a drawer opened by the hamburger button.
 * Sections are collapsible accordions; the yellow scrollbar appears on hover.
 */
export function Sidebar({ activePath, role, open, isOpen, onClose, onToggle }: SidebarProps) {
  const { db, currentAccount, isStaffUser, clearBrowseFilters } = useTindahan()

  const normalizedActive = PATH_ALIASES[activePath] || activePath
  const showAdmin = isStaffUser || canSeeAdmin(role)

  /** Tracks whether the user explicitly closed the sidebar via the toggle button.
   * When true, hover-to-expand is disabled until the button reopens it. */
  const [userClosed, setUserClosed] = useState(false)
  /** Tracks hover-to-open state. Triggered only by hovering the sidebar rail,
   * NOT the toggle button or its surrounding buffer. */
  const [isHoverOpen, setIsHoverOpen] = useState(false)
  /** Debounce timer for hover-to-open so quick passes don't flash the sidebar open. */
  const hoverTimerRef = useRef<number | null>(null)

  // Reset user-closed and hover-open flags when the button reopens the sidebar
  useEffect(() => {
    if (isOpen) {
      setUserClosed(false)
      setIsHoverOpen(false)
    }
  }, [isOpen])

  const handleToggle = () => {
    setUserClosed(!isOpen)
    setIsHoverOpen(false)
    onToggle()
  }

  /** Hover-to-open: only the sidebar rail triggers this. The toggle button wrapper
   * has its own handlers that cancel any pending open timer. */
  const handleSidebarMouseEnter = () => {
    if (userClosed) return
    hoverTimerRef.current = window.setTimeout(() => setIsHoverOpen(true), 100)
  }

  const handleSidebarMouseLeave = () => {
    if (hoverTimerRef.current) {
      window.clearTimeout(hoverTimerRef.current)
      hoverTimerRef.current = null
    }
    setIsHoverOpen(false)
  }

  /** Toggle button buffer: hovering here must NOT open the sidebar.
   * Cancels any pending hover-open timer so the sidebar stays closed. */
  const handleToggleBufferMouseEnter = () => {
    if (hoverTimerRef.current) {
      window.clearTimeout(hoverTimerRef.current)
      hoverTimerRef.current = null
    }
    setIsHoverOpen(false)
  }

  const handleToggleBufferMouseLeave = () => {
    // Intentionally empty: the toggle button is click-only, never hover-open.
  }

  const activeOrders = (currentAccount?.orders || []).filter((o) => o.tab === 'Active').length
  const newSellerReqs = (currentAccount?.sellerReq || []).filter((r) => r.state === 'new').length
  const openFlags = db.flags.filter((f) => f.state === 'open').length
  const openForumReports = db.freports.filter((r) => r.status === FR_STATUS.pending).length
  const baoWaitingCount = db.txn
    .filter(baoIsOfficialTxn)
    .filter((t) => baoStatusOf(t) === 'Request Received').length
  const baoLowCount = baoLowUnits(db.official).length

  const badgeFor = (path: string): number => {
    if (path === 'orders') return activeOrders
    if (path === 'shop') return newSellerReqs
    if (path === 'moderation') return openFlags
    if (path === 'baoorders') return baoWaitingCount
    if (path === 'baostock') return baoLowCount
    if (path === 'forum-reports') return openForumReports
    return 0
  }

  /** Track which sections are collapsed (accordion state). */
  const [collapsedSections, setCollapsedSections] = useState<Set<string>>(new Set())

  const isSectionCollapsed = (section: string) => collapsedSections.has(section)
  const toggleSection = (section: string) => {
    setCollapsedSections((prev) => {
      const next = new Set(prev)
      if (next.has(section)) next.delete(section)
      else next.add(section)
      return next
    })
  }

  return (
    <>
      <div
        className={`scrim ${open ? 'show' : ''}`}
        onClick={onClose}
        aria-hidden="true"
      >
        {open && (
          <span className="sr-only" aria-live="polite">
            Navigation drawer open. Press Escape or click outside to close.
          </span>
        )}
      </div>
      <aside
        className={`side ${isOpen ? '' : 'collapsed'} ${!isOpen && userClosed ? 'user-closed' : ''} ${isHoverOpen ? 'hover-open' : ''} ${open ? 'open' : ''}`}
        aria-label="Main"
        onMouseEnter={handleSidebarMouseEnter}
        onMouseLeave={handleSidebarMouseLeave}
      >
        {/* Toggle button + surrounding buffer zone.
           Rendered as a sibling of .sidebar-inner (NOT inside the hover target)
           so hovering the button never triggers hover-to-open. */}
        <div
          className="toggle-wrapper"
          onMouseEnter={handleToggleBufferMouseEnter}
          onMouseLeave={handleToggleBufferMouseLeave}
        >
          <button
            type="button"
            className="sidebar-toggle"
            aria-expanded={isOpen}
            aria-label="Toggle navigation sidebar"
            title={isOpen ? 'Collapse sidebar' : 'Expand sidebar'}
            onClick={handleToggle}
          >
            <span className={`toggle-arrow ${(isOpen || isHoverOpen) ? '' : 'rotate'}`} aria-hidden="true" />
          </button>
        </div>

        <div className="sidebar-inner">
          {/* .sidebar-scroll gives the yellow/gold scrollbar on hover */}
          <div className="sidebar-scroll">
            {NAV_SECTIONS.filter((s) => s !== 'ADMIN' || showAdmin).map((section, i, arr) => (
              <div key={section} className="side-group">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  className={`sect ${isSectionCollapsed(section) ? 'collapsed' : ''}`}
                  aria-expanded={!isSectionCollapsed(section)}
                  aria-controls={`section-${section}`}
                  onClick={() => toggleSection(section)}
                  onKeyDown={(e) => {
                    if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') {
                      e.preventDefault()
                      toggleSection(section)
                    }
                  }}
                >
                  {section}
                  <Icon name="chev" size="sm" className="sect-chev" aria-hidden="true" />
                </button>
                <div
                  id={`section-${section}`}
                  className={`section-content ${isSectionCollapsed(section) ? 'collapsed-section' : ''}`}
                >
                  {APP_PAGES.filter((p) => p.section === section).map((p) => {
                    const badge = badgeFor(p.path)
                    const isOn = normalizedActive === p.path
                    return (
                      <Link
                        key={p.path}
                        to={p.path}
                        className={`nav ${isOn ? 'on' : ''}`}
                        aria-current={isOn ? 'page' : undefined}
                        aria-label={p.title}
                        onClick={() => {
                          if (p.path === 'browse') {
                            clearBrowseFilters()
                          }
                          onClose()
                        }}
                      >
                        <Icon name={p.icon} aria-hidden="true" />
                        <span>{showAdmin && p.path === 'create' ? 'Admin | Sell an Item' : showAdmin && p.path === 'shop' ? 'Admin | RTU Shop' : p.title}</span>
                        {badge > 0 && <span className="badge" aria-label={`${badge} notifications`}>{badge}</span>}
                      </Link>
                    )
                  })}
                </div>
                {i < arr.length - 1 && <hr className="nav-divider" aria-hidden="true" />}
              </div>
            ))}

            <div className="campus">
              <b>Pasig Campus only</b>
              <span>Meetups happen on campus. RTU Tindahan does not provide delivery or logistics.</span>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </aside>
    </>
  )
}

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react'
import { Icon } from '@/common/components/Icon'
import { Link, navigate } from '@/common/router/router'
import { useTheme } from '@/common/hooks/useTheme'
import { useAuth } from '@/features/authentication'
import type { User } from '@/common/types'
import { ago, initialsOf } from '@/features/marketplace/constants'
import { useTindahan } from '@/features/marketplace/context/TindahanContext'
import { imgSrc } from '@/features/marketplace/imageStore'
import logoImg from '@/assets/logo-removebg-preview.png'
import './Topbar.css'

const MEMBER_LABEL: Record<User['member_type'], string> = {
  student: 'Student',
  faculty: 'Faculty',
  personnel: 'Personnel',
}

interface TopbarProps {
  user: User
  onMenuClick: () => void
  onCloseMobileMenu?: () => void
}

/**
 * TOP BAR for signed-in pages: menu button (phones), search, messages,
 * notifications, cart and the user menu.
 */
export function Topbar({ user, onMenuClick, onCloseMobileMenu }: TopbarProps) {
  const { logout } = useAuth()
  const { theme, toggle } = useTheme()
  const {
    currentAccount,
    isStaffUser,
    cartCount,
    unreadMessagesCount,
    browseState,
    browseFor,
    markAllNotifsRead,
    openNotification,
  } = useTindahan()

  const [open, setOpen] = useState<'' | 'bell' | 'user'>('')
  const [query, setQuery] = useState(browseState.q || '')

  useEffect(() => {
    setQuery(browseState.q || '')
  }, [browseState.q])

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open) return
    const onDocClick = () => setOpen('')
    window.addEventListener('click', onDocClick)
    return () => window.removeEventListener('click', onDocClick)
  }, [open])

  const submitSearch = (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault()
    const q = query.trim()
    browseFor({ q, goBrowse: true })
    onCloseMobileMenu?.()
  }

  const toggleMenu = (which: 'bell' | 'user') => setOpen((cur) => (cur === which ? '' : which))

  const notifs = currentAccount?.notifs || []
  const unreadNotifs = notifs.filter((n) => !n.read).length
  const displayName = currentAccount?.name || user.display_name
  const avatarSrc =
    (currentAccount?.avatar ? imgSrc(currentAccount.avatar) : null) || user.profile_photo || null
  const init = initialsOf(displayName)
  const subLabel = currentAccount?.aff || MEMBER_LABEL[user.member_type] || 'Student'

  return (
    <header className="top">
      <div className="top-start">
        <Link
          to="marketplace"
          className="logo-link"
          aria-label="RTU Tindahan Home"
          onClick={() => {
            setOpen('')
            onCloseMobileMenu?.()
          }}
        >
          <img src={logoImg} alt="RTU Tindahan" className="topbar-logo" />
        </Link>
        <button
          type="button"
          className="menu-btn"
          aria-label="Open menu"
          onClick={() => {
            setOpen('')
            onMenuClick()
          }}
        >
          <Icon name="menu" />
        </button>
      </div>

      <form className="search" role="search" onSubmit={submitSearch}>
        <Icon name="search" size="sm" />
        <input
          placeholder="Search textbooks, uniforms, calculators or course codes..."
          aria-label="Search marketplace"
          value={query}
          onChange={(e) => setQuery(e.target.value)}
          onFocus={() => onCloseMobileMenu?.()}
        />
      </form>

      <div className="top-end">
        <div className="right-actions">
          <Link
            to="messages"
            className="iconbtn"
            aria-label="Messages"
            title="Messages"
            onClick={() => {
              setOpen('')
              onCloseMobileMenu?.()
            }}
          >
            <Icon name="msg" />
            {unreadMessagesCount > 0 && <span className="dot">{unreadMessagesCount}</span>}
          </Link>

          <div className="rel" onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}>
            <button
              type="button"
              className={`iconbtn bellbtn ${open === 'bell' ? 'is-open' : ''}`.trim()}
              aria-label="Notifications"
              aria-haspopup="true"
              aria-expanded={open === 'bell'}
              onClick={() => {
                toggleMenu('bell')
                onCloseMobileMenu?.()
              }}
            >
              <Icon name="bell" />
              {unreadNotifs > 0 && <span className="dot">{unreadNotifs}</span>}
            </button>
            {open === 'bell' && (
              <div className="menu notif-menu" role="region" aria-label="Notifications">
                <div className="row between" style={{ padding: '6px 10px' }}>
                  <b className="small">Notifications</b>
                  {unreadNotifs > 0 && (
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      className="link"
                      onClick={() => markAllNotifsRead()}
                    >
                      Mark all read
                    </button>
                  )}
                </div>
                <hr />
                {notifs.length ? (
                  notifs.slice(0, 12).map((n, i) => (
                    <button
                      key={i}
                      type="button"
                      className={`mi notif ${n.read ? 'read' : 'unread'}`}
                      onClick={() => {
                        setOpen('')
                        openNotification(i)
                      }}
                    >
                      <span className="nbul" aria-hidden="true" />
                      <span className="grow">
                        <span className="ntxt">{n.t}</span>
                        <span className="tiny muted">{n.at ? ago(n.at) : n.ts}</span>
                      </span>
                    </button>
                  ))
                ) : (
                  <div className="small muted" style={{ padding: 12 }}>
                    Nothing yet. Updates about your requests show up here.
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
            )}
          </div>

          <Link
            to="cart"
            className="iconbtn"
            aria-label="Pickup cart"
            title="Pickup cart"
            onClick={() => {
              setOpen('')
              onCloseMobileMenu?.()
            }}
          >
            <Icon name="cart" />
            {cartCount > 0 && <span className="dot">{cartCount}</span>}
          </Link>

          <div className="rel" onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}>
            <button
              type="button"
              className="userbtn"
              aria-haspopup="true"
              aria-expanded={open === 'user'}
              onClick={() => {
                toggleMenu('user')
                onCloseMobileMenu?.()
              }}
            >
              <span className="avw av-sm">
                <span className={`avatar ${isStaffUser ? 'staff' : ''}`.trim()}>
                  {avatarSrc ? <img className="avimg" src={avatarSrc} alt={displayName} /> : init}
                </span>
              </span>
              <span className="user-text-slot">
                <b title={displayName} className="user-name">
                  {displayName}
                </b>
                <span title={`${subLabel} Â· Pasig`} className="user-sub">
                  {subLabel} Â· Pasig
                </span>
              </span>
            </button>
            {open === 'user' && (
              <div className="menu" role="menu">
                <div style={{ padding: '8px 10px' }}>
                  <b style={{ fontSize: 13 }}>{displayName}</b>
                  <div className="tiny muted" style={{ overflowWrap: 'anywhere' }}>
                    {currentAccount?.email || user.email} Â· {currentAccount?.sid || user.id}
                  </div>
                </div>
                <hr />
                <Link to="profile" className="mi" role="menuitem" onClick={() => setOpen('')}>
                  <Icon name="user" /> My profile
                </Link>
                <Link to="orders" className="mi" role="menuitem" onClick={() => setOpen('')}>
                  <Icon name="order" /> My orders
                </Link>
                <Link to="shop" className="mi" role="menuitem" onClick={() => setOpen('')}>
                  <Icon name="shop" /> {isStaffUser ? 'Admin | RTU Shop' : 'My shop'}
                </Link>
                <Link to="favorites" className="mi" role="menuitem" onClick={() => setOpen('')}>
                  <Icon name="heart" /> Favorites ({currentAccount?.favs.length || 0})
                </Link>
                <Link to="messages" className="mi" role="menuitem" onClick={() => setOpen('')}>
                  <Icon name="msg" /> Messages
                  {unreadMessagesCount > 0 ? ` (${unreadMessagesCount})` : ''}
                </Link>
                <Link to="help" className="mi" role="menuitem" onClick={() => setOpen('')}>
                  <Icon name="info" /> Help Center & Manual
                </Link>
                <button type="button" className="mi" role="menuitem" onClick={toggle}>
                  <Icon name={theme === 'dark' ? 'sun' : 'moon'} />{' '}
                  {theme === 'dark' ? 'Switch to light theme' : 'Switch to dark theme'}
                </button>
                {isStaffUser && (
                  <>
                    <hr />
                    <Link to="moderation" className="mi" role="menuitem" onClick={() => setOpen('')}>
                      <Icon name="flag" /> Listing approval
                    </Link>
                    <Link to="staff" className="mi" role="menuitem" onClick={() => setOpen('')}>
                      <Icon name="sliders" /> Staff tools
                    </Link>
                  </>
                )}
                <hr />
                <button
                  type="button"
                  className="mi"
                  role="menuitem"
                  style={{ color: 'var(--red)' }}
                  onClick={() => {
                    setOpen('')
                    void logout().then(() => navigate(''))
                  }}
                >
                  <Icon name="logout" /> Sign out
                </button>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </header>
  )
}

// ===== C:\Users\Lian Andrew\Desktop\RTU_Tindahan_Capstone\RTU_Tindahan_Final\RTU_Tindahan\frontend\src\features\core\layouts\AppLayout.tsx =====
import { useState, useEffect, type ReactNode } from 'react'
import type { User } from '@/common/types'
import { GlobalOverlays } from '@/features/marketplace/components/GlobalOverlays'
import { Sidebar } from '../components/Sidebar'
import { Topbar } from '../components/Topbar'
import { SiteFooter } from '../components/SiteFooter'
import './AppLayout.css'

interface AppLayoutProps {
  user: User
  activePath: string
  children: ReactNode
}

/**
 * LAYOUT for signed-in pages:
 *   [ Topbar (full width, fixed)         ]
 *   [ Sidebar (fixed, collapsible) ] [ page content ]
 *               [ footer under page only ]
 * Page components only provide the content; this layout adds everything else.
 *
 * The exact height of the fixed topbar + scalloped awning is measured via
 * ResizeObserver and exposed as --header-offset so the sidebar and <main>
   can position themselves precisely below it without any overlap or guesswork.
 */
export function AppLayout({ user, activePath, children }: AppLayoutProps) {
  const [isMobileMenuOpen, setIsMobileMenuOpen] = useState(false)
  const [isSidebarOpen, setIsSidebarOpen] = useState(
    typeof window !== 'undefined' ? window.innerWidth >= 768 : true
  )

  // Re-evaluate default open/closed state when the viewport crosses 768px.
  // Close the mobile drawer when resizing to desktop (>= 768px).
  useEffect(() => {
    const onResize = () => {
      const wasMobile = window.innerWidth < 768
      setIsSidebarOpen(window.innerWidth >= 768)
      if (!wasMobile && window.innerWidth >= 768 && isMobileMenuOpen) {
        setIsMobileMenuOpen(false)
      }
    }
    window.addEventListener('resize', onResize)
    return () => window.removeEventListener('resize', onResize)
  }, [isMobileMenuOpen])

  // Measure the fixed topbar+awning height (--header-offset) AND navbar-only height (--navbar-height).
  // --header-offset stays untouched for desktop and <main>. --navbar-height is mobile-only.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (typeof window === 'undefined' || !ResizeObserver) return

    const setOffset = () => {
      const el = document.querySelector('.top')
      if (!el) return

      const rect = el.getBoundingClientRect()
      // --navbar-height: just the navy bar content height (mobile drawer anchors here)
      document.documentElement.style.setProperty(
        '--navbar-height',
        `${Math.ceil(rect.height)}px`
      )
      // --header-offset: navbar + scalloped awning strip (+10px). Untouched for desktop/<main>.
      document.documentElement.style.setProperty(
        '--header-offset',
        `${Math.ceil(rect.height) + 10}px`
      )
    }

    setOffset()
    const ro = new ResizeObserver(() => setOffset())
    ro.observe(document.documentElement)
    window.addEventListener('resize', setOffset)
    return () => {
      ro.disconnect()
      window.removeEventListener('resize', setOffset)
    }
  }, [])

  // Mobile drawer (< 900px): lock background scroll and close on Escape
  useEffect(() => {
    const isMobile = window.innerWidth < 900
    if (!isMobileMenuOpen || !isMobile) return

    // Save scroll position so the page doesn't jump when we lock it
    const scrollY = window.scrollY

    document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden'
    document.body.style.position = 'fixed'
    document.body.style.top = `-${scrollY}px`
    document.body.style.left = '0'
    document.body.style.width = '100%'
    document.documentElement.style.overflow = 'hidden'
    document.documentElement.style.touchAction = 'none'
    document.body.style.touchAction = 'none'

    const onKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.key === 'Escape') setIsMobileMenuOpen(false)
    }

    window.addEventListener('keydown', onKeyDown)

    return () => {
      document.body.style.removeProperty('overflow')
      document.body.style.removeProperty('position')
      document.body.style.removeProperty('top')
      document.body.style.removeProperty('left')
      document.body.style.removeProperty('width')
      document.documentElement.style.removeProperty('overflow')
      document.documentElement.style.removeProperty('touchAction')
      document.body.style.removeProperty('touchAction')
      window.scrollTo(0, scrollY)
      window.removeEventListener('keydown', onKeyDown)
    }
  }, [isMobileMenuOpen])

  // Safety net: close the mobile drawer whenever the route changes,
  // so topbar navigation always dismisses the drawer.
  useEffect(() => {
    setIsMobileMenuOpen(false)
  }, [activePath])
  return (
    <div className={`app ${isSidebarOpen ? 'sidebar-open' : ''} ${isMobileMenuOpen ? 'mobile-drawer-open' : ''}`}>
      <Topbar
        user={user}
        onMenuClick={() => setIsMobileMenuOpen((prev) => !prev)}
        onCloseMobileMenu={() => setIsMobileMenuOpen(false)}
      />
      {/* Mobile-only click-outside backdrop â€” renders only when drawer is open (< 768px) */}
      {isMobileMenuOpen && (
        <div
          className="mobile-backdrop"
          onClick={() => setIsMobileMenuOpen(false)}
          aria-hidden="true"
        />
      )}
      <div className="main">
        <Sidebar
          activePath={activePath}
          role={user.role}
          open={isMobileMenuOpen}
          isOpen={isSidebarOpen}
          onClose={() => setIsMobileMenuOpen(false)}
          onToggle={() => setIsSidebarOpen((prev) => !prev)}
        />
        <div className="page-wrap">
          <main className="page">
            <div className="page-content-shell">{children}</div>
          </main>
          <SiteFooter variant="member" />
        </div>
      </div>
      <GlobalOverlays />
    </div>
  )
}

            <ul className="small muted" style={{ lineHeight: 1.55, marginBottom: 20, paddingLeft: 20 }}>
              {popup === 'guidelines' ? (
                <>
                  <li>Be honest about what you sell, including its condition.</li>
                  <li>Meet only at visible spots inside Pasig Campus.</li>
                  <li>Pay in person. RTU Tindahan never handles money or delivery.</li>
                  <li>No exam answers, vaping products, medicines, resale tickets or weapons.</li>
                  <li>Treat every student and staff member with respect.</li>
                </>
              ) : (
                <>
                  <li>Exam answers, test papers and similar material</li>
                  <li>Medicines, supplements and regulated health products</li>
                  <li>Vaping products and tobacco</li>
                  <li>Tickets sold above face value</li>
                  <li>Weapons and dangerous items</li>
                  <li>Anything that cannot be handed over safely on campus</li>
                </>
              )}
            </ul>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'row', gap: 8, justifyContent: 'flex-end' }}>
              <button type="button" className="btn" onClick={() => setPopup(null)}>
                Got it
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* ---------- POPUP: SIGN IN TO CONTINUE (locked tiles) ---------- */}
      {lockedPopup && (
        <div className="popup-overlay" onClick={() => setLockedPopup(null)}>
          <div className="popup-box" onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}>
            <div className="row" style={{ gap: 8, marginBottom: 16 }}>
              <Icon name="lock" size="sm" />
              <span style={{ fontWeight: 600, color: 'var(--ink)' }}>Sign in to continue</span>
            </div>
            <p className="small muted" style={{ lineHeight: 1.55, marginBottom: 20 }}>
              You need a verified RTU account to {lockedPopup.why}. Sign in with your RTU email, or create an account if you are new. You can keep browsing the Books and Merchandise pages as a guest.
            </p>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'row', gap: 8, justifyContent: 'flex-end' }}>
              <button type="button" className="btn ghost" onClick={() => setLockedPopup(null)}>
                Not now
              </button>
              <button type="button" className="btn ghost" onClick={() => {
                setLockedPopup(null)
                navigate('register')
              }}>
                Create account
              </button>
              <button type="button" className="btn" onClick={() => {
                setLockedPopup(null)
                navigate('login')
              }}>
                <Icon name="lock" size="sm" /> Sign in
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </>
  )
}
