/**
 * ROUTES: decides which page to show.
 *  - Visitors (not signed in): landing page, login, register/verify, books, merch.
 *  - Signed-in users: all student, seller, community, and admin pages inside AppLayout.
 *  - Wrong combination: redirect (visitor opens a member page -> login).
 */

/** Import page icons from src/assets/icons/ so they are version-controlled and processed by Vite. */
import buyMarketplaceIco from '@/assets/icons/buy-marketplace.ico'

/** Maps each signed-in route path to its .ico favicon. */
const PAGE_FAVICONS: Record<string, string> = {

function renderActiveRoute(path: string, user: { email: string; role: string } | null) {
  const active = path === '' || path === 'landing' ? 'marketplace' : path

  // ----- signed-in -----
  if (user) {
    switch (active) {
      case 'marketplace':
      case 'market':
        return <MarketplacePage />
      case 'browse':
        return <BrowsePage />
      case 'product':
        return <ProductPage />
      case 'store':
      case 'official':
        return <OfficialStorePage />
      case 'student-sellers':
      case 'sellers':
        return <StudentSellersPage />
      case 'cart':
        return <CartPage />
      case 'confirm':
        return <ConfirmPage />
      case 'orders':
        return <OrdersPage />
      case 'create':
      case 'list':
        return <CreateListingPage />
      case 'shop':
      case 'seller':
        return <MyShopPage />
      case 'forum':
        return <ForumPage />
      case 'help':
      case 'help-center':
        return <HelpCenterPage />
      case 'post':
        return <ForumPostPage />
      case 'messages':
        return <MessagesPage />
      case 'favorites':
        return <FavoritesPage />
      case 'profile':
        return <ProfilePage />
      case 'books':
        return <GuestSectionPage kind="books" />
      case 'merch':
        return <GuestSectionPage kind="merch" />
      case 'moderation':
        return <ModerationPage />
      case 'users':
        return <UsersAuditPage />
      case 'baoorders':
      case 'store-orders':
        return <StoreOrdersPage />
      case 'baostock':
      case 'store-inventory':
        return <StoreInventoryPage />
      case 'transactions':
        return <TransactionsPage />
      case 'forum-reports':
      case 'forumreports':
        return <ForumReportsPage />
      case 'staff':
        return <StaffToolsPage />
      default:
        return <NotFoundPage />
    }
  }

  // ----- visitor -----
  if (path === 'login') {
    return <LoginPage />
  }
  if (path === 'register' || path === 'verify') {
    return <VerifyPage />
  }
  if (path === 'forgot-password') {
    return <ForgotPasswordPage />
  }
  if (path === 'books') {
    return <GuestSectionPage kind="books" />
  }
  if (path === 'merch') {
    return <GuestSectionPage kind="merch" />
  }
  if (path === 'student-sellers') {
    return <GuestStudentSellersPage />
  }
  if (path === 'store') {
    return <GuestOfficialStorePage />
  }
  if (path === 'help' || path === 'help-center') {
    return (
      <div className="g-wrap" style={{ padding: '24px 16px' }}>
        <HelpCenterPage />
      </div>
    )
  }
  return <LandingPage />
}

export function AppRoutes() {
  const { path } = useRoute()
  const { user, isLoading: authLoading, isSigningIn } = useAuth()
  const { hasSettledInitialFetch } = useTindahan()

  /** Canonical page key used for both rendering and favicon selection. */
  const activePage = path === '' || path === 'landing' ? 'marketplace' : path

  const isPublicPath =
    path === '' ||
    path === 'landing' ||
    path === 'login' ||
    path === 'register' ||
    path === 'verify' ||
    path === 'forgot-password' ||
    path === 'books' ||
    path === 'merch' ||
    path === 'student-sellers' ||
    path === 'store' ||
    path === 'help' ||
    path === 'help-center'

  const redirectTo =
    !authLoading &&
    (user
      ? path === 'login' || path === 'register' || path === 'verify' || path === 'forgot-password'
        ? 'marketplace'
        : null
      : !isPublicPath
        ? 'login'
        : null)

  const appReady = useAppReady({
    authLoading,
    isAuthenticated: !!user,
    listingsSettled: hasSettledInitialFetch,
  })

  const showOverlay = !appReady || Boolean(redirectTo) || Boolean(isSigningIn)

  /** Swap the page favicon to match the current route. */
  useEffect(() => {
    const href = PAGE_FAVICONS[activePage] || '/favicon.svg'
    const link = document.querySelector('link[rel="icon"]') as HTMLLinkElement | null
    if (link) link.href = href
  }, [activePage])

  useEffect(() => {
    if (redirectTo) navigate(redirectTo, { replace: true })
  }, [redirectTo])

  /** Mobile only: after signing in / creating an account from the landing page,
   * stay at the top for 3 seconds, then scroll down with animation. The flag is
   * set in sessionStorage by PubTop before navigation, so it survives the page
   * change (PubTop unmounts on login/register). */
  useEffect(() => {
    const isMobile = window.innerWidth <= 900
    const shouldScroll = sessionStorage.getItem('rtu:scroll-after-login') === 'true'
    const isAuthPage = path === 'login' || path === 'register' || path === 'forgot-password'

    if (!isMobile || !shouldScroll || !isAuthPage) return

    sessionStorage.removeItem('rtu:scroll-after-login')

    const timer = setTimeout(() => {
      window.scrollTo({ top: document.documentElement.scrollHeight, behavior: 'smooth' })
    }, 1000)

    return () => clearTimeout(timer)
  }, [path])

  return (
    <>
      <BrandLoader
        isLoading={showOverlay}
        variant={isSigningIn ? 'full' : 'auto'}
        immediate={isSigningIn}
        onExited={() => {}}
      />
      {!authLoading && !redirectTo && (
        <>
          {/* Signed-in pages use AppLayout; login/verify pages have their own layout */}
          {user ? (
            <AppLayout user={user} activePath={activePage}>
              {renderActiveRoute(path, user)}
            </AppLayout>
          ) : path === 'login' || path === 'register' || path === 'verify' || path === 'forgot-password' ? (
            renderActiveRoute(path, user)
          ) : (
            <PublicLayout>{renderActiveRoute(path, user)}</PublicLayout>
          )}
        </>
      )}
    </>
  )
}

import type { IconName } from '@/common/components/icons'

/**
 * PAGE REGISTRY
 * ---------------------------------------------------------------
 * One list that describes every signed-in page. The sidebar menu, the
 * placeholder pages and the page titles are all built from it.
 *
 * To add a page to the sidebar: add an entry here, then add its component
 * in AppRoutes.tsx. `backend` tells us if an API exists for it yet.
 */
export type NavSection = 'BUY' | 'SELL' | 'COMMUNITY' | 'ADMIN'

export interface PageInfo {
  path: string
  title: string
  icon: IconName
  /** Which sidebar group it belongs to. Omit for pages not in the sidebar. */
  section?: NavSection
  /** Short description of the prototype page this will become. */
  about: string
  /** 'missing' = the Django backend has no endpoint for this yet. */
  backend: 'missing' | 'available'
}

export function findPage(path: string): PageInfo | undefined {
  return APP_PAGES.find((p) => p.path === path)
}

/** Staff roles see the ADMIN group in the sidebar (same rule as the prototype's moderator). */
export function canSeeAdmin(role: Role): boolean {
  return role === 'moderator' || role === 'administrator'
}


// ===== C:\Users\Lian Andrew\Desktop\RTU_Tindahan_Capstone\RTU_Tindahan_Final\RTU_Tindahan\frontend\src\features\marketplace\api\listings.ts =====
/**
 * CATALOGUE API
 * ---------------------------------------------------------------
 * The bridge between the Django backend and the marketplace UI.
 *
 * The pages do not know about this module: they keep reading
 * `PrototypeProduct` from `TindahanContext`. This file is the only place that
 * knows the backend's field names, so when the API changes, only this file
 * changes.
 *
 * Two naming traps are handled here:
 *   - the backend calls a listing's name `title`, and its category by id/name
 *   - the frontend groups listings into CATEGORIES, which the backend does not
 *     use, so `mapCategory()` translates (and falls back to 'Other Items')
 *
 * Everything is public: these endpoints need no token.
 */

import { apiFetch } from '@/common/api/client'
import type { IconName } from '@/common/components/icons'

import { CAT_META, OFFCAT } from '../constants'
import type { PrototypeProduct, UserListingRecord } from '../types'

/** Prefix for ids that came from the backend, so local ids never collide. */
export const API_ID_PREFIX = 'api:'

export interface ApiPhoto {
  id: number
  url: string
  alt_text: string
  sort_order: number
}

export interface ApiVariant {
  id: number
  name: string
  sku: string
  price: string | null
  unit_price: string
  on_hand: number
  available: number
  reserved: number
  low_stock_threshold: number | null
  is_active: boolean
}

export interface ApiListing {
  id: number
  slug: string
  title: string
  description: string
  category: number
  category_name: string
  category_slug: string
  listing_type: 'product' | 'service'
  condition: 'new' | 'used' | 'na'
  price: string
  quantity: number
  meetup_place: string
  is_official: boolean
  status: string
  view_count: number
  sold_count: number
  created_at: string
  seller_name: string
  seller_email: string
  photos: ApiPhoto[]
  variants: ApiVariant[]
}

export interface ApiCategory {
  id: number
  name: string
  slug: string
  parent: number | null
  sort_order: number
  is_active: boolean
}

export interface ApiPage<T> {
  count: number
  next: string | null
  previous: string | null
  results: T[]
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Backend category -> UI category
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

const CATEGORY_ALIASES: Array<[RegExp, string]> = [
  [/uniform|apparel|clothing|shirt|polo|pants|skirt|blouse/i, 'Clothing and Accessories'],
  [/book|manual|textbook|module|worksheet|reviewer/i, 'Books and Academic Materials'],
  [/food|snack|drink|meal|rice|coffee|pastry/i, 'Food and Snacks'],
  [/merch|souvenir|lanyard|id lace/i, 'RTU Merchandise'],
  [/suppl|pen|paper|notebook|folder/i, 'School Supplies'],
  [/gadget|electronic|calc|charger|usb|cable/i, 'Electronics and Gadgets'],
  [/collect|craft|knick|custom/i, 'Knickknacks and Collectibles'],
]

/** Translate the backend's category into one the existing filters understand. */
export function mapCategory(dto: ApiListing): string {
  if (dto.listing_type === 'service') return 'Services'

  const name = dto.category_name ?? ''
  if (CAT_META[name]) return name

  for (const [pattern, category] of CATEGORY_ALIASES) {
    if (pattern.test(name)) return category
  }
  return 'Other Items'
}

/** Rough "how long ago" label, used when a card has no meetup window. */
function timeAgo(iso: string): string {
  const then = new Date(iso).getTime()
  if (Number.isNaN(then)) return ''
  const minutes = Math.floor((Date.now() - then) / 60000)
  if (minutes < 1) return 'just now'
  if (minutes < 60) return `${minutes}m ago`
  const hours = Math.floor(minutes / 60)
  if (hours < 24) return `${hours}h ago`
  const days = Math.floor(hours / 24)
  if (days < 7) return `${days}d ago`
  return new Date(then).toLocaleDateString('en-PH', { month: 'short', day: 'numeric' })
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Mapping
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

/** The prototype's official sub-type (OFFSUB keys), guessed from the title. */
function officialSub(title: string): string {
  const name = title.toLowerCase()
  if (name.includes('uniform')) return 'Uniform'
  if (name.includes('manual')) return 'Manual'
  if (name.includes('textbook')) return 'Textbook'
  return ''
}

/** Turn one backend listing into the shape the pages already render. */
export function toPrototypeProduct(dto: ApiListing): PrototypeProduct {
  const browseCategory = mapCategory(dto)
  const service = dto.listing_type === 'service'
  // The Official Store page filters on cat === 'Official' (see sellerKind), so
  // official items must move into that bucket, exactly like the prototype does.
  const official = dto.is_official && !service
  const sub = official ? officialSub(dto.title) : ''
  const cat = official ? 'Official' : browseCategory
  const category = (sub ? OFFCAT[sub] : '') || browseCategory

  const meta = CAT_META[category] ?? CAT_META['Other Items']
  const tone = meta[0]
  const icon = meta[1] as IconName
  const shortLabel = meta[2]

  const variants = (dto.variants ?? []).filter((v) => v.is_active)
  const hasVariants = variants.length > 0

  const vars = hasVariants
    ? {
        attrs: [{ name: 'Size', opts: variants.map((v) => v.name) }],
        rows: variants.map((v) => ({
          id: `v${v.id}`,
          opts: { Size: v.name },
          qty: v.available,
          onHand: v.on_hand,
          price: Number(v.unit_price),
        })),
      }
    : undefined

  const left = hasVariants
    ? variants.reduce((total, v) => total + v.available, 0)
    : dto.quantity

  return {
    id: API_ID_PREFIX + dto.slug,
    name: dto.title,
    price: Number(dto.price),
    cat,
    category,
    sub: official ? sub : undefined,
    tone,
    icon,
    tag: official ? sub || shortLabel : service ? 'Service' : dto.condition === 'used' ? 'Used' : shortLabel,
    seller: dto.seller_name,
    // 'official' is the prototype's seller key for the RTU store.
    owner: official ? 'official' : dto.seller_email,
    left,
    unit: 'pc',
    when: dto.meetup_place || timeAgo(dto.created_at),
    cond: service ? undefined : dto.condition === 'used' ? 'Used' : 'New',
    desc: dto.description,
    imgs: dto.photos && dto.photos.length > 0 ? dto.photos.map((p) => p.url) : undefined,
    pub: new Date(dto.created_at).getTime() || undefined,
    kind: service ? 'service' : undefined,
    vars,
    soldCount: dto.sold_count,
    hidden: false,
  }
}

/** `http://host/api/v1/listings/?page=2` -> `/listings/?page=2` */
function pathFromNextUrl(url: string): string {
  const marker = '/api/v1'
  const at = url.indexOf(marker)
  return at >= 0 ? url.slice(at + marker.length) : url
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Calls
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

/** Every published listing, following pagination (5 pages = 100 listings). */
export async function fetchListings(maxPages = 5): Promise<ApiListing[]> {
  const collected: ApiListing[] = []
  let path: string | null = '/listings/'

  for (let page = 0; page < maxPages && path; page += 1) {
    const data: ApiPage<ApiListing> = await apiFetch<ApiPage<ApiListing>>(path)
    collected.push(...(data.results ?? []))
    path = data.next ? pathFromNextUrl(data.next) : null
  }
  return collected
}

/** One listing by its slug, or undefined when it is not visible to the caller. */
export async function fetchListing(slug: string): Promise<ApiListing | undefined> {
  try {
    return await apiFetch<ApiListing>(`/listings/${encodeURIComponent(slug)}/`)
  } catch {
    return undefined
  }
}

export async function fetchCategories(): Promise<ApiCategory[]> {
  return apiFetch<ApiCategory[]>('/categories/')
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Merging into the local snapshot
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

// The context's DatabaseSnapshot is not exported, so describe just what is
// needed here. Keeping the merge dumb makes it easy to test and to remove.
export interface DatabaseShape {
  official: PrototypeProduct[]
  userListings: UserListingRecord[]
}

/**
 * Replace the backend-sourced entries in the snapshot with a fresh copy.
 * Local entries (ids that do not carry the API prefix) are left untouched, so
 * nothing a user created in the prototype disappears.
 */
export function mergeApiCatalogue<T extends DatabaseShape>(prev: T, listings: ApiListing[]): T {
  const isFromApi = (id: string) => id.startsWith(API_ID_PREFIX)

  const mapped = listings.map((dto) => ({ dto, product: toPrototypeProduct(dto) }))

  const officialFromApi = mapped.filter((x) => x.dto.is_official).map((x) => x.product)
  const studentFromApi = mapped.filter((x) => !x.dto.is_official).map((x) => x.product)

  const studentRecords: UserListingRecord[] = studentFromApi.map((product) => ({
    lid: product.id,
    ownerEmail: product.owner ?? '',
    state: 'live',
    paused: false,
    product,
  }))

  return {
    ...prev,
    official: [...officialFromApi, ...prev.official.filter((p) => !isFromApi(p.id))],
    userListings: [
      ...studentRecords,
      ...prev.userListings.filter((l) => !isFromApi(l.lid)),
    ],
  }
}

import { useState } from 'react'
import { Icon } from '@/common/components/Icon'
import { initialsOf } from '../constants'
import { imgSrc } from '../imageStore'
import type { PrototypeAccount } from '../types'
import './AvatarBadge.css'

interface AvatarBadgeProps {
  account?: PrototypeAccount | null
  name?: string
  photoUrl?: string | null
  isStaff?: boolean
  size?: 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg' | 'xl' | ''
  showVerified?: boolean
  noTip?: boolean
}

export function AvatarBadge({
  account,
  name,
  photoUrl,
  isStaff,
  size = 'md',
  showVerified = true,
  noTip = false,
}: AvatarBadgeProps) {
  const [tipOpen, setTipOpen] = useState(false)
  const [imgFailed, setImgFailed] = useState(false)
  const staff = Boolean(isStaff ?? account?.role === 'moderator')
  const displayName = account?.name || name || (staff ? 'RTU Staff' : 'RTU Student')
  const init = initialsOf(displayName)
  const rawSrc = photoUrl || (account?.avatar ? imgSrc(account.avatar) : null)
  const src = imgFailed ? null : rawSrc
  const ver = showVerified && Boolean(account ? account.verified !== false : true)
  const sizeClass = size ? `av-${size}` : 'av-md'

  return (
    <span className={`avw ${sizeClass}`.trim()}>
      <span className={`avatar ${staff ? 'staff' : ''}`.trim()}>
        {src ? (
          <img
            className="avimg"
            src={src}
            alt=""
            data-ini={init}
            onError={() => setImgFailed(true)}
          />
        ) : (
          init
        )}
      </span>
      {ver &&
        (noTip ? (
          <span className="vbadge" aria-hidden="true">
            <Icon name="check" />
          </span>
        ) : (
          <span
            className={`vbadge ${tipOpen ? 'tip-on' : ''}`.trim()}
            tabIndex={0}
            role="img"
            aria-label="Verified RTU account"
            data-tip="Verified RTU account"
            onClick={(e) => {
              e.stopPropagation()
              e.preventDefault()
              setTipOpen((prev) => !prev)
            }}
            onBlur={() => setTipOpen(false)}
            onKeyDown={(e) => {
              if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') {
                e.preventDefault()
                setTipOpen((prev) => !prev)
              } else if (e.key === 'Escape') {
                setTipOpen(false)
              }
            }}
          >
            <Icon name="check" />
          </span>
        ))}
    </span>
  )
}

function DialogShell({
  title,
  wide,
  children,
  onClose,
}: {
  title: string
  wide?: boolean
  children: React.ReactNode
  onClose: () => void
}) {
  return (
    <div
      className={`card dlg ${wide ? 'dlg-wide' : ''}`.trim()}
      role="dialog"
      aria-modal="true"
      aria-labelledby="dlg-title"
    >
      <div className="row between">
        <h3 id="dlg-title">{title}</h3>
        <button type="button" className="iconbtn" aria-label="Close" onClick={onClose}>
          <Icon name="x" />
        </button>
      </div>
      {children}
    </div>
  )
}

function ModalContent(props: ModalContentProps) {
  const { activeModal, closeModal } = props

  switch (activeModal.kind) {
    case 'guidelines':
      return (
        <DialogShell title="Community guidelines" onClose={closeModal}>
          <ul className="small dlg-ul">
            <li>Be honest about what you sell, including its condition.</li>
            <li>Meet only at visible spots inside Pasig Campus.</li>
            <li>Pay in person. RTU Tindahan never handles money or delivery.</li>
            <li>No exam answers, vaping products, medicines, resale tickets or weapons.</li>
            <li>Treat every student and staff member with respect.</li>
          </ul>
          <div className="row dlg-actions">
            <button type="button" className="btn ghost" onClick={closeModal}>
              Close
            </button>
          </div>
        </DialogShell>
      )

    case 'policy':
      return (
        <DialogShell title="Prohibited items policy" onClose={closeModal}>
          <ul className="small dlg-ul">

    case 'txn-view': {

      const mine = !t.sellerEmail
      const acts: [string, string, string][] =
        t.status === 'Pending'

              ['Confirmed', 'Confirm request', ''],

            ]
          : t.status === 'Confirmed'
            ? [
                ['Completed', 'Mark as completed', ''],
                ['Cancelled', 'Cancel request', 'danger'],
              ]
            : []

      const rows: [string, string][] = [

        ['Buyer', t.buyerName + (t.buyerSid ? ` (${t.buyerSid})` : '')],

          <div>

            <div className="tl" style={{ marginTop: 8 }}>
              {(t.history || []).map((h, idx) => (
                <div key={idx}>
                  <b className="small">{h.status}</b>{' '}
                  <span className="tiny muted">
                    {stamp(h.ts)} Â· {h.by}
                  </span>

                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>

          {acts.length > 0 && mine ? (

    case 'forum-photo': {
      const f = props.db.feed.find((x) => x.id === activeModal.postId)

      if (!f || !src) return null
      return (

    case 'forum-edit-post':
      return <ForumEditPostDialog {...props} postId={activeModal.postId} />

    case 'forum-report':
      return (
        <ForumReportDialog
          {...props}
          postId={activeModal.postId}

      )

    case 'order-report':
      return (
        <OrderReportDialog
          {...props}
          orderId={activeModal.orderId}
          role={activeModal.role}

      )

    case 'forum-mod-action':

    case 'admin-user':

    case 'admin-remove-listing':

    case 'reset-all':
      return <ResetAllDialog {...props} />

    case 'bao-ticket':

    case 'bao-move':

        <BaoMoveDialog

      )

    case 'bao-item':

    case 'bao-email-prev':
      return <BaoEmailPreviewDialog {...props} emailId={activeModal.emailId} />

    default:
      return null
  }
}

function EditProfileDialog(props: ModalContentProps) {
  const { user } = useAuth()
  const u = props.currentAccount
  const fileInputId = useId()
  const [name, setName] = useState(u?.name || '')
  const [prog, setProg] = useState(u?.prog || PROGRAMS[0])
  const [yearLevel, setYearLevel] = useState<string>(
    user?.year_level != null ? String(user.year_level) : '2',
  )
  const [contactNumber, setContactNumber] = useState<string>(user?.contact_number || '')
  const [newAvatarId, setNewAvatarId] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const [profilePhotoFile, setProfilePhotoFile] = useState<File | null>(null)
  const [removeAvatar, setRemoveAvatar] = useState(false)
  const [avatarBusy, setAvatarBusy] = useState(false)
  const [avatarErr, setAvatarErr] = useState('')
  const [nameErr, setNameErr] = useState('')
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false)

  if (!u) return null

  const isStudent = (user?.member_type || 'student') === 'student' && u.role !== 'moderator'
  const pendSrc = newAvatarId ? imgSrc(newAvatarId) : null
  const curSrc: string | null = removeAvatar
    ? null
    : (u.avatar ? imgSrc(u.avatar) : null) || user?.profile_photo || null
  const progs = PROGRAMS.includes(prog as (typeof PROGRAMS)[number])
    ? [...PROGRAMS]
    : [prog, ...PROGRAMS]

  const handleAvatarFile = async (file: File | undefined) => {
    if (!file) return
    setAvatarBusy(true)
    setAvatarErr('')
    const res = await imgAdd(file, { minSide: 64, maxSide: 360, square: true })
    setAvatarBusy(false)
    if (res.err || !res.id) {
      setAvatarErr(res.err || 'Could not upload photo.')
      return
    }
    setNewAvatarId(res.id)
    setProfilePhotoFile(file)
    setRemoveAvatar(false)
    props.bumpImgVersion()
  }

  return (
    <DialogShell title="Edit profile" onClose={props.closeModal}>
      <form
        className="stack"
        style={{ gap: 14 }}
        noValidate
        onSubmit={async (e) => {
          e.preventDefault()
          if (name.trim().length < 2) {
            setNameErr('Enter your display name (at least 2 letters).')
            return
          }
          setSaving(true)
          const ok = await props.saveProfile(
            name,
            prog,
            newAvatarId,
            removeAvatar,
            isStudent ? Number(yearLevel) || 1 : null,
            contactNumber,
            profilePhotoFile,
          )
          setSaving(false)
          if (ok) props.closeModal()
        }}
      >
        <div className="stack" style={{ gap: 10 }}>
          <div className="row between wrap">
            <b className="small">Profile picture</b>
            <span className="tiny muted">JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to 5 MB</span>
          </div>
          <div className="row" style={{ gap: 16, alignItems: 'center', flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
            <div className="av-prev" aria-label="Picture preview">
              {pendSrc ? (
                <span className="avw av-xl">
                  <span className="avatar">
                    <img
                      className="avimg"
                      src={pendSrc}
                      alt="Preview of your new picture"
                    />
                  </span>
                </span>
              ) : removeAvatar ? (
                <span className="avw av-xl">
                  <span className="avatar">{initialsOf(name || u.name)}</span>
                </span>
              ) : (
                <AvatarBadge
                  account={u}
                  photoUrl={curSrc}
                  size="xl"
                  noTip
                />
              )}
            </div>
            <div className="stack grow" style={{ gap: 8, minWidth: 0 }}>
              <p className="small muted">
                {pendSrc
                  ? 'New picture ready. It is saved when you press Save changes.'
                  : removeAvatar
                    ? 'Your picture will be removed when you press Save changes.'
                    : curSrc
                      ? 'Other students see this on your reviews, forum posts and shop.'
                      : 'You are using your initials. Add a photo so people can recognize you.'}
              </p>
              <div className="row wrap">
                <label
                  className={`btn sm ghost ${avatarBusy ? 'busy' : ''}`.trim()}
                  htmlFor={fileInputId}
                >
                  <Icon name="upload" size="sm" />
                  {avatarBusy
                    ? 'Preparing photo'
                    : pendSrc || curSrc
                      ? 'Replace picture'
                      : 'Upload picture'}
                </label>
                {(pendSrc || removeAvatar) && (
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    className="btn ghost sm"
                    onClick={() => {
                      setNewAvatarId(null)
                      setProfilePhotoFile(null)
                      setRemoveAvatar(false)
                      setAvatarErr('')
                    }}
                  >
                    Undo
                  </button>
                )}
                {!pendSrc && !removeAvatar && curSrc && (
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    className="btn ghost sm"
                    onClick={() => setRemoveAvatar(true)}
                  >
                    Remove picture
                  </button>
                )}
              </div>
              <input
                type="file"
                id={fileInputId}
                accept="image/jpeg,image/png,image/webp"
                hidden
                disabled={avatarBusy}
                onChange={(e) => {
                  const file = e.target.files?.[0]
                  e.target.value = ''
                  void handleAvatarFile(file)
                }}
              />
              {avatarErr && (
                <span className="err" role="alert">
                  {avatarErr}
                </span>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="field">
          <label htmlFor="pname">Display name</label>
          <input
            className="input"
            id="pname"
            value={name}
            maxLength={60}
            autoComplete="name"
            aria-invalid={Boolean(nameErr)}
            onChange={(e) => {
              setName(e.target.value)
              setNameErr('')
            }}
          />
          {nameErr && (
            <span className="err" id="pname-err" role="alert">
              {nameErr}
            </span>
          )}
        </div>

        <div className="field">
          <label htmlFor="pprog">Program</label>
          <select
            className="input"
            id="pprog"
            value={prog}
            onChange={(e) => setProg(e.target.value)}
          >
            {progs.map((o) => (
              <option key={o} value={o}>
                {o}
              </option>
            ))}
          </select>
        </div>

        <div className="grid2">
          {isStudent && (
            <div className="field">
              <label htmlFor="pyear">Year level</label>
              <select
                className="input"
                id="pyear"
                value={yearLevel}
                onChange={(e) => setYearLevel(e.target.value)}
              >
                {[1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6].map((yr) => (
                  <option key={yr} value={String(yr)}>
                    Year {yr}
                  </option>
                ))}
              </select>
            </div>
          )}
          <div className="field">
            <label htmlFor="pcontact">Contact number (optional)</label>
            <input
              className="input"
              id="pcontact"
              value={contactNumber}
              maxLength={20}
              placeholder="09XX XXX XXXX"
              onChange={(e) => setContactNumber(e.target.value)}
            />
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="row dlg-actions">
          <button type="button" className="btn ghost" onClick={props.closeModal}>
            Cancel
          </button>
          <button type="submit" className="btn" disabled={avatarBusy || saving}>
            {saving ? 'Saving...' : 'Save changes'}
          </button>
        </div>
      </form>
    </DialogShell>
  )
}

function ForumEditPostDialog(props: ModalContentProps & { postId: string }) {
  const f = props.db.feed.find((x) => x.id === props.postId)
  const [title, setTitle] = useState(f?.title || '')
  const [body, setBody] = useState(f?.body || '')

              setBody(e.target.value)
              setErr('')

          </button>

          </button>

      </form>
    </DialogShell>
  )
}

function OrderReportDialog(
  props: ModalContentProps & {
    orderId: string
    role: 'buyer' | 'seller'
    targetEmail: string | null
    targetName: string
    itemTitle: string
  },
) {
  const { submitOrderReport } = useTindahan()
  const reasons =
    props.role === 'seller' ? ORDER_REPORT_REASONS_SELLER : ORDER_REPORT_REASONS_BUYER
  const [reason, setReason] = useState<string>(reasons[0])
  const [details, setDetails] = useState('')
  const [err, setErr] = useState('')

  return (
    <DialogShell
      title={
        props.role === 'seller'
          ? `Report buyer (${props.targetName})`
          : `Report seller (${props.targetName})`
      }
      onClose={props.closeModal}
    >
      <form
        className="stack"
        style={{ gap: 12 }}
        noValidate
        onSubmit={(e) => {
          e.preventDefault()
          if (details.trim().length < 5) {
            setErr('Please describe what happened (at least 5 characters).')
            return
          }
          const ok = submitOrderReport(
            props.orderId,
            props.role,
            props.targetEmail,
            props.targetName,
            props.itemTitle,
            reason,
            details,
          )
          if (ok) props.closeModal()
        }}
      >
        <p className="small muted">
          Report a transaction or meetup problem for <b>Order {props.orderId}</b> ({props.itemTitle}
          ). RTU administrators will review this report and can warn, suspend, or ban the reported
          account if needed.
        </p>
        <div className="field">
          <label htmlFor="orp-reason">Problem / Reason</label>
          <select
            id="orp-reason"
            className="input"
            value={reason}
            onChange={(e) => setReason(e.target.value)}
          >
            {reasons.map((r) => (
              <option key={r} value={r}>
                {r}
              </option>
            ))}
          </select>
        </div>
        <div className="field">
          <label htmlFor="orp-text">What happened? (Required)</label>
          <textarea
            id="orp-text"
            className="input"
            rows={3}
            maxLength={400}
            placeholder={
              props.role === 'seller'
                ? 'e.g. Waited 2 hours at the Main Lobby during our agreed time window and the buyer never showed up or replied...'
                : 'e.g. Waited at the meetup point and the seller never arrived, or the item had undisclosed issues...'
            }
            value={details}
            onChange={(e) => {
              setDetails(e.target.value)
              setErr('')
            }}
          />
          {err && (
            <span className="err" role="alert">
              {err}
            </span>
          )}
        </div>
        <div className="row dlg-actions">
          <button type="button" className="btn ghost" onClick={props.closeModal}>
            Cancel
          </button>
          <button type="submit" className="btn danger">
            Submit report
          </button>
        </div>
      </form>
    </DialogShell>
  )
}

function AdminUserDialog(props: ModalContentProps & { email: string }) {
  const t = props.acctByEmail(props.email)
  const [reason, setReason] = useState('')
  const [err, setErr] = useState('')

  if (!t) {
    return (
      <DialogShell title="Manage account" onClose={props.closeModal}>
        <p className="small">That account no longer exists.</p>
        <div className="row dlg-actions">
          <button type="button" className="btn ghost" onClick={props.closeModal}>
            Close
          </button>
        </div>
      </DialogShell>
    )
  }

  const cur = t.status || 'active'
  const can =
    t.role !== 'moderator' &&
    !(props.currentAccount && t.email === props.currentAccount.email)
  const posts = props.db.feed.filter((f) => f.authorEmail === t.email).length
  const uListings = props.db.userListings.filter((l) => l.ownerEmail === t.email)
  const live = uListings.filter((l) => l.state === 'live' && !l.modHold).length

  const info: [string, string][] = [
    ['Email', t.email],
    ['Student number', t.sid || 'Not set'],
    ['Program', t.prog || 'Not set'],
    ['Role', t.role === 'moderator' ? 'Staff' : 'Student'],
    [
      'Joined',
      t.since
        ? new Date(t.since).toLocaleDateString('en-PH', {
            month: 'long',
            day: 'numeric',
            year: 'numeric',
          })
        : 'Not set',
    ],
    ['Listings', `${uListings.length} (${live} live)`],
    ['Orders placed', String(t.orders.length)],
    ['Forum posts', String(posts)],
  ]

  const handleSetStatus = (to: 'active' | 'suspended' | 'banned') => {
    if (to !== 'active' && reason.trim().length < 5) {
      setErr('Write a short reason (at least 5 characters).')
      return
    }
    const ok = props.adminSetUserStatus(t.email, to, reason.trim())
    if (ok) props.closeModal()
  }

  return (
    <DialogShell title="Manage account" onClose={props.closeModal}>
      <div className="stack" style={{ gap: 12 }}>
        <div className="row between wrap">
          <b style={{ fontSize: 16 }}>{t.name}</b>
          <span
            className={`pill ${
              cur === 'banned' ? 'red' : cur === 'suspended' ? 'yellow' : 'green'
            }`}
          >
            {cur === 'banned' ? 'Banned' : cur === 'suspended' ? 'Suspended' : 'Active'}
          </span>
        </div>

        <dl className="adm-dl">
          {info.map((x) => (
            <div key={x[0]}>
              <dt>{x[0]}</dt>
              <dd>{x[1]}</dd>
            </div>
          ))}
        </dl>

        {(t.statusNote || (cur !== 'active' && t.statusAt)) && (
          <p className="small note-box">
            Last status change{t.statusAt ? ` on ${stamp(t.statusAt)}` : ''}
            {t.statusBy
              ? ` by ${props.acctByEmail(t.statusBy)?.name || t.statusBy}`
              : ''}
            . {t.statusNote ? `Reason: ${t.statusNote}` : ''}
          </p>
        )}

        {can ? (
          <>
            <div className="field">
              <label htmlFor="adm-reason">
                Reason{' '}
                {cur === 'active'
                  ? '(required to suspend or ban)'
                  : '(optional when restoring)'}
              </label>
              <textarea
                className="input"
                id="adm-reason"
                maxLength={200}
                rows={2}
                placeholder="For example: repeated no-shows, or a post that broke the guidelines"
                value={reason}
                onChange={(e) => {
                  setReason(e.target.value)
                  setErr('')
                }}
              />
              {err && (
                <span className="err" id="adm-err" role="alert">
                  {err}
                </span>
              )}
            </div>
            <p className="small muted">
              Suspended and banned members cannot sign in and their listings are hidden. Their
              orders, messages and posts stay in the records. You can restore access at any time.
            </p>
          </>
        ) : (
          <p className="small muted">
            {t.role === 'moderator'
              ? 'Staff accounts cannot be suspended or banned here.'
              : 'You cannot change your own account here.'}{' '}
            Roles cannot be changed from this page.
          </p>
        )}

        <div className="row dlg-actions wrap">
          <button type="button" className="btn ghost" onClick={props.closeModal}>
            Close
          </button>
          {can &&
            (cur === 'active' ? (
              <>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  className="btn yellow"
                  onClick={() => handleSetStatus('suspended')}
                >
                  Suspend
                </button>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  className="btn danger"
                  onClick={() => handleSetStatus('banned')}
                >
                  Ban
                </button>
              </>
            ) : cur === 'suspended' ? (
              <>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  className="btn danger"
                  onClick={() => handleSetStatus('banned')}
                >
                  Ban
                </button>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  className="btn"
                  onClick={() => handleSetStatus('active')}
                >
                  Restore access
                </button>
              </>
            ) : (
              <button
                type="button"
                className="btn"
                onClick={() => handleSetStatus('active')}
              >
                Restore access
              </button>
            ))}
        </div>
      </div>
    </DialogShell>
  )
}

function AdminRemoveListingDialog(props: ModalContentProps & { lid: string }) {
  const { adminPauseListing } = useTindahan()
  const l = props.db.userListings.find((x) => x.lid === props.lid)
  const [reason, setReason] = useState('')
  const [err, setErr] = useState('')

  if (!l || !l.product) return null

  const handleAction = (mode: 'pause' | 'remove') => {
    if (reason.trim().length < 5) {
      setErr('Write a short reason (at least 5 characters) so the student seller knows what to fix.')
      return
    }
    const ok =
      mode === 'pause'
        ? adminPauseListing(l.lid, reason.trim())
        : props.adminRemoveListing(l.lid, reason.trim())
    if (ok) props.closeModal()
  }

  return (
    <DialogShell title="Pause or delete student listing" onClose={props.closeModal}>
      <form
        className="stack"
        style={{ gap: 12 }}
        noValidate
        onSubmit={(e) => {
          e.preventDefault()
          handleAction('remove')
        }}
      >
        <p className="small" style={{ lineHeight: 1.55 }}>
          Choose whether to <b>Pause</b> or <b>Delete / Remove</b> â€œ{l.product.name}â€. The student
          seller will receive a notification and a two-way message in their Inbox with your reason.
        </p>
        <div className="field">
          <label htmlFor="adm-lreason">Reason to send to the student seller</label>
          <textarea
            className="input"
            id="adm-lreason"
            maxLength={200}
            rows={3}
            placeholder="Write the reason for pausing or removing this listing..."
            value={reason}
            onChange={(e) => {
              setReason(e.target.value)
              setErr('')
            }}
          />
          {err && (
            <span className="err" id="adm-lerr" role="alert">
              {err}
            </span>
          )}
        </div>
        <div className="row dlg-actions wrap" style={{ gap: 8 }}>
          <button type="button" className="btn ghost" onClick={props.closeModal}>
            Cancel
          </button>
          {!l.paused && (
            <button
              type="button"
              className="btn yellow"
              onClick={() => handleAction('pause')}
            >
              Pause listing
            </button>
          )}
          <button type="submit" className="btn danger">
            Delete / Remove listing
          </button>
        </div>
      </form>
    </DialogShell>
  )
}

          Yes, reset it
        </button>
      </div>
    </DialogShell>
  )
}

function BaoTicketDialog(props: ModalContentProps & { txnId: string }) {
  const { baoTransitionTicket } = useTindahan()
  const t = props.db.txn.find((x) => x.id === props.txnId)
  const st = t ? baoStatusOf(t) : 'Request Received'
  const nextAllowed = t ? props.db.bao.settings.transitions[st] || [] : []
  const reqReason = props.db.bao.settings.reasonRequired || []

  const [toStatus, setToStatus] = useState<BaoStatus>(
    () => nextAllowed[0] || st,
  )
  const [pickupDate, setPickupDate] = useState<string>(() => t?.pickup || '')
  const [note, setNote] = useState<string>('')

  useEffect(() => {
    if (nextAllowed.length && !nextAllowed.includes(toStatus)) {
      setToStatus(nextAllowed[0])
    }
  }, [nextAllowed, toStatus])

  if (!t || !baoIsOfficialTxn(t)) return null

  const rows: [string, string][] = [
    ['Requested', stamp(t.created)],
    ['Source', (t.src || 'Online') + (t.staff ? `, entered by ${t.staff}` : '')],
    ['Student', t.buyerName + (t.buyerSid ? ` (${t.buyerSid})` : '')],
    ['Email', t.buyerEmail || 'No account linked'],
    ['Pickup date', t.pickup ? baoDate(t.pickup) : 'Not set'],
    ['Quantity', String(t.qty)],
    ['Total', peso(t.total)],
  ]

  return (
    <DialogShell title={`Ticket ${t.id}`} wide onClose={props.closeModal}>
      <div className="row wrap" style={{ gap: 6 }}>
        <span className={`pill ${BAO_PILL[st] || ''}`.trim()}>{st}</span>
        <span className="srcpill school">Official RTU Store</span>
        <span className="srcpill student">{t.src || 'Online'}</span>
        {t.queue && <span className="pill">Queue {t.queue}</span>}
      </div>

      <BaoProgressBar txn={t} />

      <div className="stack" style={{ gap: 6 }}>
        {rows.map((r) => (
          <div
            key={r[0]}
            className="row between small wrap"
            style={{ alignItems: 'flex-start' }}
          >
            <span className="muted">{r[0]}</span>
            <b style={{ textAlign: 'right', overflowWrap: 'anywhere', maxWidth: '70%' }}>
              {r[1]}
            </b>
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>

      <div className="card flat stack" style={{ gap: 6, background: 'var(--bg)' }}>
        <b className="small">Items</b>
        {t.lines.map((l, idx) => (
          <div key={idx} className="row between small wrap">
            <span style={{ overflowWrap: 'anywhere' }}>
              {l.name} Ã— {l.qty}
            </span>
            <span className="tnum">{peso(l.price * l.qty)}</span>
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>

      <div>
        <b className="small">Status history (never edited)</b>
        <div className="tl" style={{ marginTop: 8 }}>
          {(t.bhist || []).map((h, idx) => (
            <div key={idx}>
              <b className="small">
                {h.from ? `${h.from} to ` : ''}
                {h.to}
              </b>{' '}
              <span className="tiny muted">
                {stamp(h.ts)} Â· {h.by}
              </span>
              {h.note && <div className="tiny muted">{h.note}</div>}
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>

      {nextAllowed.length ? (
        <form
          className="stack"
          noValidate
          onSubmit={(e) => {
            e.preventDefault()
            const res = baoTransitionTicket(t.id, toStatus, {
              note,
              pickup: pickupDate,
            })
            if (!res.ok) {
              props.toast(res.msg || 'Could not update ticket status.')
              return
            }
            setNote('')
            props.toast(`Ticket ${t.id} is now ${toStatus}.`)
          }}
        >
          <b className="small">Change the status</b>
          <div className="grid2">
            <div className="field">
              <label htmlFor="bt-to">New status</label>
              <select
                className="input"
                id="bt-to"
                value={toStatus}
                onChange={(e) => setToStatus(e.target.value as BaoStatus)}
              >
                {nextAllowed.map((x) => (
                  <option key={x} value={x}>
                    {x}
                  </option>
                ))}
              </select>
            </div>
            <div className="field">
              <label htmlFor="bt-pickup">Pickup date (optional)</label>
              <input
                className="input"
                id="bt-pickup"
                type="date"
                value={pickupDate}
                onChange={(e) => setPickupDate(e.target.value)}
              />
            </div>
          </div>
          <div className="field">
            <label htmlFor="bt-note">
              Reason or note (the student can see this
              {reqReason.length ? `. Required for ${reqReason.join(' and ')}` : ''})
            </label>
            <textarea
              className="input"
              id="bt-note"
              maxLength={300}
              value={note}
              onChange={(e) => setNote(e.target.value)}
            />
          </div>
          <div className="row dlg-actions">
            <button type="button" className="btn ghost" onClick={props.closeModal}>
              Close
            </button>
            <button type="submit" className="btn">
              Save status
            </button>
          </div>
        </form>
      ) : (
        <>
          <div className="note blue">
            <Icon name="info" />
            <span className="small">
              This ticket is {st}. No further change is allowed.
            </span>
          </div>
          <div className="row dlg-actions">
            <button type="button" className="btn ghost" onClick={props.closeModal}>
              Close
            </button>
          </div>
        </>
      )}
    </DialogShell>
  )
}

function BaoMoveDialog(
  props: ModalContentProps & {
    pid: string
    vid: string
    moveType: 'Stock In' | 'Adjustment'
  },
) {
  const { baoApplyStockMove } = useTindahan()
  const p = props.db.official.find((x) => x.id === props.pid)
  const u = p ? baoUnit(p, props.vid) : null

  const [dir, setDir] = useState<'1' | '-1'>('1')
  const [qty, setQty] = useState<string>('')
  const [reason, setReason] = useState<string>('')

  if (!p || !u) return null

  return (
    <DialogShell
      title={`${props.moveType === 'Stock In' ? 'Stock in: ' : 'Adjust stock: '}${baoUnitName(u)}`}
      onClose={props.closeModal}
    >
      <div className="note blue">
        <Icon name="info" />
        <span className="small">
          Now: {u.onHand} on hand, {baoReserved(u)} reserved, {u.available} available.
        </span>
      </div>

      <form
        className="stack"
        noValidate
        onSubmit={(e) => {
          e.preventDefault()
          const q = parseInt(qty, 10)
          const sign = props.moveType === 'Adjustment' ? parseInt(dir, 10) || 1 : 1
          if (!(q >= 1)) {
            props.toast('Enter a whole number of units, 1 or more.')
            return
          }
          const r = baoApplyStockMove([
            {
              pid: props.pid,
              vid: props.vid,
              type: props.moveType,
              qty: q * sign,
              reason:
                reason.trim() || (props.moveType === 'Stock In' ? 'Stock in' : ''),
            },
          ])
          if (!r.ok) {
            props.toast(r.msg || 'Could not update stock.')
            return
          }
          props.closeModal()
          props.toast(
            props.moveType === 'Stock In' ? 'Stock added.' : 'Stock adjusted.',
          )
        }}
      >
        {props.moveType === 'Adjustment' && (
          <div className="field">
            <label htmlFor="mv-dir">Change</label>
            <select
              className="input"
              id="mv-dir"
              value={dir}
              onChange={(e) => setDir(e.target.value as '1' | '-1')}
            >
              <option value="1">Add to the count</option>
              <option value="-1">Remove from the count</option>
            </select>
          </div>
        )}

        <div className="field">
          <label htmlFor="mv-q">Units</label>
          <input
            className="input tnum"
            id="mv-q"
            type="number"
            min="1"
            step="1"
            inputMode="numeric"
            value={qty}
            onChange={(e) => setQty(e.target.value)}
          />
        </div>

        <div className="field">
          <label htmlFor="mv-r">
            Reason
            {props.moveType === 'Adjustment'
              ? ' (required)'
              : ' (optional, for example what arrived)'}
          </label>
          <textarea
            className="input"
            id="mv-r"
            maxLength={200}
            value={reason}
            onChange={(e) => setReason(e.target.value)}
          />
        </div>

        <div className="row dlg-actions">
          <button type="button" className="btn ghost" onClick={props.closeModal}>
            Cancel
          </button>
          <button type="submit" className="btn">
            Save
          </button>
        </div>
      </form>
    </DialogShell>
  )
}

function BaoItemSettingsDialog(props: ModalContentProps & { pid: string }) {
  const {
    baoSaveItemSettings,
    baoStartItemSizes,
    baoAddItemSizeRow,
    baoRemoveItemSizeRow,
  } = useTindahan()

  const p = props.db.official.find((x) => x.id === props.pid)
  const curType = p ? baoItemType(props.db.bao, p) : null
  const inv = p?.inv || {
    type: curType?.id || 'ty-other',
    low: null,
    win: null,
    limit: 0,
    claimNote: '',
  }
  const win = inv.win || { enabled: false, start: '', end: '', message: '' }
  const vr = Boolean(p && hasVars(p) && p.vars)

  const [typeId, setTypeId] = useState<string>(curType?.id || 'ty-other')
  const [lowText, setLowText] = useState<string>(
    inv.low == null ? '' : String(inv.low),
  )
  const [winEnabled, setWinEnabled] = useState<boolean>(Boolean(win.enabled))
  const [winStart, setWinStart] = useState<string>(
    win.start ? String(win.start).slice(0, 16) : '',
  )
  const [winEnd, setWinEnd] = useState<string>(
    win.end ? String(win.end).slice(0, 16) : '',
  )
  const [winMsg, setWinMsg] = useState<string>(win.message || '')
  const [limitText, setLimitText] = useState<string>(String(inv.limit || 0))
  const [claimNote, setClaimNote] = useState<string>(inv.claimNote || '')
  const [varName, setVarName] = useState<string>(
    p && hasVars(p) && p.vars ? p.vars.attrs[0].name : 'Size',
  )
  const [rowLows, setRowLows] = useState<Record<string, string>>(() => {
    const map: Record<string, string> = {}
    if (p && hasVars(p) && p.vars) {
      p.vars.rows.forEach((r) => {
        map[r.id] = r.low == null ? '' : String(r.low)
      })
    }
    return map
  })
  const [newSizeLabel, setNewSizeLabel] = useState<string>('')
  const [newSizeQty, setNewSizeQty] = useState<string>('0')
  const [firstSizeLabel, setFirstSizeLabel] = useState<string>('')

  if (!p) return null

  const parseIntOrNull = (val: string): number | null => {
    const trimmed = String(val).trim()
    if (!trimmed) return null
    const parsed = parseInt(trimmed, 10)
    return Number.isNaN(parsed) ? null : Math.max(0, parsed)
  }

  return (
    <DialogShell title={`Item settings: ${p.name}`} wide onClose={props.closeModal}>
      <form
        className="stack"
        noValidate
        onSubmit={(e) => {
          e.preventDefault()
          const parsedRowLows: Record<string, number | null> = {}
          Object.entries(rowLows).forEach(([rid, val]) => {
            parsedRowLows[rid] = parseIntOrNull(val)
          })
          const ok = baoSaveItemSettings(p.id, {
            typeId,
            low: parseIntOrNull(lowText),
            limit: parseInt(limitText, 10) || 0,
            claimNote,
            win: {
              enabled: winEnabled,
              start: winStart,
              end: winEnd,
              message: winMsg,
            },
            varAttrName: varName,
            rowLows: parsedRowLows,
          })
          if (ok) props.closeModal()
        }}
      >
        <div className="grid2">
          <div className="field">
            <label htmlFor="is-type">Item type</label>
            <select
              className="input"
              id="is-type"
              value={typeId}
              onChange={(e) => setTypeId(e.target.value)}
            >
              {props.db.bao.types
                .filter((x) => x.active || (curType && curType.id === x.id))
                .map((x) => (
                  <option key={x.id} value={x.id}>
                    {x.name}
                    {x.active ? '' : ' (off)'}
                  </option>
                ))}
            </select>
          </div>
          <div className="field">
            <label htmlFor="is-low">Low stock at (blank = no warning)</label>
            <input
              className="input tnum"
              id="is-low"
              type="number"
              min="0"
              value={lowText}
              onChange={(e) => setLowText(e.target.value)}
            />
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="card flat stack" style={{ background: 'var(--bg)' }}>
          <b className="small">Ordering window for this item</b>
          <label className="row small" style={{ gap: 6 }}>
            <input
              type="checkbox"
              checked={winEnabled}
              onChange={(e) => setWinEnabled(e.target.checked)}
            />
            Use an ordering window
          </label>
          <div className="grid2">
            <div className="field">
              <label htmlFor="is-ws">Opens</label>
              <input
                className="input"
                id="is-ws"
                type="datetime-local"
                value={winStart}
                onChange={(e) => setWinStart(e.target.value)}
              />
            </div>
            <div className="field">
              <label htmlFor="is-wd">Closes</label>
              <input
                className="input"
                id="is-wd"
                type="datetime-local"
                value={winEnd}
                onChange={(e) => setWinEnd(e.target.value)}
              />
            </div>
          </div>
          <div className="field">
            <label htmlFor="is-wm">Message shown to students (optional)</label>
            <input
              className="input"
              id="is-wm"
              maxLength={140}
              value={winMsg}
              onChange={(e) => setWinMsg(e.target.value)}
            />
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="field">
          <label htmlFor="is-lim">Limit per student (0 = none)</label>
          <input
            className="input tnum"
            id="is-lim"
            type="number"
            min="0"
            value={limitText}
            style={{ maxWidth: 160 }}
            onChange={(e) => setLimitText(e.target.value)}
          />
        </div>

        <div className="field">
          <label htmlFor="is-cn">
            Claim notes for this item (shown on the product page and on tickets)
          </label>
          <textarea
            className="input"
            id="is-cn"
            maxLength={300}
            placeholder="Leave empty until the BAO gives the wording"
            value={claimNote}
            onChange={(e) => setClaimNote(e.target.value)}
          />
        </div>

        {vr && p.vars ? (
          <>
            <div className="field">
              <label htmlFor="is-vn">What the variations are called</label>
              <input
                className="input"
                id="is-vn"
                maxLength={20}
                value={varName}
                style={{ maxWidth: 220 }}
                onChange={(e) => setVarName(e.target.value)}
              />
            </div>
            <div className="stack" style={{ gap: 6 }}>
              <b className="small">{varName}s</b>
              {p.vars.rows.map((r) => {
                const u = baoUnit(p, r.id)
                return (
                  <div
                    key={r.id}
                    className="row between wrap"
                    style={{
                      gap: 8,
                      borderTop: '1px solid var(--line)',
                      paddingTop: 6,
                    }}
                  >
                    <span className="small">
                      <b>{varLabel(p, r)}</b>{' '}
                      {u && (
                        <span className="muted">
                          on hand {u.onHand}, reserved {baoReserved(u)}, available{' '}
                          {u.available}
                        </span>
                      )}
                    </span>
                    <span className="row" style={{ gap: 6 }}>
                      <label className="tiny muted" htmlFor={`vl-${r.id}`}>
                        Low at
                      </label>
                      <input
                        className="input tnum"
                        id={`vl-${r.id}`}
                        type="number"
                        min="0"
                        value={rowLows[r.id] ?? (r.low == null ? '' : String(r.low))}
                        style={{ width: 80 }}
                        aria-label={`Low stock for ${varLabel(p, r)}`}
                        onChange={(e) =>
                          setRowLows((prev) => ({
                            ...prev,
                            [r.id]: e.target.value,
                          }))
                        }
                      />
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        className="btn danger sm"
                        onClick={() => baoRemoveItemSizeRow(p.id, r.id)}
                      >
                        Remove
                      </button>
                    </span>
                  </div>
                )
              })}

              <div className="row wrap" style={{ gap: 8, alignItems: 'flex-end' }}>
                <div className="field">
                  <label htmlFor="nv-l">New {varName.toLowerCase()}</label>
                  <input
                    className="input"
                    id="nv-l"
                    maxLength={30}
                    value={newSizeLabel}
                    onChange={(e) => setNewSizeLabel(e.target.value)}
                  />
                </div>
                <div className="field">
                  <label htmlFor="nv-q">Opening stock</label>
                  <input
                    className="input tnum"
                    id="nv-q"
                    type="number"
                    min="0"
                    value={newSizeQty}
                    style={{ width: 110 }}
                    onChange={(e) => setNewSizeQty(e.target.value)}
                  />
                </div>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  className="btn ghost sm"
                  onClick={() => {
                    if (
                      baoAddItemSizeRow(
                        p.id,
                        newSizeLabel,
                        parseInt(newSizeQty, 10) || 0,
                      )
                    ) {
                      setNewSizeLabel('')
                      setNewSizeQty('0')
                    }
                  }}
                >
                  Add
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
          </>
        ) : (
          <div className="card flat stack" style={{ background: 'var(--bg)' }}>
            <b className="small">Track by size or variation</b>
            <p className="tiny muted">
              Move this item&rsquo;s stock into a first size. It needs nothing reserved by open
              tickets. The move is written to the ledger as two adjustments.
            </p>
            <div className="row wrap" style={{ gap: 8, alignItems: 'flex-end' }}>
              <div className="field">
                <label htmlFor="nv-first">Name of the first size or variation</label>
                <input
                  className="input"
                  id="nv-first"
                  maxLength={30}
                  value={firstSizeLabel}
                  onChange={(e) => setFirstSizeLabel(e.target.value)}
                />
              </div>
              <button
                type="button"
                className="btn ghost sm"
                onClick={() => {
                  if (baoStartItemSizes(p.id, firstSizeLabel)) {
                    setFirstSizeLabel('')
                  }
                }}
              >
                Start tracking sizes
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        <div className="row dlg-actions">
          <button type="button" className="btn ghost" onClick={props.closeModal}>
            Close
          </button>
          <button type="submit" className="btn">
            Save settings
          </button>
        </div>
      </form>
    </DialogShell>
  )
}

function BaoEmailPreviewDialog(props: ModalContentProps & { emailId: string }) {
  const e = props.db.bao.outbox.find((x) => x.id === props.emailId)
  if (!e) return null

  return (
    <DialogShell title={`Prepared message ${e.id}`} onClose={props.closeModal}>
      <div className="note">
        <Icon name="lock" />
        <span className="small">
          Not sent. This is only a preview of what would be sent.
        </span>
      </div>
      <div className="stack" style={{ gap: 6 }}>
        <div className="small">
          <span className="muted">To:</span>{' '}
          {e.to.length ? e.to.join(', ') : 'No address'}
        </div>
        <div className="small">
          <span className="muted">Subject:</span> <b>{e.subject}</b>
        </div>
      </div>
      <pre
        className="card flat"
        style={{
          whiteSpace: 'pre-wrap',
          overflowWrap: 'anywhere',
          fontFamily: 'inherit',
          fontSize: 13,
          background: 'var(--bg)',
          margin: 0,
        }}
      >
        {e.text}
      </pre>
      <div className="row dlg-actions">
        <button type="button" className="btn ghost" onClick={props.closeModal}>
          Close
        </button>
      </div>
    </DialogShell>
  )
}

// ===== C:\Users\Lian Andrew\Desktop\RTU_Tindahan_Capstone\RTU_Tindahan_Final\RTU_Tindahan\frontend\src\features\marketplace\components\MarketplaceProductShelf.tsx =====
import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react'
import { Icon } from '@/common/components/Icon'
import { ProductCard } from './ProductCard'
import type { PrototypeProduct } from '../types'
import './MarketplaceProductShelf.css'

interface MarketplaceProductShelfProps {
  title: string
  subtitle: string
  items: PrototypeProduct[]
  viewMoreLabel?: string
  onViewMore?: () => void
  onEmptyAction?: () => void
  emptyActionLabel?: string
  emptyTitle?: string
  emptySubtitle?: string
}

/**
 * MARKETPLACE PRODUCT SHELF
 * Reusable 5-on-2 (10 visible) horizontally scrollable showcase grid.
 * Used by Latest Items, Best-Selling Items, and Student Services.
 */
export function MarketplaceProductShelf({
  title,
  subtitle,
  items,
  viewMoreLabel = 'View more',
  onViewMore,
  onEmptyAction,
  emptyActionLabel,
  emptyTitle,
  emptySubtitle,
}: MarketplaceProductShelfProps) {
  const shelfRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement | null>(null)
  const viewportRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement | null>(null)
  const [canScrollLeft, setCanScrollLeft] = useState(false)
  const [canScrollRight, setCanScrollRight] = useState(false)

  // Distribute items into two rows for the marquee-style shelf.
  // Row 1 (top): items[0..4], then items[10], items[12], items[14], ...
  // Row 2 (bottom): items[5..9], then items[11], items[13], items[15], ...
  const buildRows = useCallback((list: PrototypeProduct[]) => {
    if (list.length <= 5) {
      return { rows: [list] as PrototypeProduct[][] }
    }
    const top: PrototypeProduct[] = list.slice(0, 5)
    const bottom: PrototypeProduct[] = list.slice(5, 10)
    for (let i = 10; i < list.length; i++) {
      if (i % 2 === 0) top.push(list[i])
      else bottom.push(list[i])
    }
    return { rows: [top, bottom] as PrototypeProduct[][] }
  }, [])

  const { rows } = buildRows(items)

  const scrollStep = useCallback((el: HTMLElement) => Math.round(el.clientWidth * 0.6), [])

  const updateScrollStates = useCallback(() => {
    const el = viewportRef.current
    if (!el) return
    setCanScrollLeft(el.scrollLeft > 2)
    setCanScrollRight(el.scrollLeft + el.clientWidth < el.scrollWidth - 2)
  }, [])

  const scrollShelf = useCallback((dir: -1 | 1) => {
    const el = viewportRef.current
    if (!el) return
    el.scrollBy({ left: dir * scrollStep(el), behavior: 'smooth' })
  }, [scrollStep])

  // Recalculate on mount, items changes, scroll, and resize (sidebar toggle, etc.)
  useEffect(() => {
    const el = viewportRef.current
    if (!el) return
    const onScroll = () => updateScrollStates()
    const onResize = () => updateScrollStates()

    updateScrollStates()
    el.addEventListener('scroll', onScroll)
    window.addEventListener('resize', onResize)

    const ro = new ResizeObserver(() => updateScrollStates())
    ro.observe(el)
    if (shelfRef.current) ro.observe(shelfRef.current)

    return () => {
      el.removeEventListener('scroll', onScroll)
      window.removeEventListener('resize', onResize)
      ro.disconnect()
    }
  }, [items.length, updateScrollStates])

  const hasItems = items.length > 0

  return (
    <div className="shelf-section" style={{ gap: 10, display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', position: 'relative', overflow: 'visible' }}>
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="row between wrap">
        <div>
          <h2 style={{ fontSize: 18, margin: 0 }}>{title}</h2>
          <span className="small muted">{subtitle}</span>
        </div>
        {hasItems && onViewMore && (
          <button
            type="button"
            className="link"
            onClick={onViewMore}
          >
            {viewMoreLabel}
          </button>
        )}
      </div>

      {hasItems ? (
        <>
          <div
            className="shelf-viewport"
            ref={viewportRef}
            style={{ overflowX: 'auto', overflowY: 'visible' }}
            aria-label={`${title}. Swipe left or right to browse more items.`}
          >
            <div
              className="shelf-track"
              ref={shelfRef}
            >
              {rows.map((row, rowIdx) => (
                <div
                  key={`shelf-row-${rowIdx}`}
                  className="shelf-row"
              >
                  {row.map((p) => (
                    <ProductCard key={p.id} product={p} />
                  ))}
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Chevrons live OUTSIDE the scrollable track as direct children of shelf-section */}
          {canScrollLeft && (
            <button
              type="button"
              className="shelf-chev shelf-chev-left"
              aria-label={`Scroll ${title} left`}
              onClick={() => scrollShelf(-1)}
            >
              <Icon name="chev" size="sm" />
            </button>
          )}
          {canScrollRight && (
            <button
              type="button"
              className="shelf-chev shelf-chev-right"
              aria-label={`Scroll ${title} right`}
              onClick={() => scrollShelf(1)}
            >
              <Icon name="chev" size="sm" />
            </button>
          )}
        </>
      ) : (
        <div
          className="card stack"
          style={{ alignItems: 'center', textAlign: 'center', padding: 30 }}
        >
          <b>{emptyTitle || 'No items yet'}</b>
          <p className="small muted">{emptySubtitle}</p>
          {onEmptyAction && emptyActionLabel && (
            <button
              type="button"
              className="btn yellow"
              onClick={onEmptyAction}
            >
              {emptyActionLabel}
            </button>
          )}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  )
}
