        result = r
        if (!r.ok) return prev
        return next
      })
      return result
    },
    [currentAccount, isStaffUser],
  )

  const baoSaveItemSettings = useCallback(
    (
      pid: string,
      input: {
        typeId: string
        low: number | null
        limit: number
        claimNote: string
        win: { enabled: boolean; start: string; end: string; message: string }
        varAttrName?: string
        rowLows?: Record<string, number | null>
      },
    ): boolean => {
      if (!currentAccount || !isStaffUser) {
        toast('Only RTU staff can do that.')
        return false
      }
      if (input.limit < 0) {
        toast('The limit cannot be negative.')
        return false
      }
      if (input.win.enabled && !input.win.start && !input.win.end) {
        toast('Choose when ordering opens or closes, or switch the window off.')
        return false
      }
      if (
        input.win.enabled &&
        input.win.start &&
        input.win.end &&
        Date.parse(input.win.end) <= Date.parse(input.win.start)
      ) {
        toast('The closing time must be after the opening time.')
        return false
      }

      const now = new Date().toISOString()
      setDb((prev) => {
        const next: DatabaseSnapshot = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(prev))
        const p = next.official.find((x) => x.id === pid)
        if (!p) return prev
        const t = baoTypeById(next.bao, input.typeId)
        p.inv = {
          ...(p.inv || {}),
          type: t ? t.id : p.inv?.type || 'ty-other',
          low: input.low,
          limit: input.limit,
          claimNote: input.claimNote.trim(),
          win: input.win,
          mig: 1,
        }
        if (t) {
          p.tag = t.name
          p.tone = t.tone
          p.icon = t.icon
          p.category = t.category
          p.sub = t.sub || ''
        }
        if (hasVars(p) && p.vars) {
          const vn = (input.varAttrName || 'Size').trim().slice(0, 20) || 'Size'
          const oldName = p.vars.attrs[0].name
          if (vn !== oldName) {
            p.vars.rows.forEach((r) => {
              r.opts = { [vn]: r.opts[oldName] }
            })
            p.vars.attrs[0].name = vn
          }
          if (input.rowLows) {
            p.vars.rows.forEach((r) => {
              if (r.id in input.rowLows!) {
                r.low = input.rowLows![r.id]
              }
            })
          }
        }
        next.audit.push({
          id: 'au' + uid(),
          ts: now,
          by: currentAccount.email,
          byName: currentAccount.name,
          action: 'item settings',
          targetType: 'official product',
          targetId: p.id,
          targetName: p.name,
          note: 'type, low stock, window, limit or claim notes changed',
        })
        return next
      })
      toast('Item settings saved.')
      return true
    },
    [currentAccount, isStaffUser, toast],
  )

  const baoStartItemSizes = useCallback(
    (pid: string, firstLabel: string): boolean => {
      if (!currentAccount || !isStaffUser) {
        toast('Only RTU staff can do that.')
        return false
      }
      const label = firstLabel.trim()
      if (!label) {
        toast('Enter the name of the first size or variation.')
        return false
      }
      const existing = db.official.find((x) => x.id === pid)
      if (!existing || hasVars(existing)) return false
      const u = baoUnit(existing, '')
      if (u && baoReserved(u) > 0) {
        toast(
          `This item has ${baoReserved(u)} reserved for open tickets. Finish or cancel them first.`,
        )
        return false
      }

      let ok = true
      const n = u ? u.onHand : 0
      const now = new Date().toISOString()

      setDb((prev) => {
        const next: DatabaseSnapshot = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(prev))
        const p = next.official.find((x) => x.id === pid)
        if (!p || hasVars(p)) return prev
        const unit0 = baoUnit(p, '')
        const count = unit0 ? unit0.onHand : 0
        const reason = `Moved to ${label} when sizes were turned on`

        if (count > 0) {
          const r1 = applyLedgerOnSnapshot(
            next,
            [{ pid: p.id, vid: '', type: 'Adjustment', qty: -count, reason }],
            { by: currentAccount.name, byEmail: currentAccount.email },
          )
          if (!r1.ok) {
            ok = false
            return prev
          }
        }

        const rid =
          'v' +
          Date.now().toString(36).slice(-4) +
          Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 5)
        p.vars = {
          attrs: [{ name: 'Size', opts: [label] }],
          rows: [{ id: rid, opts: { Size: label }, qty: 0, onHand: 0, price: null, low: null }],
        }
        delete p.onHand
        syncLeft(p)

        if (count > 0) {
          applyLedgerOnSnapshot(
            next,
            [{ pid: p.id, vid: rid, type: 'Adjustment', qty: count, reason }],
            { by: currentAccount.name, byEmail: currentAccount.email },
          )
        }

        next.audit.push({
          id: 'au' + uid(),
          ts: now,
          by: currentAccount.email,
          byName: currentAccount.name,
          action: 'item sizes on',
          targetType: 'official product',
          targetId: p.id,
          targetName: p.name,
          note: label,
        })
        return next
      })

      if (ok) {
        toast(`Sizes are on. ${n} unit${n === 1 ? '' : 's'} moved to ${label}.`)
      }
      return ok
    },
    [currentAccount, isStaffUser, db.official, toast],
  )

  const baoAddItemSizeRow = useCallback(
    (pid: string, label: string, openingQty: number): boolean => {
      if (!currentAccount || !isStaffUser) {
        toast('Only RTU staff can do that.')
        return false
      }
      const cleanLabel = label.trim()
      if (!cleanLabel) {
        toast('Enter a name.')
        return false
      }
      if (openingQty < 0) {
        toast('Opening stock cannot be negative.')
        return false
      }
      const existing = db.official.find((x) => x.id === pid)
      if (!existing || !hasVars(existing) || !existing.vars) return false
      const attrName = existing.vars.attrs[0].name
      if (
        existing.vars.rows.some(
          (r) => String(r.opts[attrName]).toLowerCase() === cleanLabel.toLowerCase(),
        )
      ) {
        toast('That one is already in the list.')
        return false
      }

      const now = new Date().toISOString()
      setDb((prev) => {
        const next: DatabaseSnapshot = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(prev))
        const p = next.official.find((x) => x.id === pid)
        if (!p || !hasVars(p) || !p.vars) return prev
        const nm = p.vars.attrs[0].name
        const rid =
          'v' +
          Date.now().toString(36).slice(-4) +
          Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 5)
        p.vars.rows.push({
          id: rid,
          opts: { [nm]: cleanLabel },
          qty: 0,
          onHand: 0,
          price: null,
          low: null,
        })
        p.vars.attrs[0].opts.push(cleanLabel)
        syncLeft(p)
        if (openingQty > 0) {
          applyLedgerOnSnapshot(
            next,
            [
              {
                pid: p.id,
                vid: rid,
                type: 'Stock In',
                qty: openingQty,
                reason: `Opening stock for the new ${nm.toLowerCase()}`,
              },
            ],
            { by: currentAccount.name, byEmail: currentAccount.email },
          )
        }
        next.audit.push({
          id: 'au' + uid(),
          ts: now,
          by: currentAccount.email,
          byName: currentAccount.name,
          action: 'item size added',
          targetType: 'official product',
          targetId: p.id,
          targetName: p.name,
          note: cleanLabel,
        })
        return next
      })
      toast(`Added ${cleanLabel}.`)
      return true
    },
    [currentAccount, isStaffUser, db.official, toast],
  )

  const baoRemoveItemSizeRow = useCallback(
    (pid: string, rowId: string): boolean => {
      if (!currentAccount || !isStaffUser) {
        toast('Only RTU staff can do that.')
        return false
      }
      const existing = db.official.find((x) => x.id === pid)
      if (!existing || !hasVars(existing) || !existing.vars) return false
      const u = baoUnit(existing, rowId)
      if (!u) return false
      if (u.onHand > 0 || baoReserved(u) > 0) {
        toast(
          'Only a size with nothing on hand and nothing reserved can be removed. Adjust the count to 0 first.',
        )
        return false
      }

      const now = new Date().toISOString()
      setDb((prev) => {
        const next: DatabaseSnapshot = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(prev))
        const p = next.official.find((x) => x.id === pid)
        if (!p || !hasVars(p) || !p.vars) return prev
        const row = findVar(p, rowId)
        if (!row) return prev
        const nm = p.vars.attrs[0].name
        const lbl = row.opts[nm]
        p.vars.rows = p.vars.rows.filter((x) => x.id !== rowId)
        p.vars.attrs[0].opts = p.vars.attrs[0].opts.filter((x) => x !== lbl)
        if (!p.vars.rows.length) {
          delete p.vars
          p.left = 0
          p.onHand = 0
        } else {
          syncLeft(p)
        }
        next.audit.push({
          id: 'au' + uid(),
          ts: now,
          by: currentAccount.email,
          byName: currentAccount.name,
          action: 'item size removed',
          targetType: 'official product',
          targetId: p.id,
          targetName: p.name,
          note: lbl,
        })
        return next
      })
      toast('Size removed.')
      return true
    },
    [currentAccount, isStaffUser, db.official, toast],
  )

  const baoSaveItemTypes = useCallback(
    (nextTypes: BaoItemType[]): boolean => {
      if (!currentAccount || !isStaffUser) {
        toast('Only RTU staff can do that.')
        return false
      }
      const seen: string[] = []
      for (const t of nextTypes) {
        if (!t.name.trim()) {
          toast('Every type needs a name.')
          return false
        }
        const low = t.name.trim().toLowerCase()
        if (seen.includes(low)) {
          toast(`Two types have the same name: ${t.name}.`)
          return false
        }
        seen.push(low)
      }
      if (!nextTypes.some((t) => t.active)) {
        toast('Keep at least one type active.')
        return false
      }
      const now = new Date().toISOString()
      setDb((prev) => {
        const next: DatabaseSnapshot = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(prev))
        const validSub = (cat: string, s: string) => !s || (SUBCATS[cat] || []).includes(s)
        const cleaned = nextTypes.map((t) => ({
          ...t,
          name: t.name.trim(),
          sub: validSub(t.category, t.sub) ? t.sub : '',
        }))
        next.bao.types = cleaned
        syncBaoTypeMaps(next.bao)
        next.official.forEach((p) => {
          const t = baoItemType(next.bao, p)
          if (t && p.inv && p.inv.type === t.id) {
            p.tag = t.name
            p.tone = t.tone
            p.icon = t.icon
            p.category = t.category
            p.sub = t.sub || ''
          }
        })
        next.audit.push({
          id: 'au' + uid(),
          ts: now,
          by: currentAccount.email,
          byName: currentAccount.name,
          action: 'item types',
          targetType: 'settings',
          targetId: '',
          targetName: 'Item types',
          note: 'Item types changed',
        })
        return next
      })
      toast('Item types saved.')
      return true
    },
    [currentAccount, isStaffUser, toast],
  )

  const baoCreateFaceToFaceOrder = useCallback(
    (input: {
      name: string
      sid: string
      email: string
      date: string
      notes: string
      lines: Array<{ pid: string; vid: string; qty: number }>
    }): { ok: boolean; msg?: string; txnId?: string; queue?: string | null } => {
      if (!currentAccount || !isStaffUser) {
        return { ok: false, msg: 'Only RTU staff can do that.' }
      }
      const name = input.name.trim()
      const sid = input.sid.trim()
      const email = input.email.trim().toLowerCase()
      const todayStr = new Date().toLocaleDateString('en-CA')

      if (name.length < 2) return { ok: false, msg: 'Enter the student name.' }
      if (email && !/^[^@\s]+@[^@\s]+\.[^@\s]+$/.test(email)) {
        return { ok: false, msg: 'That email does not look right.' }
      }
      if (!input.lines.length) return { ok: false, msg: 'Add at least one item.' }
      if (!input.date || input.date > todayStr) {
        return { ok: false, msg: 'Choose today or an earlier date.' }
      }

      const acct =
        (email
          ? db.accounts.find((a) => a.role !== 'moderator' && a.email === email)
          : undefined) ||
        (sid
          ? db.accounts.find((a) => a.role !== 'moderator' && String(a.sid || '') === sid)
          : undefined) ||
        null

      const perItem = new Map<string, number>()
      input.lines.forEach((l) => perItem.set(l.pid, (perItem.get(l.pid) || 0) + l.qty))
      for (const [pid, q] of perItem) {
        const p = db.official.find((x) => x.id === pid)
        if (!p || p.hidden) {
          return {
            ok: false,
            msg: 'An item is no longer on sale. Remove it from the list.',
          }
        }
        if (email || sid || acct) {
          const lim = baoLimitFor(db.bao, p)
          if (lim > 0) {
            const had = baoStudentCount(
              db.bao,
              db.txn,
              p,
              acct ? acct.email : email,
              acct ? acct.sid : sid,
            )
            if (had + q > lim) {
              return {
                ok: false,
                msg:
                  `${p.name}: the limit is ${lim} per student.` +
                  (had ? ` This student already has ${had}.` : ''),
              }
            }
          }
        }
      }

      let outcome: { ok: boolean; msg?: string; txnId?: string; queue?: string | null } = {
        ok: true,
      }

      setDb((prev) => {
        const next: DatabaseSnapshot = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(prev))
        const whenDate =
          input.date === todayStr ? new Date() : new Date(input.date + 'T12:00:00')
        const day = baoDayKey(whenDate)
        const txnId = `TXN-${day}-${String(next.seq.tx + 1).padStart(3, '0')}`

        const builtLines = input.lines.map((l) => {
          const p = next.official.find((x) => x.id === l.pid)!
          return {
            pid: l.pid,
            vid: l.vid || '',
            name: vLineName(p, l.vid),
            qty: l.qty,
            price: unitPrice(p, l.vid),
            kind: 'product' as const,
          }
        })

        // 1. Deduct stock via Sold ledger lines
        const st = applyLedgerOnSnapshot(
          next,
          builtLines.map((l) => ({
            pid: l.pid,
            vid: l.vid,
            type: 'Sold' as const,
            qty: l.qty,
            ticket: txnId,
            reason: 'Face to face sale',
          })),
          { by: currentAccount.name, byEmail: currentAccount.email },
        )
        if (!st.ok) {
          outcome = st
          return prev
        }

        next.seq.tx += 1
        const oid = `FTF-${day}-${String(next.seq.o++).padStart(3, '0')}`
        const firstProd = next.official.find((x) => x.id === builtLines[0].pid)!
        const total = builtLines.reduce((a, l) => a + l.price * l.qty, 0)

        let queueVal: string | null = null
        const qCfg = next.bao.settings.queue
        if (qCfg && qCfg.enabled) {
          const qDay = baoDayKey(whenDate)
          if (qCfg.dailyReset && next.bao.queue.day !== qDay) {
            next.bao.queue = { day: qDay, n: 0 }
          }
          next.bao.queue.day = qDay
          next.bao.queue.n += 1
          queueVal =
            String(qCfg.prefix || '') +
            String(next.bao.queue.n).padStart(Math.max(1, Number(qCfg.pad) || 1), '0')
        }

        const o: OrderRecord = {
          id: oid,
          title:
            builtLines.length === 1
              ? (builtLines[0].qty > 1 ? `${builtLines[0].qty} Ã— ` : '') +
                builtLines[0].name
              : `${builtLines.reduce((a, l) => a + l.qty, 0)} items from RTU Pasig Campus Store`,
          total,
          status: 'Completed',
          tab: 'Completed',
          seller: 'RTU Pasig Campus Store',
          when: `Face to face, ${baoDate(input.date)}`,
          stage: 4,
          tone: firstProd.tone,
          icon: firstProd.icon,
          buyerEmail: acct ? acct.email : email,
          sellerEmail: null,
          lines: builtLines.map((l) => {
            const prod = next.official.find((x) => x.id === l.pid)
            const vr = l.vid && prod ? findVar(prod, l.vid) : undefined
            return {
              pid: l.pid,
              qty: l.qty,
              vid: l.vid,
              vlabel: vr && prod ? varLabel(prod, vr) : '',
              price: l.price,
            }
          }),
        }

        const newTxn: TransactionRecord = {
          id: txnId,
          orderId: o.id,
          type: 'official',
          kind: 'product',
          lines: builtLines,
          summary: builtLines
            .map((l) => l.name + (l.qty > 1 ? ' Ã— ' + l.qty : ''))
            .join(', '),
          qty: builtLines.reduce((a, l) => a + l.qty, 0),
          total,
          buyerEmail: acct ? acct.email : email,
          buyerName: name,
          buyerSid: acct ? acct.sid : sid,
          sellerEmail: null,
          sellerName: 'RTU Pasig Campus Store',
          sellerSid: '',
          meetup: o.when,
          created: whenDate.toISOString(),
          updated: whenDate.toISOString(),
          status: 'Completed',
          history: [
            {
              status: 'Completed',
              ts: whenDate.toISOString(),
              by: currentAccount.name,
              note: 'Face to face entry',
            },
          ],
          bst: 'Claimed',
          src: 'Face to face',
          queue: queueVal,
          pickup: input.date,
          note: input.notes.trim(),
          staff: currentAccount.name,
          staffEmail: currentAccount.email,
          bhist: [
            {
              from: null,
              to: 'Claimed',
              by: currentAccount.name,
              byEmail: currentAccount.email,
              ts: whenDate.toISOString(),
              note:
                'Face to face entry. Handed over at the counter.' +
                (input.notes.trim() ? ' ' + input.notes.trim() : ''),
            },
          ],
        }

        next.txn.push(newTxn)
        const targetAcct = acct
          ? next.accounts.find((a) => a.email === acct.email)
          : undefined
        if (targetAcct) {
          targetAcct.orders.unshift(o)
          targetAcct.notifs.unshift({
            t: `The BAO recorded a face to face claim for ${o.title}. Ticket ${newTxn.id}.`,
            read: false,
            ts: nowT(),
            at: whenDate.toISOString(),
            link: { k: 'order', id: o.id },
          })
        }

        next.audit.push({
          id: 'au' + uid(),
          ts: whenDate.toISOString(),
          by: currentAccount.email,
          byName: currentAccount.name,
          action: 'face to face entry',
          targetType: 'ticket',
          targetId: newTxn.id,
          targetName: newTxn.summary,
          note: `${name}${sid ? ' (' + sid + ')' : ''}`,
        })

        outcome = { ok: true, txnId: newTxn.id, queue: queueVal }
        return next
      })

      return outcome
    },
    [currentAccount, isStaffUser, db.accounts, db.official, db.bao, db.txn],
  )

  const baoSaveDailyReconciliation = useCallback(
    (
      counts: Record<string, string>,
      reasons: Record<string, string>,
    ): { ok: boolean; msg?: string; recId?: string } => {
      if (!currentAccount || !isStaffUser) {
        return { ok: false, msg: 'Only RTU staff can do that.' }
      }
      const allUnits: Array<ReturnType<typeof baoUnits>[0]> = []
      db.official
        .slice()
        .sort((a, b) => a.name.localeCompare(b.name))
        .forEach((p) => {
          baoUnits(p).forEach((u) => allUnits.push(u))
        })

      const lines: Array<{
        u: (typeof allUnits)[0]
        n: number
        diff: number
        reason: string
      }> = []

      for (const u of allUnits) {
        const k = `${u.p.id}|${u.vid}`
        const cVal = counts[k]
        if (cVal === undefined || cVal === '') continue
        const n = parseInt(cVal, 10)
        if (!Number.isInteger(n) || n < 0) {
          return { ok: false, msg: `${baoUnitName(u)}: the count must be 0 or more.` }
        }
        const diff = n - u.onHand
        const reason = String(reasons[k] || '').trim()
        if (diff !== 0 && !reason) {
          return {
            ok: false,
            msg: `${baoUnitName(u)} is different (${diff > 0 ? '+' : ''}${diff}). Add a reason.`,
          }
        }
        lines.push({ u, n, diff, reason })
      }

      if (!lines.length) {
        return { ok: false, msg: 'Enter at least one count.' }
      }

      let outcome: { ok: boolean; msg?: string; recId?: string } = { ok: true }

      setDb((prev) => {
        const next: DatabaseSnapshot = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(prev))
        const adj = lines.filter((l) => l.diff !== 0)
        next.bao.seq.rec += 1
        const rid = 'R-' + String(next.bao.seq.rec).padStart(4, '0')

        if (adj.length) {
          const r = applyLedgerOnSnapshot(
            next,
            adj.map((l) => ({
              pid: l.u.p.id,
              vid: l.u.vid,
              type: 'Adjustment' as const,
              qty: l.diff,
              reason: `Daily count ${rid}: ${l.reason}`,
            })),
            { by: currentAccount.name, byEmail: currentAccount.email },
          )
          if (!r.ok) {
            next.bao.seq.rec -= 1
            outcome =
              r.msg && /reserved|available/.test(r.msg)
                ? {
                    ok: false,
                    msg: `${r.msg} Put the tickets on hold or cancel them first, then count again.`,
                  }
                : r
            return prev
          }
        }

        const now = new Date().toISOString()
        const rec: BaoReconRecord = {
          id: rid,
          ts: now,
          day: new Date().toLocaleDateString('en-CA'),
          by: currentAccount.name,
          byEmail: currentAccount.email,
          lines: lines.map((l) => ({
            pid: l.u.p.id,
            item: l.u.p.name,
            vid: l.u.vid,
            label: l.u.label,
            expected: l.u.onHand,
            counted: l.n,
            diff: l.diff,
            reason: l.reason,
          })),
        }
        next.bao.recon.push(rec)
        next.audit.push({
          id: 'au' + uid(),
          ts: now,
          by: currentAccount.email,
          byName: currentAccount.name,
          action: 'daily count',
          targetType: 'inventory',
          targetId: rid,
          targetName: 'Daily count',
          note: `${lines.length} counted, ${adj.length} different`,
        })
        outcome = { ok: true, recId: rid }
        return next
      })

      return outcome
    },
    [currentAccount, isStaffUser, db.official],
  )

  const storageKb = useMemo(() => {

  }, [db])

  const value = useMemo<TindahanContextValue>(
    () => ({
      db,

// eslint-disable-next-line react-refresh/only-export-components
export function useTindahan(): TindahanContextValue {
  const ctx = useContext(TindahanContext)
  if (!ctx) throw new Error('useTindahan must be used inside <TindahanProvider>')
  return ctx
}

// ===== C:\Users\Lian Andrew\Desktop\RTU_Tindahan_Capstone\RTU_Tindahan_Final\RTU_Tindahan\frontend\src\features\marketplace\pages\admin\ForumReportsPage.tsx =====
import { useState } from 'react'
import { Icon } from '@/common/components/Icon'
import { FR_ACTIONS, stamp } from '../../constants'
import { useTindahan } from '../../context/TindahanContext'
import type { ForumPost } from '../../types'
import './ForumReportsPage.css'

const FR_STATUS_LABELS: Record<string, string> = {
  open: 'Open',
  reviewed: 'Reviewed',
  dismissed: 'Dismissed',
  actioned: 'Action taken',
}

function postTitle(f: ForumPost): string {
  const t = String(f.title || '').trim()
  if (t) return t
  const b = String(f.body || '').trim().replace(/\s+/g, ' ')
  return b ? (b.length > 70 ? b.slice(0, 70).trim() + '...' : b) : 'Untitled post'
}

export function ForumReportsPage() {
  const {
    db,
    isStaffUser,
    openPost,
    setForumReportStatus,
    openModal,
  } = useTindahan()

  const [frTab, setFrTab] = useState<'open' | 'reviewed' | 'dismissed' | 'actioned' | 'all'>('open')

  if (!isStaffUser) {
    return (
      <div className="card stack">
        <b>This page is for RTU staff accounts only.</b>
      </div>
    )
  }

  const tabs: ['open' | 'reviewed' | 'dismissed' | 'actioned' | 'all', string][] = [
    ['open', 'Open'],
    ['reviewed', 'Reviewed'],
    ['dismissed', 'Dismissed'],
    ['actioned', 'Action taken'],
    ['all', 'All'],
  ]

  const cnt = (k: string) =>
    db.freports.filter((r) => k === 'all' || r.status === k).length
  const list = db.freports.filter((r) => frTab === 'all' || r.status === frTab)

  return (
    <div className="fcol wide">
      <div>
        <span className="eyebrow">STAFF Â· MEMBER & FORUM REPORTS</span>
        <h1>Member, Order & Forum Reports</h1>
        <p className="muted small">
          Reports sent by buyers and sellers about meetup/order problems (such as no-shows) as well
          as reported forum posts and comments.
        </p>
      </div>

      <div className="tabs" role="tablist" aria-label="Report status">
        {tabs.map((t) => (
          <button
            key={t[0]}
            type="button"
            className={`tab ${frTab === t[0] ? 'on' : ''}`.trim()}
            role="tab"
            aria-selected={frTab === t[0]}
            onClick={() => setFrTab(t[0])}
          >
            {t[1]} <span className="tnum">({cnt(t[0])})</span>
          </button>
        ))}
      </div>

      {list.length ? (
        list.map((r) => {
          const f = db.feed.find((x) => x.id === r.postId)
          const c = f && r.commentId ? f.comments.find((x) => x.id === r.commentId) : undefined
          const gone = !f || (Boolean(r.commentId) && (!c || c.deleted))
          const live = gone ? null : c || f
          const text = gone ? r.snap.text : c ? c.text : f?.body || r.snap.text

          return (
            <article
              key={r.id}
              className="card stack frcard"
              id={`rep-${r.id}`}
              style={{ gap: 10 }}
            >
              <div className="row between wrap" style={{ gap: 8 }}>
                <div className="row wrap" style={{ gap: 6 }}>
                  <span
                    className={`pill ${
                      r.status === 'open'
                        ? 'red'
                        : r.status === 'actioned'
                          ? 'navy'
                          : ''
                    }`.trim()}
                  >
                    {FR_STATUS_LABELS[r.status] || r.status}
                  </span>
                  <span className={`pill ${r.type === 'order' ? 'yellow' : ''}`.trim()}>
                    {r.type === 'order'
                      ? `Order Report (${r.reporterRole === 'seller' ? 'Seller â†’ Buyer' : 'Buyer â†’ Seller'})`
                      : r.type === 'post'
                        ? 'Post'
                        : 'Comment'}
                  </span>
                  <b>{r.reason}</b>
                </div>
                <span className="tiny muted">{stamp(r.ts)}</span>
              </div>

              {r.details && (
                <p className="small" style={{ overflowWrap: 'anywhere' }}>
                  {r.details}
                </p>
              )}

              <div className="frquote">
                <div className="tiny muted">
                  {r.type === 'order'
                    ? `Transaction / Meetup Report Â· ${r.snap.title}`
                    : `Reported ${r.type}${r.type === 'comment' ? ` on the post "${r.snap.title}"` : ''}${
                        gone
                          ? ' (no longer exists, copy saved when reported)'
                          : live && live.hidden
                            ? ' (currently hidden)'
                            : ''
                      }`}
                </div>
                {(r.type === 'post' || r.type === 'order') && (
                  <b>{r.type === 'order' ? r.snap.title : f ? postTitle(f) : r.snap.title}</b>
                )}
                <div
                  className="small"
                  style={{ overflowWrap: 'anywhere', whiteSpace: 'pre-wrap' }}
                >
                  {String(text || '').slice(0, 400) || <i>No text</i>}
                </div>
                {r.snap.imgs > 0 && (
                  <div className="tiny muted">
                    {r.snap.imgs} photo{r.snap.imgs === 1 ? '' : 's'} attached
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>

              <div className="frmeta">
                <div>
                  <span className="tiny muted">REPORTED BY</span>
                  <br />
                  {r.reporterName}
                  <br />
                  <span className="tiny muted">{r.reporterEmail}</span>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <span className="tiny muted">REPORTED USER</span>
                  <br />
                  {r.targetName}
                  {r.targetEmail && (
                    <>
                      <br />
                      <span className="tiny muted">{r.targetEmail}</span>
                    </>
                  )}
                </div>
                <div>
                  <span className="tiny muted">SUBMITTED</span>
                  <br />
                  {stamp(r.ts)}
                </div>
                <div>
                  <span className="tiny muted">STATUS</span>
                  <br />
                  {FR_STATUS_LABELS[r.status] || r.status}
                  {r.handledBy && (
                    <>
                      <br />
                      <span className="tiny muted">
                        by {r.handledBy}
                        {r.handledAt ? `, ${stamp(r.handledAt)}` : ''}
                      </span>
                    </>
                  )}
                </div>
              </div>

              {r.action ? (
                <div className="small">
                  <b>Action:</b> {FR_ACTIONS[r.action] ? FR_ACTIONS[r.action][0] : r.action}
                  {r.note ? ` Â· ${r.note}` : ''}
                </div>
              ) : (
                r.note && (
                  <div className="small">
                    <b>Note:</b> {r.note}
                  </div>
                )
              )}

              <div className="row wrap" style={{ gap: 6 }}>
                {r.type === 'order' ? (
                  r.targetEmail ? (
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      className="btn ghost sm"
                      onClick={() => openModal({ kind: 'admin-user', email: r.targetEmail! })}
                    >
                      Manage reported account ({r.targetName})
                    </button>
                  ) : null
                ) : (
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    className="btn ghost sm"
                    disabled={gone}
                    onClick={() => openPost(r.postId, r.commentId)}
                  >
                    Open content
                  </button>
                )}
                {r.status === 'open' ? (
                  <>
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      className="btn ghost sm"
                      onClick={() => setForumReportStatus(r.id, 'reviewed')}
                    >
                      Mark reviewed
                    </button>
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      className="btn ghost sm"
                      onClick={() => setForumReportStatus(r.id, 'dismissed')}
                    >
                      Dismiss report
                    </button>
                  </>
                ) : (
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    className="btn ghost sm"
                    onClick={() => setForumReportStatus(r.id, 'open')}
                  >
                    Reopen
                  </button>
                )}
                {r.type !== 'order' && (
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    className="btn sm"
                    onClick={() =>
                      openModal({ kind: 'forum-mod-action', reportId: r.id })
                    }
                  >
                    Take moderation action
                  </button>
                )}
              </div>
            </article>
          )
        })
      ) : (
        <div
          className="card stack"
          style={{ alignItems: 'center', textAlign: 'center', padding: 36 }}
        >
          <span style={{ color: 'var(--blue)' }}>
            <Icon name="check" />
          </span>
          <b>{frTab === 'open' ? 'No open reports' : 'No reports here'}</b>
          <p className="small muted">Reports from members will appear in this list.</p>
        </div>
      )}

      <section className="card stack" style={{ gap: 8 }}>
        <b>
          Moderation log <span className="tiny muted tnum">({db.modlog.length})</span>
        </b>
        {db.modlog.length ? (
          <div style={{ overflowX: 'auto' }}>
            <table className="tbl">
              <thead>
                <tr>
                  <th>When</th>
                  <th>Staff</th>
                  <th>Action</th>
                  <th>Target</th>
                  <th>Outcome</th>
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody>
                {db.modlog.slice(0, 25).map((m) => (
                  <tr key={m.id}>
                    <td className="tnum">{stamp(m.ts)}</td>
                    <td>{m.by}</td>
                    <td>{m.kind}</td>
                    <td>
                      {m.type} by {m.targetName || 'unknown'}
                    </td>
                    <td>
                      {m.outcome || ''}
                      {m.note ? ` Â· ${m.note}` : ''}
                    </td>
                  </tr>
                ))}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <p className="small muted">No moderation actions yet.</p>
        )}
      </section>
    </div>
  )
}

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react'
import { Icon } from '@/common/components/Icon'
import type { IconName } from '@/common/components/icons'
import { navigate } from '@/common/router/router'
import { catOf, peso, subOf } from '../../constants'
import { useTindahan } from '../../context/TindahanContext'
import { IMG_RULES, imgSrc, imgsOf } from '../../imageStore'
import './ModerationPage.css'

export function ModerationPage() {
  const {
    db,
    isStaffUser,
    modTab,
    setModTab,
    selectedFlagId,
    setSelectedFlagId,
    decideFlag,
    reopenFlag,
    adminPauseListing,
    adminResumeListing,
    adminRemoveListing,
    openModal,
  } = useTindahan()

  const [modNote, setModNote] = useState('')
  const [activeImgIdx, setActiveImgIdx] = useState(0)
  const [lightboxOpen, setLightboxOpen] = useState(false)

  const openFlags = db.flags.filter((f) => f.state === 'open')
  const doneFlags = db.flags.filter((f) => f.state !== 'open')
  const list = modTab === 'open' ? openFlags : doneFlags
  const f = list.find((x) => x.id === selectedFlagId) || list[0]
  const lst = f ? db.userListings.find((l) => l.lid === f.lid) : undefined
  const p = lst?.product

  // Reset image index when switching selected flag
  useEffect(() => {
    setActiveImgIdx(0)
    setLightboxOpen(false)
  }, [f?.id])

  if (!isStaffUser) {
    return (
      <div className="card stack">
        <b>This page is for RTU staff accounts only.</b>
      </div>
    )
  }

  const submittedImgIds = p ? imgsOf(p) : []
  const submittedUrls = submittedImgIds.map((id) => imgSrc(id)).filter(Boolean)
  const safeIdx =
    submittedUrls.length > 0 ? Math.min(activeImgIdx, submittedUrls.length - 1) : 0
  const currentImgUrl = submittedUrls[safeIdx] || ''

  const stats: [string, number][] = [
    ['Waiting for approval', openFlags.length],
    ['Approved', db.flags.filter((x) => x.state === 'approved').length],
    ['Rejected', db.flags.filter((x) => x.state === 'removed').length],
    ['Members', db.accounts.filter((a) => a.role !== 'moderator').length],
  ]

  const labelFor = (x: (typeof db.flags)[number]) =>
    x.state === 'open'
      ? x.pri
      : x.state === 'approved'
        ? 'Approved'
        : x.state === 'removed'
          ? 'Rejected'
          : 'Needs review'

  return (
    <>
      <div className="row between wrap">
        <div>
          <span className="eyebrow">STAFF Â· LISTING APPROVAL</span>
          <h1>Approve student listings</h1>
          <p className="muted small">
            Every new listing waits here. Inspect the submitted photos and details before approving
            or rejecting.
          </p>
        </div>
        <span className="row">
          <button
            type="button"
            className="btn ghost"
            onClick={() => openModal({ kind: 'modguide' })}
          >
            Approval guide
          </button>
          <button
            type="button"
            className="btn"
            onClick={() => navigate('staff')}
          >
            Staff tools
          </button>
        </span>
      </div>

      <div className="mod-stats">
        {stats.map((x) => (
          <div key={x[0]} className="card flat stack" style={{ gap: 2 }}>
            <span className="small muted">{x[0]}</span>
            <b className="tnum" style={{ fontSize: 24 }}>
              {x[1]}
            </b>
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>

      <div className="tabs" role="tablist">
        {(
          [
            ['open', 'Waiting', openFlags.length],
            ['done', 'Decided', doneFlags.length],
          ] as const
        ).map((t) => (
          <button
            key={t[0]}
            type="button"
            className={`tab ${modTab === t[0] ? 'on' : ''}`.trim()}
            role="tab"
            aria-selected={modTab === t[0]}
            onClick={() => {
              setModTab(t[0])
              const targetList = t[0] === 'open' ? openFlags : doneFlags
              setSelectedFlagId(targetList[0]?.id || null)
              setModNote('')
            }}
          >
            {t[1]} <span className="tnum">({t[2]})</span>
          </button>
        ))}
      </div>

      {!list.length ? (
        <div
          className="card stack"
          style={{ alignItems: 'center', textAlign: 'center', padding: 40 }}
        >
          <span style={{ color: 'var(--green)' }}>
            <Icon name="shield" />
          </span>
          <b>{modTab === 'open' ? 'Nothing is waiting' : 'No decisions yet'}</b>
          <p className="small muted" style={{ maxWidth: '48ch' }}>
            {modTab === 'open'
              ? 'When a student submits a listing, it shows up here for you to approve or reject.'
              : 'Approved and rejected listings are kept here.'}
          </p>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div className="mod-two two">
          <div className="stack" style={{ gap: 8 }}>
            {list.map((x) => {
              const rowListing = db.userListings.find((l) => l.lid === x.lid)?.product
              const rowImgs = rowListing ? imgsOf(rowListing) : []
              const rowThumb = rowImgs.length ? imgSrc(rowImgs[0]) : ''
              return (
                <button
                  key={x.id}
                  type="button"
                  className="card flat stack"
                  style={{
                    gap: 6,
                    textAlign: 'left',
                    borderColor: f && f.id === x.id ? 'var(--blue)' : undefined,
                    background: f && f.id === x.id ? 'var(--soft)' : undefined,
                  }}
                  onClick={() => {
                    setSelectedFlagId(x.id)
                    setModNote('')
                  }}
                >
                  <div className="row between">
                    <span className="tiny muted">{x.id}</span>
                    <span
                      className={`pill ${
                        x.state === 'approved'
                          ? 'green'
                          : x.state === 'removed'
                            ? 'red'
                            : x.risky
                              ? 'red'
                              : 'yellow'
                      }`}
                    >
                      {labelFor(x)}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="row" style={{ gap: 10 }}>
                    <div
                      className={`photo ${rowListing?.tone || 't-study'} ${
                        rowThumb ? 'has-img' : 'nophoto-tile'
                      }`.trim()}
                      style={{ width: 46, height: 46, aspectRatio: '1', flex: 'none' }}
                    >
                      {rowThumb ? <img className="pimg" src={rowThumb} alt={x.title} /> : null}
                      <Icon name={((rowListing?.icon || 'tag') as IconName)} />
                    </div>
                    <div style={{ minWidth: 0 }}>
                      <b className="small" style={{ display: 'block', overflowWrap: 'anywhere' }}>
                        {x.title}
                      </b>
                      <span className="tiny muted">
                        {peso(x.price)} Â· {x.seller} Â· {rowImgs.length}/{IMG_RULES.listing} photos
                      </span>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </button>
              )
            })}
          </div>

          {f && (
            <div className="card stack">
              <div className="row between wrap">
                <b>Listing details & submitted photos</b>
                <span className="tiny muted">{f.id}</span>
              </div>
              <h2 style={{ fontSize: 19 }}>{f.title}</h2>
              <div className="row wrap">
                <span className="price tnum">{peso(f.price)}</span>
                <span className="small muted" style={{ overflowWrap: 'anywhere' }}>
                  {f.seller}
                </span>
              </div>

              {p ? (
                <>
                  {/* Requirement #2: Student Product Approval - Display Submitted Images */}
                  <div className="mod-gallery" aria-label="Submitted listing images">
                    <div className="row between wrap">
                      <b className="small">
                        Submitted Listing Photos ({submittedUrls.length}/{IMG_RULES.listing} Photos)
                      </b>
                      {submittedUrls.length > 0 && (
                        <span className="tiny muted">
                          Showing photo {safeIdx + 1} of {submittedUrls.length}
                          {safeIdx === 0 ? ' Â· Primary listing cover' : ''}
                        </span>
                      )}
                    </div>

                    {submittedUrls.length > 0 ? (
                      <>
                        <div className="mod-stage">
                          <img
                            className="mod-stage-img"
                            src={currentImgUrl}
                            alt={`${f.title} â€” photo ${safeIdx + 1}`}
                            onClick={() => setLightboxOpen(true)}
                          />
                          <span className="mod-stage-badge">
                            {safeIdx === 0 ? 'Main Cover Â· #1' : `Photo #${safeIdx + 1}`}
                          </span>
                          {submittedUrls.length > 1 && (
                            <>
                              <button
                                type="button"
                                className="mod-stage-nav prev"
                                aria-label="Previous submitted image"
                                onClick={() =>
                                  setActiveImgIdx(
                                    (idx) =>
                                      (idx - 1 + submittedUrls.length) % submittedUrls.length,
                                  )
                                }
                              >
                                â€¹
                              </button>
                              <button
                                type="button"
                                className="mod-stage-nav next"
                                aria-label="Next submitted image"
                                onClick={() =>
                                  setActiveImgIdx((idx) => (idx + 1) % submittedUrls.length)
                                }
                              >
                                â€º
                              </button>
                            </>
                          )}
                          <button
                            type="button"
                            className="mod-enlarge-btn"
                            onClick={() => setLightboxOpen(true)}
                          >
                            <Icon name="eye" size="sm" />
                            Enlarge image
                          </button>
                        </div>

                        <div className="mod-thumbs" role="list" aria-label="Image order">
                          {submittedUrls.map((url, idx) => (
                            <button
                              key={`${submittedImgIds[idx]}-${idx}`}
                              type="button"
                              role="listitem"
                              className={`mod-thumb ${idx === safeIdx ? 'on' : ''}`.trim()}
                              title={idx === 0 ? 'Main listing image (#1)' : `Image #${idx + 1}`}
                              onClick={() => setActiveImgIdx(idx)}
                            >
                              <img src={url} alt={`Submitted thumbnail ${idx + 1}`} />
                              <span className="mod-thumb-idx">
                                {idx === 0 ? 'Main' : `#${idx + 1}`}
                              </span>
                            </button>
                          ))}
                        </div>
                      </>
                    ) : (
                      <div
                        className="card flat row"
                        style={{
                          background: 'var(--card)',
                          padding: 16,
                          justifyContent: 'center',
                        }}
                      >
                        <Icon name="img" size="sm" />
                        <span className="small muted">
                          No photos were uploaded for this submission (0/{IMG_RULES.listing} Photos).
                        </span>
                      </div>
                    )}
                  </div>

                  <div className="grid2 small">
                    <div>
                      <span className="tiny muted">CATEGORY</span>
                      <br />
                      <b>
                        {catOf(p)}
                        {subOf(p) ? ` Â· ${subOf(p)}` : ''}
                      </b>
                    </div>
                    <div>
                      <span className="tiny muted">AVAILABLE</span>
                      <br />
                      <b>{p.left}</b>
                    </div>
                    <div>
                      <span className="tiny muted">PICKUP / SCHEDULE</span>
                      <br />
                      <b>{p.when}</b>
                    </div>
                    <div>
                      <span className="tiny muted">FULFILLMENT OFFERED</span>
                      <br />
                      <b>
                        {p.fulfillment === 'both'
                          ? 'Pickup & Delivery'
                          : p.fulfillment === 'delivery'
                            ? 'Delivery only'
                            : 'Pickup only'}
                      </b>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <div className="card flat" style={{ background: 'var(--bg)' }}>
                    <span className="tiny muted">DESCRIPTION</span>
                    <p
                      className="small"
                      style={{ marginTop: 4, overflowWrap: 'anywhere' }}
                    >
                      {p.desc}
                    </p>
                  </div>
                </>
              ) : (
                <p className="small muted">This listing was deleted by the seller.</p>
              )}

              <div
                className="card flat stack"
                style={{
                  gap: 4,
                  background: f.risky ? 'var(--red-bg)' : 'var(--green-bg)',
                  borderColor: 'transparent',
                }}
              >
                <b className="small">Automatic screening</b>
                <span className="small">{f.reason}</span>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  className="link"
                  style={{ alignSelf: 'flex-start' }}
                  onClick={() => openModal({ kind: 'policy' })}
                >
                  Open prohibited items policy
                </button>
              </div>

              {f.state === 'open' ? (
                <div className="stack" style={{ gap: 8 }}>
                  <b>Your decision</b>
                  <label className="field">
                    <span className="small muted">
                      Note to the seller (sent to Notifications and opens a two-way Inbox
                      conversation if rejected)
                    </span>
                    <textarea
                      className="input"
                      id="modnote"
                      placeholder="Write the approval note or the reason for rejection so the student can reply in Messages..."
                      value={modNote}
                      onChange={(e) => setModNote(e.target.value)}
                    />
                  </label>
                  <div className="row wrap">
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      className="btn"
                      onClick={() => {
                        decideFlag('approved', modNote)
                        setModNote('')
                      }}
                    >
                      <Icon name="check" size="sm" />
                      Approve and publish
                    </button>
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      className="btn danger"
                      onClick={() => {
                        decideFlag('removed', modNote)
                        setModNote('')
                      }}
                    >
                      Reject & message seller
                    </button>
                  </div>
                </div>
              ) : (
                <div className="stack" style={{ gap: 10 }}>
                  <div className="note green">
                    <Icon name="check" />
                    <span className="grow">
                      Decision:{' '}
                      <b>
                        {lst?.modHold
                          ? 'Removed by staff (sent to student Inbox)'
                          : lst?.paused
                            ? 'Paused by staff (sent to student Inbox)'
                            : f.state === 'approved'
                              ? 'Approved and published'
                              : f.state === 'removed'
                                ? 'Rejected (sent to student Inbox)'
                                : 'Needs review'}
                      </b>
                      {f.note ? `. Note: ${f.note}` : ''}
                    </span>
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      className="link"
                      onClick={() => reopenFlag()}
                    >
                      Reopen
                    </button>
                  </div>

                  {lst && f.state === 'approved' && !lst.modHold && (
                    <div className="card flat stack" style={{ background: 'var(--bg)', gap: 8 }}>
                      <b className="small">Manage approved student listing</b>
                      <span className="tiny muted">
                        Pause or delete this published student listing. The student seller will be
                        notified and receive your reason in their Messages Inbox.
                      </span>
                      <input
                        className="input"
                        placeholder="Reason to send to the student seller (at least 5 characters for delete)..."
                        value={modNote}
                        onChange={(e) => setModNote(e.target.value)}
                      />
                      <div className="row wrap" style={{ gap: 8 }}>
                        {lst.paused ? (
                          <button
                            type="button"
                            className="btn sm"
                            onClick={() => adminResumeListing(lst.lid)}
                          >
                            Resume listing
                          </button>
                        ) : (
                          <button
                            type="button"
                            className="btn yellow sm"
                            onClick={() => {
                              if (
                                adminPauseListing(
                                  lst.lid,
                                  modNote.trim() ||
                                    'Temporarily paused by administrator for review.',
                                )
                              ) {
                                setModNote('')
                              }
                            }}
                          >
                            Pause listing & notify student
                          </button>
                        )}
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          className="btn danger sm"
                          onClick={() => {
                            if (modNote.trim().length < 5) {
                              openModal({ kind: 'admin-remove-listing', lid: lst.lid })
                              return
                            }
                            if (adminRemoveListing(lst.lid, modNote.trim())) {
                              setModNote('')
                            }
                          }}
                        >
                          Delete listing & notify student
                        </button>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  )}
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Enlarged Image Inspection Lightbox Modal (Requirement #2) */}
      {lightboxOpen && submittedUrls.length > 0 && f && (
        <>
          <div
            className="modal-scrim cfm-scrim show"
            onClick={() => setLightboxOpen(false)}
          />
          <div
            className="card dlg dlg-wide mod-lightbox"
            role="dialog"
            aria-modal="true"
            aria-label="Inspect submitted image"
            style={{ zIndex: 112 }}
            onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
          >
            <div className="row between wrap">
              <div>
                <b className="small">{f.title}</b>
                <div className="tiny muted">
                  Photo {safeIdx + 1} of {submittedUrls.length}
                  {safeIdx === 0 ? ' (Primary listing image)' : ''} Â· Submitted by {f.seller}
                </div>
              </div>
              <button
                type="button"
                className="iconbtn"
                aria-label="Close image preview"
                onClick={() => setLightboxOpen(false)}
              >
                <Icon name="x" />
              </button>
            </div>

            <div className="mod-lightbox-stage">
              <img
                src={currentImgUrl}
                alt={`${f.title} enlarged photo ${safeIdx + 1}`}
              />
              {submittedUrls.length > 1 && (
                <>
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    className="mod-stage-nav prev"
                    aria-label="Previous photo"
                    onClick={() =>
                      setActiveImgIdx(
                        (idx) => (idx - 1 + submittedUrls.length) % submittedUrls.length,
                      )
                    }
                  >
                    â€¹
                  </button>
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    className="mod-stage-nav next"
                    aria-label="Next photo"
                    onClick={() =>
                      setActiveImgIdx((idx) => (idx + 1) % submittedUrls.length)
                    }
                  >
                    â€º
                  </button>
                </>
              )}
            </div>

            {submittedUrls.length > 1 && (
              <div className="mod-thumbs" style={{ justifyContent: 'center' }}>
                {submittedUrls.map((url, idx) => (
                  <button
                    key={`lb-${idx}`}
                    type="button"
                    className={`mod-thumb ${idx === safeIdx ? 'on' : ''}`.trim()}
                    onClick={() => setActiveImgIdx(idx)}
                  >
                    <img src={url} alt={`Thumbnail ${idx + 1}`} />
                    <span className="mod-thumb-idx">
                      {idx === 0 ? 'Main' : `#${idx + 1}`}
                    </span>
                  </button>
                ))}
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        </>
      )}
    </>
  )
}

// ===== C:\Users\Lian Andrew\Desktop\RTU_Tindahan_Capstone\RTU_Tindahan_Final\RTU_Tindahan\frontend\src\features\marketplace\pages\admin\StaffToolsPage.tsx =====
import { useState } from 'react'
import { Icon } from '@/common/components/Icon'
import { navigate } from '@/common/router/router'
import { monthYear } from '../../constants'
import { useTindahan } from '../../context/TindahanContext'
import './StaffToolsPage.css'

export function StaffToolsPage() {
  const {
    db,
    isStaffUser,
    storageOk,
    storageKb,
    postStaffAnnouncement,
    deleteStaffAnnouncement,
    exportDatabaseBackup,
    importDatabaseBackup,
    openModal,
    setDraft,
    setListStep,
  } = useTindahan()

  const [annTitle, setAnnTitle] = useState('')
  const [annBody, setAnnBody] = useState('')

  if (!isStaffUser) {
    return (
      <div className="card stack">
        <b>This page is for RTU staff accounts only.</b>
      </div>
    )
  }

  const members = db.accounts.filter((a) => a.role !== 'moderator')
  const waiting = db.flags.filter((f) => f.state === 'open').length
  const storeReq = db.txn.filter(
    (t) =>
      t.type === 'official' &&
      !t.sellerEmail &&
      (t.status === 'Pending' || t.status === 'Confirmed'),
  ).length

  return (
    <>
      <div className="row between wrap">
        <div>
          <span className="eyebrow">RTU STAFF</span>
          <h1>Staff tools</h1>
          <p className="muted small">
            Post campus notices, view members, and manage backups. Official RTU Store products are
            created via <b>Admin | Sell an Item</b> and managed in <b>Admin | RTU Shop</b>.
          </p>
        </div>
        <div className="row wrap" style={{ gap: 8 }}>
          <button
            type="button"
            className="btn yellow sm"
            onClick={() => navigate('shop')}
          >
            <Icon name="eye" size="sm" />
            Admin | RTU Shop
          </button>
          <button
            type="button"
            className="btn ghost sm"
            onClick={() => {
              setDraft((prev) => (prev.editLid ? prev : { ...prev, type: 'product' }))
              setListStep(1)
              navigate('create')
            }}
          >
            <Icon name="plus" size="sm" />
            Admin | Sell an Item
          </button>
          <button
            type="button"
            className="btn ghost sm"
            onClick={() => navigate('baoorders')}
          >
            <Icon name="bag" size="sm" />
            Store orders
          </button>
          <button
            type="button"
            className="btn ghost sm"
            onClick={() => navigate('baostock')}
          >
            <Icon name="tag" size="sm" />
            Store inventory
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="staff-stats">
        {(
          [
            ['Members', String(members.length)],
            ['Student listings', String(db.userListings.length)],
            [
              'Official products on sale',
              `${db.official.filter((p) => !p.hidden).length} of ${db.official.length}`,
            ],
            ['Waiting for approval', String(waiting)],
            ['Store requests open', String(storeReq)],
          ] as const
        ).map((x) => (
          <div key={x[0]} className="card flat stack" style={{ gap: 2 }}>
            <span className="small muted">{x[0]}</span>
            <b className="tnum" style={{ fontSize: 24 }}>
              {x[1]}
            </b>
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>

      <div className="staff-two two">
        <div className="stack">
          <form
            className="card stack"
            noValidate
            onSubmit={(e) => {
              e.preventDefault()
              if (postStaffAnnouncement(annTitle, annBody)) {
                setAnnTitle('')
                setAnnBody('')
              }
            }}
          >
            <div>
              <b>Post an announcement</b>
              <p className="small muted">
                Members see it on their profile and get an alert.
              </p>
            </div>
            <div className="field">
              <label htmlFor="an-t">Title</label>
              <input
                className="input"
                id="an-t"
                value={annTitle}
                onChange={(e) => setAnnTitle(e.target.value)}
              />
            </div>
            <div className="field">
              <label htmlFor="an-b">Message</label>
              <textarea
                className="input"
                id="an-b"
                value={annBody}
                onChange={(e) => setAnnBody(e.target.value)}
              />
            </div>
            <div className="row" style={{ justifyContent: 'flex-end' }}>
              <button type="submit" className="btn">
                Post
              </button>
            </div>
          </form>

          <div className="card stack">
            <b>Posted announcements</b>
            {db.ann.length ? (
              db.ann.map((a, i) => (
                <div
                  key={a.id || i}
                  className="row between wrap"
                  style={{ borderTop: '1px solid var(--line)', paddingTop: 8 }}
                >
                  <div>
                    <b className="small">{a.t}</b>
                    <div className="tiny muted">{a.d}</div>
                  </div>
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    className="btn danger sm"
                    onClick={() => deleteStaffAnnouncement(i)}
                  >
                    Delete
                  </button>
                </div>
              ))
            ) : (
              <p className="small muted">Nothing posted yet.</p>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="stack">
          <div className="card stack">
            <b>Members</b>
            {members.length ? (
              members.map((a) => (
                <div
                  key={a.email}
                  className="row between wrap"
                  style={{ borderTop: '1px solid var(--line)', paddingTop: 8 }}
                >
                  <div>
                    <b className="small">{a.name}</b>
                    <div className="tiny muted" style={{ overflowWrap: 'anywhere' }}>
                      {a.email}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <span className="tiny muted">Joined {monthYear(a.since)}</span>
                </div>
              ))
            ) : (
              <p className="small muted">Nobody has signed up yet.</p>
            )}
          </div>

          <div className="card stack">
            <div>
              <b>Backup and storage</b>
              <p className="small muted">
                {storageOk
                  ? 'Saved in this browser (localStorage). No server needed.'
                  : 'Browser storage is blocked, so data lives in memory only.'}{' '}
                Current size: <span className="tnum">{storageKb} KB</span>. Open the app in two
                tabs and changes show up in both.
              </p>
            </div>
            <div className="row wrap">
              <button
                type="button"
                className="btn"
                onClick={exportDatabaseBackup}
              >
                Download backup
              </button>
              <label className="btn ghost" style={{ cursor: 'pointer' }}>
                Import backup
                <input
                  type="file"
                  id="imp-file"
                  accept="application/json,.json"
                  hidden
                  onChange={(e) => {
                    const file = e.target.files?.[0]
                    e.target.value = ''
                    if (file) importDatabaseBackup(file)
                  }}
                />
              </label>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div
            className="card stack"
            style={{ background: 'var(--red-bg)', borderColor: 'transparent' }}
          >
            <b>Reset the prototype</b>
            <p className="small">
              Deletes every account, listing, order, request and announcement saved in this
              browser. Use it before a presentation to start clean.
            </p>
            <button
              type="button"
              className="btn danger"
              onClick={() => openModal({ kind: 'reset-all' })}
            >
              Reset everything
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </>
  )
}

import { useMemo, useState } from 'react'
import { Icon } from '@/common/components/Icon'
import { navigate } from '@/common/router/router'
import { playSuccess } from '@/common/sounds'
import {
  BAO_LTYPES,
  baoDownloadCsv,
  baoIsLow,
  baoItemType,
  baoLedgerCheck,
  baoLowUnits,
  baoReserved,
  baoThreshold,
  baoUnitName,
  baoUnits,
} from '../../baoHelpers'
import { CATEGORIES, stamp } from '../../constants'
import { useTindahan } from '../../context/TindahanContext'
import type { BaoItemType } from '../../types'
import './StoreInventoryPage.css'

const dayKey = (iso: string) => new Date(iso).toLocaleDateString('en-CA')

export function StoreInventoryPage() {
  const {
    db,
    currentAccount,
    isStaffUser,
    invTab,
    setInvTab,
    baoSaveItemTypes,
    baoSaveStoreWindowAndLimit,
    baoSaveDailyReconciliation,
    openModal,
    toast,
  } = useTindahan()

  // Stock tab search & low filter
  const [itemQ, setItemQ] = useState('')
  const [onlyLow, setOnlyLow] = useState(false)

  // Stock ledger filters
  const [lgTicket, setLgTicket] = useState('')
  const [lgType, setLgType] = useState('')
  const [lgItem, setLgItem] = useState('')
  const [lgFrom, setLgFrom] = useState('')
  const [lgTo, setLgTo] = useState('')

  // Item types state
  const [editTypes, setEditTypes] = useState<BaoItemType[]>(() =>
    db.bao.types.map((t) => ({ ...t })),
  )
  const [newTypeName, setNewTypeName] = useState('')
  const [newTypeCat, setNewTypeCat] = useState<string>('Other Items')

  // Windows & limits state
  const wCfg = db.bao.settings.window
  const [winEnabled, setWinEnabled] = useState<boolean>(wCfg.enabled)
  const [winStart, setWinStart] = useState<string>(
    wCfg.start ? String(wCfg.start).slice(0, 16) : '',
  )
  const [winEnd, setWinEnd] = useState<string>(wCfg.end ? String(wCfg.end).slice(0, 16) : '')
  const [winMsg, setWinMsg] = useState<string>(wCfg.message || '')
  const [limitPerStu, setLimitPerStu] = useState<string>(
    String(db.bao.settings.limitPerStudent || 0),
  )

  // Daily Count (reconciliation) state
  const [rcCounts, setRcCounts] = useState<Record<string, string>>({})
  const [rcReasons, setRcReasons] = useState<Record<string, string>>({})

  const unitRows = useMemo(() => {
    const q = itemQ.trim().toLowerCase()
    const out: Array<{
      u: ReturnType<typeof baoUnits>[0]
      first: boolean
      t: BaoItemType | null
    }> = []
    db.official
      .slice()
      .sort((a, b) => a.name.localeCompare(b.name))
      .forEach((p) => {
        const t = baoItemType(db.bao, p)
        if (q && !(p.name + ' ' + (t ? t.name : '')).toLowerCase().includes(q)) return
        baoUnits(p).forEach((u, i) => {
          if (onlyLow && !baoIsLow(u)) return
          out.push({ u, first: i === 0, t })
        })
      })
    return out
  }, [db.official, db.bao, itemQ, onlyLow])

  const allUnitRows = useMemo(() => {
    const out: Array<{
      u: ReturnType<typeof baoUnits>[0]
      first: boolean
      t: BaoItemType | null
    }> = []
    db.official
      .slice()
      .sort((a, b) => a.name.localeCompare(b.name))
      .forEach((p) => {
        const t = baoItemType(db.bao, p)
        baoUnits(p).forEach((u, i) => out.push({ u, first: i === 0, t }))
      })
    return out
  }, [db.official, db.bao])

  if (!isStaffUser) {
    return (
      <div
        className="card stack"
        style={{ alignItems: 'center', textAlign: 'center', padding: 40 }}
      >
        <span style={{ color: 'var(--blue)' }}>
          <Icon name="lock" />
        </span>
        <b>RTU staff only</b>
        <p className="small muted">
          Store inventory can only be opened by BAO and RTU staff accounts.
        </p>
        <button type="button" className="btn" onClick={() => navigate('marketplace')}>
          Back to marketplace
        </button>
      </div>
    )
  }

  const lowList = baoLowUnits(db.official)
  const totalOnHand = allUnitRows.reduce((a, r) => a + r.u.onHand, 0)
  const totalAvailable = allUnitRows.reduce((a, r) => a + r.u.available, 0)
  const totalReserved = Math.max(0, totalOnHand - totalAvailable)

  // Filtered ledger
  const filteredLedger = db.bao.ledger
    .filter((e) => {
      if (lgType && e.type !== lgType) return false
      if (lgItem && e.pid !== lgItem) return false
      if (lgFrom && dayKey(e.ts) < lgFrom) return false
      if (lgTo && dayKey(e.ts) > lgTo) return false
      const q = lgTicket.trim().toLowerCase()
      if (

      ) {
        return false
      }
      return true
    })
    .slice()
    .reverse()

  const ledgerItemOptions = [

  const tabs: Array<['items' | 'ledger' | 'types' | 'rules' | 'recon', string]> = [

    ['recon', 'Daily count'],
  ]

  return (

          <span className="eyebrow">BAO Â· OFFICIAL RTU STORE</span>

          <p className="muted small">
            Stock for the Official RTU Store. Every change is a ledger line with who, when and
            why. Nothing is changed silently.
          </p>
        </div>
        <div className="row wrap no-print" style={{ gap: 8 }}>
          <button
            type="button"
            className="btn ghost sm"
            onClick={() => navigate('baoorders')}
          >
            <Icon name="bag" size="sm" />
            Store orders
          </button>
          <button
            type="button"
            className="btn ghost sm"
            onClick={() => navigate('shop')}
          >
            <Icon name="eye" size="sm" />
            Admin | RTU Shop
          </button>
          <button
            type="button"
            className="btn yellow sm"
            onClick={() => navigate('create')}
          >
            <Icon name="plus" size="sm" />
            Add official product
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Live Inventory Summary Cards */}
      <div className="inv-summary no-print">
        <div className="card flat stack inv-formula-card" style={{ gap: 2 }}>
          <span className="small muted">On Hand (Store room)</span>
          <b className="tnum" style={{ fontSize: 24 }}>
            {totalOnHand}
          </b>
        </div>
        <div className="card flat stack" style={{ gap: 2 }}>
          <span className="small muted">Reserved (Open tickets)</span>
          <b className="tnum" style={{ fontSize: 24 }}>
            {totalReserved}
          </b>
        </div>
        <div className="card flat stack" style={{ gap: 2 }}>
          <span className="small muted">Available (Shown to students)</span>
          <b className="tnum" style={{ fontSize: 24, color: 'var(--green)' }}>
            {totalAvailable}
          </b>
        </div>
        <button
          type="button"
          className={`card flat stack bao-stat ${onlyLow && invTab === 'items' ? 'on' : ''}`.trim()}
          style={{ gap: 2, textAlign: 'left' }}
          onClick={() => {
            setOnlyLow((prev) => !prev)
            setInvTab('items')
          }}
        >
          <span className="small muted">Low / Out of stock</span>
          <b
            className="tnum"
            style={{
              fontSize: 24,
              color: lowList.length ? 'var(--red, #b33939)' : undefined,
            }}
          >
            {lowList.length}
          </b>
        </button>
      </div>

      <div className="tabs no-print" role="tablist">
        {tabs.map(([k, label]) => (

            role="tab"
            aria-selected={invTab === k}
            onClick={() => {
              if (k === 'types') {
                setEditTypes(db.bao.types.map((t) => ({ ...t })))
              }
              setInvTab(k)
            }}
          >
            {label}
          </button>
        ))}
      </div>

      {/* TAB 1: STOCK */}
      {invTab === 'items' && (
        <>
          {lowList.length > 0 && (
            <div className="note" role="status" data-bao-low>
              <Icon name="clock" />
              <span>
                <b>
                  {lowList.length} low stock warning{lowList.length === 1 ? '' : 's'}.
                </b>{' '}

                  .map((u) => `${baoUnitName(u)} (${u.available} available)`)
                  .join(', ')}

            </div>
          )}

          <div className="row between wrap" style={{ alignItems: 'flex-end' }}>
            <div className="field" style={{ minWidth: 240, flex: 1 }}>
              <label htmlFor="iv-q">Search items</label>

                value={itemQ}

                onChange={(e) => setItemQ(e.target.value)}
              />
            </div>
            <span className="row wrap" style={{ gap: 8 }}>
              {onlyLow && (
                <button
                  type="button"
                  className="btn ghost sm"

                  Show all items
                </button>

              <button
                type="button"

                onClick={() => {
                  const bad = baoLedgerCheck(db.bao, db.official, db.txn)
                  toast(

              {!db.official.length && (

          </div>

          <div className="row between wrap">
