// ===== C:\Users\Lian Andrew\Desktop\RTU_Tindahan_Capstone\RTU_Tindahan_Final\RTU_Tindahan\frontend\src\features\marketplace\pages\admin\TransactionsPage.tsx =====
import { useState } from 'react'
import { Icon } from '@/common/components/Icon'
import { navigate } from '@/common/router/router'
import { BAO_PILL, baoIsOfficialTxn, baoStatusOf } from '../../baoHelpers'
import { TX_PILL, peso, stamp } from '../../constants'
import { useTindahan } from '../../context/TindahanContext'
import './TransactionsPage.css'

const dayKey = (iso: string) => new Date(iso).toLocaleDateString('en-CA')

export function TransactionsPage() {
  const { db, isStaffUser, exportTransactionsCsv, openModal } = useTindahan()

  const [tab, setTab] = useState<'all' | 'student' | 'official'>('all')
  const [q, setQ] = useState('')
  const [status, setStatus] = useState('')
  const [kind, setKind] = useState('')
  const [from, setFrom] = useState('')
  const [to, setTo] = useState('')

  if (!isStaffUser) {
    return (
      <div
        className="card stack"
        style={{ alignItems: 'center', textAlign: 'center', padding: 40 }}
      >
        <span style={{ color: 'var(--blue)' }}>
          <Icon name="lock" />
        </span>
        <b>RTU staff only</b>
        <p className="small muted">
          Transaction records can only be opened by RTU staff accounts.
        </p>
        <button
          type="button"
          className="btn"
          onClick={() => navigate('marketplace')}
        >
          Back to marketplace
        </button>
      </div>
    )
  }

  const scope = db.txn.filter((t) => tab === 'all' || t.type === tab)
  const cnt = (s: string) => scope.filter((t) => t.status === s).length
  const doneVal = scope
    .filter((t) => t.status === 'Completed')
    .reduce((a, t) => a + t.total, 0)

  const rows = db.txn
    .filter((t) => {
      if (tab !== 'all' && t.type !== tab) return false
      if (status && t.status !== status) return false
      if (kind && t.kind !== kind) return false
      if (from && dayKey(t.created) < from) return false
      if (to && dayKey(t.created) > to) return false
      const sq = q.trim().toLowerCase()
      if (
        sq &&
        !(
          t.id +
          ' ' +
          t.orderId +
          ' ' +
          t.summary +
          ' ' +
          t.buyerName +
          ' ' +
          t.buyerEmail +
          ' ' +
          t.buyerSid +
          ' ' +
          t.sellerName +
          ' ' +
          (t.sellerEmail || '') +
          ' ' +
          t.sellerSid
        )
          .toLowerCase()
          .includes(sq)
      ) {
        return false
      }
      return true
    })
    .sort((a, b) => String(b.created).localeCompare(String(a.created)))

  const waiting = db.txn.filter(
    (t) =>
      t.type === 'official' &&
      !t.sellerEmail &&
      (t.status === 'Pending' || t.status === 'Confirmed'),
  ).length

  const tabs: ['all' | 'student' | 'official', string, number][] = [
    ['all', 'All transactions', db.txn.length],
    ['student', 'Student to student', db.txn.filter((t) => t.type === 'student').length],
    ['official', 'Official RTU Store', db.txn.filter((t) => t.type === 'official').length],
  ]

  const clearFilters = () => {
    setQ('')
    setStatus('')
    setKind('')
    setFrom('')
    setTo('')
  }

  return (
    <>
      <div className="row between wrap">
        <div style={{ maxWidth: '66ch' }}>
          <span className="eyebrow">STAFF Â· TRANSACTIONS</span>
          <h1>Transaction history</h1>
          <p className="muted small">
            Every request made on Tindahan is recorded here with its buyer, seller, items and
            total. A record starts as Pending when the buyer sends a request, not when someone
            sends a message. Records stay even if a listing is changed or removed.
          </p>
        </div>
        <button
          type="button"
          className="btn ghost"
          onClick={() => exportTransactionsCsv(rows)}
        >
          <Icon name="upload" size="sm" />
          Export as CSV
        </button>
      </div>

      {waiting > 0 && (
        <div className="note" role="status">
          <Icon name="clock" />
          <span>
            <b>
              {waiting} Official RTU Store request{waiting === 1 ? '' : 's'} need
              {waiting === 1 ? 's' : ''} staff action.
            </b>{' '}
            Open one to manage its ticket status, or open Store orders.
          </span>
          <span className="row" style={{ gap: 8 }}>
            <button
              type="button"
              className="btn ghost sm"
              onClick={() => setTab('official')}
            >
              Show here
            </button>
            <button
              type="button"
              className="btn sm"
              onClick={() => navigate('baoorders')}
            >
              Open Store orders
            </button>
          </span>
        </div>
      )}

      <div className="tabs" role="tablist" aria-label="Source">
        {tabs.map((t) => (
          <button
            key={t[0]}
            type="button"
            className={`tab ${tab === t[0] ? 'on' : ''}`.trim()}
            role="tab"
            aria-selected={tab === t[0]}
            onClick={() => setTab(t[0])}
          >
            {t[1]} <span className="tnum">({t[2]})</span>
          </button>
        ))}
      </div>

      <div className="txstat">
        {(
          [
            ['Pending', String(cnt('Pending'))],
            ['Confirmed', String(cnt('Confirmed'))],
            ['Completed', String(cnt('Completed'))],
            ['Cancelled', String(cnt('Cancelled'))],
            ['Completed value', peso(doneVal)],
          ] as const
        ).map((x) => (
          <div key={x[0]} className="card flat stack" style={{ gap: 2 }}>
            <span className="small muted">{x[0]}</span>
            <b className="tnum" style={{ fontSize: 22 }}>
              {x[1]}
            </b>
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>

      <div className="card tx-filters">
        <div className="field">
          <label htmlFor="tx-q">Search</label>
          <input
            className="input"
            id="tx-q"
            value={q}
            placeholder="ID, item, buyer, seller or student number"
            onChange={(e) => setQ(e.target.value)}
          />
        </div>
        <div className="field">
          <label htmlFor="tx-status">Status</label>
          <select
            className="input"
            id="tx-status"
            value={status}
            onChange={(e) => setStatus(e.target.value)}
          >
            <option value="">All</option>
            {['Pending', 'Confirmed', 'Completed', 'Cancelled'].map((s) => (
              <option key={s} value={s}>
                {s}
              </option>
            ))}
          </select>
        </div>
        <div className="field">
          <label htmlFor="tx-kind">Type</label>
          <select
            className="input"
            id="tx-kind"
            value={kind}
            onChange={(e) => setKind(e.target.value)}
          >
            <option value="">Products and services</option>
            <option value="product">Products</option>
            <option value="service">Services</option>
          </select>
        </div>
        <div className="field">
          <label htmlFor="tx-from">From</label>
          <input
            className="input"
            id="tx-from"
            type="date"
            value={from}
            onChange={(e) => setFrom(e.target.value)}
          />
        </div>
        <div className="field">
          <label htmlFor="tx-to">To</label>
          <input
            className="input"
            id="tx-to"
            type="date"
            value={to}
            onChange={(e) => setTo(e.target.value)}
          />
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="row between wrap">
        <span className="small muted tnum">
          {rows.length} of {db.txn.length} record{db.txn.length === 1 ? '' : 's'}
        </span>
        {(q || status || kind || from || to) && (
          <button type="button" className="link" onClick={clearFilters}>
            Clear filters
          </button>
        )}
      </div>

      {rows.length ? (
        <div className="card" style={{ padding: 0 }}>
          <div className="scroll-x">
            <table className="tbl" style={{ minWidth: 860 }}>
              <thead>
                <tr>
                  <th>ID</th>
                  <th>Date</th>
                  <th>Item</th>
                  <th>Qty</th>
                  <th>Buyer</th>
                  <th>Seller</th>
                  <th>Total</th>
                  <th>Status</th>
                  <th />
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody>
                {rows.map((t) => {
                  const isOff = baoIsOfficialTxn(t)
                  const bSt = isOff ? baoStatusOf(t) : null
                  return (
                    <tr key={t.id}>
                      <td className="tnum">
                        <b>{t.id}</b>
                        <div className="tiny muted">{t.orderId}</div>
                      </td>
                      <td className="tnum" style={{ whiteSpace: 'nowrap' }}>
                        {stamp(t.created)}
                      </td>
                      <td>
                        {t.summary}
                        {t.kind !== 'product' && (
                          <>
                            {' '}
                            <span className="srcpill svc">Service</span>
                          </>
                        )}
                      </td>
                      <td className="tnum">{t.qty}</td>
                      <td>
                        {t.buyerName}
                        <div className="tiny muted">{t.buyerSid || ''}</div>
                      </td>
                      <td>
                        {t.sellerName}
                        <div>
                          <span
                            className={`srcpill ${
                              t.type === 'official' ? 'school' : 'student'
                            }`}
                          >
                            {t.type === 'official' ? 'Official RTU Store' : 'Student'}
                          </span>
                        </div>
                      </td>
                      <td className="tnum">{peso(t.total)}</td>
                      <td>
                        {isOff && bSt ? (
                          <span className={`pill ${BAO_PILL[bSt] || ''}`.trim()}>
                            {bSt}
                          </span>
                        ) : (
                          <span className={`pill ${TX_PILL[t.status] || ''}`.trim()}>
                            {t.status}
                          </span>
                        )}
                      </td>
                      <td>
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          className="rowbtn"
                          onClick={() =>
                            openModal(
                              isOff
                                ? { kind: 'bao-ticket', txnId: t.id }
                                : { kind: 'txn-view', txnId: t.id },
                            )
                          }
                        >
                          Review
                        </button>
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  )
                })}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </div>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div
          className="card stack"
          style={{ alignItems: 'center', textAlign: 'center', padding: 40 }}
        >
          <span style={{ color: 'var(--blue)' }}>
            <Icon name="bag" />
          </span>
          <b>{db.txn.length ? 'No records match' : 'No transactions yet'}</b>
          <p className="small muted" style={{ maxWidth: '52ch' }}>
            {db.txn.length
              ? 'Try clearing a filter or searching for something else.'
              : 'When a student sends a request for a product or service, it is recorded here as Pending.'}
          </p>
          {db.txn.length > 0 && (
            <button type="button" className="btn" onClick={clearFilters}>
              Clear filters
            </button>
          )}
        </div>
      )}
    </>
  )
}

// ===== C:\Users\Lian Andrew\Desktop\RTU_Tindahan_Capstone\RTU_Tindahan_Final\RTU_Tindahan\frontend\src\features\marketplace\pages\admin\UsersAuditPage.tsx =====
import { useState } from 'react'
import { Icon } from '@/common/components/Icon'
import { navigate } from '@/common/router/router'
import { catOf, isSvc, peso, stamp } from '../../constants'
import { useTindahan } from '../../context/TindahanContext'
import type { UserListingRecord } from '../../types'
import './UsersAuditPage.css'

const ADM_TABS = [
  ['users', 'Users'],
  ['listings', 'Listings'],
  ['audit', 'Audit log'],
] as const

export function UsersAuditPage() {
  const {
    db,
    isStaffUser,
    acctByEmail,
    openProduct,
    openModal,
    confirmDlg,
    adminRestoreListing,
    adminResumeListing,
    toggleHideOfficialProduct,
    toast,
  } = useTindahan()

  const [tab, setTab] = useState<'users' | 'listings' | 'audit'>('users')

  // Users filters
  const [uq, setUq] = useState('')
  const [ust, setUst] = useState('all')
  const [urole, setUrole] = useState('all')

  // Listings filters
  const [lq, setLq] = useState('')
  const [lst, setLst] = useState('all')
  const [lkind, setLkind] = useState('all')
  const [lowner, setLowner] = useState('')

  // Audit filters
  const [aq, setAq] = useState('')
  const [aact, setAact] = useState('all')
  const [atype, setAtype] = useState('all')
  const [alimit, setAlimit] = useState(50)

  if (!isStaffUser) {
    return (
      <div className="card stack">
        <b>This page is for RTU staff accounts only.</b>
      </div>
    )
  }

  const admCount = (n: number, one: string, many?: string) =>
    `${n} ${n === 1 ? one : many || `${one}s`}`

  const admListState = (l: UserListingRecord): [string, string, string] => {
    const o = acctByEmail(l.ownerEmail)
    if (l.modHold) return ['Removed by staff', 'red', 'staff']
    if (o && o.status && o.status !== 'active')
      return [`Hidden, seller ${o.status}`, 'yellow', 'hidden']
    if (l.state === 'live')
      return l.paused ? ['Paused', 'yellow', 'paused'] : ['Live', 'green', 'live']
    if (l.state === 'review') return ['Pending review', 'yellow', 'review']
    if (l.state === 'removed') return ['Not approved', 'red', 'rejected']
    return [String(l.state), 'yellow', 'other']
  }

  const blocked = db.accounts.filter((a) => a.status && a.status !== 'active').length
  const held = db.userListings.filter((l) => l.modHold).length
  const reports = db.freports.filter((r) => r.status === 'open').length
  const waiting = db.flags.filter((f) => f.state === 'open').length

  const filteredUsers = db.accounts
    .filter((a) => {
      const st = a.status || 'active'
      if (ust !== 'all' && st !== ust) return false
      if (urole !== 'all' && (urole === 'staff') !== (a.role === 'moderator'))
        return false
      const q = uq.trim().toLowerCase()
      if (!q) return true
      return [a.name, a.email, a.sid].some((x) =>
        String(x || '').toLowerCase().includes(q),
      )
    })
    .sort(
      (x, y) =>
        Number(x.role === 'moderator') - Number(y.role === 'moderator') ||
        x.name.localeCompare(y.name),
    )

  const filteredListings = db.userListings
    .map((l) => ({ l, st: admListState(l), o: acctByEmail(l.ownerEmail) }))
    .filter((r) => {
      const p = r.l.product
      if (lst !== 'all' && r.st[2] !== lst) return false
      if (lkind !== 'all' && (lkind === 'service') !== isSvc(p)) return false
      if (lowner && r.l.ownerEmail !== lowner) return false
      const q = lq.trim().toLowerCase()
      if (!q) return true
      return [p.name, r.o ? r.o.name : '', r.l.ownerEmail].some((x) =>
        String(x || '').toLowerCase().includes(q),
      )
    })

  const auditActs = Array.from(new Set(db.audit.map((a) => a.action))).sort()
  const auditTypes = Array.from(new Set(db.audit.map((a) => a.targetType))).sort()
  const allAudit = db.audit.slice().reverse()
  const filteredAudit = allAudit.filter((a) => {
    if (aact !== 'all' && a.action !== aact) return false
    if (atype !== 'all' && a.targetType !== atype) return false
    const q = aq.trim().toLowerCase()
    if (!q) return true
    return [a.byName, a.by, a.action, a.targetName, a.targetId, a.note].some((x) =>
      String(x || '').toLowerCase().includes(q),
    )
  })
  const shownAudit = filteredAudit.slice(0, alimit)
  const ownerAcct = lowner ? acctByEmail(lowner) : undefined

  return (
    <div className="stack" style={{ gap: 16 }}>
      <div>
        <span className="eyebrow">STAFF Â· USERS AND AUDIT</span>
        <h1>Users and audit</h1>
        <p className="muted small" style={{ maxWidth: '68ch' }}>
          See every account, suspend or ban a member, restore access, remove or restore listings,
          and read the record of what staff did. Nothing here deletes an account or a transaction.
        </p>
      </div>

      <div className="adm-stats">
        {(
          [
            ['Accounts', db.accounts.length, ''],
            ['Suspended or banned', blocked, ''],
            ['Listings removed by staff', held, ''],
            ['Open forum reports', reports, 'forum-reports'],
            ['Listings waiting for approval', waiting, 'moderation'],
          ] as const
        ).map((x) =>
          x[2] ? (
            <button
              key={x[0]}
              type="button"
              className="card flat stack adm-stat"
              style={{ gap: 2, textAlign: 'left' }}
              onClick={() => navigate(x[2])}
            >
              <span className="small muted">{x[0]}</span>
              <b className="tnum" style={{ fontSize: 22 }}>
                {x[1]}
              </b>
            </button>
          ) : (
            <div key={x[0]} className="card flat stack adm-stat" style={{ gap: 2 }}>
              <span className="small muted">{x[0]}</span>
              <b className="tnum" style={{ fontSize: 22 }}>
                {x[1]}
              </b>
            </div>
          ),
        )}
      </div>

      <div className="tabs" role="tablist" aria-label="Users and audit sections">
        {ADM_TABS.map((t) => (
          <button
            key={t[0]}
            type="button"
            className={`tab ${tab === t[0] ? 'on' : ''}`.trim()}
            role="tab"
            aria-selected={tab === t[0]}
            onClick={() => setTab(t[0])}
          >
            {t[1]}
            {t[0] === 'audit' && <span className="tnum"> ({db.audit.length})</span>}
          </button>
        ))}
      </div>

      <div role="tabpanel" className="stack" style={{ gap: 12 }}>
        {tab === 'users' && (
          <>
            <div className="card flat adm-filters">
              <div className="field">
                <label htmlFor="adm-q">Search</label>
                <input
                  className="input"
                  id="adm-q"
                  value={uq}
                  placeholder="Name, email or student number"
                  autoComplete="off"
                  onChange={(e) => setUq(e.target.value)}
                />
              </div>
              <div className="field">
                <label htmlFor="adm-st">Status</label>
                <select
                  className="input"
                  id="adm-st"
                  value={ust}
                  onChange={(e) => setUst(e.target.value)}
                >
                  <option value="all">All statuses</option>
                  <option value="active">Active</option>
                  <option value="suspended">Suspended</option>
                  <option value="banned">Banned</option>
                </select>
              </div>
              <div className="field">
                <label htmlFor="adm-role">Role</label>
                <select
                  className="input"
                  id="adm-role"
                  value={urole}
                  onChange={(e) => setUrole(e.target.value)}
                >
                  <option value="all">Students and staff</option>
                  <option value="student">Students</option>
                  <option value="staff">Staff</option>
                </select>
              </div>
            </div>

            <p className="small muted" role="status">
              {filteredUsers.length} of {admCount(db.accounts.length, 'account')}
              {(uq || ust !== 'all' || urole !== 'all') && (
                <>
                  {' '}
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    className="link"
                    onClick={() => {
                      setUq('')
                      setUst('all')
                      setUrole('all')
                    }}
                  >
                    Clear filters
                  </button>
                </>
              )}
            </p>

            {filteredUsers.length ? (
              <div className="scroll-x">
                <table className="tbl adm-tbl">
                  <thead>
                    <tr>
                      <th>Name</th>
                      <th>Email</th>
                      <th>Role</th>
                      <th>Status</th>
                      <th>Joined</th>
                      <th>Listings</th>
                      <th>Orders</th>
                      <th>
                        <span className="sr-only">Actions</span>
                      </th>
                    </tr>
                  </thead>
                  <tbody>
                    {filteredUsers.map((a) => {
                      const st = a.status || 'active'
                      return (
                        <tr key={a.email}>
                          <td>
                            <b>{a.name}</b>
                            <div className="tiny muted">{a.sid || ''}</div>
                          </td>
                          <td style={{ overflowWrap: 'anywhere' }}>{a.email}</td>
                          <td>{a.role === 'moderator' ? 'Staff' : 'Student'}</td>
                          <td>
                            <span
                              className={`pill ${
                                st === 'banned'
                                  ? 'red'
                                  : st === 'suspended'
                                    ? 'yellow'
                                    : 'green'
                              }`}
                            >
                              {st === 'banned'
                                ? 'Banned'
                                : st === 'suspended'
                                  ? 'Suspended'
                                  : 'Active'}
                            </span>
                          </td>
                          <td className="tnum">
                            {a.since
                              ? new Date(a.since).toLocaleDateString('en-PH', {
                                  month: 'short',
                                  day: 'numeric',
                                  year: 'numeric',
                                })
                              : ''}
                          </td>
                          <td className="tnum">
                            {
                              db.userListings.filter((l) => l.ownerEmail === a.email)
                                .length
                            }
                          </td>
                          <td className="tnum">{a.orders.length}</td>
                          <td>
                            <button
                              type="button"
                              className="btn ghost sm"
                              aria-label={`Manage ${a.name}`}
                              onClick={() =>
                                openModal({ kind: 'admin-user', email: a.email })
                              }
                            >
                              Manage
                            </button>
                          </td>
                        </tr>
                      )
                    })}
                  </tbody>
                </table>
              </div>
            ) : (
              <div
                className="card stack"
                style={{ alignItems: 'center', textAlign: 'center', padding: 32 }}
              >
                <b>No accounts match</b>
                <p className="small muted">
                  Try a different search or clear the filters.
                </p>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  className="btn"
                  onClick={() => {
                    setUq('')
                    setUst('all')
                    setUrole('all')
                  }}
                >
                  Clear filters
                </button>
              </div>
            )}
          </>
        )}

        {tab === 'listings' && (
          <>
            <div className="card flat adm-filters">
              <div className="field">
                <label htmlFor="adm-lq">Search</label>
                <input
                  className="input"
                  id="adm-lq"
                  value={lq}
                  placeholder="Listing or seller"
                  autoComplete="off"
                  onChange={(e) => setLq(e.target.value)}
                />
              </div>
              <div className="field">
                <label htmlFor="adm-lst">Status</label>
                <select
                  className="input"
                  id="adm-lst"
                  value={lst}
                  onChange={(e) => setLst(e.target.value)}
                >
                  <option value="all">All statuses</option>
                  <option value="live">Live</option>
                  <option value="paused">Paused by seller</option>
                  <option value="review">Pending review</option>
                  <option value="rejected">Not approved</option>
                  <option value="staff">Removed by staff</option>
                  <option value="hidden">Hidden, seller suspended or banned</option>
                </select>
              </div>
              <div className="field">
                <label htmlFor="adm-lkind">Type</label>
                <select
                  className="input"
                  id="adm-lkind"
                  value={lkind}
                  onChange={(e) => setLkind(e.target.value)}
                >
                  <option value="all">Products and services</option>
                  <option value="product">Products</option>
                  <option value="service">Services</option>
                </select>
              </div>
            </div>

            {ownerAcct && (
              <p className="small">
                <span className="chip">
                  Seller: {ownerAcct.name}{' '}
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    aria-label="Clear seller filter"
                    onClick={() => setLowner('')}
                  >
                    <Icon name="x" size="sm" />
                  </button>
                </span>
              </p>
            )}

            <p className="small muted" role="status">
              {filteredListings.length} of{' '}
              {admCount(db.userListings.length, 'student listing')}
              {(lst !== 'all' || lq || lkind !== 'all' || lowner) && (
                <>
                  {' '}
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    className="link"
                    onClick={() => {
                      setLq('')
                      setLst('all')
                      setLkind('all')
                      setLowner('')
                    }}
                  >
                    Clear filters
                  </button>
                </>
              )}
            </p>

            {filteredListings.length ? (
              <div className="scroll-x">
                <table className="tbl adm-tbl">
                  <thead>
                    <tr>
                      <th>Listing</th>
                      <th>Seller</th>
                      <th>Type</th>
                      <th>Price</th>
                      <th>Status</th>
                      <th>
                        <span className="sr-only">Actions</span>
                      </th>
                    </tr>
                  </thead>
                  <tbody>
                    {filteredListings.map((r) => {
                      const p = r.l.product
                      return (
                        <tr key={r.l.lid}>
                          <td>
                            <b>{p.name}</b>
                            {r.l.modHold && (
                              <div className="tiny muted">
                                Reason: {r.l.modHold.note}
                              </div>
                            )}
                          </td>
                          <td>{r.o ? r.o.name : r.l.ownerEmail}</td>
                          <td>{isSvc(p) ? 'Service' : catOf(p)}</td>
                          <td className="tnum">{peso(p.price)}</td>
                          <td>
                            <span className={`pill ${r.st[1]}`}>{r.st[0]}</span>
                          </td>
                          <td>
                            <span className="row wrap" style={{ gap: 6 }}>
                              <button
                                type="button"
                                className="btn ghost sm"
                                onClick={() => openProduct(p.id)}
                              >
                                View
                              </button>
                              {r.l.modHold ? (
                                <button
                                  type="button"
                                  className="btn sm"
                                  onClick={() =>
                                    confirmDlg({
                                      title: 'Restore this listing?',
                                      msg: `â€œ${p.name}â€ goes back to the state it had before it was removed, and the seller is told.`,
                                      yes: 'Restore listing',
                                      no: 'Cancel',
                                      run: () => {
                                        if (adminRestoreListing(r.l.lid)) {
                                          toast('Listing restored.')
                                        }
                                      },
                                    })
                                  }
                                >
                                  Restore
                                </button>
                              ) : (
                                <>
                                  {r.l.state === 'live' &&
                                    (r.l.paused ? (
                                      <button
                                        type="button"
                                        className="btn ghost sm"
                                        onClick={() => adminResumeListing(r.l.lid)}
                                      >
                                        Resume
                                      </button>
                                    ) : (
                                      <button
                                        type="button"
                                        className="btn ghost sm"
                                        onClick={() =>
                                          openModal({
                                            kind: 'admin-remove-listing',
                                            lid: r.l.lid,
                                          })
                                        }
                                      >
                                        Pause
                                      </button>
                                    ))}
                                  <button
                                    type="button"
                                    className="btn danger sm"
                                    onClick={() =>
                                      openModal({
                                        kind: 'admin-remove-listing',
                                        lid: r.l.lid,
                                      })
                                    }
                                  >
                                    Delete
                                  </button>
                                </>
                              )}
                            </span>
                          </td>
                        </tr>
                      )
                    })}
                  </tbody>
                </table>
              </div>
            ) : (
              <div
                className="card stack"
                style={{ alignItems: 'center', textAlign: 'center', padding: 32 }}
              >
                <b>No listings match</b>
                <p className="small muted">
                  Student listings appear here once members create them.
                </p>
                {(lst !== 'all' || lq || lkind !== 'all' || lowner) && (
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    className="btn"
                    onClick={() => {
                      setLq('')
                      setLst('all')
                      setLkind('all')
                      setLowner('')
                    }}
                  >
                    Clear filters
                  </button>
                )}
              </div>
            )}

            <section className="card stack" style={{ gap: 10 }}>
              <div className="row between wrap">
                <div>
                  <b>Official RTU Store</b>
                  <p className="small muted">
                    Items sold by the school. Hiding an item is reversible. Add, edit or remove
                    items in Admin | RTU Shop.
                  </p>
                </div>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  className="btn ghost sm"
                  onClick={() => navigate('shop')}
                >
                  Open Admin | RTU Shop
                </button>
              </div>
              {db.official.length ? (
                <div className="scroll-x">
                  <table className="tbl adm-tbl">
                    <thead>
                      <tr>
                        <th>Item</th>
                        <th>Price</th>
                        <th>In stock</th>
                        <th>Status</th>
                        <th>
                          <span className="sr-only">Actions</span>
                        </th>
                      </tr>
                    </thead>
                    <tbody>
                      {db.official.map((p) => (
                        <tr key={p.id}>
                          <td>
                            <b>{p.name}</b>
                          </td>
                          <td className="tnum">{peso(p.price)}</td>
                          <td className="tnum">{p.left == null ? '' : p.left}</td>
                          <td>
                            <span className={`pill ${p.hidden ? 'yellow' : 'green'}`}>
                              {p.hidden ? 'Hidden' : 'On sale'}
                            </span>
                          </td>
                          <td>
                            <button
                              type="button"
                              className="btn ghost sm"
                              onClick={() => toggleHideOfficialProduct(p.id)}
                            >
                              {p.hidden ? 'Publish' : 'Hide'}
                            </button>
                          </td>
                        </tr>
                      ))}
                    </tbody>
                  </table>
                </div>
              ) : (
                <p className="small muted">No official items yet.</p>
              )}
            </section>
          </>
        )}

        {tab === 'audit' && (
          <>
            <p className="small muted" style={{ maxWidth: '68ch' }}>
              Every staff action on this page and on the other staff pages is written here with who
              did it, what it was done to and when. Entries cannot be edited or deleted from the
              screen.
            </p>
            <div className="card flat adm-filters">
              <div className="field">
                <label htmlFor="adm-aq">Search</label>
                <input
                  className="input"
                  id="adm-aq"
                  value={aq}
                  placeholder="Staff, target or note"
                  autoComplete="off"
                  onChange={(e) => {
                    setAq(e.target.value)
                    setAlimit(50)
                  }}
                />
              </div>
              <div className="field">
                <label htmlFor="adm-aact">Action</label>
                <select
                  className="input"
                  id="adm-aact"
                  value={aact}
                  onChange={(e) => {
                    setAact(e.target.value)
                    setAlimit(50)
                  }}
                >
                  <option value="all">All actions</option>
                  {auditActs.map((a) => (
                    <option key={a} value={a}>
                      {a}
                    </option>
                  ))}
                </select>
              </div>
              <div className="field">
                <label htmlFor="adm-atype">Target</label>
                <select
                  className="input"
                  id="adm-atype"
                  value={atype}
                  onChange={(e) => {
                    setAtype(e.target.value)
                    setAlimit(50)
                  }}
                >
                  <option value="all">All targets</option>
                  {auditTypes.map((t) => (
                    <option key={t} value={t}>
                      {t}
                    </option>
                  ))}
                </select>
              </div>
            </div>

            <p className="small muted" role="status">
              {filteredAudit.length} of{' '}
              {admCount(db.audit.length, 'entry', 'entries')}
              {(aq || aact !== 'all' || atype !== 'all') && (
                <>
                  {' '}
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    className="link"
                    onClick={() => {
                      setAq('')
                      setAact('all')
                      setAtype('all')
                      setAlimit(50)
                    }}
                  >
                    Clear filters
                  </button>
                </>
              )}
            </p>

            {shownAudit.length ? (
              <>
                <div className="scroll-x">
                  <table className="tbl adm-tbl">
                    <thead>
                      <tr>
                        <th>When</th>
                        <th>Staff</th>
                        <th>Action</th>
                        <th>Target</th>
                        <th>Note</th>
                      </tr>
                    </thead>
                    <tbody>
                      {shownAudit.map((a) => (
                        <tr key={a.id}>
                          <td className="tnum" style={{ whiteSpace: 'nowrap' }}>
                            {stamp(a.ts)}
                          </td>
                          <td>{a.byName || a.by}</td>
                          <td>
                            <b>{a.action}</b>
                          </td>
                          <td>
                            {a.targetType}: {a.targetName || a.targetId}
                          </td>
                          <td style={{ overflowWrap: 'anywhere' }}>{a.note || ''}</td>
                        </tr>
                      ))}
                    </tbody>
                  </table>
                </div>
                {filteredAudit.length > shownAudit.length && (
                  <div className="row" style={{ justifyContent: 'center' }}>
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      className="btn ghost"
                      onClick={() => setAlimit((n) => n + 50)}
                    >
                      Show more
                    </button>
                  </div>
                )}
              </>
            ) : (
              <div
                className="card stack"
                style={{ alignItems: 'center', textAlign: 'center', padding: 32 }}
              >
                <b>
                  {db.audit.length
                    ? 'No entries match'
                    : 'No staff actions recorded yet'}
                </b>
                <p className="small muted">
                  {db.audit.length
                    ? 'Try a different search or clear the filters.'
                    : 'When staff suspend an account, remove a listing or moderate the forum, it appears here.'}
                </p>
                {db.audit.length > 0 && (
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    className="btn"
                    onClick={() => {
                      setAq('')
                      setAact('all')
                      setAtype('all')
                      setAlimit(50)
                    }}
                  >
                    Clear filters
                  </button>
                )}
              </div>
            )}
          </>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}

// ===== C:\Users\Lian Andrew\Desktop\RTU_Tindahan_Capstone\RTU_Tindahan_Final\RTU_Tindahan\frontend\src\features\marketplace\pages\BrowsePage.tsx =====
import { useMemo, useRef, useState, useEffect } from 'react'
import { Icon } from '@/common/components/Icon'
import { navigate, useRoute } from '@/common/router/router'
import { MiniLoader } from '@/common/components/BrandLoader'
import {
  BROWSE_CATS,
  SERVICES_CAT,
  SORT_MODES,
  SUBCATS,
  catOf,
  subOf,
} from '../constants'
import { useTindahan } from '../context/TindahanContext'
import { ProductCard } from '../components/ProductCard'
import './BrowsePage.css'

export function BrowsePage() {
  const { params } = useRoute()
  const {
    allOnSale,
    browseState,
    setBrowseState,
    clearBrowseFilters,
    sellerKind,
    sortProducts,
    listingsLoading,
  } = useTindahan()

  // Optional URL query sync
  const [filterSheetOpen, setFilterSheetOpen] = useState(false)
  const [sortOpen, setSortOpen] = useState(false)
  const chipTrackRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null)
  const sortWrapRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null)
  const setWidthRef = useRef<number>(0)
  const [isMobile, setIsMobile] = useState(typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.matchMedia('(max-width: 767px)').matches)

  useEffect(() => {
    const media = window.matchMedia('(max-width: 767px)')
    const handleChange = (e: MediaQueryListEvent) => setIsMobile(e.matches)
    media.addEventListener('change', handleChange)
    return () => media.removeEventListener('change', handleChange)
  }, [])

  const urlQ = params.get('q')
  const activeQ = browseState.q || urlQ || ''

  const allCats = BROWSE_CATS
  const singleCat = browseState.cats.length === 1 ? browseState.cats[0] : ''
  const subsForCat = singleCat && SUBCATS[singleCat] ? SUBCATS[singleCat] : []

  const countsBySeller = useMemo(() => {
    return {
      all: allOnSale.length,
      student: allOnSale.filter((p) => sellerKind(p) === 'student').length,
      school: allOnSale.filter((p) => sellerKind(p) === 'school').length,
    }
  }, [allOnSale, sellerKind])

  const filteredList = useMemo(() => {
    const q = activeQ.trim().toLowerCase()
    const base = allOnSale.filter((p) => {
      const sk = sellerKind(p)
      const c = catOf(p)
      if (browseState.cats.length && !browseState.cats.includes(c)) return false
      if (browseState.sub && subOf(p) !== browseState.sub) return false
      if (browseState.tag && p.tag !== browseState.tag) return false
      if (browseState.sellerType.length) {
        const label = sk === 'school' ? 'Official store' : 'Student sellers'
        if (!browseState.sellerType.includes(label)) return false
      }
      if (browseState.maxPrice && p.price > Number(browseState.maxPrice)) return false
      if (browseState.onlyToday && p.left < 1) return false
      if (
        browseState.mapFree &&
        !/^(Main lobby|Library|Canteen|Campus store)/i.test(p.when || '')
      ) {
        return false
      }
      if (
        q &&
        !(
          p.name +
          ' ' +
          p.seller +
          ' ' +
          c +
          ' ' +
          (subOf(p) || '') +
          ' ' +
          p.tag +
          ' ' +
          (p.svcType || '')
        )
          .toLowerCase()
          .includes(q)
      ) {
        return false
      }
      return true
    })
    return sortProducts(base, browseState.sortBy, browseState.rateBasis)
  }, [allOnSale, activeQ, browseState, sellerKind, sortProducts])

  const perPage = isMobile ? 20 : 50
  const pages = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(filteredList.length / perPage))
  const currentPage = Math.min(browseState.page, pages)
  const slice = filteredList.slice((currentPage - 1) * perPage, currentPage * perPage)

  const stOn = browseState.sellerType.includes('Student sellers')
  const scOn = browseState.sellerType.includes('Official store')
  const curSellerTab = stOn && !scOn ? 'student' : scOn && !stOn ? 'school' : 'all'

  const QUICK_CHOICES = [
    {
      label: 'Uniforms',
      icon: 'shirt' as const,
      onClick: () =>
        setBrowseState((prev) => {
          const alreadyActive =
            prev.tag === 'Uniform' &&
            !prev.cats.length &&
            !prev.onlyToday &&
            !prev.maxPrice
          if (alreadyActive) {
            return { ...prev, cats: [], sub: '', tag: '', onlyToday: false, maxPrice: '', page: 1 }
          }
          return {
            ...prev,
            cats: [],
            sub: '',
            tag: 'Uniform',
            onlyToday: false,
            maxPrice: '',
            page: 1,
          }
        }),
      active:
        browseState.tag === 'Uniform' &&
        !browseState.cats.length &&
        !browseState.onlyToday &&
        !browseState.maxPrice,
    },
    {
      label: 'Clothing',
      icon: 'shirt' as const,
      onClick: () =>
        setBrowseState((prev) => {
          const alreadyActive =
            prev.cats.length === 1 &&
            prev.cats[0] === 'Clothing and Accessories' &&
            !prev.tag &&
            !prev.onlyToday &&
            !prev.maxPrice
          if (alreadyActive) {

    n += browseState.onlyToday ? 1 : 0
    n += browseState.mapFree ? 1 : 0
    n += activeQ ? 1 : 0

      if (e.key === 'Escape') setFilterSheetOpen(false)

    if (filterSheetOpen) {
      document.body.classList.add('filter-sheet-open')
      window.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeydown)
    } else {
      document.body.classList.remove('filter-sheet-open')
    }
    return () => {
      document.body.classList.remove('filter-sheet-open')
      window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeydown)
    }
  }, [filterSheetOpen])

  // Close sort dropdown on outside click or Escape key
  useEffect(() => {

      if (sortWrapRef.current && !sortWrapRef.current.contains(e.target as Node)) {
        setSortOpen(false)
      }
    }

    const handleKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.key === 'Escape') setSortOpen(false)
    }

    document.addEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside)
    document.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown)

      document.removeEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside)

    if (listingsLoading || !el) return
    const ro = new ResizeObserver(() => {
      setWidthRef.current = el.scrollWidth / 3
      el.scrollLeft = setWidthRef.current
    })
    ro.observe(el)
    setWidthRef.current = el.scrollWidth / 3
    el.scrollLeft = setWidthRef.current
    return () => ro.disconnect()
  }, [listingsLoading])

  const handleChipScroll = (e: React.UIEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    const el = e.currentTarget
    const sw = setWidthRef.current
    if (!sw) return
    if (el.scrollLeft <= 2) el.scrollLeft += sw
    else if (el.scrollLeft >= sw * 2 - 2) el.scrollLeft -= sw
  }

  const scrollChip = (dir: -1 | 1) => {
    const el = chipTrackRef.current
    if (!el) return
    const step = Math.round(el.clientWidth * 0.55)
    el.scrollBy({ left: dir * step, behavior: 'smooth' })
  }

                    Ã—

                  â€œ{activeQ}â€{' '}
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    aria-label="Clear search"
                    style={{ background: 'none', border: 0, padding: 0 }}
                    onClick={() => {
                      setBrowseState((prev) => ({ ...prev, q: '', page: 1 }))
                      if (urlQ) navigate('browse')
                    }}
                  >
                    Ã—
                  </button>
                </span>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>

          {slice.length ? (
            <div className="pgrid">
              {slice.map((p) => (
                <ProductCard key={p.id} product={p} rateBasis={cardRateBasis} />
              ))}
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div
              className="card stack"
              style={{ alignItems: 'center', textAlign: 'center', padding: 40 }}
            >
              <span style={{ color: 'var(--blue)' }}>
                <Icon name="search" />
              </span>
              <b>
                {allOnSale.length ? 'No listings match your filters' : 'No listings yet'}
              </b>
              <p className="small muted">
                {allOnSale.length
                  ? 'Clear a filter or try a broader search word.'
                  : 'Approved student listings and official store products will appear here.'}
              </p>
              {allOnSale.length ? (
                <button
                  type="button"
                  className="btn"
                  onClick={() => clearBrowseFilters()}
                >
                  Clear all filters
                </button>
              ) : (
                <button
                  type="button"
                  className="btn yellow"
                  onClick={() => navigate('create')}
                >
                  Sell an item
                </button>
              )}
            </div>
          )}

          {pages > 1 && (
            <div className="row" style={{ justifyContent: 'center' }}>
              {Array.from({ length: pages }, (_, i) => i + 1).map((pg) => (
                <button
                  key={pg}
                  type="button"
                  className={`btn sm ${currentPage === pg ? '' : 'ghost'} tnum`.trim()}
                  onClick={() => setBrowseState((prev) => ({ ...prev, page: pg }))}
                >
                  {pg}
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Mobile bottom sheet filter drawer */}
      {filterSheetOpen && (
        <div
          className="mobile-filter-sheet"
          onClick={(e) => {
            if (e.target === e.currentTarget) setFilterSheetOpen(false)
          }}
          onKeyDown={(e) => {
            if (e.key === 'Escape') setFilterSheetOpen(false)
          }}
          role="dialog"
          aria-modal="true"
          aria-label="Filters"
        >
          <div className="mobile-filter-sheet-content">
            <div className="mobile-filter-sheet-header">
              <h2>Filters</h2>
              <div className="row between">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  className="link small"
                  onClick={() => clearBrowseFilters()}
                >
                  Reset
                </button>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  className="link small"
                  onClick={() => setFilterSheetOpen(false)}
                >
                  Ã—
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="mobile-filter-sheet-body stack">
              <div className="mobile-filter-section">
                <b>Category</b>
                {allCats.map((c) => {
                  const checked = browseState.cats.includes(c)
                  const count = allOnSale.filter((p) => catOf(p) === c).length
                  return (
                    <label key={c} className="check">
                      <input
                        type="checkbox"
                        checked={checked}
                        onChange={(e) => {
                          const isChecked = e.target.checked
                          setBrowseState((prev) => {
                            const nextCats = isChecked
                              ? [...prev.cats, c]
                              : prev.cats.filter((x) => x !== c)
                            const nextSingle = nextCats.length === 1 ? nextCats[0] : ''
                            const nextSub =
                              prev.sub &&
                              nextSingle &&
                              (SUBCATS[nextSingle] || []).includes(prev.sub)
                                ? prev.sub
                                : ''
                            return { ...prev, cats: nextCats, sub: nextSub, page: 1 }
                          })
                        }}
                      />
                      {c}{' '}
                      <span className="muted tiny" style={{ marginLeft: 'auto' }}>
                        {count}
                      </span>
                    </label>
                  )
                })}

                {subsForCat.length > 0 && (
                  <div
                    className="stack"
                    style={{ gap: 6, borderTop: '1px solid var(--line)', paddingTop: 10 }}
                  >
                    <b className="small">Subcategory</b>
                    <div className="row wrap" style={{ gap: 6 }}>
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        className={`btn sm ${!browseState.sub ? '' : 'ghost'}`.trim()}
                        onClick={() => setBrowseState((prev) => ({ ...prev, sub: '', page: 1 }))}
                      >
                        All
                      </button>
                      {subsForCat.map((s) => (
                        <button
                          key={s}
                          type="button"
                          className={`btn sm ${browseState.sub === s ? '' : 'ghost'}`.trim()}
                          onClick={() =>
                            setBrowseState((prev) => ({
                              ...prev,
                              sub: prev.sub === s ? '' : s,
                              page: 1,
                            }))
                          }
                        >
                          {s}
                        </button>
                      ))}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                )}

                <b style={{ marginTop: 14 }}>Seller type</b>
                {(['Student sellers', 'Official store'] as const).map((t) => {
                  const checked = browseState.sellerType.includes(t)
                  return (
                    <label key={t} className="check">
                      <input
                        type="checkbox"
                        checked={checked}
                        onChange={(e) => {
                          const isChecked = e.target.checked
                          setBrowseState((prev) => ({
                            ...prev,
                            sellerType: isChecked
                              ? [...prev.sellerType, t]
                              : prev.sellerType.filter((x) => x !== t),
                            page: 1,
                          }))
                        }}
                      />
                      {t}
                    </label>
                  )
                })}
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="mobile-filter-sheet-footer">
              <button
                type="button"
                className="btn ghost"
                onClick={() => {
                  clearBrowseFilters()
                  setFilterSheetOpen(false)
                }}
              >
                Clear all
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                className="btn yellow"
                onClick={() => setFilterSheetOpen(false)}
              >
                Show results
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
      </>)}
    </>
  )
}

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react'
import { Icon } from '@/common/components/Icon'
import type { IconName } from '@/common/components/icons'
import { playRemove, playSuccess } from '@/common/sounds'
import { navigate } from '@/common/router/router'
import { PLACES, findVar, getSellerTimeWindows, isSvc, peso, unitPrice, varLabel } from '../constants'
import { getPickupDates } from '../dateHelper'
import { useTindahan } from '../context/TindahanContext'
import { imgSrc, imgsOf } from '../imageStore'
import type { ChosenFulfillment, FulfillmentMethod } from '../types'
import './CartPage.css'

export function CartPage() {
  const {
    currentAccount,
    cartStep,
    setCartStep,
    cartMsg,
    setCartMsg,
    cartAgree,
    setCartAgree,
    cartErr,
    setCartErr,
    byId,
    sellerKind,
    updateCartQty,
    removeCartLine,
    toggleCartEdit,
    toggleCartSelect,
    toggleCartSelectAll,
    updateCartMeetup,
    sendMeetupRequest,
    selectedCartItems,
    toast,
    lastOrderId,
    lastOrderIds,
    myConversations,
    sendOrderMessage,
    batchOrders,
  } = useTindahan()

  const [activeOrderIdx, setActiveOrderIdx] = useState(0)
  const [chatInput, setChatInput] = useState('')

  const cartStepRef = useRef(cartStep)
  cartStepRef.current = cartStep

  useEffect(() => {
    setActiveOrderIdx(0)
    setChatInput('')
  }, [lastOrderIds])

  useEffect(() => {
    if (cartStep === 2 && cart.length > 0 && selectedCount === 0) {
      setCartStep(1)
    }
  }, [cartStep, cart.length, selectedCount, setCartStep])

  useEffect(() => {
    return () => {
      if (cartStepRef.current === 3) {
        setCartStep(1)
      }
    }
  }, [])

  const [othersCartIdx, setOthersCartIdx] = useState<Record<number, boolean>>({})
  const presetPlaces = PLACES.filter((pl) => pl !== 'Others')

  const getFulfillment = (p: any, c: any): { avail: FulfillmentMethod | 'none'; chosen: ChosenFulfillment } => {
    const avail: FulfillmentMethod | 'none' =
      p.cat === 'Official' && !p.fulfillment
        ? 'pickup'
        : p.fulfillment === 'pickup' ||
            p.fulfillment === 'delivery' ||
            p.fulfillment === 'both'
          ? p.fulfillment
          : 'none'
    const chosen: ChosenFulfillment =
      c.fulfillment || (avail === 'delivery' ? 'delivery' : 'pickup')
    return { avail, chosen }
  }

  if (!currentAccount) return null
  const cart = currentAccount.cart || []
  const selectedCount = selectedCartItems.size

  const selectedSellers = new Set(
    cart
      .filter((_, i) => selectedCartItems.has(i))
      .map((c) => byId(c.id)?.seller)
      .filter(Boolean),
  ).size

  const hasInvalidFulfillment = cart.some((c, i) => {
    if (!selectedCartItems.has(i)) return false
    const p = byId(c.id)
    if (!p) return true
    const { avail, chosen } = getFulfillment(p, c)
    if (avail === 'none') return true
    if (avail === 'pickup' && chosen !== 'pickup') return true
    if (avail === 'delivery' && chosen !== 'delivery') return true
    return false
  })

  const selectedCartCount = cart.reduce(
    (acc, c, i) => (selectedCartItems.has(i) ? acc + c.qty : acc),
    0,
  )
  const selectedCartTotal = cart.reduce(
    (acc, c, i) => {
      if (!selectedCartItems.has(i)) return acc
      const p = byId(c.id)
      if (!p) return acc
      return acc + unitPrice(p, c.vid) * c.qty
    },
    0,
  )

  const handleSend = () => {
    if (hasInvalidFulfillment) {
      toast('Please select a valid fulfillment method enabled by the seller before proceeding.')
      return
    }
    playSuccess()
    sendMeetupRequest()
  }

  return (
    <>
      <div>
        <span className="eyebrow">PICKUP & DELIVERY REQUEST</span>
        <h1>Review and schedule your order</h1>
        <p className="muted small">
          No online checkout. You are sending a pickup or delivery request to the seller and paying
          in person on campus.
        </p>
      </div>

      <div className="steps" role="list">
        {(
          ['1. Review items & fulfillment', '2. Message & confirm', '3. Request sent'] as const
        ).map((s, i) => (
          <div
            key={s}
            role="listitem"
            className={`step ${
              cartStep === i + 1 ? 'on' : cartStep > i + 1 ? 'done' : ''
            }`.trim()}
          >
            {s}
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>

      {!cart.length ? (
        <div
          className="card stack"
          style={{ alignItems: 'center', textAlign: 'center', padding: 40 }}
        >
          <span style={{ color: 'var(--blue)' }}>
            <Icon name="cart" />
          </span>
          <b>Your request cart is empty</b>
          <p className="small muted">
            Reserve an item from the marketplace to schedule a campus pickup or delivery.
          </p>
          <button
            type="button"
            className="btn"
            onClick={() => {
              navigate('browse')
            }}
          >
            Browse listings
          </button>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div className="cart-two two">
          <div className="stack">
            <div className="selection-bar">
              <label className="check row between wrap">
                <input
                  type="checkbox"
                  checked={selectedCount > 0 && selectedCount === cart.length}
                  onChange={() => toggleCartSelectAll()}
                />
                <span>
                  <b>Select all</b> ({selectedCount} of {cart.length} selected)
                </span>
              </label>
              {selectedCount > 0 && (
                <span className="tiny muted">
                  {selectedCartTotal > 0 ? peso(selectedCartTotal) : ''} Â·{' '}
                  {selectedCartCount} item{selectedCartCount === 1 ? '' : 's'}
                </span>
              )}
            </div>

            {cart.map((c, idx) => {
              const p = byId(c.id)
              if (!p) return null
              const vr = c.vid && findVar(p, c.vid)
              const pr = unitPrice(p, c.vid)
              const imgs = imgsOf(p)
              const src = imgs.length ? imgSrc(imgs[0]) : ''
              const svc = isSvc(p)

              const availMethod: FulfillmentMethod | 'none' =
                p.cat === 'Official' && !p.fulfillment
                  ? 'pickup'
                  : p.fulfillment === 'pickup' ||
                      p.fulfillment === 'delivery' ||
                      p.fulfillment === 'both'
                    ? p.fulfillment
                    : 'none'
              const chosenMethod: ChosenFulfillment =
                availMethod === 'delivery'
                  ? 'delivery'
                  : availMethod === 'pickup'
                    ? 'pickup'
                    : c.fulfillment || 'pickup'

              const isOfficial = p.cat === 'Official' || sellerKind(p) === 'school'
              const sellerTimeSlots = getSellerTimeWindows(p)
              const activeTime = sellerTimeSlots.includes(c.time)
                ? c.time
                : sellerTimeSlots[0] || c.time
              const officialPlace = (p.when.split(',')[0] || 'BAU Office').trim()

              const { options: dateOpts, todayStatus, windowEndText } = getPickupDates(p)
              const activeDateLabel =
                c.date || (dateOpts.length ? dateOpts[0].label : 'Today')

              const isSelected = selectedCartItems.has(idx)

              return (
                <div
                  key={`${c.id}-${c.vid || ''}-${idx}`}
                  className={`card stack ${isSelected ? 'cart-item-selected' : 'cart-item-dimmed'}`}
                >
                  <div className="row between wrap">
                    <div className="row" style={{ minWidth: 0 }}>
                      <div
                        className={`photo cart-photo ${p.tone || 't-study'} ${
                          src ? 'has-img' : 'nophoto-tile'
                        }`.trim()}
                      >
                        {src ? <img className="pimg" src={src} alt={p.name} /> : null}
                        <Icon name={(p.icon || 'tag') as IconName} />
                      </div>
                      <div style={{ minWidth: 0 }}>
                        <b style={{ overflowWrap: 'anywhere' }}>{p.name}</b>
                        <div className="row wrap" style={{ gap: 6, marginTop: 2 }}>
                          {vr && <span className="pill">{varLabel(p, vr)}</span>}
                          <span
                            className={`pill ${chosenMethod === 'delivery' ? 'blue' : 'green'}`}
                          >
                            {chosenMethod === 'delivery' ? 'Delivery' : 'Pickup'}
                          </span>
                        </div>
                        <div className="small muted">Seller: {p.seller}</div>
                        <span className="price tnum">{peso(pr)}</span>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                    <div className="row" style={{ gap: 8, alignItems: 'center' }}>
                      <div className="qty" role="group" aria-label={`Quantity for ${p.name}`}>
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          aria-label="Decrease"
                          onClick={() => {
                            updateCartQty(idx, -1)
                          }}
                        >
                          âˆ’
                        </button>
                        <span className="tnum">{c.qty}</span>
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          aria-label="Increase"
                          onClick={() => {
                            updateCartQty(idx, 1)
                          }}
                        >
                          +
                        </button>
                      </div>
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        className="iconbtn"
                        aria-label={`Remove ${p.name}`}
                        onClick={() => {
                          playRemove()
                          removeCartLine(idx)
                        }}
                      >
                        <Icon name="trash" />
                      </button>
                      <label className="check">
                        <input
                          type="checkbox"
                          checked={isSelected}
                          onChange={() => toggleCartSelect(idx)}
                          aria-label={`Select ${p.name}`}
                        />
                      </label>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  <div
                    className="card flat stack"
                    style={{ background: 'var(--bg)', padding: 12, gap: 10 }}
                  >
                    <div className="row between wrap">
                      <div className="row wrap" style={{ gap: 8 }}>

                          <b>Fulfillment:</b>{' '}
                          {availMethod === 'none'

                            : chosenMethod === 'delivery'
                              ? 'Campus Delivery'

                        </span>
                        <span className="tiny muted">
                          (
                          {availMethod === 'both'
                            ? 'Seller offers Pickup & Delivery'
                            : availMethod === 'delivery'
                              ? 'Seller offers Delivery only'
                              : availMethod === 'pickup'
                                ? 'Seller offers Pickup only'
                                : 'No method configured'}
                          )
                        </span>
                      </div>
                      {availMethod === 'both' && (
                        <div className="row" role="radiogroup" aria-label="Fulfillment method" style={{ gap: 6 }}>
                          <button
                            type="button"
                            role="radio"
                            aria-checked={chosenMethod === 'pickup'}
                            className={`btn sm ${chosenMethod === 'pickup' ? '' : 'ghost'}`.trim()}
                            onClick={() => updateCartMeetup(idx, 'fulfillment', 'pickup')}
                          >

                        {isOfficial
                          ? officialPlace
                          : chosenMethod === 'delivery' && c.deliverySpot
                            ? `${c.deliverySpot} (${c.place})`
                            : c.place}{' '}
                        Â· <b>{activeDateLabel}</b> Â· {activeTime}
                      </span>
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        className="link"
                        onClick={() => {
                          toggleCartEdit(idx)
                        }}
                      >
                        {c.edit || c.editing
                          ? 'Done'
                          : `Change ${chosenMethod === 'delivery' ? 'delivery' : 'pickup'} date & time`}
                      </button>
                    </div>

                    {(c.edit || c.editing || chosenMethod === 'delivery' || cartStep === 2) ? (
                      <div className="stack" style={{ gap: 10, marginTop: 4 }}>
                        {chosenMethod === 'delivery' && (
                          <div className="field">
                            <label htmlFor={`cdspot-${idx}`}>
                              Campus delivery drop-off spot (room / building / landmark)
                            </label>
                            <input
                              className="input"
                              id={`cdspot-${idx}`}

                              value={c.deliverySpot || ''}
                              onChange={(e) =>
                                updateCartMeetup(idx, 'deliverySpot', e.target.value)
                              }
                            />
                          </div>
                        )}

                        {(c.edit || c.editing || cartStep === 2) && (
                          <>
                            {isOfficial ? (
                              <div className="stack" style={{ gap: 8 }}>
                                <div className="field">
                                  <label htmlFor={`cd-${idx}`}>
                                    Pickup date (within store schedule)
                                  </label>
                                  <select
                                    className="input"
                                    id={`cd-${idx}`}
                                    value={activeDateLabel}
                                    onChange={(e) => {
                                      updateCartMeetup(idx, 'date', e.target.value)
                                    }}
                                  >
                                    {dateOpts.map((opt) => (
                                      <option key={opt.id} value={opt.label}>
                                        {opt.label}
                                      </option>
                                    ))}
                                  </select>
                                </div>

                                <div className="field">
                                  <label>Official Store Location & Time Window (Fixed by Admin)</label>
                                  <div
                                    className="input"
                                    style={{
                                      background: 'var(--soft)',
                                      color: 'var(--muted)',
                                      display: 'flex',
                                      alignItems: 'center',
                                      fontWeight: 600,
                                    }}
                                  >
                                    <span className="tiny" style={{ color: 'var(--yellow)' }}>
                                      <Icon name="shield" size="sm" />{' '}
                                      Location & open hours set by RTU Admin
                                    </span>
                                    <span className="small" style={{ marginLeft: 6 }}>
                                      {officialPlace} Â· {activeTime}
                                    </span>
                                  </div>
                                </div>
                              </div>
                            ) : (
                              <>
                                {chosenMethod === 'delivery' ? null : null}
                                <div className="grid2">
                                  <div className="field">
                                    <label htmlFor={`cd-${idx}`}>
                                      {chosenMethod === 'delivery'
                                        ? 'Delivery date'
                                        : 'Pickup date'}
                                    </label>
                                    <select
                                      className="input"
                                      id={`cd-${idx}`}
                                      value={activeDateLabel}
                                      onChange={(e) => {
                                        updateCartMeetup(idx, 'date', e.target.value)
                                      }}
                                    >
                                      {dateOpts.map((opt) => (
                                        <option key={opt.id} value={opt.label}>
                                          {opt.label}
                                        </option>
                                      ))}
                                    </select>
                                  </div>

                                  <div className="field">
                                    <label htmlFor={`ct-${idx}`}>
                                      Sellerâ€™s available time window
                                    </label>
                                    <select
                                      className="input"
                                      id={`ct-${idx}`}
                                      value={activeTime}
                                      onChange={(e) => {

                                          ? 'Others'
                                          : c.place
                                      }
