// ===== C:\Users\Lian Andrew\Desktop\RTU_Tindahan_Capstone\RTU_Tindahan_Final\RTU_Tindahan\frontend\src\features\marketplace\pages\MarketplacePage.tsx =====
import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react'
import { Icon } from '@/common/components/Icon'
import type { IconName } from '@/common/components/icons'
import { navigate } from '@/common/router/router'
import { MiniLoader } from '@/common/components/BrandLoader'
import { CATEGORIES, CAT_META, SERVICES_CAT } from '../constants'
import { useTindahan } from '../context/TindahanContext'
import { MarketplaceProductShelf } from '../components/MarketplaceProductShelf'
import './MarketplacePage.css'

export function MarketplacePage() {
  const {
    currentAccount,
    allOnSale,
    allServices,
    salesIndex,
    sortProducts,
    browseFor,
    setDraft,
    setListStep,
    listingsLoading,
  } = useTindahan()

  const catRowRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement | null>(null)
  const groupRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement | null>(null)
  const trackRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement | null>(null)
  const offsetRef = useRef(0)
  const rafRef = useRef<number | null>(null)
  const groupWidthRef = useRef(0)
  const isPausedRef = useRef(false)
  const isDraggingRef = useRef(false)
  const startXRef = useRef(0)
  const startOffsetRef = useRef(0)
  const [isReducedMotion, setIsReducedMotion] = useState(false)

  // Measure group width via ResizeObserver
  useEffect(() => {
    const el = groupRef.current
    if (!el) return
    const ro = new ResizeObserver((entries) => {
      for (const entry of entries) {
        groupWidthRef.current = entry.contentRect.width
      }
    })
    ro.observe(el)
    return () => ro.disconnect()
  }, [])

  // Sync reduced-motion preference
  useEffect(() => {
    const mq = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)')
    setIsReducedMotion(mq.matches)
    const onChange = (e: MediaQueryListEvent) => setIsReducedMotion(e.matches)
    mq.addEventListener('change', onChange)
    return () => mq.removeEventListener('change', onChange)
  }, [])

  // Marquee animation loop (50px/sec, GPU-composited translate3d)
  useEffect(() => {
    if (isReducedMotion) return
    const track = trackRef.current
    if (!track) return

    const SPEED = 50
    let last = performance.now()

    const loop = (now: number) => {
      const dt = (now - last) / 1000
      last = now

      if (!isPausedRef.current && !isDraggingRef.current) {
        offsetRef.current += SPEED * dt
        const gw = groupWidthRef.current
        if (gw > 0) {
          offsetRef.current = ((offsetRef.current % gw) + gw) % gw
        }
        track.style.transform = `translate3d(${-offsetRef.current}px, 0, 0)`
      }

      rafRef.current = requestAnimationFrame(loop)
    }

    rafRef.current = requestAnimationFrame(loop)
    return () => {
      if (rafRef.current !== null) cancelAnimationFrame(rafRef.current)
    }
  }, [isReducedMotion])

  // Mouse wheel on catrow container
  useEffect(() => {
    const row = catRowRef.current
    if (!row) return
    const onWheel = (e: WheelEvent) => {
      e.preventDefault()
      e.stopPropagation()
      const gw = groupWidthRef.current
      offsetRef.current += (e.deltaY + e.deltaX) * 0.8
      if (gw > 0) {
        offsetRef.current = ((offsetRef.current % gw) + gw) % gw
      }
      const track = trackRef.current
      if (track) track.style.transform = `translate3d(${-offsetRef.current}px, 0, 0)`
    }
    row.addEventListener('wheel', onWheel, { passive: false })
    return () => row.removeEventListener('wheel', onWheel)
  }, [])

  // Touch drag on catrow container
  useEffect(() => {
    const row = catRowRef.current
    if (!row) return
    const onStart = (e: TouchEvent) => {
      isDraggingRef.current = true
      startXRef.current = e.touches[0].clientX
      startOffsetRef.current = offsetRef.current
    }
    const onMove = (e: TouchEvent) => {
      if (!isDraggingRef.current) return
      const dx = e.touches[0].clientX - startXRef.current
      offsetRef.current = startOffsetRef.current - dx
      const gw = groupWidthRef.current
      if (gw > 0) {
        offsetRef.current = ((offsetRef.current % gw) + gw) % gw
      }
      const track = trackRef.current
      if (track) track.style.transform = `translate3d(${-offsetRef.current}px, 0, 0)`
    }
    const onEnd = () => {
      isDraggingRef.current = false
    }
    row.addEventListener('touchstart', onStart, { passive: false })
    row.addEventListener('touchmove', onMove, { passive: false })
    row.addEventListener('touchend', onEnd)
    row.addEventListener('touchcancel', onEnd)
    return () => {
      row.removeEventListener('touchstart', onStart)
      row.removeEventListener('touchmove', onMove)
      row.removeEventListener('touchend', onEnd)
      row.removeEventListener('touchcancel', onEnd)
    }
  }, [])

  // Smooth arrow-nudge animation (~260px over ~250ms)
  const nudgeOffset = useCallback((delta: number) => {
    const gw = groupWidthRef.current
    if (gw <= 0) return
    const start = offsetRef.current
    const target = start + delta
    const startTime = performance.now()
    const duration = 250

    const animate = (now: number) => {
      const elapsed = now - startTime
      const t = Math.min(elapsed / duration, 1)
      const ease = 1 - Math.pow(1 - t, 3)
      offsetRef.current = start + (target - start) * ease
      offsetRef.current = ((offsetRef.current % gw) + gw) % gw
      const track = trackRef.current
      if (track) track.style.transform = `translate3d(${-offsetRef.current}px, 0, 0)`
      if (t < 1) {
        rafRef.current = requestAnimationFrame(animate)
      }
    }

    rafRef.current = requestAnimationFrame(animate)
  }, [])

  const scrollCats = (dir: -1 | 1) => {
    nudgeOffset(dir * 260)
  }

  const firstName = currentAccount?.first || 'Student'
  const greeting = (() => {
    const h = new Date().getHours()
    return h < 12 ? 'Good morning' : h < 18 ? 'Good afternoon' : 'Good evening'
  })()

  const allChips = [...CATEGORIES, SERVICES_CAT]
  const latest = sortProducts(allOnSale, 'Newest')
  const best = sortProducts(
    allOnSale.filter((p) => (salesIndex.get(p.id)?.units || 0) > 0),
    'Best-Selling',
  )
  const svcs = sortProducts(allServices, 'Newest')

  return (
    <>
      {listingsLoading && (
        <div style={{ padding: 40, textAlign: 'center', minHeight: 400 }}>
          <MiniLoader variant="section" size="lg" label="Loading campus listingsâ€¦" />
        </div>
      )}
      {!listingsLoading && (
        <>
          <div className="row between wrap">
            <div>
              <span className="eyebrow">
                {greeting.toUpperCase()}, {firstName.toUpperCase()}
              </span>
              <h1>What do you need around campus?</h1>
              <p className="muted small">
                Discover verified Pasig campus sellers, official products, and services ready for
                meetup.
              </p>
            </div>
      </div>

      <div
        className="card"
        style={{
          background: 'var(--navy)',
          color: '#fff',
          border: 0,
          display: 'flex',
          gap: 16,
          flexWrap: 'wrap',
          alignItems: 'center',
          justifyContent: 'space-between',
        }}
      >
        <div className="stack" style={{ gap: 6, maxWidth: 520 }}>
          <span className="pill yellow" style={{ alignSelf: 'flex-start' }}>
            Today at RTU Pasig
          </span>
          <h2 style={{ fontSize: 22 }}>
            Merienda, school supplies, and more, ready for campus meetup.
          </h2>
          <p className="small" style={{ opacity: 0.85 }}>
            Browse listings that students and RTU staff have posted for campus meetup.
          </p>
        </div>
        <button
          type="button"
          className="btn yellow"
          onClick={() => browseFor({ goBrowse: true })}
        >
          Browse listings
          <Icon name="arrow" size="sm" />
        </button>
      </div>

      <div className="catwrap" role="group" aria-label="Product categories">
        <button
          type="button"
          className="catarrow l"
          aria-label="Scroll categories left"
          onClick={() => scrollCats(-1)}
        >
          <Icon name="chev" size="sm" />
        </button>
        <div
          ref={catRowRef}
          className="catrow"
          tabIndex={0}
          aria-label="Categories, scroll sideways for more"
          onMouseEnter={() => {
            isPausedRef.current = true
          }}
          onMouseLeave={() => {
            isPausedRef.current = false
          }}
        >
          <div
            ref={trackRef}
            className="marquee-track"
            style={{ transform: 'translate3d(0, 0, 0)' }}
          >
            {[0, 1, 2].flatMap((copy) => (
              <div
                key={`group-${copy}`}
                className="marquee-group"
                ref={copy === 0 ? groupRef : undefined}
              >
                {allChips.map((c) => {
                  const m = CAT_META[c] || ['t-drink', 'tag', 'Other']
                  return (
                    <button
                      key={`${copy}-${c}`}
                      type="button"
                      className="catchip"
                      onClick={() => browseFor({ cats: [c] })}
                    >
                      <span className="catico">
                        <Icon name={m[1] as IconName} />
                      </span>
                      <span>{c}</span>
                    </button>
                  )
                })}
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>
        <button
          type="button"
          className="catarrow r"
          aria-label="Scroll categories right"
          onClick={() => scrollCats(1)}
        >
          <Icon name="chev" size="sm" />
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* Latest Items */}
      <MarketplaceProductShelf
        title="Latest Items"
        subtitle="Newly published listings, newest first."
        items={latest}
        viewMoreLabel="View more"
        onViewMore={() => browseFor({ sortBy: 'Newest' })}
        onEmptyAction={() => {
          setDraft((prev) => (prev.editLid ? prev : { ...prev, type: 'product' }))
          setListStep(1)
          navigate('create')
        }}
        emptyActionLabel="Sell an item"
        emptyTitle="No listings yet"
        emptySubtitle="Be the first to post something for the Pasig campus."
      />

      {/* Best-Selling Items */}
      <MarketplaceProductShelf
        title="Best-Selling Items"
        subtitle="Ranked by completed pickups only."
        items={best}
        viewMoreLabel="View more"
        onViewMore={() => browseFor({ sortBy: 'Best-Selling' })}
        emptyTitle="No best sellers yet"
        emptySubtitle="This list fills in after students complete their first pickups. Requests and messages do not count."
      />

      {/* Student Services */}
      <MarketplaceProductShelf
        title="Student Services"
        subtitle="Printing, tutoring, rentals and other services offered by students. Open one to see details or request a booking."
        items={svcs}
        viewMoreLabel="View more"
        onViewMore={() => browseFor({ cats: [SERVICES_CAT] })}
        onEmptyAction={() => {
          setDraft((prev) => (prev.editLid ? prev : { ...prev, type: 'service' }))
          setListStep(1)
          navigate('create')
        }}
        emptyActionLabel="Offer a service"
        emptyTitle="No services offered yet"
        emptySubtitle="Students can offer printing, tutoring, rentals and more from Sell an item."
      />
      </>)}
    </>
  )
}

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react'
import { Icon } from '@/common/components/Icon'
import { playMessage, playPop } from '@/common/sounds'
import { navigate } from '@/common/router/router'
import { ago, isSvc, refLabel, stamp } from '../constants'
import { useTindahan } from '../context/TindahanContext'
import type { Conversation, MessageRef } from '../types'
import { AvatarBadge } from '../components/AvatarBadge'
import './MessagesPage.css'

const CHAT_EMOJIS = ['ðŸ‘', 'â¤ï¸', 'ðŸ˜Š', 'ðŸ˜®', 'ðŸ™', 'ðŸŽ‰']

export function MessagesPage() {
  const {
    currentAccount,
    isStaffUser,
    selectedConvId,
    setSelectedConvId,
    myConversations,
    unreadMessagesCount,
    unreadInConv,
    byId,
    acctByEmail,
    openProduct,
    startEditListing,
    sendChatMessage,
    reactToChatMessage,
    markConvRead,
    openContextOrder,
  } = useTindahan()

  const [draftText, setDraftText] = useState('')
  const [pickerIndex, setPickerIndex] = useState<number | null>(null)
  const bodyRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement | null>(null)

  const cur = selectedConvId
    ? myConversations.find(
        (c) => c.id === selectedConvId || (c.alias || []).includes(selectedConvId),
      ) || null
    : null

  useEffect(() => {
    if (cur && currentAccount && unreadInConv(cur) > 0) {
      markConvRead(cur.id)
    }
  }, [cur, currentAccount, unreadInConv, markConvRead])

  useEffect(() => {
    if (bodyRef.current) {
      bodyRef.current.scrollTop = bodyRef.current.scrollHeight
    }
  }, [cur?.id, cur?.msgs.length])

  if (!currentAccount) return null

  const pool = (c: Conversation) => !c.seller && isStaffUser
  const peer = (c: Conversation) =>
    currentAccount.email === c.buyer
      ? c.seller
        ? c.sellerName
        : 'RTU Pasig Campus Store'
      : c.buyerName
  const peerEmail = (c: Conversation) =>
    currentAccount.email === c.buyer ? c.seller : c.buyer

  const renderCtxChip = (r: MessageRef, c: Conversation) => {
    const isOrder = r.type === 'order'
    const listing = !isOrder && r.id ? byId(r.id) : undefined
    const isMyRejectedOrDraft =
      !isOrder &&
      r.id &&
      currentAccount.sellerList?.some((l) => l.lid === r.id)
    return (
      <div className="m-ctx">
        <span className="refchip">
          <span>{refLabel(r)}</span>Â· {r.name || ''}
        </span>
        {isOrder ? (
          <button
            type="button"
            className="link"
            onClick={() => {
              openContextOrder(r.id, c.id)
            }}
          >
            View order {r.id}
          </button>
        ) : listing ? (
          <button
            type="button"
            className="link"
            onClick={() => {
              openProduct(listing.id)
            }}
          >
            View {isSvc(listing) ? 'service' : 'listing'}
          </button>
        ) : isMyRejectedOrDraft ? (
          <button
            type="button"
            className="link"
            onClick={() => {
              startEditListing(r.id)
            }}
          >
            Edit & resubmit listing
          </button>
        ) : (
          <span className="tiny muted">Under review / not public</span>
        )}
      </div>
    )
  }

  const handleSend = () => {
    if (!cur) return
    if (sendChatMessage(cur.id, draftText)) {
      setDraftText('')
      playMessage()
    }
  }

  const handleReactionClick = (msgIdx: number, emoji: string) => {
    if (!cur) return
    playPop()
    reactToChatMessage(cur.id, msgIdx, emoji)
    setPickerIndex(null)
  }

  return (
    <>
      <div>
        <span className="eyebrow">COMMUNITY Â· MESSAGES</span>
        <h1>Messages</h1>
        <p className="muted small">
          Chat with sellers, service providers, buyers, and RTU administrators.{' '}
          {unreadMessagesCount > 0 && <b>{unreadMessagesCount} unread. </b>}
          Only the people in a conversation can read it.
          {isStaffUser ? ' As staff you also see chats with the Official RTU Store.' : ''}
        </p>
      </div>

      <div className={`msgs ${cur ? 'has-thread' : ''}`.trim()}>
        <div className="m-list" aria-label="Conversations">
          {myConversations.length ? (
            myConversations.map((c) => {
              const un = unreadInConv(c)
              const last = c.msgs[c.msgs.length - 1]
              const nm = peer(c)
              const pe = peerEmail(c)
              const peerAcct = pe ? acctByEmail(pe) : undefined
              const isStaffPeer =
                (!c.seller && currentAccount.email === c.buyer) ||
                peerAcct?.role === 'moderator'
              const hasAdminReview = c.msgs.some((m) => Boolean(m.adminReview))

              return (
                <button
                  key={c.id}
                  type="button"
                  className={`m-item ${cur && cur.id === c.id ? 'on' : ''} ${
                    un ? 'unread' : ''
                  }`.trim()}
                  onClick={() => {
                    setSelectedConvId(c.id)
                  }}
                >
                  <AvatarBadge
                    account={peerAcct}
                    name={nm}
                    isStaff={isStaffPeer}
                    size="md"
                    noTip
                  />
                  <span className="m-t">
                    <span className="row between" style={{ gap: 6 }}>
                      <b
                        className="small"
                        style={{
                          overflow: 'hidden',
                          textOverflow: 'ellipsis',
                          whiteSpace: 'nowrap',
                        }}
                      >
                        {nm}
                      </b>
                      <span className="tiny muted" style={{ whiteSpace: 'nowrap' }}>
                        {last ? ago(last.ts) : ''}
                      </span>
                    </span>
                    <span className="row wrap" style={{ gap: 4 }}>
                      {hasAdminReview && (
                        <span className="pill red" style={{ fontSize: 10, padding: '1px 6px' }}>
                          Admin Review
                        </span>
                      )}
                      <span className="refchip" style={{ alignSelf: 'flex-start' }}>
                        <span>{refLabel(c.ref)}</span>Â·{' '}
                        <span
                          style={{
                            overflow: 'hidden',
                            textOverflow: 'ellipsis',
                            whiteSpace: 'nowrap',
                            maxWidth: 135,
                          }}
                        >
                          {c.ref.name}
                        </span>
                      </span>
                    </span>
                    <span className="m-prev">
                      {last
                        ? (last.from === currentAccount.email ? 'You: ' : '') + last.text
                        : 'No messages yet'}
                    </span>
                  </span>
                  {un > 0 && <span className="m-dot">{un}</span>}
                </button>
              )
            })
          ) : (
            <div className="m-empty" style={{ padding: 24 }}>
              <b className="small">No conversations</b>
              <p className="small muted">Your chats will be listed here.</p>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>

        <div className="m-thread">
          {cur ? (
            <>
              {(() => {
                const nm = peer(cur)
                const pe = peerEmail(cur)
                const peerAcct = pe ? acctByEmail(pe) : undefined
                const isStaffPeer =
                  (!cur.seller && currentAccount.email === cur.buyer) ||
                  peerAcct?.role === 'moderator'
                const listing = cur.ref.pid ? byId(cur.ref.pid) : undefined
                const canEditRejectedListing =
                  cur.ref.pid &&
                  currentAccount.sellerList?.some((l) => l.lid === cur.ref.pid)

                return (
                  <div className="m-head">
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      className="btn ghost sm m-back"
                      onClick={() => {
                        setSelectedConvId(null)
                      }}
                    >
                      <Icon name="back" size="sm" />
                      Back
                    </button>
                    <AvatarBadge
                      account={peerAcct}
                      name={nm}
                      isStaff={isStaffPeer}
                      size="md"
                    />
                    <div className="grow">
                      <b>{nm}</b>
                      <div className="row wrap" style={{ gap: 6 }}>
                        <span className="refchip">
                          {refLabel(cur.ref)}: {cur.ref.name}
                        </span>
                        {pool(cur) && (
                          <span className="tiny muted">Official RTU Store inbox</span>
                        )}
                      </div>
                    </div>
                    {listing ? (
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        className="btn ghost sm"
                        onClick={() => {
                          openProduct(listing.id)
                        }}
                      >
                        View {isSvc(listing) ? 'service' : 'listing'}
                      </button>
                    ) : canEditRejectedListing && cur.ref.pid ? (
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        className="btn ghost sm"
                        onClick={() => {
                          startEditListing(cur.ref.pid!)
                        }}
                      >
                        <Icon name="edit" size="sm" />
                        Edit & resubmit
                      </button>
                    ) : null}
                    {cur.ref.type === 'order' && (
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        className="btn ghost sm"
                        onClick={() => {
                          navigate(
                            currentAccount.email === cur.buyer
                              ? 'orders'
                              : pool(cur)
                                ? 'transactions'
                                : 'shop',
                          )
                        }}
                      >
                        View order
                      </button>
                    )}
                  </div>
                )
              })()}

              <div
                ref={bodyRef}
                className="m-body"
                aria-live="polite"
                onClick={() => {
                  if (pickerIndex !== null) setPickerIndex(null)
                }}
              >
                {cur.msgs.map((m, i) => {
                  const me = m.from === currentAccount.email
                  const pr = i ? cur.msgs[i - 1].ref : null
                  const r = m.ref
                  const same = pr && r && pr.type === r.type && pr.id === r.id

                  // Count reactions grouped by emoji
                  const counts: Record<string, { count: number; hasMine: boolean }> = {}
                  if (m.reacts) {
                    Object.entries(m.reacts).forEach(([userEmail, emoji]) => {
                      if (!counts[emoji]) counts[emoji] = { count: 0, hasMine: false }
                      counts[emoji].count++
                      if (userEmail === currentAccount.email) {
                        counts[emoji].hasMine = true
                      }
                    })
                  }
                  const reactionEntries = Object.entries(counts)

                  return (
                    <div
                      key={m.id || i}
                      className={`m-row ${me ? 'me' : 'them'}`}
                    >
                      {r && !same && renderCtxChip(r, cur)}
                      <div className="m-bub-wrap">
                        <div
                          className={`bub ${me ? 'me' : 'them'} ${
                            m.adminReview ? 'admin-review-bub' : ''
                          }`.trim()}
                        >
                          {m.adminReview && (
                            <div className="m-admin-review-head">
                              <Icon name="shield" size="sm" />
                              <span>
                                Administrative Listing Review Â· {m.adminReview.decision}
                              </span>
                            </div>
                          )}
                          {m.text}
                          <small>
                            {me ? 'You' : m.name} Â· {stamp(m.ts)}
                          </small>
                        </div>

                        {/* Requirement #8: Reaction button and reaction pills anchored at the bottom corner of the message bubble */}
                        <div className="m-react-dock">
                          {reactionEntries.length > 0 && (
                            <div className={`m-react-pills ${me ? 'me' : 'them'}`}>
                              {reactionEntries.map(([emoji, data]) => (
                                <button
                                  key={emoji}
                                  type="button"
                                  className={`m-react-pill ${data.hasMine ? 'active' : ''}`}
                                  title={data.hasMine ? 'Remove reaction' : 'Add reaction'}
                                  onClick={(e) => {
                                    e.stopPropagation()
                                    handleReactionClick(i, emoji)
                                  }}
                                >
                                  <span>{emoji}</span>
                                  <span className="tiny tnum">{data.count}</span>
                                </button>
                              ))}
                            </div>
                          )}

                          <button
                            type="button"
                            className={`m-react-trigger ${pickerIndex === i ? 'is-open' : ''}`.trim()}
                            title="Add reaction"
                            aria-label="Add reaction"
                            onClick={(e) => {
                              e.stopPropagation()
                              playPop()
                              setPickerIndex(pickerIndex === i ? null : i)
                            }}
                          >
                            <Icon name="star" size="sm" />
                          </button>

                          {pickerIndex === i && (
                            <div
                              className="m-react-picker"
                              onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
                            >
                              {CHAT_EMOJIS.map((emoji) => (
                                <button
                                  key={emoji}
                                  type="button"
                                  className="m-react-emoji-btn"
                                  onClick={() => handleReactionClick(i, emoji)}
                                >
                                  {emoji}
                                </button>
                              ))}
                            </div>
                          )}
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  )
                })}
              </div>

              <form
                className="m-comp"
                onSubmit={(e) => {
                  e.preventDefault()
                  handleSend()
                }}
              >
                <textarea
                  className="input"
                  id="mi-text"
                  rows={1}
                  placeholder="Write a message or reply to the review..."
                  aria-label="Message"
                  value={draftText}
                  onChange={(e) => setDraftText(e.target.value)}
                  onKeyDown={(e) => {
                    if (e.key === 'Enter' && !e.shiftKey) {
                      e.preventDefault()
                      handleSend()
                    }
                  }}
                />
                <button type="submit" className="btn">
                  <Icon name="send" size="sm" />
                  Send
                </button>
              </form>
            </>
          ) : (
            <div className="m-empty" style={{ margin: 'auto' }}>
              <span style={{ color: 'var(--blue)' }}>
                <Icon name="msg" />
              </span>
              <b>{myConversations.length ? 'Pick a conversation' : 'No messages yet'}</b>
              <p className="small muted">
                {myConversations.length
                  ? 'Choose a chat on the left to read it and reply.'
                  : 'Open any listing or service and tap Message seller or Contact provider. When a buyer or administrator writes to you, the chat shows up here.'}
              </p>
              {!myConversations.length && (
                <button
                  type="button"
                  className="btn"
                  onClick={() => {
                    navigate('browse')
                  }}
                >
                  Browse listings
                </button>
              )}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </>
  )
}

                  ] as const)
                : ([
                    [

                    ],

          {isStaffUser ? (
            <div className="card stack">
              <div className="row between">
                <b>Views by listing</b>
                <span className="tiny muted">Since you posted each item</span>
              </div>
              {sellerList.length ? (
                <div className="stack" style={{ gap: 10 }}>
                  {sellerList.map((l, i) => (
                    <div key={`${l.lid || l.name}-${i}`} className="stack" style={{ gap: 4 }}>
                      <div className="row between small">
                        <span style={{ overflowWrap: 'anywhere' }}>{l.name}</span>
                        <span className="tnum muted">
                          {l.views} view{l.views === 1 ? '' : 's'} Â· {l.req} req
                        </span>
                      </div>
                      <div style={{ height: 8, background: 'var(--soft)', borderRadius: 6 }}>
                        <div
                          style={{
                            width: `${Math.round((l.views / maxViews) * 100)}%`,
                            height: 8,
                            background: 'var(--blue)',
                            borderRadius: 6,
                          }}
                        />
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </div>
              ) : (
                <p className="small muted">
                  Post a listing to see how many students view and request it.
                </p>
              )}
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div className="seller-overview-two two">
              <div
                className="card stack"
                style={{ background: 'var(--navy)', color: '#fff', border: 0 }}
              >
                <span className="pill yellow" style={{ alignSelf: 'flex-start' }}>
                  First-time seller guide
                </span>
                <h3>Build trust from your first listing</h3>
                <p className="small" style={{ opacity: 0.85 }}>
                  Finish these three quick steps so buyers know who they are meeting.
                </p>
                {(
                  [
                    ['profile', 'Profile verified (RTU email & student ID)'],
                    ['pickup', 'Pickup location added'],
                    ['rules', 'Read prohibited items guide'],
                  ] as const
                ).map(([k, label]) => (
                  <label key={k} className="check" style={{ color: '#fff' }}>
                    <input
                      type="checkbox"
                      checked={Boolean(currentAccount.checklist[k])}
                      onChange={(e) => toggleChecklist(k, e.target.checked)}
                    />
                    {label}
                  </label>
                ))}
                <button
                  type="button"
                  className="btn yellow block"
                  onClick={continueSellerSetup}
                >
                  Continue setup
                </button>
              </div>

              <div className="card stack">
                <div className="row between">
                  <b>Views by listing</b>
                  <span className="tiny muted">Since you posted each item</span>
                </div>
                {sellerList.length ? (
                  <div className="stack" style={{ gap: 10 }}>
                    {sellerList.map((l, i) => (
                      <div key={`${l.lid || l.name}-${i}`} className="stack" style={{ gap: 4 }}>
                        <div className="row between small">
                          <span style={{ overflowWrap: 'anywhere' }}>{l.name}</span>
                          <span className="tnum muted">
                            {l.views} view{l.views === 1 ? '' : 's'} Â· {l.req} req
                          </span>
                        </div>
                        <div style={{ height: 8, background: 'var(--soft)', borderRadius: 6 }}>
                          <div
                            style={{
                              width: `${Math.round((l.views / maxViews) * 100)}%`,
                              height: 8,
                              background: 'var(--blue)',
                              borderRadius: 6,
                            }}
                          />
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                ) : (
                  <p className="small muted">
                    Post a listing to see how many students view and request it.
                  </p>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {openReqs.length > 0 && (
            <div className="card stack">
              <div className="row between wrap">
                <b>Incoming orders waiting for you ({openReqs.length})</b>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  className="link"
                  onClick={() => setShopTab('orders')}
                >
                  Open Incoming orders
                </button>
              </div>
              {openReqs.slice(0, 3).map(renderReqRow)}
            </div>
          )}
        </>
      )}

      {/* Incoming orders tab */}
      {shopTab === 'orders' && (
        <>
          <div className="card stack">
            <div className="row between wrap">
              <div>
                <b>Open orders and meetup requests</b>
                <p className="small muted">
                  Accept to confirm the campus meetup, or message the buyer to agree on a time.
                </p>
              </div>
              <span className="pill">{openReqs.length} open</span>
            </div>
            {openReqs.length ? (
              openReqs.map(renderReqRow)
            ) : (
              <p className="small muted">
                No open requests right now. When a student reserves one of your items or services,
                it appears here.
              </p>
            )}
          </div>

          <div className="card stack">
            <div className="row between wrap">
              <b>Past requests</b>
              <span className="tiny muted tnum">{pastReqs.length}</span>
            </div>
            {pastReqs.length ? (
              pastReqs.map(renderReqRow)
            ) : (
              <p className="small muted">Completed and declined requests are kept here.</p>
            )}
          </div>
        </>
      )}

      {/* Listings tab */}
      {shopTab === 'listings' && (
        <div className="stack">
          {/* Requirement #2: Official RTU Store products rendered in the clean table UI matching Your listings */}
          {isStaffUser && (
            <>
              {editId && (
                <form
                  className="card stack"
                  noValidate
                  onSubmit={(e) => {
                    e.preventDefault()
                    if (
                      saveOfficialProduct({
                        id: editId,
                        name: opName,
                        tag: opType,
                        price: Number(opPrice),
                        stock: Number(opStock),
                        desc: opDesc,
                      })
                    ) {
                      setEditId(null)
                      setOpName('')
                      setOpType(activeTypeNames[0] || 'Uniform')
                      setOpPrice('')
                      setOpStock('')
                      setOpDesc('')
                    }
                  }}
                >
                  <div className="row between wrap">
                    <div>
                      <b>Quick edit official store product</b>
                      <p className="small muted">
                        Changes show right away in the Official RTU Store, the category lists, and
                        the marketplace counts.
                      </p>
                    </div>
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      className="btn ghost sm"
                      onClick={() => startEditListing(editId)}
                    >
                      Open full editor (photos & variations)
                    </button>
                  </div>
                  <div className="grid2">
                    <div className="field">
                      <label htmlFor="op-n">Product name</label>
                      <input
                        className="input"
                        id="op-n"
                        value={opName}
                        placeholder="Name of the item"
                        onChange={(e) => setOpName(e.target.value)}
                      />
                    </div>
                    <div className="field">
                      <label htmlFor="op-t">Type</label>
                      <select
                        className="input"
                        id="op-t"
                        value={opType}
                        onChange={(e) => setOpType(e.target.value)}
                      >
                        {typeOptions.map((t) => (
                          <option key={t} value={t}>
                            {t}
                          </option>
                        ))}
                      </select>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <div className="grid2">
                    <div className="field">
                      <label htmlFor="op-p">Price (â‚±)</label>
                      <input
                        className="input tnum"
                        id="op-p"
                        type="number"
                        min="1"
                        inputMode="numeric"
                        value={opPrice}
                        onChange={(e) => setOpPrice(e.target.value)}
                      />
                    </div>
                    <div className="field">
                      <label htmlFor="op-s">In stock</label>
                      <input
                        className="input tnum"
                        id="op-s"
                        type="number"
                        min="0"
                        inputMode="numeric"
                        value={opStock}
                        readOnly
                        title="Stock is changed in Store inventory"
                      />
                      <span className="tiny muted">
                        Available now. Change stock in{' '}
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          className="link"
                          onClick={() => navigate('baostock')}
                        >
                          Store inventory
                        </button>
                        .
                      </span>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <div className="field">
                    <label htmlFor="op-d">Short description</label>
                    <textarea
                      className="input"
                      id="op-d"
                      placeholder="Sizes, edition or other details"
                      value={opDesc}
                      onChange={(e) => setOpDesc(e.target.value)}
                    />
                  </div>
                  <div className="row" style={{ justifyContent: 'flex-end' }}>
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      className="btn ghost"
                      onClick={() => setEditId(null)}
                    >
                      Cancel
                    </button>
                    <button type="submit" className="btn">
                      Save changes
                    </button>
                  </div>
                </form>
              )}

              <div className="card stack">
                <div className="row between wrap">
                  <div>
                    <b>Official RTU Store products</b>
                    <p className="small muted">
                      Official products you have posted. Edit details, publish/hide, or remove an
                      item at any time.
                    </p>
                  </div>
                  <div className="row wrap" style={{ gap: 8 }}>
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      className="btn sm"
                      onClick={() => {
                        setDraft((prev) => (prev.editLid ? prev : { ...prev, type: 'product' }))
                        setListStep(1)
                        navigate('create')
                      }}
                    >
                      <Icon name="plus" size="sm" />
                      Admin | Sell an Item
                    </button>
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      className="btn ghost sm"
                      onClick={() => navigate('baostock')}
                    >
                      Store inventory
                    </button>
                  </div>
                </div>

                {db.official.length ? (
                  <div className="scroll-x">
                    <table className="tbl">
                      <thead>
                        <tr>
                          <th>Item</th>
                          <th>Type</th>
                          <th>Status</th>
                          <th>Stock</th>
                          <th>Reserved / Req</th>
                          <th>Available</th>
                          <th>Sold</th>
                          <th>Views</th>
                          <th>Price</th>
                          <th>Actions</th>
                        </tr>
                      </thead>
                      <tbody>
                        {db.official.map((p) => {
                          const it = baoItemType(db.bao, p)
                          const typeName = it ? it.name : p.tag || 'Official'
                          const sl = sellerList.find((l) => l.lid === p.id)
                          const itemViews = sl ? sl.views : 0
                          const units = baoUnits(p)
                          const onHand = units.reduce((a, u) => a + u.onHand, 0)
                          const available = units.reduce((a, u) => a + u.available, 0)
                          const reserved = units.reduce((a, u) => a + baoReserved(u), 0)
                          const sold = salesIndex.get(p.id)?.units || 0
                          return (
                            <tr key={p.id}>
                              <td>
                                <b>{p.name}</b>
                              </td>
                              <td>
                                <span
                                  className={`pill ${
                                    typeName === 'Uniform' ? 'blue' : ''
                                  }`.trim()}
                                >
                                  {typeName}
                                </span>
                              </td>
                              <td>
                                <span className={`pill ${p.hidden ? 'yellow' : 'green'}`}>
                                  {p.hidden ? 'Hidden' : 'On sale'}
                                </span>
                              </td>
                              <td className="tnum" title={`${available} available + ${reserved} reserved = ${onHand} on hand`}>
                                <b>{onHand}</b>
                              </td>
                              <td className="tnum">
                                <span className={`pill ${reserved > 0 ? 'yellow' : ''}`.trim()}>
                                  {reserved}
                                </span>
                              </td>
                              <td className="tnum">
                                <b style={{ color: available > 0 ? 'var(--green)' : 'var(--red)' }}>
                                  {available}
                                </b>
                              </td>
                              <td className="tnum">
                                <span className={`pill ${sold > 0 ? 'blue' : ''}`.trim()}>
                                  {sold}
                                </span>
                              </td>
                              <td className="tnum">{itemViews}</td>
                              <td className="tnum">{peso(p.price)}</td>
                              <td>
                                <div className="row wrap" style={{ gap: 6 }}>
                                  <button
                                    type="button"
                                    className="btn ghost sm"
                                    onClick={() => navigate(`product?id=${p.id}`)}
                                  >
                                    View
                                  </button>
                                  <button
                                    type="button"
                                    className="btn ghost sm"
                                    onClick={() => {
                                      setEditId(p.id)
                                      setOpName(p.name)
                                      setOpType(typeName)
                                      setOpPrice(String(p.price))
                                      setOpStock(String(p.left))
                                      setOpDesc(p.desc || '')
                                      window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'smooth' })
                                    }}
                                  >
                                    Quick edit
                                  </button>
                                  <button
                                    type="button"
                                    className="btn ghost sm"
                                    onClick={() => startEditListing(p.id)}
                                  >
                                    Edit
                                  </button>
                                  <button
                                    type="button"
                                    className="btn ghost sm"
                                    onClick={() => toggleHideOfficialProduct(p.id)}
                                  >
                                    {p.hidden ? 'Publish' : 'Hide'}
                                  </button>
                                  <button
                                    type="button"
                                    className="btn danger sm"
                                    onClick={() => deleteOfficialProduct(p.id)}
                                  >
                                    Remove
                                  </button>
                                </div>
                              </td>
                            </tr>
                          )
                        })}
                      </tbody>
                    </table>
                  </div>
                ) : (
                  <p className="small muted">
                    No official products yet. Use â€œAdmin | Sell an Itemâ€ to post an official
                    product.
                  </p>
                )}
              </div>
            </>
          )}

          {/* Standard Listings table (for students, or any additional services posted by staff) */}
          {(!isStaffUser ||
            sellerList.some((l) => !db.official.some((o) => o.id === l.lid))) && (
            <div className="card stack">
              <div className="row between wrap">
                <div>
                  <b>{isStaffUser ? 'Your services & other listings' : 'Your listings'}</b>
                  <p className="small muted">
                    Products and services you have posted. Edit details, pause or remove an item at
                    any time.
                  </p>
                </div>
                <div className="row wrap" style={{ gap: 8 }}>
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    className="btn sm"
                    onClick={() => {
                      setDraft((prev) => (prev.editLid ? prev : { ...prev, type: 'product' }))
                      setListStep(1)
                      navigate('create')
                    }}
                  >
                    <Icon name="plus" size="sm" />
                    {isStaffUser ? 'Admin | Sell an Item' : 'Add listing'}
                  </button>
                  {sellerList.length > 0 && (
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      className="link"
                      onClick={() => openModal({ kind: 'manage-listings' })}
                    >
                      Manage all
                    </button>
                  )}
                </div>
              </div>

              {sellerList.filter((l) => !isStaffUser || !db.official.some((o) => o.id === l.lid))
                .length ? (
                <div className="scroll-x">
                  <table className="tbl">
                    <thead>
                      <tr>
                        <th>Item</th>
                        <th>Type</th>
                        <th>Status</th>
                        <th>Stock</th>
                        <th>Reserved / Req</th>
                        <th>Available</th>
                        <th>Sold</th>
                        <th>Views</th>
                        <th>Price</th>
                        <th>Actions</th>
                      </tr>
                    </thead>
                    <tbody>
                      {sellerList.map((l, i) => {
                        if (isStaffUser && db.official.some((o) => o.id === l.lid)) return null
                        const p = l.lid ? byId(l.lid) : undefined
                        const sv = p && isSvc(p)
                        const available = sv ? null : p ? p.left : 0
                        const reserved = l.lid
                          ? db.txn
                              .filter(
                                (t) =>
                                  t.status === 'Pending' || t.status === 'Confirmed',
                              )
                              .reduce(
                                (acc, t) =>
                                  acc +
                                  (t.lines || [])
                                    .filter((ln) => ln.pid === l.lid)
                                    .reduce((s, ln) => s + ln.qty, 0),
                                0,
                              )
                          : 0
                        const sold = l.lid ? salesIndex.get(l.lid)?.units || 0 : 0
                        const totalStock =
                          available === null ? null : available + reserved
                        return (
                          <tr key={`${l.lid || l.name}-${i}`}>
                            <td>
                              <b>{l.name}</b>
                            </td>
                            <td>
                              <span className={`pill ${sv ? 'purple' : ''}`.trim()}>
                                {sv ? 'Service' : 'Product'}
                              </span>
                            </td>
                            <td>
                              <span
                                className={`pill ${
                                  l.status === 'Active'
                                    ? 'green'
                                    : l.status === 'Rejected' || l.status === 'Removed'
                                      ? 'red'
                                      : 'yellow'
                                }`}
                              >
                                {l.status}
                              </span>
                            </td>
                            <td className="tnum">
                              {sv ? (
                                <span className="tiny muted">By schedule</span>
                              ) : (
                                <b>{totalStock}</b>
                              )}
                            </td>
                            <td className="tnum">
                              <span className={`pill ${reserved > 0 ? 'yellow' : ''}`.trim()}>
                                {reserved}
                              </span>
                            </td>
                            <td className="tnum">
                              {sv ? (
                                <span className="tiny muted">Open</span>
                              ) : (
                                <b
                                  style={{
                                    color:
                                      (available || 0) > 0 ? 'var(--green)' : 'var(--red)',
                                  }}
                                >
                                  {available}
                                </b>
                              )}
                            </td>
                            <td className="tnum">
                              <span className={`pill ${sold > 0 ? 'blue' : ''}`.trim()}>
                                {sold}
                              </span>
                            </td>
                            <td className="tnum">{l.views}</td>
                            <td className="tnum">{peso(l.price)}</td>
                            <td>
                              <div className="row wrap" style={{ gap: 6 }}>
                                {l.lid && (
                                  <>
                                    <button
                                      type="button"
                                      className="btn ghost sm"
                                      onClick={() => navigate(`product?id=${l.lid}`)}
                                    >
                                      View
                                    </button>
                                    <button
                                      type="button"
                                      className="btn ghost sm"
                                      onClick={() => startEditListing(l.lid!)}
                                    >
                                      Edit
                                    </button>
                                  </>
                                )}
                                {(l.status === 'Active' || l.status === 'Paused') && (
                                  <button
                                    type="button"
                                    className="btn ghost sm"
                                    onClick={() => toggleSellerListingPause(i)}
                                  >
                                    {l.status === 'Active' ? 'Pause' : 'Resume'}
                                  </button>
                                )}
                                <button
                                  type="button"
                                  className="btn danger sm"
                                  onClick={() => deleteSellerListing(i)}
                                >
                                  Delete
                                </button>
                              </div>
                            </td>
                          </tr>
                        )
                      })}
                    </tbody>
                  </table>
                </div>
              ) : (
                <p className="small muted">
                  You have no listings yet. Use â€œSell an itemâ€ to post your first product or
                  service.
                </p>
              )}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Shop ratings tab */}
      {shopTab === 'reviews' && (
        <div className="card stack">
          <div className="row between wrap">
            <div>
              <b>Shop ratings and reviews</b>
              <p className="small muted">
                Ratings from buyers who completed a pickup with you, for your shop and for your
                items.
              </p>
            </div>
            <div>
              <RatingText kind="seller" targetKey={sellerKey} />
            </div>
          </div>

          {sellerDirectReviews.length > 0 && (
            <div className="shop-rate-grid">
              <div className="row" style={{ gap: 10 }}>
                <b className="tnum" style={{ fontSize: 30 }}>
                  {sellerRating.avg.toFixed(1)}
                </b>
                <div>
                  <StarsDisplay avg={sellerRating.avg} />
                  <div className="tiny muted tnum">
                    {sellerRating.n} seller {sellerRating.n === 1 ? 'rating' : 'ratings'}
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
              <div className="stack" style={{ gap: 4 }}>
                {[5, 4, 3, 2, 1].map((s) => {
                  const c = sellerDirectReviews.filter((r) => r.stars === s).length
                  return (
                    <div key={s} className="row tiny" style={{ gap: 6 }}>
                      <span className="tnum" style={{ width: 28 }}>
                        {s} â˜…
                      </span>
                      <div className="bar">
                        <div
                          style={{
                            width: `${Math.round((c / sellerRating.n) * 100)}%`,
                          }}
                        />
                      </div>
                      <span
                        className="tnum muted"
                        style={{ width: 24, textAlign: 'right' }}
                      >
                        {c}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                  )
                })}
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {shopReviews.length ? (
            <div className="stack" style={{ gap: 10 }}>
              {shopReviews.map((x) => {
                const p = x.kind === 'item' && x.pid ? byId(x.pid) : undefined
                const reviewerAcct = acctByEmail(x.buyerEmail)
                return (
                  <div
                    key={x.id}
                    className="card flat stack"
                    style={{ gap: 6, background: 'var(--bg)' }}
                  >
                    <div className="row between wrap">
                      <span className="row wrap" style={{ gap: 8 }}>
                        <AvatarBadge
                          account={reviewerAcct}
                          name={x.buyerName}
                          size="sm"
                        />
                        <b>{x.buyerName}</b>
                        <span className="pill green">Verified pickup</span>
                        <span className="pill">
                          {x.kind === 'seller'
                            ? 'Seller rating'
                            : `Item: ${p ? p.name : 'Listing'}`}
                        </span>
                        <StarsDisplay avg={x.stars} />
                      </span>
                      <span className="row" style={{ gap: 8 }}>
                        <span className="tiny muted">
                          {new Date(x.ts).toLocaleDateString('en-PH', {
                            month: 'short',
                            day: 'numeric',
                            year: 'numeric',
                          })}
                          {rDateSuffix(x.edited)}
                        </span>
                        {isStaffUser && (
                          <button
                            type="button"
                            className="link"
                            style={{ color: 'var(--red)' }}
                            onClick={() => confirmDeleteReview(x.id)}
                          >
                            Remove
                          </button>
                        )}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                    {x.text ? (
                      <p className="small" style={{ overflowWrap: 'anywhere' }}>
                        {x.text}
                      </p>
                    ) : (
                      <p className="tiny muted">Rated with stars only.</p>
                    )}
                  </div>
                )
              })}
            </div>
          ) : (
            <p className="small muted">
              No ratings yet. After a buyer completes a pickup, they can rate you and the item from
              My Orders.
            </p>
          )}
        </div>
      )}
    </>
  )
}

function rDateSuffix(edited?: number | null): string {
  return edited ? ' Â· edited' : ''
}

// ===== C:\Users\Lian Andrew\Desktop\RTU_Tindahan_Capstone\RTU_Tindahan_Final\RTU_Tindahan\frontend\src\features\marketplace\pages\OfficialStorePage.tsx =====
import { useState } from 'react'
import { Icon } from '@/common/components/Icon'
import { playHeart } from '@/common/sounds'
import { navigate } from '@/common/router/router'
import { MiniLoader } from '@/common/components/BrandLoader'
import { baoItemType } from '../baoHelpers'
import { useTindahan } from '../context/TindahanContext'
import { ProductCard } from '../components/ProductCard'
import { RatingText } from '../components/StarRating'
import './OfficialStorePage.css'

export function OfficialStorePage() {
  const {
    db,
    currentAccount,
    isStaffUser,
    allOnSale,
    sellerKind,
    toggleSellerFav,
    setDraft,
    setListStep,
    listingsLoading,
  } = useTindahan()
  const [storeTab, setStoreTab] = useState<string>('All')

  // Exclusively display products managed and sold by authorized RTU administrators
  const officialItems = allOnSale.filter(
    (p) => sellerKind(p) === 'school' && p.kind !== 'service',
  )

  // v1.6: tabs follow the active BAO item types from Store inventory > Item types, with live counts
  const dynamicTabs: Array<[string, string, number]> = [
    ['All', 'All official products', officialItems.length],
    ...db.bao.types
      .filter((t) => t.active)
      .map((t): [string, string, number] => {
        const label =
          t.name === 'Uniform'
            ? 'Uniforms'
            : t.name === 'Book'
              ? 'Books & manuals'
              : t.name === 'Merchandise'
                ? 'RTU merchandise'
                : t.name
        const count = officialItems.filter((p) => {
          const it = baoItemType(db.bao, p)
          return Boolean(it && it.id === t.id)
        }).length
        return [t.id, label, count]
      }),
  ]

  const activeTab = dynamicTabs.some((t) => t[0] === storeTab) ? storeTab : 'All'

  const list = officialItems.filter((p) => {
    if (activeTab === 'All') return true
    const it = baoItemType(db.bao, p)
    return Boolean(it && it.id === activeTab)
  })

  const sfav = Boolean(currentAccount?.sfavs?.includes('official'))

  return (
    <>
      {listingsLoading && (
        <div style={{ padding: 40, textAlign: 'center', minHeight: 400 }}>
          <MiniLoader variant="section" size="lg" label="Loading campus listingsâ€¦" />
        </div>
      )}
      {!listingsLoading && (
        <>
          <div className="srchead school">
        <div className="stack" style={{ gap: 6, maxWidth: 'none' }}>
          <span className="pill yellow" style={{ alignSelf: 'flex-start' }}>
            <Icon name="shield" size="sm" />
            OFFICIAL RTU PASIG STORE
          </span>
          <h1 style={{ fontSize: 24 }}>Uniforms, books and campus merchandise</h1>
          <p className="small" style={{ opacity: 0.9 }}>
            Published and managed by RTU staff. Reserve online, then pay and claim at the Pasig
            Campus Store window with your student ID. Student listings are on the{' '}
            <button
              type="button"
              className="link"
              style={{ color: 'var(--yellow)' }}
              onClick={() => navigate('student-sellers')}
            >
              Student Sellers page
            </button>
            .
          </p>
          <div className="small" style={{ opacity: 0.95 }}>
            Store rating: <RatingText kind="seller" targetKey="official" />
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className="stack" style={{ gap: 8, alignItems: 'flex-end' }}>

          {currentAccount && (
            <button
              type="button"
              className={`btn ghost sm sfav ${sfav ? 'on' : ''}`.trim()}
              aria-pressed={sfav}
              onClick={() => {
                playHeart()
                toggleSellerFav('official')
              }}
            >
              <Icon name="heart" size="sm" />
              {sfav ? 'Favorite seller' : 'Add seller to favorites'}
            </button>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="tabs" role="tablist">
        {dynamicTabs.map(([k, label, count]) => (
          <button
            key={k}
            type="button"
            className={`tab ${activeTab === k ? 'on' : ''}`.trim()}
            role="tab"
            aria-selected={activeTab === k}
            onClick={() => setStoreTab(k)}
          >
            {label} <span className="tnum muted">({count})</span>
          </button>
        ))}
      </div>

      {list.length ? (
        <div className="pgrid">
          {list.map((p) => (
            <ProductCard key={p.id} product={p} />
          ))}
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div
          className="card stack"
          style={{ alignItems: 'center', textAlign: 'center', padding: 40 }}
        >
          <span style={{ color: 'var(--blue)' }}>
            <Icon name="store" />
          </span>
          <b>
            {officialItems.length ? 'Nothing in this section yet' : 'No official products yet'}
          </b>
          <p className="small muted" style={{ maxWidth: '48ch' }}>
            {officialItems.length
              ? 'Choose another tab above.'
              : 'RTU staff publish uniforms, manuals and merchandise from Sell an item and manage them in Admin | RTU Shop.'}
          </p>
          {isStaffUser && (
            <div className="row wrap" style={{ justifyContent: 'center', gap: 8 }}>
              <button
                type="button"
                className="btn yellow"
                onClick={() => {
                  setDraft((prev) => (prev.editLid ? prev : { ...prev, type: 'product' }))
                  setListStep(1)
                  navigate('create')
                }}
              >
                <Icon name="plus" size="sm" />
                Admin | Sell an Item
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                className="btn ghost"
                onClick={() => navigate('shop')}
              >
                Admin | RTU Shop
              </button>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      )}

      <div className="grid2">
        <div className="card stack" style={{ gap: 6 }}>
          <b>Sizes</b>
          <p className="small muted">
            Uniforms and PE shirts follow the campus store size chart (S, M, L, XL). Try the
            sample rack at the window before you pay.
          </p>
        </div>
        <div className="card stack" style={{ gap: 6 }}>
          <b>Claiming at the store window</b>
          <p className="small muted">
            Show your order number and RTU ID at the window. Unclaimed reservations are released
            after two school days so other students can reserve them.
          </p>
        </div>
      </div>
      </>)}
    </>
  )
}

import { useState, useEffect } from 'react'
import { Icon } from '@/common/components/Icon'
import type { IconName } from '@/common/components/icons'
import { navigate } from '@/common/router/router'
import {
  BAO_PILL,
  BAO_STEPS,
  baoClaimNotes,
  baoDate,
  baoIsOfficialOrder,
  baoIsOfficialTxn,
  baoProgress,
  baoStatusOf,
  baoTxnFor,
} from '../baoHelpers'
import { PLACES, TIMES, getSellerTimeWindows, peso, stamp } from '../constants'
import { useTindahan } from '../context/TindahanContext'
import { imgSrc, imgsOf } from '../imageStore'
import type { OrderRecord, TransactionRecord } from '../types'
import { StarPicker, StarsDisplay } from '../components/StarRating'
import './OrdersPage.css'

export function BaoProgressBar({ txn }: { txn: TransactionRecord }) {
  const p = baoProgress(txn)
  return (
    <ol className="bstep" aria-label="Request progress">
      {BAO_STEPS.map((s, i) => {
        let cls = i < p.idx ? 'done' : i === p.idx ? 'cur' : 'todo'
        let mark: React.ReactNode = i < p.idx ? <Icon name="check" size="sm" /> : String(i + 1)
        let label: string = s

        if (i === p.idx && p.cur === 'Claimed') {
          cls = 'done'
          mark = <Icon name="check" size="sm" />
        }
        if (i === p.idx && p.hold) {
          cls = 'hold'
          mark = 'II'
          label = 'On Hold'
        }
        if (i === p.idx && p.cancelled) {
          cls = 'stop'
          mark = 'X'
          label = 'Cancelled'
        }
        return (
          <li key={s} className={cls}>
            <span className="dot">{mark}</span>
            <span className="lbl">{label}</span>
          </li>
        )
      })}
    </ol>
  )
}

export function OrdersPage() {
  const {
    db,
    currentAccount,
    orderTab,
    setOrderTab,
    selectedOrderId,
    setSelectedOrderId,
    byId,
    proposeOrderMeetup,
    confirmOrderPickup,
    confirmDlg,
    cancelOrderRequest,
    sendOrderMessage,
    orderRateable,
    reviewOf,
    submitReview,
    openModal,
  } = useTindahan()

  const [openBox, setOpenBox] = useState<'' | 'msg' | 'edit' | 'cancel'>('')
  const [msgText, setMsgText] = useState('')
  const presetPlaces = PLACES.filter((pl) => pl !== 'Others')
  const [editPlace, setEditPlace] = useState(PLACES[0])
  const [editOthersMode, setEditOthersMode] = useState(false)
  const [editTime, setEditTime] = useState(TIMES[0])

  if (!currentAccount) return null
  const orders = currentAccount.orders || []
  const tabs: ('Requesting' | 'For Pickup' | 'Completed' | 'Cancelled')[] = ['Requesting', 'For Pickup', 'Completed', 'Cancelled']

  // Determine whether an Active order belongs in 'Requesting' or 'For Pickup'.
  // Student seller orders: status 'Awaiting seller'/'Pending' or stage <= 1 => Requesting;
  // status 'Meetup set'/'Confirmed'/'Ready' or stage >= 2 => For Pickup.
  // Official RTU Store (BAO) orders: status 'Request Received' => Requesting;
  // status 'Confirmed'/'Ready for Pickup' => For Pickup.
  const isRequestingOrder = (o: OrderRecord): boolean => {
    if (o.tab !== 'Active') return false
    const t = baoTxnFor(o, db.txn ?? [])
    if (baoIsOfficialTxn(t) && t) {
      const st = baoStatusOf(t)
      return st === 'Request Received'
    }
    return o.status === 'Awaiting seller' || o.stage <= 1
  }

  const isForPickupOrder = (o: OrderRecord): boolean => {
    if (o.tab !== 'Active') return false
    const t = baoTxnFor(o, db.txn ?? [])
    if (baoIsOfficialTxn(t) && t) {
      const st = baoStatusOf(t)
      return st === 'Confirmed' || st === 'Ready for Pickup'
    }
    return o.status === 'Meetup set' || o.stage >= 2
  }

  // Split Active orders into Requesting vs For Pickup; Completed/Cancelled stay as-is.
  const list = orders.filter((o) => {
    if (orderTab === 'Requesting') return isRequestingOrder(o)
    if (orderTab === 'For Pickup') return isForPickupOrder(o)
    return o.tab === orderTab
  })

  // Auto-select the first order in the current tab (or null if empty)
  useEffect(() => {
    const first = list.length ? list[0].id : null
    setSelectedOrderId(first)
    setOpenBox('')
  }, [orderTab, list])

  const sel = list.find((o) => o.id === selectedOrderId) || list[0]

  const steps = [
    { label: 'Requested', stageThreshold: 1 },
    { label: 'Meetup set', stageThreshold: 2 },
    { label: 'Completed', stageThreshold: 4 },
  ]

  const renderOrderPill = (o: OrderRecord) => {
    const t = baoTxnFor(o, db.txn ?? [])
    if (baoIsOfficialTxn(t) && t) {
      const st = baoStatusOf(t)
      return <span className={`pill ${BAO_PILL[st] || ''}`.trim()}>{st}</span>
    }
    return (
      <span
        className={`pill ${
          o.tab === 'Completed' ? 'green' : o.tab === 'Cancelled' ? 'red' : 'yellow'
        }`}
      >
        {o.status}
      </span>
    )
  }

  const renderOrderThumb = (o: OrderRecord, size: number) => {
    const pid = o.lines && o.lines[0] && o.lines[0].pid
    const prod = pid ? byId(pid) : undefined
    const imgs = prod ? imgsOf(prod) : []
    const src = imgs.length ? imgSrc(imgs[0]) : ''
    return (
      <div
        className={`photo ${o.tone || 't-study'} ${src ? 'has-img' : 'nophoto-tile'}`.trim()}
        style={{ width: size, height: size, aspectRatio: '1', flex: 'none' }}
      >
        {src ? <img className="pimg" src={src} alt={o.title} /> : null}
        <Icon name={(o.icon || 'bag') as IconName} />
      </div>
    )
  }

  const selTxn = sel ? baoTxnFor(sel, db.txn ?? []) : null
  const selIsOfficial = Boolean(sel && baoIsOfficialOrder(sel, db.txn ?? []) && selTxn)
  const sellerAccepted = sel ? sel.status === 'Meetup set' : false

  // Strict cancel check: only while still pending (Requesting).
  // Allowed: Active + status Awaiting seller / Pending / stage <= 1 (student seller),
  //          or BAO status Request Received (Official RTU Store).
  // Blocked: Meetup set, Confirmed, Ready, Completed, Cancelled.
  const canCancelOrder = (o?: OrderRecord): boolean => {
    if (!o || o.tab !== 'Active') return false
    if (o.status === 'Completed' || o.status === 'Cancelled') return false
    const t = baoTxnFor(o, db.txn ?? [])
    if (baoIsOfficialTxn(t) && t) {
      const st = baoStatusOf(t)
      return st === 'Request Received'
    }
    return o.status === 'Awaiting seller' || o.stage <= 1
  }

  const selCanCancel = canCancelOrder(sel)
  const selFirstProd = sel && sel.lines && sel.lines[0] ? byId(sel.lines[0].pid) : undefined
  const selTimeOptions = selFirstProd ? getSellerTimeWindows(selFirstProd) : TIMES

  return (
    <>
      <div>
        <span className="eyebrow">MY ORDERS</span>
        <h1>Your requests and campus pickups</h1>
        <p className="muted small">
          Follow each meetup from request to in-person pickup.
        </p>
      </div>

      <div className="tabs orders-tabs" role="tablist">
        {tabs.map((t) => {
          const count = t === 'Requesting'
            ? orders.filter(isRequestingOrder).length
            : t === 'For Pickup'
              ? orders.filter(isForPickupOrder).length
              : orders.filter((o) => o.tab === t).length
          return (
            <button
              key={t}
              type="button"
              className={`tab ${orderTab === t ? 'on' : ''}`.trim()}
              role="tab"
              aria-selected={orderTab === t}
              onClick={() => {
                setOrderTab(t)
                setOpenBox('')
              }}
            >
              {t} <span className="tnum">({count})</span>
            </button>
          )
        })}
      </div>

      {!list.length ? (
        <div
          className="card stack"
          style={{ alignItems: 'center', textAlign: 'center', padding: 40 }}
        >
          <span style={{ color: 'var(--blue)' }}>
            <Icon name="bag" />
          </span>
          {orderTab === 'Requesting' ? (
            <>
              <b>No pending requests right now.</b>
              <p className="small muted">
                Your active requests awaiting seller confirmation will show here.
              </p>
            </>
          ) : orderTab === 'For Pickup' ? (
            <>
              <b>No items ready for pickup yet.</b>
              <p className="small muted">
                Accepted requests scheduled for meetup will show here.
              </p>
            </>
          ) : orderTab === 'Completed' ? (
            <>
              <b>No completed pickups.</b>
              <p className="small muted">
                Completed campus pickups will show here.
              </p>
            </>
          ) : (
            <>
              <b>No cancelled requests.</b>
              <p className="small muted">
                Cancelled requests will show here.
              </p>
            </>
          )}
          <button type="button" className="btn" onClick={() => navigate('browse')}>
            Browse listings
          </button>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div className="orders-two two">
          {/* Left list of orders */}
          <div className="stack">
            {list.map((o) => (
              <button
                key={o.id}
                type="button"
                className="card row between"
                style={{
                  textAlign: 'left',
                  borderColor: sel && sel.id === o.id ? 'var(--blue)' : undefined,
                }}
                onClick={() => {
                  setSelectedOrderId(o.id)
                  setOpenBox('')
                }}
              >
                <div className="row" style={{ minWidth: 0 }}>
