                    style={{ background: 'var(--red-bg)', borderColor: 'transparent' }}
                  >
                    This request was cancelled. No payment was made.
                  </div>
                ))}

              <div className="card flat stack" style={{ background: 'var(--bg)', gap: 6 }}>
                <div className="row between small">
                  <span className="muted">Seller</span>
                  <b>{sel.seller}</b>
                </div>
                <div className="row between small">
                  <span className="muted">Fulfillment method</span>
                  <span className={`pill ${sel.fulfillment === 'delivery' ? 'blue' : 'green'}`}>
                    {sel.fulfillment === 'delivery' ? 'Delivery' : 'Pickup'}
                  </span>
                </div>
                <div className="row between small">
                  <span className="muted">{sel.fulfillment === 'delivery' ? 'Delivery schedule' : 'Meetup'}</span>
                  <b>{sel.when}</b>
                </div>
                <div className="row between small">
                  <span className="muted">Pay on meetup</span>
                  <b className="tnum">{peso(sel.total)}</b>
                </div>
              </div>

              {sel.tab === 'Active' && (
                <>
                  <div className="order-actions">
                    {!selIsOfficial && (
                      <>
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          className="btn sm"
                          disabled={!sellerAccepted}
                          aria-disabled={!sellerAccepted}
                          onClick={() => {
                            confirmDlg({
                              title:
                                'Confirm ' +
                                (sel.fulfillment === 'delivery' ? 'delivery' : 'pickup') + '?',
                              msg: `Only confirm once you have received "${sel.title}" from ${sel.seller} and paid in person. This marks the order as completed and lets the seller know.`,
                              yes: 'Yes, I received it',
                              no: 'Not yet',
                              danger: false,
                              run: () => {
                                confirmOrderPickup(sel.id, sel.proofPhoto || null)
                              },
                            })
                          }}
                        >
                          <Icon name="check" size="sm" />
                          Confirm {sel.fulfillment === 'delivery' ? 'delivery' : 'pickup'}
                        </button>
                      </>
                    )}
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      className="btn ghost sm"
                      onClick={() =>
                        setOpenBox((cur) => (cur === 'msg' ? '' : 'msg'))
                      }
                    >
                      <Icon name="msg" size="sm" />
                      Message seller
                    </button>
                    {!selIsOfficial && (
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        className="btn ghost sm"
                        onClick={() => {
                          const rawPlace = (sel.when || '').split(',')[0] || ''
                          const cleanPl = rawPlace.replace(/^(Pickup|Delivery)\s*Â·\s*/i, '').trim()
                          if (cleanPl) {
                            setEditPlace(cleanPl)
                            setEditOthersMode(!presetPlaces.includes(cleanPl))
                          }
                          setEditTime(selTimeOptions[0] || TIMES[0])
                          setOpenBox((cur) => (cur === 'edit' ? '' : 'edit'))
                        }}
                      >
                        Reschedule
                      </button>
                    )}
                    {!selIsOfficial && (
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        className="btn ghost sm"
                        onClick={() =>
                          openModal({
                            kind: 'order-report',
                            orderId: sel.id,
                            role: 'buyer',
                            targetEmail: sel.sellerEmail,
                            targetName: sel.seller,
                            itemTitle: sel.title,
                          })
                        }
                      >
                        <Icon name="flag" size="sm" />
                        Report issue
                      </button>
                    )}
                    {sel && selCanCancel ? (
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        className="btn danger sm"
                        onClick={() =>
                          setOpenBox((cur) => (cur === 'cancel' ? '' : 'cancel'))
                        }
                      >
                        Cancel request
                      </button>
                    ) : sel && !selCanCancel ? (
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        className="btn danger sm disabled"
                        disabled
                        title="Cannot cancel once meetup is set. Message the seller or request a reschedule instead."
                      >
                        Cancel request
                      </button>
                    ) : null}
                  </div>

                  {!sellerAccepted && !selIsOfficial && (
                    <div className="note blue">
                      <Icon name="info" size="sm" />
                      <span>
                        Confirm {sel.fulfillment === 'delivery' ? 'delivery' : 'pickup'} unlocks once the seller accepts your request.
                      </span>
                    </div>
                  )}

                  {openBox === 'msg' && (
                    <form
                      className="card flat stack"
                      style={{ background: 'var(--bg)' }}
                      onSubmit={(e) => {
                        e.preventDefault()
                        if (sendOrderMessage(sel.id, msgText, true)) {
                          setMsgText('')
                          setOpenBox('')
                        }
                      }}
                    >
                      <b className="small">Message {sel.seller}</b>
                      <textarea
                        className="input"
                        id="omsg-t"
                        placeholder="Write a message about this meetup..."
                        value={msgText}
                        onChange={(e) => setMsgText(e.target.value)}
                      />
                      <div className="row" style={{ justifyContent: 'flex-end' }}>
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          className="btn ghost sm"
                          onClick={() => setOpenBox('')}
                        >
                          Close
                        </button>
                        <button type="submit" className="btn sm">
                          Send
                        </button>
                      </div>
                    </form>
                  )}

                  {!selIsOfficial && openBox === 'edit' && (
                    <form
                      className="card flat stack"
                      style={{ background: 'var(--bg)' }}
                      onSubmit={(e) => {
                        e.preventDefault()
                        proposeOrderMeetup(sel.id, editPlace, editTime)
                        setOpenBox('')
                      }}
                    >
                      <b className="small">Propose a new meetup</b>
                      <div className="grid2">
                        <div className="field">
                          <label htmlFor="oep">Location</label>
                          <select
                            className="input"
                            id="oep"
                            value={
                              editOthersMode || !presetPlaces.includes(editPlace)
                                ? 'Others'
                                : editPlace
                            }
                            onChange={(e) => {
                              const val = e.target.value
                              if (val === 'Others') {
                                setEditOthersMode(true)
                                if (presetPlaces.includes(editPlace)) setEditPlace('')
                              } else {
                                setEditOthersMode(false)
                                setEditPlace(val)
                              }
                            }}
                          >
                            {PLACES.map((pl) => (
                              <option key={pl} value={pl}>
                                {pl}
                              </option>
                            ))}
                          </select>
                          {(editOthersMode || !presetPlaces.includes(editPlace)) && (
                            <input
                              className="input"
                              style={{ marginTop: 8 }}
                              placeholder="Write your specific campus spot..."
                              value={presetPlaces.includes(editPlace) ? '' : editPlace}
                              onChange={(e) => setEditPlace(e.target.value)}
                            />
                          )}
                        </div>
                        <div className="field">
                          <label htmlFor="oet">Time window</label>
                          <select
                            className="input"
                            id="oet"
                            value={selTimeOptions.includes(editTime) ? editTime : selTimeOptions[0] || editTime}
                            onChange={(e) => setEditTime(e.target.value)}
                          >
                            {selTimeOptions.map((tm) => (
                              <option key={tm} value={tm}>
                                {tm}
                              </option>
                            ))}
                          </select>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                      <div className="row" style={{ justifyContent: 'flex-end' }}>
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          className="btn ghost sm"
                          onClick={() => setOpenBox('')}
                        >
                          Cancel
                        </button>
                        <button type="submit" className="btn sm">
                          Save new time
                        </button>
                      </div>
                    </form>
                  )}

                  {openBox === 'cancel' && (
                    <div
                      className="card flat stack"
                      style={{ background: 'var(--red-bg)' }}
                    >
                      <b className="small">Cancel request {sel.id}?</b>
                      <p className="tiny">
                        The seller will be notified and the reserved stock will be returned.
                      </p>
                      <div className="row" style={{ justifyContent: 'flex-end' }}>
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          className="btn ghost sm"
                          onClick={() => setOpenBox('')}
                        >
                          Keep request
                        </button>
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          className="btn danger sm"
                          onClick={() => {
                            cancelOrderRequest(sel.id)
                            setOpenBox('')
                          }}
                        >
                          Yes, cancel it
                        </button>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  )}
                </>
              )}

              {!selIsOfficial && sel.tab !== 'Active' && (
                <div className="row wrap" style={{ justifyContent: 'flex-end' }}>
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    className="btn ghost sm"
                    onClick={() =>
                      openModal({
                        kind: 'order-report',
                        orderId: sel.id,
                        role: 'buyer',
                        targetEmail: sel.sellerEmail,
                        targetName: sel.seller,
                        itemTitle: sel.title,
                      })
                    }
                  >
                    <Icon name="flag" size="sm" />
                    Report issue with seller
                  </button>
                </div>
              )}

              {/* Order review section for completed pickups (orderReviewHtml in js/9e-reviews-ranking.js) */}
              {orderRateable(sel) && (
                <OrderReviewSection
                  order={sel}
                  reviewOf={reviewOf}
                  submitReview={submitReview}
                  byId={byId}
                />
              )}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      )}
    </>
  )
}

function OrderReviewSection({
  order,
  reviewOf,
  submitReview,
  byId,
}: {
  order: OrderRecord
  reviewOf: ReturnType<typeof useTindahan>['reviewOf']
  submitReview: ReturnType<typeof useTindahan>['submitReview']
  byId: ReturnType<typeof useTindahan>['byId']
}) {
  const [editingKey, setEditingKey] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const [stars, setStars] = useState<number>(0)
  const [text, setText] = useState<string>('')

  const seenPids = new Set<string>()
  const lines = (order.lines || []).filter(
    (l) => l.pid && byId(l.pid) && !seenPids.has(l.pid) && seenPids.add(l.pid),
  )

  const renderBox = (
    kind: 'seller' | 'item',
    pid: string,
    title: string,
    sub: string,
  ) => {
    const k = kind === 'seller' ? `seller:${order.id}` : `item:${order.id}:${pid}`
    const ex = reviewOf(kind, order.id, pid)
    const isEditing = editingKey === k

    if (ex && !isEditing) {
      return (
        <div
          key={k}
          className="card flat stack"
          style={{ gap: 6, background: 'var(--bg)' }}
        >
          <div className="row between wrap">
            <div>
              <b className="small">{title}</b>
              <div className="tiny muted">{sub}</div>
            </div>
            <div className="row" style={{ gap: 8 }}>
              <StarsDisplay avg={ex.stars} />
              <b className="small tnum">{ex.stars}.0</b>
              <button
                type="button"
                className="btn ghost sm"
                onClick={() => {
                  setEditingKey(k)
                  setStars(ex.stars)
                  setText(ex.text || '')
                }}
              >
                Edit
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
          {ex.text ? (
            <p className="small" style={{ overflowWrap: 'anywhere' }}>
              {ex.text}
            </p>
          ) : (
            <p className="tiny muted">No written review.</p>
          )}
        </div>
      )
    }

    return (
      <form
        key={k}
        className="card flat stack"
        style={{ gap: 8, background: 'var(--bg)' }}
        onSubmit={(e) => {
          e.preventDefault()
          const curStars = isEditing ? stars : stars
          if (submitReview(kind, order.id, pid, curStars, text)) {
            setEditingKey(null)
            setStars(0)
            setText('')
          }
        }}
      >
        <div>
          <b className="small">{title}</b>
          <div className="tiny muted">{sub}</div>
        </div>
        <StarPicker
          value={editingKey === k ? stars : 0}
          label={title}
          onChange={(val) => {
            if (editingKey !== k) {
              setEditingKey(k)
              setText(ex?.text || '')
            }
            setStars(val)
          }}
        />
        <label className="field">
          <span className="tiny muted">Short review (optional, up to 500 characters)</span>
          <textarea
            className="input"
            maxLength={500}
            rows={2}
            placeholder="Was the item as described? How was the campus meetup?"
            value={editingKey === k ? text : ''}
            onChange={(e) => {
              if (editingKey !== k) {
                setEditingKey(k)
              }
              setText(e.target.value)
            }}
          />
        </label>
        <div className="row" style={{ justifyContent: 'flex-end', gap: 8 }}>
          {ex && (
            <button
              type="button"
              className="btn ghost sm"
              onClick={() => {
                setEditingKey(null)
                setStars(0)
                setText('')
              }}
            >
              Cancel
            </button>
          )}
          <button type="submit" className="btn sm">
            {ex ? 'Update rating' : 'Submit rating'}
          </button>
        </div>
      </form>
    )
  }

  return (
    <div
      className="stack"
      style={{ gap: 10, borderTop: '1px solid var(--line)', paddingTop: 12 }}
    >
      <div>
        <b>Rate this completed pickup</b>
        <p className="tiny muted">
          Your rating helps other RTU students know who and what to trust.
        </p>
      </div>
      {renderBox(
        'seller',
        '',
        `Rate seller: ${order.seller}`,
        'How was the communication and campus meetup?',
      )}
      {lines.map((l) => {
        const p = byId(l.pid)
        if (!p) return null
        return renderBox(
          'item',
          p.id,
          `Rate item: ${p.name}`,
          'Was it in the condition described?',
        )
      })}
    </div>
  )
}

// ===== C:\Users\Lian Andrew\Desktop\RTU_Tindahan_Capstone\RTU_Tindahan_Final\RTU_Tindahan\frontend\src\features\marketplace\pages\ProductPage.tsx =====
import { baoLimitFor, baoWindowState, baoWindowText } from '../baoHelpers'

import { Icon } from '@/common/components/Icon'

import {
  catOf,
  hasVars,

  peso,
  priceLabel,
  subOf,
  varLabel,
} from '../constants'
import { useTindahan } from '../context/TindahanContext'
import type { ChosenFulfillment, FulfillmentMethod, ProductVariationAttr, ProductVariationRow } from '../types'
import { AvatarBadge } from '../components/AvatarBadge'
import { ProductGallery } from '../components/PhotoUploader'
import { RatingText, StarsDisplay } from '../components/StarRating'
import './ProductPage.css'

export function ProductPage() {
  const { params } = useRoute()
  const {
    db,
    listingsLoading,
    currentAccount,
    isStaffUser,
    selectedProductId,
    byId,
    allOnSale,
    sellerKind,
    sellerKeyOf,
    acctByEmail,
    ratingOf,
    browseFor,
    toggleFav,
    toggleSellerFav,
    addToCart,
    reserveNow,
    startProductConversation,
    confirmDeleteReview,
    openModal,
    toast,
  } = useTindahan()
  const pid = params.get('id') || selectedProductId
  const p = pid ? byId(pid) : undefined
  const isOwner = Boolean(p && currentAccount && p.owner === currentAccount.email)
  const canView = allOnSale.some((x) => x.id === p?.id) || isOwner || isStaffUser
  const [selectedOpts, setSelectedOpts] = useState<Record<string, string>>({})
  const [variationWarned, setVariationWarned] = useState(false)
  const [qty, setQty] = useState(1)
  const [chosenFulfillment, setChosenFulfillment] = useState<ChosenFulfillment>('pickup')
  const [showMsgForm, setShowMsgForm] = useState(false)
  const [msgText, setMsgText] = useState('')
  const [revLimit, setRevLimit] = useState(5)
  const [particles, setParticles] = useState<
    { x: number; y: number; id: number; r: string; tx: number; ty: number }[]
  >([])
  const [ripple, setRipple] = useState<{ x: number; y: number; active: boolean } | null>(null)

  const sellerFulfillment: FulfillmentMethod | 'none' = useMemo(() => {
    if (!p) return 'pickup'
    // Official RTU Store items are always campus pickup at the BAO window unless explicitly configured
    if (p.cat === 'Official' && !p.fulfillment) return 'pickup'
    const f = p.fulfillment || 'pickup'
    if (f === 'pickup' || f === 'delivery' || f === 'both') return f
    return 'none'
  }, [p])

  useEffect(() => {
    if (sellerFulfillment === 'delivery') {
      setChosenFulfillment('delivery')
    } else {
      setChosenFulfillment('pickup')
    }
  }, [p?.id, sellerFulfillment])

  const handleHeartClick = (e: MouseEvent<HTMLButtonElement>) => {
    e.stopPropagation()
    e.preventDefault()
    const rect = e.currentTarget.getBoundingClientRect()
    const x = e.clientX - rect.left
    const y = e.clientY - rect.top

    setRipple({ x, y, active: true })
    setTimeout(() => setRipple(null), 600)

    const newParticles = Array.from({ length: 8 }, (_, i) => {
      const angle = (i / 8) * Math.PI * 2
      return {
        x,
        y,
        id: i,
        r: `${angle}rad`,
        tx: Math.cos(angle) * (20 + i * 3),
        ty: Math.sin(angle) * (20 + i * 3),
      }
    })
    setParticles(newParticles)
    setTimeout(() => setParticles([]), 500)

    if (p) toggleFav(p.id)
  }

  const reviewsRef = useRef<HTMLElement | null>(null)

  const itemReviews = useMemo(() => {
    if (!p) return []
    return db.reviews
      .filter((r) => r.kind === 'item' && r.pid === p.id)
      .sort((a, b) => b.ts - a.ts)
  }, [db.reviews, p])

  if (!p || !canView) {
    return (
      <div
        className="card stack"
        style={{ alignItems: 'center', textAlign: 'center', padding: 40 }}
      >
        <b>This listing is not available</b>
        <p className="small muted">
          It may have been removed or sold out. Browse the other listings instead.
        </p>
        <button
          type="button"
          className="btn"
          onClick={() => browseFor({ goBrowse: true })}
        >
          Browse listings
        </button>
      </div>
    )
  }

  const svc = isSvc(p)
  const sk = sellerKind(p)
  const skey = sellerKeyOf(p)
  const cat = catOf(p)
  const sub = subOf(p)
  const fav = Boolean(currentAccount?.favs?.includes(p.id))
  const sfav = Boolean(currentAccount?.sfavs?.includes(skey))
  const isOwnListing = Boolean(p.owner && currentAccount && p.owner === currentAccount.email)

  const [place, win] = (p.when || '').split(',').map((s: string) => s.trim())
  const hasVariations = hasVars(p) && p.vars

  // Resolve matching variation row when all attributes are selected (selVar in js/9d-listings.js)
  const chosenVar = useMemo(() => {
    if (!hasVariations || !p.vars) return null
    for (const a of p.vars.attrs) {
      if (!selectedOpts[a.name]) return null
    }
    return (
      p.vars.rows.find((r: ProductVariationRow) =>
        p.vars!.attrs.every((a: ProductVariationAttr) => r.opts[a.name] === selectedOpts[a.name]),
      ) || null
    )
  }, [hasVariations, p.vars, selectedOpts])

  const unitPr =
    chosenVar && chosenVar.price != null ? chosenVar.price : p.price
  const availStock = hasVariations ? (chosenVar ? chosenVar.qty : p.left) : p.left
  const inCartLine = currentAccount?.cart.find(
    (c) => c.id === p.id && (c.vid || '') === (chosenVar ? chosenVar.id : ''),
  )

  const ensureVariationPicked = (): string | null => {
    if (!hasVariations || !p.vars) return ''
    if (chosenVar) return chosenVar.id
    toast(
      'Please choose your ' +
        p.vars.attrs.map((a: ProductVariationAttr) => a.name.toLowerCase()).join(' and ') +
        ' first.',
    )
    return null
  }

  // Option availability helper (matching varPickerHtml in js/9d-listings.js)
  const isOptSoldOut = (attrName: string, optVal: string): boolean => {
    if (!hasVariations || !p.vars) return false
    const matchingRows = p.vars.rows.filter((r: ProductVariationRow) => {
      if (r.opts[attrName] !== optVal) return false
      return p.vars!.attrs.every(
        (other: ProductVariationAttr) =>
          other.name === attrName ||
          !selectedOpts[other.name] ||
          r.opts[other.name] === selectedOpts[other.name],
      )
    })
    return matchingRows.reduce((sum: number, r: ProductVariationRow) => sum + r.qty, 0) < 1
  }

  const itemRating = ratingOf('item', p.id)
  const starBuckets = [5, 4, 3, 2, 1].map((s) => ({
    s,
    c: itemReviews.filter((r) => r.stars === s).length,
  }))

  const sellerAcct = p.owner ? acctByEmail(p.owner) : undefined
  const activeFulfillmentChoice: ChosenFulfillment =
    sellerFulfillment === 'delivery'
      ? 'delivery'
      : sellerFulfillment === 'pickup'
        ? 'pickup'
        : chosenFulfillment

  return (
    <>
      {listingsLoading ? (
        <div style={{ padding: 40, textAlign: 'center', minHeight: 400 }}>

            /{' '}
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => browseFor({ cats: [cat], sub })}
            >
              {sub}
            </button>
          </>
        )}{' '}
        / <span>{p.name}</span>
      </div>

      <div className="pgrid2">
        {/* Left column: gallery + about */}
        <div className="stack">
          <ProductGallery
            product={p}
            favButton={
              <button
                type="button"
                className={`heart ${fav ? 'on' : ''}`.trim()}
                aria-label="Save item"
                aria-pressed={fav}
                style={{ width: 38, height: 38 }}
                onClick={handleHeartClick}
              >
                <Icon name="heart" />
                {ripple && <div className="heart-ripple" style={{ left: '50%', top: '50%' }} />}
                {particles.map((pt) => (
                  <div
                    key={pt.id}
                    className="heart-particle"
                    style={
                      {
                        left: '50%',

                        '--tx': `${pt.tx}px`,
                        '--ty': `${pt.ty}px`,
                      } as CSSProperties
                    }
                  />
                ))}
              </button>
            }
          />

          <div className="card stack">
            <b>{svc ? 'About this service' : 'About this listing'}</b>
            <p className="small muted" style={{ overflowWrap: 'anywhere' }}>
              {p.desc}
            </p>
            <div className="row wrap">
              {p.cond && <span className="pill">Condition: {p.cond}</span>}
              {p.avail && <span className="pill">Available days: {p.avail}</span>}
              <span className="pill">
                {p.cat === 'Official'
                  ? 'Sold by the Pasig Campus Store'
                  : 'Listed by a verified RTU student'}
              </span>
              <span className="pill yellow">
                {sellerFulfillment === 'both'
                  ? 'Campus Pickup or Delivery'
                  : sellerFulfillment === 'delivery'
                    ? 'Campus Delivery only'
                    : 'Campus Pickup only'}
              </span>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Right column: buy card + seller card */}
        <div className="stack">
          <div className={`card stack pdetail-card ${svc ? 'type-service' : sk === 'school' ? 'type-school' : 'type-student'}`}>
            <div className="row between wrap">
              <span className="row wrap" style={{ gap: 6 }}>
                <span className={`srcpill ${sk}`}>
                  {sk === 'school' ? (
                    <>
                      <Icon name="shield" size="sm" />
                      Official RTU Store
                    </>
                  ) : (
                    'Student seller'
                  )}
                </span>
                {svc ? (
                  <span className="srcpill svc">
                    Service{p.svcType ? ` Â· ${p.svcType}` : ''}
                  </span>
                ) : sub === 'Uniform' || p.tag === 'Uniform' ? (
                  <span className="pill blue">Uniform</span>
                ) : sub ? (
                  <span className="pill">{sub}</span>
                ) : p.cat === 'Official' && p.tag ? (
                  <span className="pill">{p.tag}</span>
                ) : null}
              </span>
              <span className="pill green">
                {svc
                  ? `Available Â· ${p.avail || 'By arrangement'}`
                  : hasVariations
                    ? chosenVar
                      ? `${chosenVar.qty} in stock (${varLabel(p, chosenVar)})`
                      : `${p.left} in stock across options`
                    : `${p.left} available`}
              </span>
            </div>

            <h1 style={{ fontSize: 22, overflowWrap: 'anywhere' }}>{p.name}</h1>

            <div className="row">
              <span className="price tnum" style={{ fontSize: 26 }}>
                {hasVariations && !chosenVar ? priceLabel(p) : peso(unitPr)}
              </span>
              <span className="muted small">per {p.unit}</span>
            </div>

            <div className="small">
              <RatingText
                kind="item"
                targetKey={p.id}
                onClick={() => reviewsRef.current?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' })}
              />
            </div>

            <div className="row wrap" style={{ gap: 8 }}>
              <button
                type="button"
                className="link"
                onClick={() => openModal({ kind: 'seller-profile', sellerName: p.seller })}
              >
                {p.seller}
              </button>
              <span className="small muted">
                Â·{' '}
                {sk === 'school'
                  ? 'Pasig Campus Store (RTU)'
                  : `Verified RTU student${svc ? '' : ' seller'}`}
              </span>
              <span className="small">
                Â· <RatingText kind="seller" targetKey={skey} />
              </span>
            </div>

            <div className="card flat grid2" style={{ background: 'var(--bg)' }}>
              <div className="row" style={{ alignItems: 'flex-start' }}>
                <Icon name="pin" />
                <div>
                  <span className="tiny muted">
                    {activeFulfillmentChoice === 'delivery' ? 'DELIVERY HUB' : 'MEETUP POINT'}
                  </span>
                  <br />
                  <b className="small">{place || p.when}</b>
                </div>
              </div>
              <div className="row" style={{ alignItems: 'flex-start' }}>
                <Icon name="clock" />
                <div>
                  <span className="tiny muted">
                    {activeFulfillmentChoice === 'delivery' ? 'DELIVERY WINDOW' : 'PICKUP WINDOW'}
                  </span>
                  <br />
                  <b className="small">{win || '12:00 to 1:00 PM'}</b>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Requirement #1: Buyer Fulfillment Method Selection based on Seller Configuration */}
            <div className="card flat stack" style={{ background: 'var(--bg)', gap: 8 }}>
              <div className="row between wrap">
                <b className="small">Fulfillment method</b>
                <span className="tiny muted">
                  {sellerFulfillment === 'both'
                    ? 'Seller offers both Pickup & Delivery'
                    : sellerFulfillment === 'delivery'
                      ? 'Seller offers Delivery only'
                      : sellerFulfillment === 'pickup'
                        ? 'Seller offers Pickup only'
                        : 'Fulfillment not configured'}
                </span>
              </div>

              {sellerFulfillment === 'none' ? (
                <div className="note" style={{ background: 'var(--red-bg)', borderColor: 'transparent' }}>
                  <Icon name="info" size="sm" />
                  <span className="small">
                    Neither pickup nor delivery is currently configured for this listing. You cannot
                    place an order until the seller configures a fulfillment method.
                  </span>
                </div>
              ) : (
                <div
                  className="row wrap"
                  role="radiogroup"
                  aria-label="Choose fulfillment method"
                  style={{ gap: 8 }}
                >
                  {(sellerFulfillment === 'pickup' || sellerFulfillment === 'both') && (
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      role="radio"
                      aria-checked={activeFulfillmentChoice === 'pickup'}
                      className={`btn sm ${activeFulfillmentChoice === 'pickup' ? '' : 'ghost'}`.trim()}
                      onClick={() => setChosenFulfillment('pickup')}
                    >
                      <Icon name="pin" size="sm" />
                      Pickup
                      {sellerFulfillment === 'pickup' ? ' (Only option)' : ''}
                    </button>
                  )}
                  {(sellerFulfillment === 'delivery' || sellerFulfillment === 'both') && (
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      role="radio"
                      aria-checked={activeFulfillmentChoice === 'delivery'}
                      className={`btn sm ${activeFulfillmentChoice === 'delivery' ? '' : 'ghost'}`.trim()}
                      onClick={() => setChosenFulfillment('delivery')}
                    >
                      <Icon name="bag" size="sm" />
                      Delivery
                      {sellerFulfillment === 'delivery' ? ' (Only option)' : ''}
                    </button>
                  )}
                </div>
              )}
            </div>

            {/* BAO v1.6 Official Store ordering window, student limit & claim notes */}
            {db.official.some((x) => x.id === p.id) &&
              (() => {
                const lines: string[] = []
                baoWindowText(db.bao, p).forEach((x) => lines.push(x))
                const lim = baoLimitFor(db.bao, p)
                if (lim) lines.push(`Limit: ${lim} per student.`)
                if (p.inv?.claimNote) lines.push(`Claim notes: ${p.inv.claimNote}`)
                if (db.bao.settings.claimNote) lines.push(`Claim notes: ${db.bao.settings.claimNote}`)
                if (!lines.length) return null
                const w = baoWindowState(db.bao, p)
                return (
                  <div
                    className={`note ${w.open ? 'blue' : ''}`.trim()}
                    role="status"
                    data-bao-notes
                  >
                    <Icon name={w.open ? 'info' : 'clock'} size="sm" />
                    <span className="small">
                      {lines.map((ln, idx) => (
                        <span key={idx} style={{ display: 'block' }}>
                          {ln}
                        </span>
                      ))}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                )
              })()}

            {/* Per-attribute variation picker (varPickerHtml in js/9d-listings.js) */}
            {hasVariations && p.vars && (
              <div className="stack" style={{ gap: 10 }}>
                {p.vars.attrs.map((a: ProductVariationAttr) => (
                  <div key={a.name} className="stack" style={{ gap: 6 }}>
                    <div className="row between">
                      <b className="small">{a.name}</b>
                      <span className="tiny muted">
                        {selectedOpts[a.name] ? `Selected: ${selectedOpts[a.name]}` : 'Choose one'}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                    <div
                      className="row wrap"
                      role="group"
                      aria-label={a.name}
                      style={{ gap: 6 }}
                    >
                      {a.opts.map((v: string) => {
                        const on = selectedOpts[a.name] === v
                        const out = isOptSoldOut(a.name, v)
                        return (
                          <button
                            key={v}
                            type="button"
                            className={`btn sm ${on ? '' : 'ghost'} vopt`.trim()}
                            aria-pressed={on}
                            disabled={out}
                            onClick={() => {
                              setSelectedOpts((prev) => ({
                                ...prev,
                                [a.name]: prev[a.name] === v ? '' : v,
                              }))
                              setQty(1)
                              setVariationWarned(false)
                            }}
                          >
                            {v}
                            {out ? ' (out)' : ''}
                          </button>
                        )
                      })}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                ))}
                <div className="tiny muted" role="status">
                  {chosenVar
                    ? `${chosenVar.qty} in stock for ${varLabel(p, chosenVar)}`
                    : 'Choose an option in each row to see stock and reserve.'}
                </div>
              </div>
            )}

            <div className="row wrap">
              <div className="qty" role="group" aria-label="Quantity">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  aria-label="Decrease quantity"
                  onClick={() => setQty((q) => Math.max(1, q - 1))}
                >
                  âˆ’
                </button>
                <span className="tnum" aria-live="polite">
                  {qty}
                </span>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  aria-label="Increase quantity"
                  onClick={() => {
                    const max = Math.max(1, availStock)
                    if (qty + 1 > max) {
                      toast(`Only ${max} left.`)
                      return
                    }
                    setQty((q) => q + 1)
                  }}
                >
                  +
                </button>
              </div>
              <button
                type="button"
                className="btn yellow grow"
                disabled={availStock < 1 || sellerFulfillment === 'none'}
                onClick={() => {
                  if (sellerFulfillment === 'none') {
                    toast('This listing does not have an active fulfillment method.')
                    return
                  }
                  if (hasVariations && !chosenVar) {
                    setVariationWarned(true)
                    return
                  }
                  const vid = ensureVariationPicked()
                  if (vid === null) return
                  reserveNow(p.id, qty, vid, activeFulfillmentChoice)
                }}
              >
                {svc
                  ? `Request service (${activeFulfillmentChoice === 'delivery' ? 'Delivery' : 'Pickup'})`
                  : `Reserve for ${activeFulfillmentChoice === 'delivery' ? 'delivery' : 'pickup'}`}{' '}
                Â· {peso(unitPr * qty)}
              </button>
            </div>

            {hasVariations && !chosenVar && variationWarned && (
              <div
                className="note"
                style={{ marginTop: 10, display: 'flex', gap: 8, alignItems: 'flex-start', color: 'var(--red)' }}
              >
                <Icon name="info" size="sm" style={{ marginTop: 2 }} />
                <span className="small">
                  Please choose{' '}
                  {p.vars?.attrs.map((a) => a.name.toLowerCase()).join(' and ')}
                  {' '}
                  to enable Reserve and Add to Cart.
                </span>
              </div>
            )}

            <div className="row">
              <button
                type="button"
                className="btn ghost grow"
                disabled={availStock < 1 || sellerFulfillment === 'none'}
                onClick={() => {
                  if (sellerFulfillment === 'none') {
                    toast('This listing does not have an active fulfillment method.')
                    return
                  }
                  if (hasVariations && !chosenVar) {
                    setVariationWarned(true)
                    return
                  }
                  const vid = ensureVariationPicked()
                  if (vid === null) return
                  if (addToCart(p.id, qty, vid, activeFulfillmentChoice)) {
                    toast(
                      `${qty} added to your request cart (${
                        activeFulfillmentChoice === 'delivery' ? 'Delivery' : 'Pickup'
                      }).`,
                    )
                    setQty(1)
                  }
                }}
              >
                <Icon name="cart" size="sm" />
                {inCartLine ? `In cart (${inCartLine.qty})` : 'Add to request cart'}
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                className="btn ghost grow"
                onClick={() => {
                  if (isOwnListing) {
                    toast('That is your own listing.')
                    return
                  }
                  setShowMsgForm((prev) => !prev)
                }}
              >
                <Icon name="msg" size="sm" />
                {svc ? 'Contact provider' : 'Message seller'}
              </button>
            </div>

            {showMsgForm && (
              <form
                className="stack"
                onSubmit={(e) => {
                  e.preventDefault()
                  if (startProductConversation(p.id, msgText)) {
                    setMsgText('')
                    setShowMsgForm(false)
                  }
                }}
              >
                <textarea
                  className="input"
                  id="smsg"
                  placeholder="Ask about condition, size or another pickup window..."
                  aria-label="Message to the seller"
                  value={msgText}
                  onChange={(e) => setMsgText(e.target.value)}
                />
                <div className="row" style={{ justifyContent: 'flex-end' }}>
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    className="btn ghost sm"
                    onClick={() => setShowMsgForm(false)}
                  >
                    Cancel
                  </button>
                  <button type="submit" className="btn sm">
                    Send message
                  </button>
                </div>
              </form>
            )}

            <p className="tiny muted">
              No online payment. You pay the seller in person when you meet on campus.
            </p>

            {isStaffUser && sk === 'student' && (
              <div
                className="card flat row between wrap"
                style={{ background: 'var(--bg)', padding: '10px 12px', gap: 8 }}
              >
                <span className="tiny muted">
                  <b>Admin moderation:</b> Pause or delete this student listing
                </span>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  className="btn danger sm"
                  onClick={() => openModal({ kind: 'admin-remove-listing', lid: p.id })}
                >
                  Pause / Delete listing
                </button>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>

          {/* Seller card */}
          <div className="card row wrap">
            {p.cat === 'Official' ? (
              <span className="avw av-lg">
                <span className="avatar staff">RTU</span>
              </span>
            ) : (
              <AvatarBadge
                account={sellerAcct}
                name={p.seller}
                size="lg"
              />
            )}
            <div className="grow">
              <b>{p.seller}</b>
              <div className="small muted">
                {p.cat === 'Official'
                  ? 'Official Pasig Campus Store'
                  : 'Verified RTU student seller'}
              </div>
              <div className="small">
                <RatingText kind="seller" targetKey={skey} />
              </div>
            </div>
            <div className="row wrap" style={{ gap: 8 }}>
              {!isOwnListing && (
                <button
                  type="button"
                  className={`btn ghost sm sfav ${sfav ? 'on' : ''}`.trim()}
                  aria-pressed={sfav}
                  onClick={() => toggleSellerFav(skey)}
                >
                  <Icon name="heart" size="sm" />
                  {sfav ? 'Favorite seller' : 'Add seller to favorites'}
                </button>
              )}
              <button
                type="button"
                className="link"
                onClick={() => openModal({ kind: 'seller-profile', sellerName: p.seller })}
              >
                View seller profile
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Item ratings and reviews panel (reviewsPanel in js/9e-reviews-ranking.js) */}
      <section
        ref={reviewsRef}
        className="card stack"
        id="item-reviews"
        aria-label="Item ratings and reviews"
      >
        <div className="row between wrap">
          <div>
            <b>Item ratings and reviews</b>
            <p className="small muted">
              Only buyers who completed a campus pickup for this item can leave a rating.
            </p>
          </div>
          <div>
            <RatingText kind="item" targetKey={p.id} />
          </div>
        </div>

        {itemReviews.length ? (
          <>
            <div className="grid2" style={{ alignItems: 'center' }}>
              <div className="stack" style={{ gap: 4 }}>
                <div className="row" style={{ gap: 8 }}>
                  <b className="tnum" style={{ fontSize: 28 }}>
                    {itemRating.avg.toFixed(1)}
                  </b>
                  <div>
                    <StarsDisplay avg={itemRating.avg} />
                    <div className="tiny muted tnum">
                      {itemRating.n} verified {itemRating.n === 1 ? 'review' : 'reviews'}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
              <div className="stack" style={{ gap: 4 }}>
                {starBuckets.map((b) => (
                  <div key={b.s} className="row tiny" style={{ gap: 6 }}>
                    <span className="tnum" style={{ width: 28 }}>
                      {b.s} â˜…
                    </span>
                    <div className="bar">
                      <div
                        style={{
                          width: `${Math.round((b.c / itemRating.n) * 100)}%`,
                        }}
                      />
                    </div>
                    <span
                      className="tnum muted"
                      style={{ width: 24, textAlign: 'right' }}
                    >
                      {b.c}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="stack" style={{ gap: 10 }}>
              {itemReviews.slice(0, revLimit).map((r) => {
                const canDelete =
                  currentAccount && (r.buyerEmail === currentAccount.email || isStaffUser)
                const reviewerAcct = acctByEmail(r.buyerEmail)
                return (
                  <div
                    key={r.id}
                    className="card flat stack"
                    style={{ gap: 6, background: 'var(--bg)' }}
                  >
                    <div className="row between wrap">
                      <span className="row" style={{ gap: 8 }}>
                        <AvatarBadge
                          account={reviewerAcct}
                          name={r.buyerName}
                          size="sm"
                        />
                        <b>{r.buyerName}</b>
                        <span className="pill green">Verified pickup</span>
                        <StarsDisplay avg={r.stars} />
                      </span>
                      <span className="row" style={{ gap: 8 }}>
                        <span className="tiny muted">
                          {new Date(r.ts).toLocaleDateString('en-PH', {
                            month: 'short',
                            day: 'numeric',
                            year: 'numeric',
                          })}
                          {r.edited ? ' Â· edited' : ''}
                        </span>
                        {canDelete && (
                          <button
                            type="button"
                            className="link"
                            style={{ color: 'var(--red)' }}
                            onClick={() => confirmDeleteReview(r.id)}
                          >
                            {r.buyerEmail === currentAccount?.email ? 'Delete' : 'Remove'}
                          </button>
                        )}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                    {r.text ? (
                      <p className="small" style={{ overflowWrap: 'anywhere' }}>
                        {r.text}
                      </p>
                    ) : (
                      <p className="tiny muted">Rated with stars only.</p>
                    )}
                  </div>
                )
              })}
            </div>

            {itemReviews.length > revLimit && (
              <button
                type="button"
                className="btn ghost sm"
                style={{ alignSelf: 'flex-start' }}
                onClick={() => setRevLimit((n) => n + 5)}
              >
                Show more reviews ({itemReviews.length - revLimit} more)
              </button>
            )}
          </>
        ) : (
          <p className="small muted">
            No ratings yet. After a buyer picks this up on campus, their rating appears here.
          </p>
        )}
      </section>
        </>
      )}
    </>
  )
}

export function baoDefaultSettings(): BaoSettings {
  return {
    transitions: {
      'Request Received': ['Confirmed', 'On Hold', 'Cancelled'],
      Confirmed: ['Ready for Pickup', 'On Hold', 'Cancelled'],
      'On Hold': ['Confirmed', 'Ready for Pickup', 'Cancelled'],
      'Ready for Pickup': ['Claimed', 'On Hold', 'Cancelled'],
      Claimed: [],
      Cancelled: [],
    },
    reasonRequired: ['On Hold', 'Cancelled'],
    studentCancelFrom: ['Request Received'],
    queue: { enabled: false, prefix: '', pad: 3, dailyReset: true },
    claimNote: '',
    window: { enabled: false, start: '', end: '', message: '' },
    limitPerStudent: 0,
  }
}

export function baoDefaultEmailConfig(raw?: Partial<BaoEmailConfig>): BaoEmailConfig {
  const events: Record<string, boolean> = {}
  BAO_EMAIL_EVENTS.forEach((e) => {
    events[e] = raw?.events?.[e] !== undefined ? Boolean(raw.events[e]) : true
  })
  return {
    enabled: false,
    provider: raw?.provider || '',
    domain: raw?.domain || 'rtu.edu.ph',
    events,
    lowStock: raw?.lowStock !== undefined ? Boolean(raw.lowStock) : true,
    lowStockTo: Array.isArray(raw?.lowStockTo) ? raw!.lowStockTo : [],
  }
}

export function baoDefaultState(raw?: Partial<BaoState>): BaoState {
  const defSet = baoDefaultSettings()
  const rawSet = raw?.settings || ({} as Partial<BaoSettings>)
  const settings: BaoSettings = {
    ...defSet,
    ...rawSet,
    transitions: {
      ...defSet.transitions,
      ...(rawSet.transitions || {}),
    },
    queue: {
      ...defSet.queue,
      ...(rawSet.queue || {}),
    },
    window: {
      ...defSet.window,
      ...(rawSet.window || {}),
    },
  }
  const types =
    raw?.types && Array.isArray(raw.types) && raw.types.length
      ? raw.types.map((t) => ({ ...t }))
      : BAO_DEFAULT_TYPES.map((t) => ({ ...t }))

  return {
    v: 1,
    settings,
    queue: { day: raw?.queue?.day || '', n: raw?.queue?.n || 0 },
    ledger: Array.isArray(raw?.ledger) ? raw!.ledger : [],
    types,
    recon: Array.isArray(raw?.recon) ? raw!.recon : [],
    outbox: Array.isArray(raw?.outbox) ? raw!.outbox : [],
    email: baoDefaultEmailConfig(raw?.email),
    alerts: raw?.alerts ? { ...raw.alerts } : {},
    seq: {
      led: raw?.seq?.led || 0,
      rec: raw?.seq?.rec || 0,
      ob: raw?.seq?.ob || 0,
    },
    migrated: raw?.migrated || 0,
  }
}

export const baoIsOfficialTxn = (t?: TransactionRecord | null): boolean =>
  Boolean(t && t.type === 'official' && !t.sellerEmail)

export const baoTxnFor = (
  o: OrderRecord | null | undefined,
  txns: TransactionRecord[],
): TransactionRecord | null => (o ? txns.find((t) => t.orderId === o.id) || null : null)

export const baoIsOfficialOrder = (
  o: OrderRecord | null | undefined,
  txns: TransactionRecord[],
): boolean => baoIsOfficialTxn(baoTxnFor(o, txns))

export const baoStatusOf = (t?: TransactionRecord | null): BaoStatus =>
  (t && (t.bst || BAO_FROM_LEGACY[t.status])) || 'Request Received'

export function baoDayKey(d = new Date()): string {
  return (
    String(d.getFullYear()).slice(2) +
    String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0') +
    String(d.getDate()).padStart(2, '0')
  )
}

export function baoDate(d?: string | null): string {
  if (!d) return ''
  const x = new Date(/^\d{4}-\d\d-\d\d$/.test(d) ? d + 'T00:00:00' : d)
  return isNaN(x.getTime())
    ? String(d)
    : x.toLocaleDateString('en-PH', { year: 'numeric', month: 'short', day: 'numeric' })
}

export function baoDt(v?: string | null): string {
  if (!v) return ''
  const d = new Date(v)
  return isNaN(d.getTime())
    ? String(v)
    : d.toLocaleString('en-PH', {
        month: 'short',
        day: 'numeric',
        year: 'numeric',
        hour: 'numeric',
        minute: '2-digit',
      })
}

export function baoAge(iso: string): string {
  const m = Math.max(0, Date.now() - Date.parse(iso))
  const d = Math.floor(m / 86400000)
  const h = Math.floor(m / 3600000)
  return d >= 1
    ? `${d} day${d === 1 ? '' : 's'}`
    : h >= 1
      ? `${h} hour${h === 1 ? '' : 's'}`
      : 'under 1 hour'
}

export function baoAllowed(bao: BaoState, from: BaoStatus, to: BaoStatus): boolean {
  return ((bao.settings.transitions || {})[from] || []).includes(to)
}

export function baoStudentCanCancel(
  o: OrderRecord,
  txns: TransactionRecord[],
  bao: BaoState,
): boolean {
  const t = baoTxnFor(o, txns)
  if (!baoIsOfficialTxn(t)) return true
  const st = baoStatusOf(t)
  return bao.settings.studentCancelFrom.includes(st) && baoAllowed(bao, st, 'Cancelled')
}

export function baoProgress(t: TransactionRecord): {
  idx: number
  hold: boolean
  cancelled: boolean
  cur: BaoStatus
} {
  const cur = baoStatusOf(t)
  let idx = BAO_STEPS.indexOf(cur)
  ;(t.bhist || []).forEach((h) => {
    const i = BAO_STEPS.indexOf(h.to)
    if (i > idx) idx = i
  })
  if (idx < 0) idx = 0
  return { idx, hold: cur === 'On Hold', cancelled: cur === 'Cancelled', cur }
}

export function baoTypeById(bao: BaoState, id?: string | null): BaoItemType | null {
  if (!id) return null
  return bao.types.find((t) => t.id === id) || null
}

export function baoMatchItemTypeForListing(
  bao: BaoState,
  input: { cat?: string; sub?: string; tag?: string; name?: string },
): BaoItemType | null {
  const cat = input.cat || ''
  const sub = input.sub || ''
  const tag = input.tag || ''
  const name = (input.name || '').toLowerCase()

  // 1. Exact subcategory or tag match first (e.g. Uniform -> ty-uniform)
  if (sub === 'Uniform' || tag === 'Uniform' || /\buniform\b|\bpe shirt\b|\bpolo\b|\bblouse\b/i.test(name)) {
    const uni = bao.types.find((t) => t.id === 'ty-uniform' || t.name === 'Uniform' || t.sub === 'Uniform')
    if (uni) return uni
  }
  // 2. Sablay only when explicitly named Sablay or tag/sub is Sablay
  if (sub === 'Sablay' || tag === 'Sablay' || /\bsablay\b/i.test(name)) {
    const sab = bao.types.find((t) => t.id === 'ty-sablay' || t.name === 'Sablay')
    if (sab) return sab
  }
  // 3. Books & Academic Materials
  if (
    cat === 'Books and Academic Materials' ||
    sub === 'Textbook' ||
    sub === 'Manual' ||
    tag === 'Book' ||
    tag === 'Textbook' ||
    tag === 'Manual'
  ) {
    const bk = bao.types.find((t) => t.id === 'ty-book' || t.name === 'Book' || t.category === 'Books and Academic Materials')
    if (bk) return bk
  }
  // 4. RTU Merchandise
  if (cat === 'RTU Merchandise' || tag === 'Merchandise' || tag === 'Merch') {
    const mc = bao.types.find((t) => t.id === 'ty-merch' || t.name === 'Merchandise' || t.category === 'RTU Merchandise')
    if (mc) return mc
  }
  // 5. Exact category match (excluding Sablay unless name matches)
  const byCat = bao.types.find((t) => t.category === cat && t.id !== 'ty-sablay' && t.name !== 'Sablay')
  if (byCat) return byCat

  return bao.types.find((t) => t.id === 'ty-other' || t.name === 'Other') || bao.types[0] || null
}

export function baoItemType(bao: BaoState, p?: PrototypeProduct | null): BaoItemType | null {
  if (!p) return null
  // If product has sub === 'Uniform' or tag === 'Uniform', always resolve to Uniform type
  if (p.sub === 'Uniform' || p.tag === 'Uniform') {
    const uni = bao.types.find((t) => t.id === 'ty-uniform' || t.name === 'Uniform' || t.sub === 'Uniform')
    if (uni) return uni
  }
  // Guard against items that were accidentally assigned ty-sablay when their name is not Sablay
  const rawId = p.inv?.type
  if (rawId && !(rawId === 'ty-sablay' && !/sablay/i.test(p.name + ' ' + (p.sub || '')))) {
    const found = baoTypeById(bao, rawId)
    if (found) return found
  }
  return (
    baoMatchItemTypeForListing(bao, {
      cat: p.category || p.cat,
      sub: p.sub,
      tag: p.tag,
      name: p.name,
    }) ||
    baoTypeById(bao, BAO_LEGACY_TYPE[p.tag] || 'ty-other') ||
    bao.types[0] ||
    null
  )
}

export interface BaoCountedUnit {
  p: PrototypeProduct
  vid: string
  row: ProductVariationRow | null
  label: string
  onHand: number
  available: number
  low: number | null
}

export function baoUnits(p?: PrototypeProduct | null): BaoCountedUnit[] {
  if (!p) return []
  if (hasVars(p) && p.vars) {
    return p.vars.rows.map((r) => ({
      p,
      vid: r.id,
      row: r,
      label: varLabel(p, r),
      onHand: r.onHand == null ? r.qty : r.onHand,
      available: r.qty,
      low: r.low == null ? null : r.low,
    }))
  }
  return [
    {
      p,
      vid: '',
      row: null,
      label: '',
      onHand: p.onHand == null ? p.left : p.onHand,
      available: p.left,
      low: null,
    },
  ]
}

export function baoUnit(p?: PrototypeProduct | null, vid?: string | null): BaoCountedUnit | null {
  return baoUnits(p).find((u) => u.vid === (vid || '')) || null
}

export const baoReserved = (u: BaoCountedUnit): number => Math.max(0, u.onHand - u.available)

export const baoUnitName = (u: BaoCountedUnit): string =>
  u.p.name + (u.label ? ` (${u.label})` : '')

export function baoThreshold(u: BaoCountedUnit): number | null {
  if (u.low != null) return u.low
  const i = u.p.inv
  if (i && i.low != null) return i.low
  return null
}

export function baoIsLow(u: BaoCountedUnit): boolean {
  const t = baoThreshold(u)
  return t != null && u.available <= t
}

export function baoLowUnits(official: PrototypeProduct[]): BaoCountedUnit[] {
  const out: BaoCountedUnit[] = []
  official.forEach((p) =>
    baoUnits(p).forEach((u) => {
      if (baoIsLow(u)) out.push(u)
    }),
  )
  return out
}

export function baoStockLine(p: PrototypeProduct): string {
  const us = baoUnits(p)
  const oh = us.reduce((a, u) => a + u.onHand, 0)
  const av = us.reduce((a, u) => a + u.available, 0)
  return `${oh} on hand Â· ${Math.max(0, oh - av)} reserved Â· ${av} available`
}

export function baoWindowState(
  bao: BaoState,
  p?: PrototypeProduct | null,
): { open: boolean; msg: string } {
  const now = Date.now()
  const check = (
    w: { enabled?: boolean; start?: string; end?: string; message?: string } | null | undefined,
    label: string,
  ) => {
    if (!w || !w.enabled) return null
    const s = w.start ? Date.parse(w.start) : null
    const e = w.end ? Date.parse(w.end) : null
    if (s && !isNaN(s) && now < s) {
      return {
        open: false,
        msg: `${label} ordering opens ${baoDt(w.start)}.${w.message ? ' ' + w.message : ''}`,
      }
    }
    if (e && !isNaN(e) && now > e) {
      return {
        open: false,
        msg: `${label} ordering closed ${baoDt(w.end)}.${w.message ? ' ' + w.message : ''}`,
      }
    }
    return null
  }
  const gw = check(bao.settings.window, 'Store')
  if (gw) return gw
  const iw = check(p?.inv?.win, 'This item')
  if (iw) return iw
  return { open: true, msg: '' }
}

export function baoWindowText(bao: BaoState, p?: PrototypeProduct | null): string[] {
  const out: string[] = []
  const now = Date.now()
  const add = (
    w: { enabled?: boolean; start?: string; end?: string; message?: string } | null | undefined,
    who: string,
  ) => {
    if (!(w && w.enabled && (w.start || w.end))) return
    const s = w.start ? Date.parse(w.start) : null
    const e = w.end ? Date.parse(w.end) : null
    let t = ''
    if (s && !isNaN(s) && now < s) {
      t = `ordering opens ${baoDt(w.start)}${e ? ' and closes ' + baoDt(w.end) : ''}`
    } else if (e && !isNaN(e) && now > e) {
      t = `ordering is closed (it closed ${baoDt(w.end)})`
    } else {
      t = `ordering is open${e ? ' until ' + baoDt(w.end) : s ? ' since ' + baoDt(w.start) : ''}`
    }
    out.push(`${who}: ${t}.${w.message ? ' ' + w.message : ''}`)
  }
  add(bao.settings.window, 'Store')
  add(p?.inv?.win, 'This item')
  return out
}

export function baoLimitFor(bao: BaoState, p?: PrototypeProduct | null): number {
  const i = p?.inv && Number(p.inv.limit)
  if (i && i > 0) return i
  return Number(bao.settings.limitPerStudent) > 0 ? Number(bao.settings.limitPerStudent) : 0
}

export function baoStudentCount(
  bao: BaoState,
  txns: TransactionRecord[],
  p: PrototypeProduct,
  email?: string | null,
  sid?: string | null,
): number {
  const e = String(email || '').toLowerCase()
  let since = 0
  const w = bao.settings.window
  const iw = p.inv?.win
  ;[w, iw].forEach((x) => {
    if (x && x.enabled && x.start && Date.parse(x.start) > since) {
      since = Date.parse(x.start)
    }
  })
  return txns
    .filter(
      (t) =>
        baoIsOfficialTxn(t) &&
        baoStatusOf(t) !== 'Cancelled' &&
        Date.parse(t.created) >= since &&
        ((e && String(t.buyerEmail || '').toLowerCase() === e) ||
          (sid && t.buyerSid && t.buyerSid === sid)),
    )
    .reduce(
      (a, t) =>
        a + t.lines.filter((l) => l.pid === p.id).reduce((b, l) => b + l.qty, 0),
      0,
    )
}

export function baoClaimNotes(
  bao: BaoState,
  official: PrototypeProduct[],
  t: TransactionRecord,
): string[] {
  const out: string[] = []
  if (bao.settings.claimNote) out.push(bao.settings.claimNote)
  t.lines.forEach((l) => {
    const p = official.find((x) => x.id === l.pid)
    if (p?.inv?.claimNote) {
      const s = `${p.name}: ${p.inv.claimNote}`
      if (!out.includes(s)) out.push(s)
    }
  })
  return out
}

export function baoMessage(t: TransactionRecord, to: BaoStatus, note?: string): string {
  const q = t.queue ? ` Queue number: ${t.queue}.` : ''
  const n = note ? ` Note: ${note}` : ''
  const m: Record<BaoStatus, string> = {
    'Request Received': `The BAO received your request ${t.id}.`,
    Confirmed: `The BAO confirmed your request ${t.id}.`,
    'On Hold': `Your request ${t.id} is on hold.`,
    'Ready for Pickup':
      `Your request ${t.id} is ready for pickup.` +
      (t.pickup ? ` Pickup date: ${baoDate(t.pickup)}.` : ''),
    Claimed: `Your request ${t.id} was marked as claimed.`,
    Cancelled: `Your request ${t.id} was cancelled.`,
  }
  return m[to] + q + n
}

export function baoEmailCompose(
  bao: BaoState,
  official: PrototypeProduct[],
  t: TransactionRecord,
  status: BaoStatus,
): { subject: string; text: string } {
  const cl = baoClaimNotes(bao, official, t)
  const lines = [
    'Hello,',
    '',
    baoMessage(t, status, t.note),
    '',
    `Reference: ${t.id}`,
    t.queue ? `Queue number: ${t.queue}` : null,
    `Status: ${status}`,
    'Items:',
    ...t.lines.map((l) => `- ${l.name} x ${l.qty}`),
    t.pickup && status !== 'Cancelled' ? `Pickup date: ${baoDate(t.pickup)}` : null,
    cl.length ? `Claim notes: ${cl.join(' ')}` : null,
    '',
    'You can see the same information in My Orders on RTU Tindahan.',
    'This is an automatic message. Please do not reply.',
  ].filter((x): x is string => x !== null)

  return {
    subject: `[RTU Tindahan] ${t.id}: ${status}`,
    text: lines.join('\n'),
  }
}

export function baoLedgerCheck(
  bao: BaoState,
  official: PrototypeProduct[],
  txns: TransactionRecord[],
): Array<{
  item: string
  ledgerOnHand?: number
  onHand?: number
  ledgerReserved?: number
  reserved: number
  openTickets?: number
}> {
  const sums = new Map<string, { oh: number; rs: number }>()
  const bad: Array<{
    item: string
    ledgerOnHand?: number
    onHand?: number
    ledgerReserved?: number
    reserved: number
    openTickets?: number
  }> = []

  bao.ledger.forEach((e: BaoLedgerEntry) => {
    const k = `${e.pid}|${e.vid || ''}`
    const s = sums.get(k) || { oh: 0, rs: 0 }
    s.oh += e.ohD
    s.rs += e.rsD
    sums.set(k, s)
  })

  official.forEach((p) =>
    baoUnits(p).forEach((u) => {
      const s = sums.get(`${p.id}|${u.vid}`) || { oh: 0, rs: 0 }
      if (
        s.oh !== u.onHand ||
        s.rs !== baoReserved(u) ||
        u.available < 0 ||
        u.onHand < 0
      ) {
        bad.push({
          item: baoUnitName(u),
          ledgerOnHand: s.oh,
          onHand: u.onHand,
          ledgerReserved: s.rs,
          reserved: baoReserved(u),
        })
      }
    }),
  )

  const held = new Map<string, number>()
  txns
    .filter(baoIsOfficialTxn)
    .filter((t) => !['Claimed', 'Cancelled'].includes(baoStatusOf(t)))
    .forEach((t) =>
      t.lines.forEach((l) => {
        if (!l.pid) return
        const k = `${l.pid}|${l.vid || ''}`
        held.set(k, (held.get(k) || 0) + l.qty)
      }),
    )

  official.forEach((p) =>
    baoUnits(p).forEach((u) => {
      const h = held.get(`${p.id}|${u.vid}`) || 0
      if (h !== baoReserved(u)) {
        bad.push({
          item: baoUnitName(u),
          openTickets: h,
          reserved: baoReserved(u),
        })
      }
    }),
  )

  return bad
}

export function baoDownloadCsv(filename: string, rows: (string | number | null | undefined)[][]) {
  const q = (v: string | number | null | undefined) =>
    '"' + String(v == null ? '' : v).replace(/"/g, '""') + '"'
  const csv = rows.map((r) => r.map(q).join(',')).join('\r\n')
  const u = URL.createObjectURL(new Blob(['\ufeff' + csv], { type: 'text/csv' }))
  const a = document.createElement('a')
  a.href = u
  a.download = filename
  document.body.appendChild(a)
  a.click()
  a.remove()
  setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(u), 500)
}

export const isSvc = (p?: PrototypeProduct | null): boolean => !!p && p.kind === 'service'

export function cleanDays(list?: Iterable<string> | string | null): string[] {
  const arr =
    typeof list === 'string'
      ? list.split(',').map((x) => x.trim())
      : Array.from(list || [])
  return DAYS.filter((x) => arr.includes(x))
}

export function normCat(p: PrototypeProduct): string {
  if (isSvc(p)) return SERVICES_CAT
  const c = p.cat
  if ((CATEGORIES as readonly string[]).includes(c)) return c
  if (c === 'Official') {
    if (OFFCAT[p.tag]) return OFFCAT[p.tag]
    if (p.category && (CATEGORIES as readonly string[]).includes(p.category)) return p.category
    const n = String(p.name || '').toLowerCase()
    if (/uniform|polo|blouse|pe shirt|jogging|lanyard|id lace/.test(n)) {
      return /lanyard|id lace/.test(n) ? 'RTU Merchandise' : 'Clothing and Accessories'
    }
    if (/manual|textbook|book|module|reviewer/.test(n)) return 'Books and Academic Materials'
    if (/merch|tumbler|mug|keychain|tote|rtu /.test(n)) return 'RTU Merchandise'
    return 'Other Items'
  }
  if (c === 'Food & drinks' || c === 'Campus food') return 'Food and Snacks'
  if (c === 'Books & notes' || c === 'Lab manuals & textbooks') return 'Books and Academic Materials'
  if (c === 'Tech & gadgets') return 'Electronics and Gadgets'
  if (c === 'Goods & apparel' || c === 'Goods') {
    const n = String(p.name || '').toLowerCase()
    if (p.tag === 'Tech') return 'Electronics and Gadgets'
    if (p.tag === 'Merch') return 'RTU Merchandise'
    if (p.tag === 'Uniform' || /shirt|hoodie|jacket|cap\b|uniform|apparel|lanyard|tote|bag\b/.test(n))
      return 'Clothing and Accessories'
    if (/\bpen\b|paper|notebook|folder|marker|ruler|stapler|scissors|highlighter|supplies/.test(n))
      return 'School Supplies'
    if (/sticker|keychain|figure|collect|plush|pin\b|charm/.test(n))
      return 'Knickknacks and Collectibles'
  }
  return 'Other Items'
}

export const catOf = (p: PrototypeProduct): string => normCat(p)

export function subOf(p?: PrototypeProduct | null): string {
  if (!p || isSvc(p)) return ''
  if (p.sub) return p.sub
  if (p.tag === 'Uniform') return 'Uniform'
  const c = normCat(p)
  const list = SUBCATS[c] || []
  if (p.cat === 'Official' && OFFSUB[p.tag] && list.includes(OFFSUB[p.tag])) return OFFSUB[p.tag]
  const n = String(p.name || '').toLowerCase()
  if ((c === 'Clothing and Accessories' || /clothing|apparel/i.test(c)) && /uniform/i.test(n)) return 'Uniform'
  if (c === 'Books and Academic Materials') {
    if (/manual/i.test(n)) return 'Manual'
    if (/textbook/i.test(n)) return 'Textbook'
  }
  return ''
}

export const hasVars = (p?: PrototypeProduct | null): boolean =>
  !!(p && p.vars && Array.isArray(p.vars.rows) && p.vars.rows.length > 0)

export function varLabel(p: PrototypeProduct, row?: { opts: Record<string, string> } | null): string {
  if (!row) return ''
  const names = ((p.vars && p.vars.attrs) || []).map((a) => a.name)
  return names
    .map((n) => row.opts[n])
    .filter(Boolean)
    .join(', ')
}

export function findVar(p?: PrototypeProduct | null, vid?: string | null) {
  if (!p || !vid || !hasVars(p)) return undefined
  return p.vars!.rows.find((r) => r.id === vid)
}

export function varTotal(p: PrototypeProduct): number {
  if (!hasVars(p)) return p.left
  return p.vars!.rows.reduce((a, r) => a + (r.qty || 0), 0)
}

export function syncLeft(p: PrototypeProduct) {
  if (hasVars(p)) p.left = varTotal(p)
}

export function unitPrice(p: PrototypeProduct, vid?: string | null): number {
  const r = vid ? findVar(p, vid) : null
  return r && Number(r.price) > 0 ? Number(r.price) : p.price
}

export function stockOf(p: PrototypeProduct, vid?: string | null): number {
  if (hasVars(p)) {
    const r = vid ? findVar(p, vid) : undefined
    return r ? r.qty : 0
  }
  return p.left
}

export function priceLabel(p: PrototypeProduct): string {
  if (!hasVars(p)) return peso(p.price)
  const ps = p.vars!.rows.map((r) => unitPrice(p, r.id))
  const lo = Math.min(...ps)
  const hi = Math.max(...ps)
  return lo === hi ? peso(lo) : 'From ' + peso(lo)
}

export function vLineName(p: PrototypeProduct, vid?: string | null): string {
  const r = vid ? findVar(p, vid) : undefined
  return r ? `${p.name} (${varLabel(p, r)})` : p.name
}

}

export const ago = (ts: string | number | Date): string => {
  const d = new Date(ts)
  const m = Math.round((Date.now() - d.getTime()) / 60000)
  if (m < 1) return 'Just now'
  if (m < 60) return m + ' min ago'
  if (m < 1440) return Math.round(m / 60) + ' h ago'
  return d.toLocaleDateString('en-PH', { month: 'short', day: 'numeric', year: 'numeric' })
}

  String(t || '?')
    .replace(/[^A-Za-z ]/g, '')
    .split(' ')
    .filter(Boolean)
    .map((w) => w[0])
    .slice(0, 2)
    .join('')
    .toUpperCase() || '?'

  const w = String(n || 'Student')
    .trim()
    .split(/\s+/)
  return w.length > 1 ? w[0] + ' ' + w[w.length - 1][0].toUpperCase() + '.' : w[0]
}

export const tc = (s: string): string =>
  s
    .trim()
    .toLowerCase()
    .replace(/(^|[\s.'-])([a-zÃ -Ã¿])/g, (_m, a: string, b: string) => a + b.toUpperCase())

export const hash = (s: string): string => {
  let h = 5381
  const t = 'rtu-tindahan:' + s
  for (let i = 0; i < t.length; i++) h = ((h << 5) + h + t.charCodeAt(i)) | 0
  return String(h >>> 0)
}

export const T_OPEN = 7 * 60
export const T_CLOSE = 19 * 60

export function toMin(t?: string | null): number | null {
  const m = /^(\d{2}):(\d{2})$/.exec(String(t || ''))
  if (!m || +m[1] > 23 || +m[2] > 59) return null
  return +m[1] * 60 + +m[2]
}

export function toHM(n: number): string {
  return String(Math.floor(n / 60)).padStart(2, '0') + ':' + String(n % 60).padStart(2, '0')
}

export function fmt12(n: number): string {
  const h = Math.floor(n / 60)
  const m = n % 60
  return (h % 12 || 12) + ':' + String(m).padStart(2, '0') + ' ' + (h < 12 ? 'AM' : 'PM')
}

export function winText(s: number, e: number): string {
  return fmt12(s) + ' to ' + fmt12(e)
}

export function parseWindow(txt?: string | null): { s: number; e: number } | null {
  const m = /^\s*(\d{1,2}):(\d{2})\s*(AM|PM)?\s+to\s+(\d{1,2}):(\d{2})\s*(AM|PM)\s*$/i.exec(
    String(txt || ''),
  )
  if (!m) return null
  const to24 = (h: string, mi: string, ap: string) =>
    ((+h % 12) + (/PM/i.test(ap) ? 12 : 0)) * 60 + +mi
  const e = to24(m[4], m[5], m[6])
  let s = to24(m[1], m[2], m[3] || m[6])
  if (!m[3] && s >= e) s = to24(m[1], m[2], 'AM')
  return s < e ? { s, e } : null
}

export function timeError(d: { tStart?: string; tEnd?: string }): string {
  const s = toMin(d.tStart)
  const e = toMin(d.tEnd)
  if (s == null || e == null) return 'Choose a start time and an end time.'
  if (s < T_OPEN || s > T_CLOSE || e < T_OPEN || e > T_CLOSE)
    return 'Times must be between 7:00 AM and 7:00 PM.'
  if (e <= s) return 'The end time must be later than the start time.'
  return ''
}

export function vCombos(d: ListingDraft): Record<string, string>[] {
  const at = d.vAttrs.filter((a) => a.opts.length && a.name.trim())
  if (!at.length) return []
  let out: Record<string, string>[] = [{}]
  at.forEach((a) => {
    out = out.flatMap((o) => a.opts.map((v) => ({ ...o, [a.name.trim()]: v })))
  })
  return out
}

export function vSyncRows(d: ListingDraft): DraftVariationRow[] {
  const old = new Map(d.vRows.map((r) => [r.key, r]))
  return vCombos(d).map((o) => {
    const key = JSON.stringify(o)
    return old.get(key) || { id: newVid(), key, opts: o, qty: '', price: '' }
  })
}

export function getSellerTimeWindows(p?: PrototypeProduct | null): string[] {
  if (!p) return [TIMES[1]]
  const rawWhen = String(p.when || '')
  const commaIdx = rawWhen.indexOf(',')
  const winPart = commaIdx > -1 ? rawWhen.slice(commaIdx + 1).trim() : rawWhen.trim()
  if (!winPart) return [TIMES[1]]
  const parsed = parseWindow(winPart)
  if (!parsed) return [winPart]
  const { s, e } = parsed
  const slots: string[] = [winText(s, e)]
  // If seller's window is wider than 60 mins, also offer 1-hour slots strictly inside the seller's window
  if (e - s > 60) {
    let cur = s
    while (cur + 60 <= e) {
      const slot = winText(cur, cur + 60)
      if (!slots.includes(slot)) slots.push(slot)
      cur += 60
    }
    if (cur < e) {
      const rem = winText(cur, e)
      if (!slots.includes(rem)) slots.push(rem)
    }
  }
  return slots
}
