// ===== C:\Users\Lian Andrew\Desktop\RTU_Tindahan_Capstone\RTU_Tindahan_Final\RTU_Tindahan\frontend\src\features\marketplace\dateHelper.ts =====
import { cleanDays, isSvc, parseWindow } from './constants'
import type { PrototypeProduct } from './types'

export interface PickupDateOption {
  id: string // "2026-11-05"
  label: string // "Today, Nov 5"
  fullLabel: string // "Today, Nov 5 Â· 12:00 to 1:00 PM"
  isToday: boolean
}

const DAY_ABBR = ['Sun', 'Mon', 'Tue', 'Wed', 'Thu', 'Fri', 'Sat'] as const

/**
 * Calculates selectable pickup/meetup dates for a buyer based on:
 * 1. The seller's available days (`product.avail`, e.g. Mon, Tue, Wed)
 * 2. Products vs Services rule:
 *    - Products: Can be ordered for today UNLESS the seller's meetup window has closed.
 *    - Services: Cannot be ordered for today; must be ordered in advance (tomorrow onwards).
 */
export function getPickupDates(
  product?: PrototypeProduct | null,
  referenceDate: Date = new Date(),
): {
  options: PickupDateOption[]
  todayStatus: 'available' | 'service_advance_only' | 'window_closed' | 'not_selling_day'
  windowEndText: string
} {
  if (!product) {
    return {
      options: [],
      todayStatus: 'window_closed',
      windowEndText: '',
    }
  }

  const rawAvail = cleanDays(product.avail)
  const availDays = rawAvail.length ? rawAvail : ['Mon', 'Tue', 'Wed', 'Thu', 'Fri']
  const svc = isSvc(product)

  // Parse time window from product.when (e.g. "Main lobby, 12:00 to 1:00 PM")
  const whenPart = product.when && product.when.includes(',')
    ? product.when.split(',')[1].trim()
    : product.when || ''
  const parsedWin = parseWindow(whenPart)

  const curMinutes = referenceDate.getHours() * 60 + referenceDate.getMinutes()
  const isWindowClosed = parsedWin ? curMinutes >= parsedWin.e : false
  const windowEndText = whenPart

  const todayDayName = DAY_ABBR[referenceDate.getDay()]
  const isTodayAvailDay = availDays.includes(todayDayName)

  let todayStatus: 'available' | 'service_advance_only' | 'window_closed' | 'not_selling_day' =
    'available'

  if (svc) {
    todayStatus = 'service_advance_only'
  } else if (!isTodayAvailDay) {
    todayStatus = 'not_selling_day'
  } else if (isWindowClosed) {
    todayStatus = 'window_closed'
  }

  const options: PickupDateOption[] = []

  // Check up to 14 days ahead
  for (let i = 0; i < 14; i++) {
    const d = new Date(
      referenceDate.getFullYear(),
      referenceDate.getMonth(),
      referenceDate.getDate() + i,
    )
    const dayName = DAY_ABBR[d.getDay()]
    if (!availDays.includes(dayName)) continue

    const isToday = i === 0

    // Apply rule:
    // Services cannot be ordered today (must be in advance)
    if (isToday && svc) continue
    // Products cannot be ordered today if window has closed
    if (isToday && isWindowClosed) continue

    const y = d.getFullYear()
    const m = String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0')
    const dayNum = String(d.getDate()).padStart(2, '0')
    const id = `${y}-${m}-${dayNum}`

    const monthName = d.toLocaleDateString('en-US', { month: 'short' })
    const label = isToday
      ? `Today, ${monthName} ${d.getDate()}`
      : i === 1
        ? `Tomorrow, ${monthName} ${d.getDate()}`
        : `${dayName}, ${monthName} ${d.getDate()}`

    const fullLabel = whenPart ? `${label} (${whenPart})` : label

    options.push({
      id,
      label,
      fullLabel,
      isToday,
    })

    if (options.length >= 7) break
  }

  return {
    options,
    todayStatus,
    windowEndText,
  }
}


// ===== C:\Users\Lian Andrew\Desktop\RTU_Tindahan_Capstone\RTU_Tindahan_Final\RTU_Tindahan\frontend\src\features\marketplace\imageStore.ts =====
/**
 * Real product, forum, and avatar image store (ported from js/9c-images.js)
 * - Validates MIME type, extension, size (<= 5 MB), and magic bytes (JPEG, PNG, WebP)
 * - Decodes image, checks minimum dimensions, resizes on canvas (maxSide 1100px or 360px square),
 *   and re-encodes as JPEG to strip embedded payloads
 * - Persists under localStorage key 'rtu_img_v1'
 */

export const IMGK = 'rtu_img_v1'

export const IMG_RULES = {
  types: { 'image/jpeg': 'jpg', 'image/png': 'png', 'image/webp': 'webp' } as Record<string, string>,
  maxBytes: 5 * 1024 * 1024,
  minSide: 100,
  maxPixels: 40e6,
  maxSide: 1100,
  quality: 0.8,
  listing: 10,
  post: 4,
  budget: 8.5e6,
}

export const IMG_URL = /^data:image\/(jpeg|png|webp);base64,/

export interface StoredImage {
  d: string
  w: number
  h: number
  n: string
  t: number
}

let IMGS: Record<string, StoredImage> = {}
let loaded = false

export function loadImgs(): Record<string, StoredImage> {
  let o: Record<string, StoredImage> = {}
  try {
    const raw = localStorage.getItem(IMGK)
    o = raw ? (JSON.parse(raw) as Record<string, StoredImage>) || {} : {}
  } catch {
    o = {}
  }
  Object.keys(o).forEach((k) => {
    if (!o[k] || typeof o[k].d !== 'string' || !IMG_URL.test(o[k].d)) {
      delete o[k]
    }
  })
  IMGS = o
  loaded = true
  return IMGS
}

function ensureLoaded() {
  if (!loaded) loadImgs()
}

export function getAllImgs(): Record<string, StoredImage> {
  ensureLoaded()
  return IMGS
}

export function replaceAllImgs(next: Record<string, StoredImage>) {
  IMGS = { ...next }
  loaded = true
  saveImgs()
}

export function clearAllImgs() {
  IMGS = {}
  loaded = true
  try {
    localStorage.removeItem(IMGK)
  } catch {
    /* ignore */
  }
}

export function saveImgs(): boolean {
  ensureLoaded()
  const txt = JSON.stringify(IMGS)
  try {
    localStorage.setItem(IMGK, txt)
    return true
  } catch {
    return false
  }
}

export function removeImg(id: string) {
  ensureLoaded()
  if (id in IMGS) {
    delete IMGS[id]
    saveImgs()
  }
}

export function replaceImgData(id: string, dataUrl: string, width = 800, height = 600): boolean {
  ensureLoaded()
  if (id in IMGS) {
    IMGS[id] = { ...IMGS[id], d: dataUrl, w: width, h: height, t: Date.now() }
    return saveImgs()
  }
  const newId = 'im_' + Date.now().toString(36) + '_' + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 7)
  IMGS[newId] = { d: dataUrl, w: width, h: height, n: 'adjusted_photo.jpg', t: Date.now() }
  saveImgs()
  return true
}

export function addImgDataUrl(dataUrl: string, name = 'adjusted.jpg', width = 800, height = 600): string | null {
  ensureLoaded()
  const id = 'im_' + Date.now().toString(36) + '_' + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 7)
  IMGS[id] = { d: dataUrl, w: width, h: height, n: name, t: Date.now() }
  if (saveImgs()) return id
  delete IMGS[id]
  return null
}

export function imgSrc(id?: string | null): string {
  ensureLoaded()
  if (!id) return ''
  if (
    id.startsWith('data:image/') ||
    id.startsWith('/') ||
    id.startsWith('http') ||
    id.startsWith('blob:') ||
    id.includes('/')
  ) {
    return id
  }
  const m = IMGS[id]
  return m && typeof m.d === 'string' && IMG_URL.test(m.d) ? m.d : ''
}

export function imgsOf(o?: { imgs?: string[] } | null): string[] {
  ensureLoaded()
  return ((o && o.imgs) || []).filter((id) => Boolean(imgSrc(id)))
}

export function imgSize(): number {
  ensureLoaded()
  let n = 0
  for (const k in IMGS) n += (IMGS[k].d || '').length
  return n
}

export function imgSniff(buf: ArrayBuffer): string {
  const b = new Uint8Array(buf)
  const at = (i: number, s: string) => [...s].every((c, k) => b[i + k] === c.charCodeAt(0))
  if (b[0] === 0xff && b[1] === 0xd8 && b[2] === 0xff) return 'jpeg'
  if (
    b[0] === 0x89 &&
    at(1, 'PNG') &&
    b[4] === 0x0d &&
    b[5] === 0x0a &&
    b[6] === 0x1a &&
    b[7] === 0x0a
  )
    return 'png'
  if (at(0, 'RIFF') && at(8, 'WEBP')) return 'webp'
  return ''
}

function imgDecode(file: File): Promise<ImageBitmap | HTMLImageElement> {
  if (typeof window.createImageBitmap === 'function') return window.createImageBitmap(file)
  return new Promise((ok, no) => {
    const u = URL.createObjectURL(file)
    const im = new Image()
    im.onload = () => {
      URL.revokeObjectURL(u)
      ok(im)
    }
    im.onerror = () => {
      URL.revokeObjectURL(u)
      no(new Error('decode'))
    }
    im.src = u
  })
}

export async function imgValidate(file: File): Promise<string> {
  const nm = file.name || 'This file'
  if (!IMG_RULES.types[file.type] || !/\.(jpe?g|png|webp)$/i.test(file.name || '')) {
    return `${nm}: only JPEG, PNG or WebP photos are allowed.`
  }
  if (!file.size) return `${nm}: the file is empty.`
  if (file.size > IMG_RULES.maxBytes) {
    return `${nm}: the photo is over ${IMG_RULES.maxBytes / 1048576} MB. Choose a smaller one.`
  }
  let kind = ''
  try {
    kind = imgSniff(await file.slice(0, 16).arrayBuffer())
  } catch {
    /* ignore */
  }
  if (!kind) return `${nm}: this is not a real photo file, so it was not added.`
  const wants = IMG_RULES.types[file.type] === 'jpg' ? 'jpeg' : IMG_RULES.types[file.type]
  if (kind !== wants) return `${nm}: the file contents do not match its type, so it was not added.`
  return ''
}

export async function imgAdd(
  file: File,
  opt?: { minSide?: number; maxSide?: number; square?: boolean },
): Promise<{ id?: string; err?: string }> {
  ensureLoaded()
  const o = opt || {}
  try {
    const bad = await imgValidate(file)
    if (bad) return { err: bad }
    let bmp: ImageBitmap | HTMLImageElement
    try {
      bmp = await imgDecode(file)
    } catch {
      return { err: `${file.name}: the photo could not be read. It may be damaged.` }
    }
    const w0 = bmp.width
    const h0 = bmp.height
    const minS = o.minSide || IMG_RULES.minSide
    const maxS = o.maxSide || IMG_RULES.maxSide
    if (Math.min(w0, h0) < minS) {
      return { err: `${file.name}: the photo is too small (at least ${minS} pixels wide and tall).` }
    }
    if (w0 * h0 > IMG_RULES.maxPixels) {
      return { err: `${file.name}: the photo has too many pixels. Choose a smaller one.` }
    }
    const sq = !!o.square
    const sw = sq ? Math.min(w0, h0) : w0
    const sh = sq ? Math.min(w0, h0) : h0
    const sx = sq ? (w0 - sw) / 2 : 0
    const sy = sq ? (h0 - sh) / 2 : 0
    const k = Math.min(1, maxS / Math.max(sw, sh))
    const w = Math.max(1, Math.round(sw * k))
    const h = Math.max(1, Math.round(sh * k))
    const c = document.createElement('canvas')
    c.width = w
    c.height = h
    const g = c.getContext('2d')
    if (!g) return { err: `${file.name}: the photo could not be prepared.` }
    g.fillStyle = '#fff'
    g.fillRect(0, 0, w, h)
    g.drawImage(bmp, sx, sy, sw, sh, 0, 0, w, h)
    if ('close' in bmp && typeof bmp.close === 'function') bmp.close()
    const d = c.toDataURL('image/jpeg', IMG_RULES.quality)
    if (!d.startsWith('data:image/jpeg')) {
      return { err: `${file.name}: the photo could not be prepared.` }
    }
    if (imgSize() + d.length > IMG_RULES.budget) {
      return {
        err: 'Photo storage is nearly full. Remove a photo from an old listing and try again.',
      }
    }
    const id = 'im_' + Date.now().toString(36) + '_' + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 7)
    IMGS[id] = { d, w, h, n: String(file.name || '').slice(0, 80), t: Date.now() }
    if (!saveImgs()) {
      delete IMGS[id]
      return { err: 'The browser could not save this photo (storage is full).' }
    }
    return { id }
  } catch {
    return { err: 'Something went wrong while adding that photo. Please try another one.' }
  }
}

     - PUBLIC PAGES
     - SMALL-SCREEN RULES FOR PUBLIC PAGES, FORMS AND THE SIDE DRAWER
     - GUEST HOMEPAGE
     - RESPONSIVE: PHONE, TABLET, LAPTOP, LARGE SCREENS
     - SMALL ADDITIONS
     - VERSION 1.2 ADDITIONS
     - SELLER GROUPS AND SOURCE LABELS
     - SERVICES CORNER
     - MESSAGES
     - FORUM
     - TRANSACTIONS
   ========================================================================== */

/* ==========================================================================
   RESET
   ========================================================================== */
/* RULE: * { margin: 0 }  (RESET, part 1)
   TARGETS: every element on every page.
   EFFECT: Removes the browser's default outer spacing (margin) from all elements, so spacing in this site comes only from the gap, padding and margin values written in the rules below and in inline style attributes in the JS templates. */
* {
  margin: 0;
}
/* RULE: [hidden] { display: none !important }
   TARGETS: any element that has the HTML attribute hidden. In this project the hidden file input #imp-file ("Import backup" in Staff tools, js/10-staff-storage-boot.js) uses it.
   EFFECT: Forces the element to stay invisible even if another rule sets its display. The !important is what makes it win. */
[hidden] {
  display: none !important;
}

/* RULE: :root { ... }  LIGHT THEME VARIABLES

   VARIABLES (what each color is used for):
     --navy and --navy2: dark blue of the sidebar, the navy pills and the dark banners.

     --ink: main text color.  --muted: grey secondary text.  --line: borders and dividers.  --soft: light blue tint (chips, soft panels, hover areas).
     --green and --green-bg: success text and its background.  --red and --red-bg: error or danger text and its background.
     --warn-bg and --warn-line: yellow notice background and border.
     --side-ink and --side-mute: text colors inside the navy sidebar.

     --f-body: the font stack (Inter first, then system fonts) used by body.
     --shadow: the card shadow.
   TO CHANGE the site colors, edit these values. The dark theme block below must be changed too if you want the same change in dark mode. */

/* Light is the default. Dark mode only turns on when the user picks it (saved in localStorage). Dark uses black, grey and white. */
/* RULE: :root[data-theme="dark"] { ... }  DARK THEME VARIABLES
   TARGETS: the html element only when it carries data-theme="dark" (set by ACT.theme and by the inline script in index.html).
   EFFECT: Replaces the same variable names with dark values (near-black backgrounds, light text, grey lines), so every rule that uses var(--...) changes color without being rewritten. Note that in dark mode --blue becomes a light grey (#e8e8e8) and --blue-ink becomes dark, so blue buttons turn light with dark text. --yellow stays the same. color-scheme: dark makes built-in controls dark. */
:root[data-theme="dark"] {
  --navy: #050505;
  --navy2: #262626;
  --blue: #e8e8e8;
  --blue-ink: #111111;
  --yellow: #f4b63a;

  --bg: #121212;
  --card: #1c1c1c;

/* ==========================================================================
   BASE ELEMENTS
   Default look of body text, links, form controls and headings.
   ========================================================================== */
/* RULE: * { box-sizing: border-box }  (BASE ELEMENTS, part 1)
   TARGETS: every element.
   EFFECT: Width and height include padding and border, so a box with width 100% and padding does not overflow its parent. */
* {
  box-sizing: border-box;
}
/* RULE: html, body { height: auto }
   TARGETS: the html and body elements.
   EFFECT: Lets the page height follow its content. */
html,
body {
  height: auto;
}
/* RULE: body
   TARGETS: the body element, which holds #root and #toast-host (index.html).
   EFFECT: Page background (--bg), text color (--ink), font family (--f-body, Inter), base text size 14px, line height 1.45, no side padding, and smoother font drawing on Mac and iOS (-webkit-font-smoothing). */
body {
  background: var(--bg);
  color: var(--ink);
  font-family: var(--f-body);
  font-size: 14px;
  line-height: 1.45;
  padding-inline: 0;
  -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
}
/* RULE: button, input, select, textarea { font: inherit; color: inherit }
   TARGETS: all buttons and form controls.
   EFFECT: They use the same font and text color as the surrounding text instead of the browser's default control font. This is why buttons look like the rest of the page. */
button,
input,
select,
textarea {
  font: inherit;
  color: inherit;
}
/* RULE: button { cursor: pointer }
   TARGETS: every button. EFFECT: Shows the hand cursor on hover. */
button {
  cursor: pointer;
}
/* RULE: a
   TARGETS: <a> links (the project uses buttons for nearly all clicks, so this rarely applies).
   EFFECT: Link color is --blue and the underline is removed. */
a {
  color: var(--blue);
  text-decoration: none;
}
/* RULE: :focus-visible
   TARGETS: any element that receives keyboard focus (Tab key). EFFECT: A 2px yellow outline with 2px offset and rounded corners, so keyboard users can see where they are. Mouse clicks do not show it. */
:focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid var(--yellow);
  outline-offset: 2px;
  border-radius: 6px;
}
/* RULE: h1, h2, h3, h4, p { margin: 0 }
   TARGETS: headings and paragraphs. EFFECT: Removes their default margins (the browser default would add space above and below). */
h1,
h2,
h3,
h4,
p {
  margin: 0;
}
/* RULE: h1, h2, h3 { text-wrap: balance }
   TARGETS: headings such as the page titles (for example "Campus forum"). EFFECT: When a heading wraps to two lines, the browser balances the line lengths. */
h1,
h2,
h3 {
  text-wrap: balance;
}

/* ==========================================================================
   TEXT AND LAYOUT HELPERS
   Small reusable classes: .row, .stack, .muted, .small and so on.
   ========================================================================== */
/* RULE: .tnum
   TARGETS: elements with class tnum (prices, counts, dates and table numbers throughout the JS templates).
   EFFECT: font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums gives every digit the same width so numbers line up in columns. */
.tnum {
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
}
/* RULE: .muted
   TARGETS: any element with class muted (helper text, captions). EFFECT: grey text color (--muted). */
.muted {
  color: var(--muted);
}
/* RULE: .row  (flexbox layout helper)
   TARGETS: any element with class row. It is used everywhere for a horizontal group, for example button groups, avatar and name pairs, card headers.
   EFFECT: display flex (items side by side), items centered vertically (align-items center), 10px gap between items. Other classes (between, wrap, grow) and inline styles modify it. */
.row {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
}
/* RULE: .between { justify-content: space-between }
   TARGETS: elements with class between, always together with row. EFFECT: pushes the first item to the left edge and the last to the right edge. */
.between {
  justify-content: space-between;
}
/* RULE: .wrap { flex-wrap: wrap }
   TARGETS: elements with class wrap (together with row). EFFECT: items drop to the next line when there is no room, which keeps rows usable on phones. */
.wrap {
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}
/* RULE: .grow { flex: 1; min-width: 0 }
   TARGETS: a child inside a row that should take all remaining width (for example the text part next to an avatar or a button). min-width 0 lets long text shrink and wrap instead of pushing the row wider. */
.grow {
  flex: 1;
  min-width: 0;
}
/* RULE: .stack  (flexbox layout helper)
   TARGETS: any element with class stack (cards and form columns in almost every page template).
   EFFECT: display flex in a column, children stacked top to bottom with 12px gap (inline styles change the gap in some places). */
.stack {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 12px;
}
/* RULE: .eyebrow
   TARGETS: the small uppercase label above page headings, for example "COMMUNITY Â· FORUM", "STAFF Â· TRANSACTIONS", "STUDENT SELLERS".
   EFFECT: 11px bold text, 0.09em letter spacing, uppercase, blue color (--blue). */
.eyebrow {
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.09em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--blue);
}
/* RULE: .small { font-size: 12px }
   TARGETS: secondary text everywhere (descriptions, table text, button labels in lists). */
.small {
  font-size: 12px;
}
/* RULE: .tiny { font-size: 11px }
   TARGETS: the smallest text (dates, hints, counts under names). */
.tiny {
  font-size: 11px;
}
